flashcards.examples: [{"id": "a8769648-2fe7-42ac-9618-b854e0d4ceee", "textEn": "What a pity you couldn't make it to the party.", "textEs": "Qué lástima que no pudiste venir a la fiesta.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "4bb9b321-190b-40a1-8039-27713dfbe855"}, {"id": "98f54d90-29f3-429d-a0e0-0b0ac638fbd7", "textEn": "It's a pity that the weather ruined our picnic.", "textEs": "Es una lástima que el clima arruinara nuestro picnic.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "4bb9b321-190b-40a1-8039-27713dfbe855"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to compare two things, often in casual speech to indicate improvement or preference, like 'This is better than that.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "5ad66fb5-643b-47cb-9e81-dff2c8fbe603", "textEn": "This soup is good, but your mom's is better.", "textEs": "Esta sopa es buena, pero la de tu mamá es mejor.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "47c57758-d81a-403e-a44d-d3a1494e2a50"}, {"id": "55060652-121d-4c4a-b15a-c9fa83d99e2c", "textEn": "I feel much better after taking a nap.", "textEs": "Me siento mucho mejor después de tomar una siesta.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "47c57758-d81a-403e-a44d-d3a1494e2a50"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a term of endearment for a romantic partner or child, or informally to address someone in a friendly or affectionate way.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "c7ab7afa-9286-4a99-b4b3-17d0ba2a5bbc", "textEn": "The baby is crying.", "textEs": "El bebé está llorando.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "f448d09c-da2c-4cf5-a680-2f3ef975fb19"}, {"id": "f908808a-f8da-45ba-b171-b1b66cce09be", "textEn": "She has a new baby.", "textEs": "Ella tiene un bebé nuevo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "f448d09c-da2c-4cf5-a680-2f3ef975fb19"}, {"id": "8208c4e3-f270-4156-b426-45ecd2c8295d", "textEn": "That baby is so cute!", "textEs": "¡Ese bebé es tan lindo!", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "f448d09c-da2c-4cf5-a680-2f3ef975fb19"}]

flashcards.native_speech: meeding
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "10d8e21a-858c-4242-a698-d9956111770c", "textEn": "The team meeting starts at three o'clock.", "textEs": "La reunión del equipo comienza a las tres en punto.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "882134d1-3aea-4870-b79a-db524f534069"}, {"id": "85df61c6-8157-4add-8425-fd2bb749100a", "textEn": "I have an important meeting with my boss today.", "textEs": "Tengo una reunión importante con mi jefe hoy.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "882134d1-3aea-4870-b79a-db524f534069"}, {"id": "acb3fc9a-62d2-419a-8f1d-685b6d36c8a6", "textEn": "I have a meeting with my boss at 3 PM to discuss the project.", "textEs": "Tengo una reunión con mi jefe a las 3 PM para discutir el proyecto.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "882134d1-3aea-4870-b79a-db524f534069"}]

flashcards.native_speech: boddle
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "06fe7c7e-85f8-463f-bb25-3ba820ec1006", "textEn": "Please fill the bottle with cold water.", "textEs": "Por favor, llena la botella con agua fría.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "06fe7a47-99e2-4c05-a70d-9e852542d0e6"}, {"id": "29885f8d-5798-42e6-92a0-9cdd7d5bd1fa", "textEn": "He drank the entire bottle of juice quickly.", "textEs": "Él se bebió toda la botella de jugo rápidamente.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "06fe7a47-99e2-4c05-a70d-9e852542d0e6"}, {"id": "5c6c4263-1cae-4571-a22d-9fc9c7735db6", "textEn": "The bottle of soda fizzed when I opened it.", "textEs": "La botella de soda burbujeó cuando la abrí.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "06fe7a47-99e2-4c05-a70d-9e852542d0e6"}]

flashcards.native_speech: budder
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "ddf82dab-478c-40b4-abc0-8c68f467423f", "textEn": "I spread butter on my toast every morning.", "textEs": "Unto mantequilla en mi tostada cada mañana.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "3b439f7b-c65d-4a11-a415-c0e7cdd358a0"}, {"id": "49a8a057-518a-4abf-b040-790e0c7edbdf", "textEn": "This butter is very soft and creamy.", "textEs": "Esta mantequilla es muy suave y cremosa.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "3b439f7b-c65d-4a11-a415-c0e7cdd358a0"}, {"id": "3e5cea9d-4f1d-4a07-b32d-c9c735ff130a", "textEn": "The cat purrs like butter melting in the sun.", "textEs": "El gato ronronea como mantequilla derritiéndose al sol.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "3b439f7b-c65d-4a11-a415-c0e7cdd358a0"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Commonly used to refer to a naturally raised area of land, often in casual conversation about geography or directions.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "8b185146-3e2c-4cd4-ae1e-8bfdacdb1576", "textEn": "The hill is very steep.", "textEs": "La colina es muy empinada.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "1a666c35-5d03-4cb0-b3e2-68049ef3b44c"}, {"id": "9e42fb98-cdb2-41f9-9d16-ee9fd51722bf", "textEn": "We climbed the hill.", "textEs": "Subimos la colina.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "1a666c35-5d03-4cb0-b3e2-68049ef3b44c"}, {"id": "38398cfa-5cdb-4735-8793-401ad0a1f10e", "textEn": "The kids love rolling down the grassy hill in the park.", "textEs": "A los niños les encanta rodar por la colina cubierta de hierba en el parque.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "1a666c35-5d03-4cb0-b3e2-68049ef3b44c"}]

flashcards.native_speech: liddle
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "97e80a65-2cdb-4c2e-93e6-66046a885245", "textEn": "The little kitten played with a ball of yarn.", "textEs": "El pequeño gatito jugó con una bola de lana.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "36ee5580-9ca5-49aa-a99f-56bfed850a1d"}, {"id": "0c0bc58f-f132-48bc-82a9-3f0a10b5bd9a", "textEn": "She has a little house near the beach.", "textEs": "Ella tiene una pequeña casa cerca de la playa.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "36ee5580-9ca5-49aa-a99f-56bfed850a1d"}, {"id": "647a4688-b150-4dd7-b33e-bc7457e4e82e", "textEn": "I speak a little Spanish, but I'm not fluent yet.", "textEs": "Hablo un poco de español, pero aún no soy fluido.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "36ee5580-9ca5-49aa-a99f-56bfed850a1d"}]

flashcards.native_speech: priddy
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "93cc8601-c7ec-47ff-a0ac-9881b30a7219", "textEn": "That flower is very pretty in the sunlight.", "textEs": "Esa flor es muy bonita bajo la luz del sol.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "57236c72-8010-4d3c-88ac-b312cdd41cd3"}, {"id": "d50902c4-1d2e-4fbd-be1b-6840c68f8e39", "textEn": "She wore a pretty dress to the party last night.", "textEs": "Ella usó un vestido bonito a la fiesta anoche.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "57236c72-8010-4d3c-88ac-b312cdd41cd3"}, {"id": "c7fc146f-b15d-4a63-8560-082cd8e59b87", "textEn": "That's a pretty good idea, actually.", "textEs": "Esa es una idea bastante buena, la verdad.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "57236c72-8010-4d3c-88ac-b312cdd41cd3"}]

flashcards.native_speech: catch up
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "959e860a-823d-4f28-b91b-d70eed6a8c25", "textEn": "Let's grab coffee and catch up this weekend.", "textEs": "Tomemos café y pongámonos al día este fin de semana.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "164b6fb1-adbb-4279-8c3a-cf045fb17f1d"}, {"id": "66de86af-25e8-4e8e-a085-ddcb2d274c0e", "textEn": "I need to catch up on my homework.", "textEs": "Necesito ponerme al día con mi tarea.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "164b6fb1-adbb-4279-8c3a-cf045fb17f1d"}, {"id": "2e124084-ec2a-44d0-acf3-d82b10519d36", "textEn": "I need to catch up on my sleep after staying up late all week.", "textEs": "Necesito ponerme al día con el sueño después de trasnochar toda la semana.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "164b6fb1-adbb-4279-8c3a-cf045fb17f1d"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to specific people or things already mentioned or easily identified, often with a slight emphasis in natural speech.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "16314d6b-be1f-4d43-be39-c034785fddd1", "textEn": "Those shoes are expensive.", "textEs": "Esos zapatos son caros.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "793586af-0f24-49e8-ae9d-c4963b620b23"}, {"id": "5c25c708-5110-4523-bd6d-cf762e0a9b30", "textEn": "I want those apples.", "textEs": "Quiero esas manzanas.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "793586af-0f24-49e8-ae9d-c4963b620b23"}, {"id": "a03fd54f-c7b1-4455-b223-26b322cfc58a", "textEn": "Those are the books I was telling you about.", "textEs": "Esos son los libros de los que te estaba hablando.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "793586af-0f24-49e8-ae9d-c4963b620b23"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally to mean cancel plans or abandon someone or something, often at the last minute.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "ebe70807-f3a8-4757-9b23-9e3536dcd858", "textEn": "I can't believe he bailed on us last minute.", "textEs": "No puedo creer que nos dejara plantados a último minuto.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "908433cb-34de-4dab-a7a1-2e26a9379f90"}, {"id": "0d41e558-6c44-43f3-a485-cad856975929", "textEn": "She bailed on the party because she was tired.", "textEs": "Ella no se presentó a la fiesta porque estaba cansada.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "908433cb-34de-4dab-a7a1-2e26a9379f90"}, {"id": "c1a305f6-e039-4671-b8fc-6f84c8a745c1", "textEn": "I was supposed to go to the party, but I had to bail on it because I wasn't feeling well.", "textEs": "Se suponía que iba a ir a la fiesta, pero tuve que cancelar porque no me sentía bien.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "908433cb-34de-4dab-a7a1-2e26a9379f90"}]

flashcards.native_speech: freak out
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "1ad2ddae-65a5-4556-bcf2-de7b13336d31", "textEn": "Don't freak out, but I lost your keys.", "textEs": "No te asustes, pero perdí tus llaves.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "5c663f12-b25c-450f-aad0-99a0c5503dd3"}, {"id": "6c2903c2-d656-4667-bee2-4c374ff6c958", "textEn": "She freaked out when she saw the spider.", "textEs": "Ella se puso nerviosa cuando vio la araña.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "5c663f12-b25c-450f-aad0-99a0c5503dd3"}, {"id": "9e1063ad-0929-4186-a1c6-8f3a14de837e", "textEn": "I totally freaked out when I saw the spider on my pillow.", "textEs": "Me asusté muchísimo cuando vi la araña en mi almohada.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "5c663f12-b25c-450f-aad0-99a0c5503dd3"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe someone's capability or skill to do something, often in phrases like 'I am able to help' or 'She is able to solve the problem.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "53889dbb-2c45-4394-a8c4-b746c79f0a1f", "textEn": "He is able to run fast.", "textEs": "Él es capaz de correr rápido.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "836e8a68-24d1-43d8-bcc0-b1bdb80c710c"}, {"id": "07e490cb-11fd-4838-b8c2-01a65699e2b7", "textEn": "She is able to solve the problem.", "textEs": "Ella es capaz de resolver el problema.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "836e8a68-24d1-43d8-bcc0-b1bdb80c710c"}, {"id": "0146b629-fa53-4496-b56a-f7db068ecadf", "textEn": "She was finally able to finish the marathon after months of training.", "textEs": "Finalmente pudo terminar la maratón después de meses de entrenamiento.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "836e8a68-24d1-43d8-bcc0-b1bdb80c710c"}]

flashcards.native_speech: yuh guys
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "1e731d3e-7de4-48ba-90d7-09e243be9aac", "textEn": "You guys want some pizza?", "textEs": "¿Ustedes quieren pizza?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "1a4fc7ab-41ad-4684-9cd5-2d2b027fa29c"}, {"id": "0957a74a-99b8-4be5-ac7e-71531a069eb6", "textEn": "I'm so glad you guys are here.", "textEs": "Estoy muy contento de que ustedes estén aquí.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "1a4fc7ab-41ad-4684-9cd5-2d2b027fa29c"}, {"id": "b72cce41-80dd-40b7-bb03-332d18d11031", "textEn": "You guys want to grab lunch together?", "textEs": "¿Ustedes quieren almorzar juntos?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "1a4fc7ab-41ad-4684-9cd5-2d2b027fa29c"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a verb to describe moving through water, often in casual contexts like 'Let's go for a swim' or 'I can swim.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "406749c9-1c2a-477c-a699-5fff4b17efd3", "textEn": "We swim every morning.", "textEs": "Nadamos cada mañana.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "24a1cbeb-3136-46fa-b939-40dad2f9b0e6"}, {"id": "6258109d-b512-48c4-b0fa-15313516c5fd", "textEn": "Can you swim across the lake?", "textEs": "¿Puedes nadar a través del lago?", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "24a1cbeb-3136-46fa-b939-40dad2f9b0e6"}, {"id": "fae8c3a4-6747-4c4e-810f-71534aa3052e", "textEn": "I can hear the fish swim in the river.", "textEs": "Puedo oír a los peces nadar en el río.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "24a1cbeb-3136-46fa-b939-40dad2f9b0e6"}]

flashcards.native_speech: chill out
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "2bbbbb55-bd33-4ceb-9bed-f27cc4266fd2", "textEn": "You need to chill out and stop stressing.", "textEs": "Necesitas relajarte y dejar de estresarte.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "629b7813-46f4-4b08-b95f-ade42d7f47e1"}, {"id": "205feb4c-0629-471f-b103-f1852350a627", "textEn": "We just chilled out at home watching movies.", "textEs": "Solo nos relajamos en casa viendo películas.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "629b7813-46f4-4b08-b95f-ade42d7f47e1"}, {"id": "9c481a1b-975c-4396-be53-8e92d535e81c", "textEn": "You need to chill out and stop worrying about things that haven't happened yet.", "textEs": "Necesitas relajarte y dejar de preocuparte por cosas que todavía no han pasado.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "629b7813-46f4-4b08-b95f-ade42d7f47e1"}]

flashcards.native_speech: zone out
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "dbddc3c7-5157-4027-be77-2d5138ec1542", "textEn": "I zoned out during the lecture.", "textEs": "Me desconecté durante la conferencia.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "957b7163-e3f3-45fc-950a-0c3034bd003a"}, {"id": "49f6b225-3228-4716-b183-c1a7ec41e1b3", "textEn": "He zones out when he's tired.", "textEs": "Él se distrae cuando está cansado.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "957b7163-e3f3-45fc-950a-0c3034bd003a"}, {"id": "987ce0a8-31e5-4847-bfcb-b96f722cc014", "textEn": "I completely zoned out during the lecture and missed the important announcement.", "textEs": "Me desconecté por completo durante la conferencia y me perdí el anuncio importante.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "957b7163-e3f3-45fc-950a-0c3034bd003a"}]

flashcards.native_speech: bɪɡ
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "2f6a3b38-539e-480a-b34b-fb592264c975", "textEn": "That is a big dog.", "textEs": "Ese es un perro grande.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "0eec3830-2159-4c14-8806-af536d0cb600"}, {"id": "f3240dd5-3125-419b-aebe-32cb862b1fc1", "textEn": "She has a big house.", "textEs": "Ella tiene una casa grande.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "0eec3830-2159-4c14-8806-af536d0cb600"}, {"id": "18ed4408-6325-463d-964f-44593cdfee45", "textEn": "The dog is big.", "textEs": "El perro es grande.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "0eec3830-2159-4c14-8806-af536d0cb600"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to indicate that something continues to happen or is ongoing, often with a sense of contrast or persistence.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "1dc7bc5b-dbd5-4d73-90d9-6c84b96f5cd7", "textEn": "The song is old; still, it gives me chills every time Bruce sings it.", "textEs": "La canción es vieja; sin embargo, me da escalofríos cada vez que Bruce la canta.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "e35793f9-92f1-4223-819f-382585e42d7b"}, {"id": "debcbe0b-35f9-492e-af0f-e191fd8eef6c", "textEn": "He's not a fan of rock, but still, he admitted 'Dancing in the Dark' is catchy.", "textEs": "No es fanático del rock, pero sin embargo, admitió que 'Dancing in the Dark' es pegajosa.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "e35793f9-92f1-4223-819f-382585e42d7b"}]

flashcards.native_speech: /bʌʔ ðɛn əˈɡɛn/
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "62ece02f-f782-4d20-8f4f-eca4e8a10b32", "textEn": "I thought the party was over, but then again, Bruce Springsteen came out for an encore.", "textEs": "Pensé que la fiesta había terminado, pero por otro lado, Bruce Springsteen salió a tocar un bis.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "2d6f00e7-61a6-4ad0-9e30-0b51ba7bcc1f"}, {"id": "c679fff5-9d53-45c1-956f-7cf727790d37", "textEn": "She said she was tired, but then again, she danced all night to 'Born to Run'.", "textEs": "Ella dijo que estaba cansada, pero por otro lado, bailó toda la noche con 'Born to Run'.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "2d6f00e7-61a6-4ad0-9e30-0b51ba7bcc1f"}, {"id": "ba62b259-e8e7-4fc8-8ca4-0d006b12157d", "textEn": "It's a long drive, but then again, the concert will be amazing.", "textEs": "Es un viaje largo, pero por otro lado, el concierto será increíble.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "2d6f00e7-61a6-4ad0-9e30-0b51ba7bcc1f"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to introduce a contrast or concession, meaning 'despite that' or 'nevertheless,' often in spoken English to soften a disagreement or acknowledge a point before countering.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "de771d15-f92e-4b16-a3da-a15249a63303", "textEn": "The traffic was terrible; even so, we made it to the stadium in time for 'Thunder Road'.", "textEs": "El tráfico era terrible; aun así, llegamos al estadio a tiempo para 'Thunder Road'.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "fe258842-1be0-447d-8dd3-3d2cad56373b"}, {"id": "7d32a116-4d03-4b53-a45b-d7160963952b", "textEn": "He didn't have a ticket, but even so, he waited outside hoping to hear 'Born in the U.S.A.'", "textEs": "No tenía boleto, pero aun así, esperó afuera con la esperanza de escuchar 'Born in the U.S.A.'.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "fe258842-1be0-447d-8dd3-3d2cad56373b"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to highlight a difference between two things, often at the start of a sentence or clause for emphasis.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "d6c29aab-9059-4a06-a39d-3e2a1a2844b1", "textEn": "Bruce's early songs are raw and angry; in contrast, his later work like 'The Rising' is more reflective.", "textEs": "Las primeras canciones de Bruce son crudas y enojadas; en contraste, su trabajo posterior como 'The Rising' es más reflexivo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "06b37ff3-cbce-40eb-b3cd-591914ed5fc0"}, {"id": "3c3ab5c3-133c-4a37-b771-8a32d40c3962", "textEn": "The band played 'Born to Run' fast; in contrast, 'I'm on Fire' was slow and haunting.", "textEs": "La banda tocó 'Born to Run' rápido; en contraste, 'I'm on Fire' fue lenta y escalofriante.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "06b37ff3-cbce-40eb-b3cd-591914ed5fc0"}, {"id": "d6dad0fd-f071-4364-883b-66930203feb1", "textEn": "In contrast to the sunny weather last week, this week has been rainy and cold.", "textEs": "En contraste con el clima soleado de la semana pasada, esta semana ha sido lluviosa y fría.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "06b37ff3-cbce-40eb-b3cd-591914ed5fc0"}]

flashcards.native_speech: yə bet
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "0734f7ac-ad73-43c4-ba77-7e47f43f1915", "textEn": "Thanks for helping me out. — You bet!", "textEs": "Gracias por ayudarme. — ¡Por supuesto!", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "87415fce-ed01-42f7-9883-d2d4f45f27ba"}, {"id": "fc92e92b-3006-44ac-89e7-1997c623445e", "textEn": "Can I count on you? — You bet you can.", "textEs": "¿Puedo contar contigo? — Claro que sí.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "87415fce-ed01-42f7-9883-d2d4f45f27ba"}, {"id": "36858728-cfc9-47e3-bbf1-79c33ed9ca67", "textEn": "You bet I'll be at the party tonight!", "textEs": "¡Claro que sí, estaré en la fiesta esta noche!", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "87415fce-ed01-42f7-9883-d2d4f45f27ba"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to introduce a contrasting point or concession, often in formal or careful speech, like 'It was difficult; nevertheless, we succeeded.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "16622923-2359-4716-9c93-0d8fb4e53340", "textEn": "The concert was sold out; nevertheless, we found a way to hear 'The River' from outside.", "textEs": "El concierto estaba agotado; no obstante, encontramos la manera de escuchar 'The River' desde afuera.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "0fb5a0dc-532f-4180-93c5-0596d2dac03b"}, {"id": "531030f3-85d1-433e-be04-54053ae35477", "textEn": "It rained all day; nevertheless, the crowd sang 'Hungry Heart' with full energy.", "textEs": "Llovió todo el día; no obstante, la multitud cantó 'Hungry Heart' con toda la energía.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "0fb5a0dc-532f-4180-93c5-0596d2dac03b"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a casual placeholder for an object whose name you can't remember or don't want to specify, like 'Pass me that thingy over there.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "227e9893-0985-4ef5-83fc-27db52dbf1b7", "textEn": "Press the red thingy to start.", "textEs": "Presiona la cosita roja para empezar.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "c469aef1-4ce8-4b20-91b0-6a5a9d45fc18"}, {"id": "b5987678-bd49-41d5-a961-0d9f6bfdd731", "textEn": "I need that thingy for the remote control.", "textEs": "Necesito esa cosa para el control remoto.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "c469aef1-4ce8-4b20-91b0-6a5a9d45fc18"}, {"id": "621c4b1e-7a3b-468d-9ee4-f72bf10522a1", "textEn": "Can you pass me that thingy on the desk?", "textEs": "¿Puedes pasarme ese coso que está en el escritorio?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "c469aef1-4ce8-4b20-91b0-6a5a9d45fc18"}]

flashcards.meaning: la culpa es mía / lo siento
flashcards.native_speech: Used informally to admit a mistake or apologize, often in casual conversation among friends or colleagues.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "dd6fd6b9-9096-4f31-93c9-cf445ae8aeab", "textEn": "You forgot to call me. — My bad, I got busy.", "textEs": "Olvidaste llamarme. — La culpa es mía, me puse ocupado.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "a54e5165-82c8-457c-8bf5-3c49fb43fe45"}, {"id": "b3868822-5245-45ca-891b-316684a01ad3", "textEn": "My bad, I didn't mean to spill that.", "textEs": "Lo siento, no quise derramar eso.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "a54e5165-82c8-457c-8bf5-3c49fb43fe45"}, {"id": "3c8ec73c-733a-4201-bda9-24f0fd8246a0", "textEn": "My bad, I forgot to send you the file yesterday.", "textEs": "La mía, olvidé enviarte el archivo ayer.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "a54e5165-82c8-457c-8bf5-3c49fb43fe45"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to express surprise, agreement, or to ask for confirmation, often in casual conversation.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "16f6d338-17bc-4ad4-af7c-b687b0adf80d", "textEn": "He said he's moving to Japan. — For real?", "textEs": "Dijo que se muda a Japón. — ¿En serio?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "d0115469-8920-45e6-8ea3-10ea856fefc8"}, {"id": "cc637989-a47a-4e96-8201-d549b940cdc9", "textEn": "I'm so tired, for real.", "textEs": "Estoy muy cansado, de verdad.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "d0115469-8920-45e6-8ea3-10ea856fefc8"}, {"id": "8f7accda-d3bf-456a-9c6e-5fee987366bc", "textEn": "Are you for real right now?", "textEs": "¿Estás hablando en serio ahora mismo?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "d0115469-8920-45e6-8ea3-10ea856fefc8"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to express casual agreement or approval, often in response to a suggestion or plan.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "d170bb72-1ef1-45a4-a858-44d19e6b8354", "textEn": "Let's meet at 7. — Sounds good.", "textEs": "Quedamos a las 7. — Suena bien.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "5279b20b-6210-4225-aa31-ea7adefbc376"}, {"id": "028240ce-537c-41f1-9d37-5ebe01a431d0", "textEn": "How about pizza for dinner? — Sounds good to me.", "textEs": "¿Qué tal pizza para cenar? — Me parece bien.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "5279b20b-6210-4225-aa31-ea7adefbc376"}, {"id": "c01a59a5-1d6a-47b7-838d-19d56e6e99a9", "textEn": "That sounds good, let's meet at 7 PM then.", "textEs": "Eso suena bien, entonces nos vemos a las 7 PM.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "5279b20b-6210-4225-aa31-ea7adefbc376"}]

flashcards.native_speech: seɪm hɪr
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "ae712e17-aa58-48e6-9e71-6346a3c2351f", "textEn": "I'm starving. — Same here.", "textEs": "Me muero de hambre. — Igual.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "5c5938e6-72c8-40f5-b7a8-aaba45fcb7ad"}, {"id": "b2346ee1-c620-499d-b62e-56c7dfea9ea8", "textEn": "I love this song. — Same here, it's amazing.", "textEs": "Me encanta esta canción. — A mí también, es increíble.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "5c5938e6-72c8-40f5-b7a8-aaba45fcb7ad"}, {"id": "dd42ea49-5a48-4650-95b7-d0b23b04adb3", "textEn": "I'm really tired today.", "textEs": "Estoy muy cansado hoy.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "5c5938e6-72c8-40f5-b7a8-aaba45fcb7ad"}]

flashcards.meaning: ni me digas / dime a mí
flashcards.native_speech: tɛl mi əbaʊt ɪt
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "19d97944-b377-4999-8629-b19fe5ebbd38", "textEn": "This traffic is insane. — Tell me about it, I've been stuck for an hour.", "textEs": "Este tráfico es una locura. — Ni me digas, llevo una hora atascado.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "d50c9db4-9258-4a48-a9f6-e93240937253"}, {"id": "c7225485-cbd5-411d-8e5b-4111a4f2f487", "textEn": "Work has been so stressful lately. — Tell me about it!", "textEs": "El trabajo ha sido muy estresante últimamente. — ¡Dime a mí!", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "d50c9db4-9258-4a48-a9f6-e93240937253"}, {"id": "0448fbc8-bf34-4d2a-8d79-fe53f314de42", "textEn": "You have to work late again? Tell me about it, I've been stuck here for hours.", "textEs": "¿Tienes que trabajar hasta tarde otra vez? A mí me lo vas a decir, llevo horas atascado aquí.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "d50c9db4-9258-4a48-a9f6-e93240937253"}]

flashcards.meaning: para ser sincero / no voy a mentir
flashcards.native_speech: nɑː gənə laɪ
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "bf8af07c-422f-4828-b3a9-3cf9a6c01246", "textEn": "Not gonna lie, that movie was boring.", "textEs": "Para ser sincero, esa película fue aburrida.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "3614b8a7-50e4-4136-ba05-5ea0d514185b"}, {"id": "deb32b36-6ce2-4262-a64e-dde800ca4b4d", "textEn": "Not gonna lie, I'm really tired today.", "textEs": "No voy a mentir, hoy estoy muy cansado.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "3614b8a7-50e4-4136-ba05-5ea0d514185b"}, {"id": "74a2263f-df84-4a4a-8b69-8e7e2a910396", "textEn": "Not gonna lie, that movie was way better than I expected.", "textEs": "No voy a mentir, esa película fue mucho mejor de lo que esperaba.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "3614b8a7-50e4-4136-ba05-5ea0d514185b"}]

flashcards.native_speech: fɛr ɪnʌf
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "a9acde00-250c-4bc3-974b-bf55e9dad3f6", "textEn": "I don't like coffee, but I get why you do. — Fair enough.", "textEs": "No me gusta el café, pero entiendo por qué a ti sí. — Vale.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "67753b61-363a-483a-a926-2486113e90bd"}, {"id": "a93e9f76-674a-4308-8e5a-383f0700f10a", "textEn": "You want to leave early? Fair enough, you worked hard.", "textEs": "¿Quieres irte temprano? Me parece justo, trabajaste duro.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "67753b61-363a-483a-a926-2486113e90bd"}, {"id": "fc9626fc-91e9-49fd-9c7d-a5a6dd655490", "textEn": "I don't really like sushi, but fair enough, you can order it if you want.", "textEs": "En realidad no me gusta el sushi, pero está bien, puedes pedirlo si quieres.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "67753b61-363a-483a-a926-2486113e90bd"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used casually to downplay a minor issue or mistake, meaning 'it's not a problem' or 'don't worry about it'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "0ff72551-1685-4a27-9b2f-84f7427500d2", "textEn": "Sorry I'm late. — No biggie, we just started.", "textEs": "Perdón por llegar tarde. — No hay problema, acabamos de empezar.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "25eacd09-357c-4077-8892-7b70d50ccd09"}, {"id": "c70b2f6f-3e76-4a06-a3d0-6ad8c5e45625", "textEn": "I forgot to bring the snacks. — No biggie, we have enough.", "textEs": "Olvidé traer los bocadillos. — Sin importancia, tenemos suficiente.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "25eacd09-357c-4077-8892-7b70d50ccd09"}, {"id": "f4781e4e-9f21-4d3c-958d-4c9afa0c67e5", "textEn": "Forgot to bring my notes? No biggie, I remember the main points.", "textEs": "¿Olvidaste traer mis apuntes? No hay problema, recuerdo los puntos principales.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "25eacd09-357c-4077-8892-7b70d50ccd09"}]

flashcards.meaning: claro que sí / ya lo sabes
flashcards.native_speech: Used as an enthusiastic affirmation or agreement, often in casual conversation to mean 'definitely' or 'absolutely'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "c90346c9-055a-4b29-b536-04b13aaf9e59", "textEn": "Are you coming to the party? — You know it!", "textEs": "¿Vienes a la fiesta? — ¡Claro que sí!", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "8068180f-c413-47de-9982-ca3cd97aae8f"}, {"id": "525b2987-3fca-49de-8b7a-a4b9be848801", "textEn": "This is the best burger in town. — You know it, man.", "textEs": "Esta es la mejor hamburguesa de la ciudad. — Ya lo sabes, tío.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "8068180f-c413-47de-9982-ca3cd97aae8f"}, {"id": "30ee9a41-1c03-489b-a83f-877d3df2d83d", "textEn": "That was the best concert ever, you know it!", "textEs": "¡Ese fue el mejor concierto de todos, lo sabes!", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "8068180f-c413-47de-9982-ca3cd97aae8f"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a contraction of 'you all' in informal Southern US and African American Vernacular English to address a group of people.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "31aef2fb-9f8d-45b8-b9c1-3277ef76b558", "textEn": "Y'all coming to the party tonight?", "textEs": "¿Ustedes vienen a la fiesta esta noche?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "7c4bb106-02f6-471a-92bc-c345acc50ad0"}, {"id": "d7b177a2-d2db-49b0-8eb7-c494fe868e35", "textEn": "I told y'all to be quiet.", "textEs": "Les dije a todos que se callaran.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "7c4bb106-02f6-471a-92bc-c345acc50ad0"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a filler or connector in conversation, often to introduce a conclusion, change topic, or emphasize a point.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "7be5a185-5f06-4a4b-9397-840bff26d064", "textEn": "So, what do you want to do now?", "textEs": "Entonces, ¿qué quieres hacer ahora?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "e6dca551-51b9-445b-96b1-cbce6d0887dd"}, {"id": "9560a11e-3271-41ca-ab6d-4634cff0e84f", "textEn": "So, I was thinking about your idea.", "textEs": "O sea, estaba pensando en tu idea.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "e6dca551-51b9-445b-96b1-cbce6d0887dd"}]

flashcards.native_speech: vej-out
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "6bf06ad3-9ec4-47f9-8870-1bd532d5bb3c", "textEn": "I just want to veg out and watch TV.", "textEs": "Solo quiero relajarme y ver la tele.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "ea0d68ab-a214-4ecb-bf17-cf29f20f74fd"}, {"id": "cd78ef9c-f566-463e-9407-bc8b87a929f2", "textEn": "After work, she vegged out on the couch.", "textEs": "Después del trabajo, se relajó en el sofá.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "ea0d68ab-a214-4ecb-bf17-cf29f20f74fd"}, {"id": "33ceb5f5-6dd5-41b3-b0cb-b9cb1daa7966", "textEn": "After a long week at work, I just want to veg out on the couch and watch TV.", "textEs": "Después de una larga semana de trabajo, solo quiero holgazanear en el sofá y ver la televisión.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "ea0d68ab-a214-4ecb-bf17-cf29f20f74fd"}]

flashcards.native_speech: ˈtoʊ.t̬əl.i
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "f4852955-2147-4346-8bff-9f07db5865cb", "textEn": "That's totally awesome!", "textEs": "¡Eso es totalmente increíble!", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "a10e3b7e-f358-4910-aa0c-eac98b41c1cf"}, {"id": "be5af005-afa0-4d90-99e1-b9bbf9bb32b4", "textEn": "I totally forgot about the meeting.", "textEs": "Me olvidé totalmente de la reunión.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "a10e3b7e-f358-4910-aa0c-eac98b41c1cf"}, {"id": "9a3d16c0-cded-4fea-a69b-6631f0ffe5ea", "textEn": "I totally forgot about our meeting this morning.", "textEs": "Me olvidé totalmente de nuestra reunión de esta mañana.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "a10e3b7e-f358-4910-aa0c-eac98b41c1cf"}]

flashcards.native_speech: pig-out
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "0675a096-8006-4885-be16-b86f8d28b87f", "textEn": "We pigged out on pizza last night.", "textEs": "Anoche nos atracamos de pizza.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "499a33bb-1498-4d81-ad4d-ff86b529f73d"}, {"id": "07e61d0c-07e3-49a5-ae36-b11022ca81e8", "textEn": "Don't pig out before the race.", "textEs": "No te atiborres antes de la carrera.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "499a33bb-1498-4d81-ad4d-ff86b529f73d"}, {"id": "87fb64d7-add3-4fb6-9123-c44e5f158532", "textEn": "We pigged out on pizza and ice cream last night.", "textEs": "Anoche nos atiborramos de pizza y helado.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "499a33bb-1498-4d81-ad4d-ff86b529f73d"}]

flashcards.native_speech: doohickey
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "7a27b8b9-9eb5-4eed-bfe7-574693cc0d2f", "textEn": "I can't find the doohickey that goes with this gadget.", "textEs": "No encuentro el artilugio que va con este aparato.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "9bffe8ab-a82a-4280-acc0-cb357d06465c"}, {"id": "85d8ac65-6518-4d27-908b-4ef0f7222177", "textEn": "This doohickey is supposed to make it easier.", "textEs": "Se supone que este cacharro lo hace más fácil.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "9bffe8ab-a82a-4280-acc0-cb357d06465c"}, {"id": "a0d1606b-dea4-40e9-acc9-7d2a28210f6d", "textEn": "Can you hand me that doohickey on the workbench?", "textEs": "¿Puedes pasarme ese chisme que está en el banco de trabajo?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "9bffe8ab-a82a-4280-acc0-cb357d06465c"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in everyday speech for a cloth for drying, often with a slight reduction of the second syllable in fast speech.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "2b13c9c8-cd8d-40de-a506-f64cebbd05b4", "textEn": "Please hand me a towel.", "textEs": "Por favor, pásame una toalla.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "022611e8-fa0c-42bd-9d6d-980201899897"}, {"id": "cea26070-243c-4bc6-a3d3-9cba1bda77b9", "textEn": "The towel is wet.", "textEs": "La toalla está mojada.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "022611e8-fa0c-42bd-9d6d-980201899897"}, {"id": "776e251b-056d-4adf-9fad-3dc99f35c10b", "textEn": "Could you toss me a towel? I'm dripping all over the floor.", "textEs": "¿Podrías pasarme una toalla? Estoy goteando por todo el suelo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "022611e8-fa0c-42bd-9d6d-980201899897"}]

flashcards.native_speech: crack-up
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "a2112f79-db1f-4d1b-b3f4-01aecbf4f9c2", "textEn": "His joke made everyone crack up.", "textEs": "Su broma hizo que todos se rieran a carcajadas.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "71d37bdf-6a69-4401-82d8-18beb40adcb1"}, {"id": "75ca3e74-cdd8-4e61-a2a6-e98e80139956", "textEn": "I cracked up when I saw the video.", "textEs": "Me partí de risa cuando vi el video.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "71d37bdf-6a69-4401-82d8-18beb40adcb1"}, {"id": "1fe3a5e3-1505-4d2b-960e-5f25c0c83f7d", "textEn": "I didn't mean to crack up during the meeting, but his joke was just too funny.", "textEs": "No fue mi intención descojonarme durante la reunión, pero su chiste fue demasiado gracioso.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "71d37bdf-6a69-4401-82d8-18beb40adcb1"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally to mean losing focus or daydreaming, often said when someone is not paying attention.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "0ab2de31-1981-4f21-809a-1625a89b8d2b", "textEn": "I spaced out during the lecture.", "textEs": "Me quedé en blanco durante la clase.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "aafeda2b-0ac5-41df-90d2-9e6f5edead45"}, {"id": "5be31b1b-dd8c-43b7-a81b-f305a81e6aba", "textEn": "Don't space out while driving.", "textEs": "No te distraigas mientras conduces.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "aafeda2b-0ac5-41df-90d2-9e6f5edead45"}, {"id": "cfdddde8-bea9-4ff5-91c9-25f6762d8b4b", "textEn": "I totally spaced out during the meeting and missed what the boss said.", "textEs": "Me quedé totalmente en blanco durante la reunión y me perdí lo que dijo el jefe.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "aafeda2b-0ac5-41df-90d2-9e6f5edead45"}]

flashcards.native_speech: flake-on
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "967a3544-01aa-41f4-8ecb-1e326083a069", "textEn": "He flaked on me again last night.", "textEs": "Me dejó plantado otra vez anoche.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "6a06ea91-bfae-41cb-a797-a102b954fd79"}, {"id": "c725b974-f846-406d-8c7e-adf5b81244cb", "textEn": "Don't flake on our meeting tomorrow.", "textEs": "No me dejes plantado en nuestra reunión mañana.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "6a06ea91-bfae-41cb-a797-a102b954fd79"}, {"id": "0cd29856-6506-417c-b140-c1bd65e7aa5a", "textEn": "I can't believe she flaked on me again after I drove all the way here.", "textEs": "No puedo creer que me haya dejado plantado otra vez después de que conduje hasta aquí.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "6a06ea91-bfae-41cb-a797-a102b954fd79"}]

flashcards.meaning: emocionarse por algo técnico o friki
flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe enthusiastically indulging in a niche interest or hobby, often with intense focus or excitement.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "56f29f9a-aace-4e40-8ab1-ee61b022e1e2", "textEn": "They geeked out over the new software.", "textEs": "Se emocionaron como frikis con el nuevo software.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "b9669f69-6a03-457f-9277-180f9dc0318b"}, {"id": "48d2c7eb-27d1-4fee-823d-22527fce69a4", "textEn": "I geek out whenever I talk about space.", "textEs": "Me vuelvo loco cada vez que hablo del espacio.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "b9669f69-6a03-457f-9277-180f9dc0318b"}, {"id": "f8818a0b-ed3f-4921-89b3-314e71d86842", "textEn": "I could geek out about Star Wars for hours if you let me.", "textEs": "Podría entusiasmarme hablando de Star Wars durante horas si me dejas.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "b9669f69-6a03-457f-9277-180f9dc0318b"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally to refer to a small object or gadget when its name is unknown or forgotten, like 'hand me that doodad over there'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "d75d1efe-9961-4d7f-b3db-60faef47ac97", "textEn": "She has a bunch of doodads on her shelf.", "textEs": "Tiene un montón de chucherías en su estante.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "6c61e761-784a-4505-b31a-49681427dbd8"}, {"id": "0bdb74cf-aed5-48bd-b08d-8a7ab16be476", "textEn": "This doodad is just for decoration.", "textEs": "Este adorno es solo para decoración.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "6c61e761-784a-4505-b31a-49681427dbd8"}, {"id": "79bd4e47-397b-47c5-a3da-f96ae52eae75", "textEn": "Hand me that red doodad on the table, please.", "textEs": "Pásame ese chisme rojo que está en la mesa, por favor.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "6c61e761-784a-4505-b31a-49681427dbd8"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to correct or clarify a point, often with a slight pause before it, or to introduce a surprising fact in casual conversation.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "f57eb7c0-dbb4-4432-b52c-36eff39bc746", "textEn": "Actually, I don't have any plans for tonight.", "textEs": "En realidad, no tengo planes para esta noche.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "4f64ba4b-abc9-4f4a-8b13-676cd622b04f"}, {"id": "c680270a-30d3-46d4-a6c6-076f9c253eba", "textEn": "Actually, that's not what I meant.", "textEs": "De hecho, eso no es lo que quise decir.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "4f64ba4b-abc9-4f4a-8b13-676cd622b04f"}]

flashcards.native_speech: ˈbeɪ.sɪ.kli
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "66b98ae8-5f64-4777-bbcb-65e553c67ddb", "textEn": "Basically, we need to finish this by Friday.", "textEs": "Básicamente, necesitamos terminar esto para el viernes.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "7c6e53b1-a9f2-4667-911f-c5668e80a477"}, {"id": "8d7f02c2-1a3e-40f2-986c-ede9d67b3eda", "textEn": "It's basically a new version of the old app.", "textEs": "Es básicamente una nueva versión de la aplicación antigua.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "7c6e53b1-a9f2-4667-911f-c5668e80a477"}, {"id": "4b226ac9-5520-4106-9d62-6245846d3d65", "textEn": "Basically, we need to finish this project by Friday.", "textEs": "Básicamente, necesitamos terminar este proyecto para el viernes.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "7c6e53b1-a9f2-4667-911f-c5668e80a477"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe a soft, wavering light or reflection, often in poetic or descriptive contexts.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "acd86f32-1293-4766-a8e2-e14187b4c3e8", "textEn": "The lake's surface began to shimmer in the moonlight.", "textEs": "La superficie del lago comenzó a brillar con la luz de la luna.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "ca29a44e-dd20-4d6b-b802-5658f3e195a1"}, {"id": "3e8552ea-f8c5-4890-9094-0da79d442f24", "textEn": "Her dress had a shimmer that caught everyone's attention.", "textEs": "Su vestido tenía un brillo que captó la atención de todos.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "ca29a44e-dd20-4d6b-b802-5658f3e195a1"}, {"id": "62422a5c-9c0b-4171-ad66-41715851ca7e", "textEn": "The leaves shimmered in the afternoon sunlight.", "textEs": "Las hojas brillaban bajo la luz de la tarde.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "ca29a44e-dd20-4d6b-b802-5658f3e195a1"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally to mean making a mistake or failing at something, often with a sense of frustration or self-blame.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "37ea3c94-928e-41e5-9deb-e6747b1444bc", "textEn": "I really screwed up the presentation.", "textEs": "De verdad arruiné la presentación.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "d130fedd-7bd6-4219-aa5d-d22d90203fc8"}, {"id": "62286fc0-8b7f-48be-b3be-05fa18b0912d", "textEn": "Don't screw up this opportunity.", "textEs": "No estropees esta oportunidad.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "d130fedd-7bd6-4219-aa5d-d22d90203fc8"}, {"id": "afaa1996-3ffc-4970-af45-cd463b3ed019", "textEn": "I really screwed up the presentation by forgetting the key data.", "textEs": "Realmente arruiné la presentación al olvidar los datos clave.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "d130fedd-7bd6-4219-aa5d-d22d90203fc8"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe watching multiple episodes of a TV series in one sitting, often for hours at a time.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "cb321611-aa99-4342-8621-60868f61135e", "textEn": "We binge watched the whole season.", "textEs": "Vimos toda la temporada de golpe.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "40ad38d5-d389-4341-aa35-1e13fc508382"}, {"id": "933970a0-9a51-44f7-bf6b-cb5b30c92221", "textEn": "I binge watched three episodes last night.", "textEs": "Anoche vi tres episodios seguidos.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "40ad38d5-d389-4341-aa35-1e13fc508382"}, {"id": "4e8e930e-4e75-4d14-a996-744672f65a67", "textEn": "I spent the whole weekend binge-watching that new series on Netflix.", "textEs": "Pasé todo el fin de semana viendo en maratón esa nueva serie de Netflix.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "40ad38d5-d389-4341-aa35-1e13fc508382"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally to describe someone deciding not to do something because they are scared, often at the last moment.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "0a6dd170-b7f2-4130-90b9-11314391e22e", "textEn": "He chickened out of the bungee jump.", "textEs": "Se acobardó y no hizo el puenting.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "fde9dc7f-4f3f-4ddc-bc34-d8e5f680e5ea"}, {"id": "f6e38842-7c33-4ce4-ac5e-f9b784624f36", "textEn": "Don't chicken out now, you can do it.", "textEs": "No te acobardes ahora, tú puedes.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "fde9dc7f-4f3f-4ddc-bc34-d8e5f680e5ea"}, {"id": "334cd09c-2fa2-4f9c-8419-5b9beb1809f4", "textEn": "I was going to ask her out, but I chickened out at the last minute.", "textEs": "Iba a invitarla a salir, pero me acobardé en el último momento.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "fde9dc7f-4f3f-4ddc-bc34-d8e5f680e5ea"}]

flashcards.native_speech: bʊk
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "a0349613-e17e-4538-8f1c-6648b3138f9a", "textEn": "I read a book every night.", "textEs": "Leo un libro cada noche.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "2b7ca3ac-5e42-4559-ba76-211984efc315"}, {"id": "0d4b0b24-8a17-4346-96fa-c601642fb20c", "textEn": "This book is interesting.", "textEs": "Este libro es interesante.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "2b7ca3ac-5e42-4559-ba76-211984efc315"}, {"id": "d8dd83f7-d047-42af-81c0-7846b7e711da", "textEn": "The restaurant is fully booked for tonight.", "textEs": "El restaurante está completamente reservado para esta noche.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "2b7ca3ac-5e42-4559-ba76-211984efc315"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe casual, aimless activity or playful behavior, often with a sense of wasting time or not being serious.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "e21a9cdf-cbdb-4840-a6ae-d71fbce8bb5c", "textEn": "Stop messing around and get to work.", "textEs": "Deja de tontear y ponte a trabajar.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "ad949274-190c-44e7-bbb7-99734478e53e"}, {"id": "ae2cb38b-bc20-451e-aef4-5c4bfd3b5f14", "textEn": "We just messed around at the park.", "textEs": "Solo estuvimos perdiendo el tiempo en el parque.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "ad949274-190c-44e7-bbb7-99734478e53e"}, {"id": "673f4007-3ede-4828-a9b9-75670ca5792a", "textEn": "Stop messing around and finish your homework.", "textEs": "Deja de perder el tiempo y termina tu tarea.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "ad949274-190c-44e7-bbb7-99734478e53e"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a filler word or hedge in casual conversation, often to soften statements or indicate approximation, e.g., 'It was, like, really big.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "df88bcae-bfc3-4127-a85b-99bac140d28f", "textEn": "I was, like, totally shocked when I heard the news.", "textEs": "Estaba, como, totalmente impactado cuando escuché la noticia.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "4f22cf81-0af4-4a5c-a3df-8b4467ff7f95"}, {"id": "3f1cec07-f645-44e2-a877-4d6dbae87f2f", "textEn": "He's, like, the nicest person ever.", "textEs": "Él es, tipo, la persona más amable del mundo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "4f22cf81-0af4-4a5c-a3df-8b4467ff7f95"}, {"id": "aa60bcb1-665e-40c4-83f5-71be51154e26", "textEn": "Like, I was so tired I couldn't even think straight.", "textEs": "Como, estaba tan cansado que ni siquiera podía pensar con claridad.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "4f22cf81-0af4-4a5c-a3df-8b4467ff7f95"}]

flashcards.native_speech: wɛl
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "cb632074-1645-4cb3-9877-06ac7c1395e6", "textEn": "Well, I guess we could try that.", "textEs": "Bueno, supongo que podríamos intentar eso.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "708baea5-4021-4083-9437-ed1cd289bb5e"}, {"id": "8d534d83-bb2f-473b-947f-f1f80208f6af", "textEn": "Well, it's not that simple.", "textEs": "Pues, no es tan sencillo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "708baea5-4021-4083-9437-ed1cd289bb5e"}, {"id": "b5dc8795-02ea-4234-9839-eb21d1af9881", "textEn": "Well, I guess we'll have to try a different approach.", "textEs": "Bueno, supongo que tendremos que probar un enfoque diferente.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "708baea5-4021-4083-9437-ed1cd289bb5e"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally when you can't remember or don't know the name of an object, like 'hand me that thingamabob over there.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "a4149cc2-0c04-4da8-b5e5-7653702d176a", "textEn": "Can you grab the thingamabob from the toolbox?", "textEs": "¿Puedes agarrar el coso de la caja de herramientas?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "aae49a68-64be-4ed4-b7a8-6fe2165aa7e3"}, {"id": "80c0624f-e2f7-42e5-b932-9e64c94f315f", "textEn": "I need a thingamabob to fix this leak.", "textEs": "Necesito un chisme para arreglar esta fuga.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "aae49a68-64be-4ed4-b7a8-6fe2165aa7e3"}, {"id": "7a386705-ff3d-4f3a-8f4c-15d9b7cc7160", "textEn": "Could you pass me that thingamabob on the table?", "textEs": "¿Podrías pasarme ese coso que está en la mesa?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "aae49a68-64be-4ed4-b7a8-6fe2165aa7e3"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something low in price or of poor quality, often in casual shopping or criticism.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "b80c5a49-11eb-46ec-9744-170c2d37fa5a", "textEn": "This jacket was very cheap.", "textEs": "Esta chaqueta fue muy barata.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "31559e38-c5dc-4a94-83c9-e0b676f186a7"}, {"id": "19bfaec6-ce62-4e13-96f7-41fa171fbcdd", "textEn": "I found a cheap flight to Madrid.", "textEs": "Encontré un vuelo barato a Madrid.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "31559e38-c5dc-4a94-83c9-e0b676f186a7"}, {"id": "b4675147-085b-48c0-b912-220ccc631a11", "textEn": "This watch looks cheap, but it actually keeps perfect time.", "textEs": "Este reloj parece barato, pero en realidad mantiene la hora perfectamente.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "31559e38-c5dc-4a94-83c9-e0b676f186a7"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to confirm understanding, agree, or indicate correctness; often drawn out as 'riiiight' for sarcasm or hesitation.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "275094b2-4d54-4850-bbde-4a6e7683643b", "textEn": "You're coming to the party, right?", "textEs": "Vienes a la fiesta, ¿verdad?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "6f34ef0f-e91c-4ce6-9421-e4fb4b067323"}, {"id": "aa0e340c-8e89-403c-9d4d-167371688970", "textEn": "That's the way it works, right?", "textEs": "Así funciona, ¿no?", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "6f34ef0f-e91c-4ce6-9421-e4fb4b067323"}, {"id": "4d191d13-08ae-4465-b1bb-eaaf2e5a014a", "textEn": "Right, I see what you mean now.", "textEs": "Claro, ahora entiendo lo que quieres decir.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "6f34ef0f-e91c-4ce6-9421-e4fb4b067323"}]

flashcards.native_speech: ˈɛn.i.weɪ
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "6e70633f-281f-4ea1-9cd4-1313c63e184a", "textEn": "Anyway, let's get back to the topic.", "textEs": "Como sea, volvamos al tema.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "4b1beacc-dd95-4ced-999f-236664ddd1d6"}, {"id": "39da3102-3e7a-47ec-bfac-d7f44140a1b4", "textEn": "Anyway, I'll see you tomorrow.", "textEs": "En fin, te veo mañana.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "4b1beacc-dd95-4ced-999f-236664ddd1d6"}, {"id": "e8eb68ea-73e3-4210-80f6-6b91c861da99", "textEn": "I know you don't agree, but anyway, let's move on.", "textEs": "Sé que no estás de acuerdo, pero de todas formas, sigamos adelante.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "4b1beacc-dd95-4ced-999f-236664ddd1d6"}]

flashcards.native_speech: sɔːrt əv
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "0267312d-d8b1-4fff-8c59-4de79ef5d2eb", "textEn": "I sort of understand what you mean.", "textEs": "Como que entiendo lo que quieres decir.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "941f4906-39e8-4e65-ac27-e7b58c71c876"}, {"id": "d19ec247-650d-4642-9b49-c124a780331d", "textEn": "It's sort of complicated to explain.", "textEs": "Es más o menos complicado de explicar.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "941f4906-39e8-4e65-ac27-e7b58c71c876"}, {"id": "c8248385-c375-494d-95fa-1e3b0ce87fed", "textEn": "I sort of like the idea, but I'm not completely sure.", "textEs": "Más o menos me gusta la idea, pero no estoy completamente seguro.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "941f4906-39e8-4e65-ac27-e7b58c71c876"}]

flashcards.native_speech: ˈɒn.ɪst.li
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "0706ca92-d1a1-493e-ba9c-813d5d4cb93c", "textEn": "Honestly, I didn't expect that to happen.", "textEs": "Honestamente, no esperaba que eso pasara.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "32c949d9-24f1-4171-bf87-6a5e7a259866"}, {"id": "004d636b-e66f-4ea0-b291-996c60084ac3", "textEn": "Honestly, I think you're overreacting.", "textEs": "La verdad, creo que estás exagerando.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "32c949d9-24f1-4171-bf87-6a5e7a259866"}, {"id": "6eaed40e-2c82-4eba-8a5b-fbcc6e342c24", "textEn": "Honestly, I never liked that movie as much as everyone else did.", "textEs": "Honestamente, nunca me gustó esa película tanto como a los demás.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "32c949d9-24f1-4171-bf87-6a5e7a259866"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in business or tech contexts to refer to a generic or unspecified product, component, or device.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "35877258-e7e5-4f93-b055-260f78aa2c3a", "textEn": "This widget makes the machine work better.", "textEs": "Este artefacto hace que la máquina funcione mejor.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "fd4ba33e-1558-4571-bc9e-ee97916e7b7b"}, {"id": "ab01a5e5-1f1a-4d14-8322-d5b94a479878", "textEn": "I lost the widget for the blender.", "textEs": "Perdí el coso de la licuadora.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "fd4ba33e-1558-4571-bc9e-ee97916e7b7b"}, {"id": "7ca5c97c-ae8f-478c-aea1-8e045e6b589a", "textEn": "Let me check the widget on the dashboard to see our sales numbers.", "textEs": "Déjame revisar el widget en el panel para ver nuestras cifras de ventas.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "fd4ba33e-1558-4571-bc9e-ee97916e7b7b"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally in British English to address a group of people, similar to 'you guys' or 'y'all' in other dialects.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "962ef36a-5427-40a3-a1e2-4edda8c5ecb4", "textEn": "What are you lot up to?", "textEs": "¿Qué están tramando ustedes?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "aa7d4579-1ea1-4534-98d8-de72042fdd5d"}, {"id": "b0a47304-0e3a-4cec-81e0-4092473a27db", "textEn": "You lot need to hurry up.", "textEs": "Ustedes necesitan apurarse.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "aa7d4579-1ea1-4534-98d8-de72042fdd5d"}, {"id": "a545534b-9bbf-4dfa-987e-82343674964f", "textEn": "You lot need to stop messing about and get on with your work.", "textEs": "Ustedes necesitan dejar de perder el tiempo y ponerse a trabajar.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "aa7d4579-1ea1-4534-98d8-de72042fdd5d"}]

flashcards.native_speech: jazz
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "950cde14-e35e-4b1f-b44d-3ed5a03cd335", "textEn": "I don't have time for all that jazz.", "textEs": "No tengo tiempo para todas esas cosas.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "4326fa9b-1e6c-4361-bfff-87e88bf9de13"}, {"id": "6039c458-f19a-41ce-94c9-5a9fc2c3a4b3", "textEn": "He's always talking about politics and all that jazz.", "textEs": "Siempre está hablando de política y todo ese rollo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "4326fa9b-1e6c-4361-bfff-87e88bf9de13"}, {"id": "00904807-bb15-437d-bab4-9a5eda3ee2b8", "textEn": "Let's stop all this jazz and get down to business.", "textEs": "Dejemos toda esta tontería y pongámonos a trabajar.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "4326fa9b-1e6c-4361-bfff-87e88bf9de13"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally to refer to a small, often electronic device or gadget, especially when its exact name is unknown or unimportant.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "f417155f-99d4-4702-a0ad-6b367e82a91f", "textEn": "He loves buying new gizmos for his computer.", "textEs": "Le encanta comprar chismes nuevos para su computadora.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "6d239f87-f00c-4111-ab33-9d56deae914c"}, {"id": "48d1fa99-5551-4ac0-9e4c-43bf27cad71f", "textEn": "What's that gizmo on your desk?", "textEs": "¿Qué es ese aparato en tu escritorio?", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "6d239f87-f00c-4111-ab33-9d56deae914c"}, {"id": "1f3e79e9-7645-447c-8bc3-dab4854168f6", "textEn": "I picked up a handy little gizmo at the hardware store that opens jars automatically.", "textEs": "Compré un pequeño artilugio útil en la ferretería que abre frascos automáticamente.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "6d239f87-f00c-4111-ab33-9d56deae914c"}]

flashcards.native_speech: watchamakallit
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "1c8abab6-c05a-49a0-804b-8438a667bac5", "textEn": "Can you pass me the whatchamacallit on the table?", "textEs": "¿Me pasas el coso que está en la mesa?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "03b00375-2b9f-4253-9e1d-24f722f32d1d"}, {"id": "b9435c79-a969-4231-920c-157603dd740d", "textEn": "I need to fix the whatchamacallit in the car.", "textEs": "Necesito arreglar el como se llame del coche.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "03b00375-2b9f-4253-9e1d-24f722f32d1d"}, {"id": "1d1dd6f4-87ff-4334-9aed-308a257c7be3", "textEn": "Can you hand me that whatchamacallit on the shelf?", "textEs": "¿Puedes pasarme ese coso que está en el estante?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "03b00375-2b9f-4253-9e1d-24f722f32d1d"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally in casual conversation as a contraction of 'kind of', often to soften statements or express approximation.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "db864dc4-fab1-47dd-8942-17a6cde113c2", "textEn": "I'm kinda tired after work.", "textEs": "Estoy un poco cansado después del trabajo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "b2114691-5a2f-4c52-b79c-2e97a229704a"}, {"id": "01030f67-544c-4415-8055-b3e00ee8c837", "textEn": "That's kinda weird, don't you think?", "textEs": "Eso es algo raro, ¿no crees?", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "b2114691-5a2f-4c52-b79c-2e97a229704a"}, {"id": "34e06767-e1b5-4d8a-971b-c649077a6415", "textEn": "I'm kinda tired after the long walk.", "textEs": "Estoy un poco cansado después de la larga caminata.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "b2114691-5a2f-4c52-b79c-2e97a229704a"}]

flashcards.native_speech: thingamajig
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "b7d080c2-a35c-4bba-9b1d-6b54d47d8cdf", "textEn": "Where's that thingamajig for opening bottles?", "textEs": "¿Dónde está ese chisme para abrir botellas?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "df9e83ac-0d6d-4d2d-a791-66e2be700966"}, {"id": "b754468e-944d-450e-845c-42e89632cc82", "textEn": "She bought a new thingamajig for the kitchen.", "textEs": "Compró un coso nuevo para la cocina.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "df9e83ac-0d6d-4d2d-a791-66e2be700966"}, {"id": "34e890b2-57ad-4e23-a431-e6c7578e2fb4", "textEn": "Could you hand me that thingamajig on the table?", "textEs": "¿Podrías pasarme ese coso que está en la mesa?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "df9e83ac-0d6d-4d2d-a791-66e2be700966"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a noun for a condition or political entity, or as a verb meaning to express something clearly; common in formal and everyday contexts.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "03832c55-ab40-4a8a-b6a9-6d5a7ed94c2b", "textEn": "The state of the house was terrible.", "textEs": "El estado de la casa era terrible.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "a195f1bb-ed8b-4ede-9824-526ba9ad8714"}, {"id": "d03cf8d1-9f96-4b77-9918-475f8a4c76dc", "textEn": "He stated his opinion clearly.", "textEs": "Él declaró su opinión claramente.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "a195f1bb-ed8b-4ede-9824-526ba9ad8714"}, {"id": "2848e5e4-2702-4a38-838f-6ad27288753c", "textEn": "The state of the economy is a major concern for voters.", "textEs": "El estado de la economía es una gran preocupación para los votantes.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "a195f1bb-ed8b-4ede-9824-526ba9ad8714"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally as a placeholder for something whose name you can't remember or don't know, like 'hand me that whatsit on the table'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "eeb15601-8d78-4f25-aec6-0d81c7f255f3", "textEn": "Hand me the whatsit from the drawer.", "textEs": "Pásame el como se llame del cajón.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "d843d46d-c085-4343-9ac6-eb8637cd3b62"}, {"id": "3ea99776-d6c8-4f87-90b8-806d6acc3b37", "textEn": "I forgot the name of the whatsit we used yesterday.", "textEs": "Olvidé el nombre del como se llame que usamos ayer.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "d843d46d-c085-4343-9ac6-eb8637cd3b62"}, {"id": "3fed2b29-45cb-491c-9d70-52d423e9f3a1", "textEn": "I can't find the whatsit that goes with this gadget.", "textEs": "No encuentro el coso que va con este aparato.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "d843d46d-c085-4343-9ac6-eb8637cd3b62"}]

flashcards.native_speech: evrywun
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "f8a7660b-c18c-4664-9617-aca3b2c51967", "textEn": "Everyone, listen up!", "textEs": "¡Todos, escuchen!", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "211502fe-2a72-4f3a-a85c-3204d057f156"}, {"id": "aa8c201f-4884-47a0-a2dc-069b46f3df60", "textEn": "Is everyone ready to go?", "textEs": "¿Todos están listos para irnos?", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "211502fe-2a72-4f3a-a85c-3204d057f156"}, {"id": "ebede59b-53d6-4a18-90de-8445b286314b", "textEn": "Everyone makes mistakes sometimes.", "textEs": "Todo el mundo comete errores a veces.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "211502fe-2a72-4f3a-a85c-3204d057f156"}]

flashcards.native_speech: yoo all
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "00f38250-6b07-433c-9a94-ba5d236bdbc3", "textEn": "You all did a great job.", "textEs": "Todos hicieron un gran trabajo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "04857b89-4cb0-4986-b492-fe51856db5cd"}, {"id": "50e67bd0-f2f5-4191-9acc-afa3e16e0729", "textEn": "I appreciate you all coming.", "textEs": "Aprecio que todos hayan venido.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "04857b89-4cb0-4986-b492-fe51856db5cd"}, {"id": "2b5a23c4-a0e6-4c8e-b326-46c441cf1a34", "textEn": "Are you all coming to the party tonight?", "textEs": "¿Todos ustedes vienen a la fiesta esta noche?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "04857b89-4cb0-4986-b492-fe51856db5cd"}]

flashcards.native_speech: null
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "7759009b-d2f2-436e-8f32-79327611859a", "textEn": "The judge entered the courtroom.", "textEs": "El juez entró a la sala del tribunal.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "2bcbecdf-b172-4147-95e8-6f08feb74101"}, {"id": "00924408-2c81-46d8-8c2b-8522a6be9749", "textEn": "Don't judge a book by its cover.", "textEs": "No juzgues un libro por su portada.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "2bcbecdf-b172-4147-95e8-6f08feb74101"}, {"id": "ffa0f368-e612-4e4e-8b59-7f2c52b1ee0f", "textEn": "I don't want to judge her, but she's been acting really strange lately.", "textEs": "No quiero juzgarla, pero ha estado actuando de manera muy extraña últimamente.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "2bcbecdf-b172-4147-95e8-6f08feb74101"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a noun for a large vehicle that carries passengers, often in phrases like 'take the bus' or 'bus stop'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "f42ba7e2-2634-4b07-b7bb-6fe5c1290194", "textEn": "We take the bus to school.", "textEs": "Tomamos el autobús a la escuela.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "56cf141d-dc25-47b4-be6c-b2635f76b7cb"}, {"id": "1fa774d6-cbdd-4f11-b2ab-323ff28df8de", "textEn": "The bus is late.", "textEs": "El autobús está retrasado.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "56cf141d-dc25-47b4-be6c-b2635f76b7cb"}, {"id": "303d5c1b-b406-4c52-a2da-9f6cf6481a8d", "textEn": "I missed the bus this morning, so I was late for work.", "textEs": "Perdí el autobús esta mañana, así que llegué tarde al trabajo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "56cf141d-dc25-47b4-be6c-b2635f76b7cb"}]

flashcards.native_speech: subsikwentli
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "2e55514f-55bb-4255-b693-11aa74d5e4e1", "textEn": "We finished the first task; subsequently, we moved on to the next one.", "textEs": "Terminamos la primera tarea; posteriormente, pasamos a la siguiente.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "6ac27d70-a068-4e1d-ad44-32615572bbb4"}, {"id": "03c46938-4797-457d-bef8-f8e260ae788f", "textEn": "She missed the bus; subsequently, she had to walk to work.", "textEs": "Ella perdió el autobús; posteriormente, tuvo que caminar al trabajo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "6ac27d70-a068-4e1d-ad44-32615572bbb4"}, {"id": "16831bc6-dc5b-4364-9a11-46738315b712", "textEn": "The company launched a new product in 2020 and subsequently saw a significant increase in sales.", "textEs": "La empresa lanzó un nuevo producto en 2020 y posteriormente experimentó un aumento significativo en las ventas.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "6ac27d70-a068-4e1d-ad44-32615572bbb4"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to indicate the final result or most important point after considering everything, often in conclusions or summaries.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "42003c30-45de-4d56-bea8-d555279ba78f", "textEn": "We tried several approaches; ultimately, we found a solution.", "textEs": "Probamos varios enfoques; finalmente, encontramos una solución.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "6c99237a-ef34-4aae-b2e4-2c176c06890f"}, {"id": "19b91ef5-fc42-4487-9673-0ffde3bc31f1", "textEn": "Ultimately, the decision rests with the manager.", "textEs": "Finalmente, la decisión recae en el gerente.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "6c99237a-ef34-4aae-b2e4-2c176c06890f"}, {"id": "4c656fda-cc36-4542-9919-579e3947b16f", "textEn": "Ultimately, the decision rests with the board of directors.", "textEs": "En última instancia, la decisión recae en la junta directiva.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "6c99237a-ef34-4aae-b2e4-2c176c06890f"}]

flashcards.native_speech: foll-oh-ing
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "3f42a77b-70eb-4817-b375-0bff5c7b7bca", "textEn": "Following the announcement, everyone cheered.", "textEs": "Después del anuncio, todos aplaudieron.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "d6b2a7f0-28b6-493c-9de9-aa6980f01b54"}, {"id": "b8ad765a-08b5-4cec-b488-b7dbde05f3fb", "textEn": "Following dinner, we went for a walk.", "textEs": "Después de la cena, salimos a caminar.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "d6b2a7f0-28b6-493c-9de9-aa6980f01b54"}, {"id": "e969a5bd-96ea-4fcd-a1e6-8344a4ee8d2f", "textEn": "Following the meeting, we will send out a summary to all attendees.", "textEs": "Después de la reunión, enviaremos un resumen a todos los asistentes.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "d6b2a7f0-28b6-493c-9de9-aa6980f01b54"}]

flashcards.native_speech: dheh-raft-er
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "ab96b078-c6f1-4cf9-a2c6-f02d669fc12e", "textEn": "He graduated in 2020; thereafter, he started his own business.", "textEs": "Se graduó en 2020; a partir de entonces, comenzó su propio negocio.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "0f398a60-2525-43b5-bc0b-94de50a42e85"}, {"id": "fe9b978d-7aeb-410a-a1a8-f409f7c080d4", "textEn": "The storm passed; thereafter, the sun came out.", "textEs": "La tormenta pasó; a partir de entonces, salió el sol.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "0f398a60-2525-43b5-bc0b-94de50a42e85"}, {"id": "113c7480-4210-489f-bd7a-d00ba9e02b65", "textEn": "He graduated in 2020 and thereafter moved to New York for work.", "textEs": "Se graduó en 2020 y posteriormente se mudó a Nueva York por trabajo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "0f398a60-2525-43b5-bc0b-94de50a42e85"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe the color of the sky or ocean, or to express sadness, as in 'I feel blue.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "81bc51be-afb9-4b59-bdef-a7263b1c50ce", "textEn": "The sky is blue.", "textEs": "El cielo es azul.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "8d4f40a0-f45a-462b-9aba-ab27d6d696f3"}, {"id": "10b7853d-7e32-4bdb-8877-79cdae0338d8", "textEn": "She wears a blue dress.", "textEs": "Ella usa un vestido azul.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "8d4f40a0-f45a-462b-9aba-ab27d6d696f3"}, {"id": "f49f72ee-83cd-4727-b55d-1ba3189efc1d", "textEn": "The sky is so blue today.", "textEs": "El cielo está tan azul hoy.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "8d4f40a0-f45a-462b-9aba-ab27d6d696f3"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a verb for applying color to a surface, or as a noun for the colored substance itself; common in everyday tasks like home improvement or art.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "3bdbf19f-efe8-45db-b899-bfc0f80f4379", "textEn": "They paint the house white.", "textEs": "Ellos pintan la casa de blanco.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "453b2ba8-d6ad-4d79-9220-648638a0db74"}, {"id": "bef0b775-7587-49e9-9fe0-2f896ec304db", "textEn": "I love to paint pictures.", "textEs": "Me encanta pintar cuadros.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "453b2ba8-d6ad-4d79-9220-648638a0db74"}, {"id": "6ff1626b-5372-431c-85d6-bbad987db477", "textEn": "The rain painted a rhythmic tap-tap on the windowpane.", "textEs": "La lluvia pintó un rítmico golpeteo en el cristal de la ventana.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "453b2ba8-d6ad-4d79-9220-648638a0db74"}]

flashcards.native_speech: pry-er too
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "6d7355e0-0057-4872-aca9-a38f51713f4e", "textEn": "Prior to the meeting, we reviewed all the documents.", "textEs": "Antes de la reunión, revisamos todos los documentos.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "19e27cf6-466c-4fe7-b5a5-ee90582c297d"}, {"id": "4dd2591b-b4a1-4e01-8e9e-c49bf5a79a78", "textEn": "She had never traveled abroad prior to last summer.", "textEs": "Ella nunca había viajado al extranjero antes del verano pasado.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "19e27cf6-466c-4fe7-b5a5-ee90582c297d"}, {"id": "944c761f-f1f5-4c4d-8fc6-9aa7ed0119bb", "textEn": "Please submit your application prior to the deadline.", "textEs": "Por favor, envíe su solicitud antes de la fecha límite.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "19e27cf6-466c-4fe7-b5a5-ee90582c297d"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to indicate a brief time interval between two events, often in storytelling or reporting.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "f01565af-37dd-4d9d-a44c-6c3060ab193e", "textEn": "He left the office; shortly after, his boss called him back.", "textEs": "Salió de la oficina; poco después, su jefe lo llamó de vuelta.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "9507df37-cabb-41f4-b619-d1b129ac852c"}, {"id": "1e8fa85a-f60c-4ea7-ade1-9adfc2d4f949", "textEn": "The concert ended; shortly after, the crowd dispersed.", "textEs": "El concierto terminó; poco después, la multitud se dispersó.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "9507df37-cabb-41f4-b619-d1b129ac852c"}, {"id": "c28dc298-10ee-48e2-acc5-f63ea0141af3", "textEn": "Shortly after the meeting ended, she received an urgent phone call.", "textEs": "Poco después de que terminara la reunión, recibió una llamada urgente.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "9507df37-cabb-41f4-b619-d1b129ac852c"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe the first stage or beginning of an event or process, often in formal or explanatory contexts.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "16bedad7-d3ff-471c-90ca-5c94979737b4", "textEn": "Initially, I thought it was a joke, but then I realized it was serious.", "textEs": "Inicialmente, pensé que era una broma, pero luego me di cuenta de que era serio.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "91843934-27b8-400a-b68d-035de7e6e16e"}, {"id": "761c6938-4155-4bd4-be38-d64bdf1690ea", "textEn": "The project was initially delayed due to bad weather.", "textEs": "El proyecto fue inicialmente retrasado debido al mal tiempo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "91843934-27b8-400a-b68d-035de7e6e16e"}, {"id": "0c89d1e1-ad64-497f-82e8-9562e11efcfd", "textEn": "Initially, I thought the project would be easy, but it turned out to be quite complex.", "textEs": "Inicialmente, pensé que el proyecto sería fácil, pero resultó ser bastante complejo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "91843934-27b8-400a-b68d-035de7e6e16e"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the period between two events, often implying something happens during that time.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "c62fed96-7701-4ac2-b2d2-f0054db0d437", "textEn": "The repair will take an hour; in the meantime, you can wait in the lounge.", "textEs": "La reparación tomará una hora; mientras tanto, puedes esperar en la sala.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "01932c44-0d89-4c4b-a22a-ed73b65fd0f0"}, {"id": "568ceeff-f6fd-4530-932d-c2f88021ac12", "textEn": "I'll finish the report; in the meantime, please gather the data.", "textEs": "Terminaré el informe; mientras tanto, por favor reúne los datos.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "01932c44-0d89-4c4b-a22a-ed73b65fd0f0"}, {"id": "870b491d-a19b-408a-9f5f-bcb30e21deec", "textEn": "Please finish your homework; in the meantime, I'll start preparing dinner.", "textEs": "Por favor, termina tu tarea; mientras tanto, empezaré a preparar la cena.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "01932c44-0d89-4c4b-a22a-ed73b65fd0f0"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to indicate that one action or event occurs before another, often emphasizing a deadline or sequence; e.g., 'By the time I arrived, they had already left.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "7f6bf3d7-1478-4cb4-90d8-c866cd6c7c1b", "textEn": "By the time we arrived, the movie had already started.", "textEs": "Para cuando llegamos, la película ya había comenzado.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "bbfb19dc-8bd6-4ae3-a99d-c8f7b0e1babe"}, {"id": "2fdf20cb-de36-4020-94fd-4602ca1b017e", "textEn": "By the time she finishes her degree, she'll be fluent in Spanish.", "textEs": "Para cuando termine su carrera, será fluida en español.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "bbfb19dc-8bd6-4ae3-a99d-c8f7b0e1babe"}, {"id": "b20d2365-c445-4ac9-9517-4998b9511e7c", "textEn": "By the time we arrived, the movie had already started.", "textEs": "Para cuando llegamos, la película ya había comenzado.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "bbfb19dc-8bd6-4ae3-a99d-c8f7b0e1babe"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to indicate that one action happens immediately after another, often in time clauses.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "947caad8-4928-49cd-bd14-461bc9990250", "textEn": "Call me as soon as you get home.", "textEs": "Llámame tan pronto como llegues a casa.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "37117a11-d19f-4d13-92b9-3e2d3c255d34"}, {"id": "7317a443-ee84-41a8-96d4-7bec39028861", "textEn": "As soon as the rain stops, we'll go outside.", "textEs": "Tan pronto como deje de llover, saldremos.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "37117a11-d19f-4d13-92b9-3e2d3c255d34"}, {"id": "c6c12037-5494-42db-a014-996acd861271", "textEn": "I'll call you as soon as I arrive at the airport.", "textEs": "Te llamaré tan pronto como llegue al aeropuerto.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "37117a11-d19f-4d13-92b9-3e2d3c255d34"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe separating something into pieces, interrupting a continuous action, or taking a pause from an activity.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "4be19b79-265b-4856-987b-117d9eb105ef", "textEn": "Don't break the glass.", "textEs": "No rompas el vidrio.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "aa54e82d-41f0-4466-ae72-ac165d633224"}, {"id": "152a6de4-5d05-4265-b6fe-b2a45be6c620", "textEn": "He needs a break from work.", "textEs": "Él necesita un descanso del trabajo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "aa54e82d-41f0-4466-ae72-ac165d633224"}, {"id": "5d9de8ef-a99a-4485-90c9-4fcf9b170ce3", "textEn": "I heard a twig break under my foot as I walked through the forest.", "textEs": "Escuché romperse una ramita bajo mi pie mientras caminaba por el bosque.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "aa54e82d-41f0-4466-ae72-ac165d633224"}]

[{"id": "30bf319a-7284-4ce3-a7a3-c80f53aa1417", "textEn": "Take a sip of your coffee.", "textEs": "Toma un sorbo de tu café.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "ec543eb5-7ea1-4d0e-8903-67e2ca09f404"}, {"id": "58b697e8-49a2-4e65-ad82-2a8eb307bc47", "textEn": "She sipped her tea slowly.", "textEs": "Ella sorbía su té lentamente.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "ec543eb5-7ea1-4d0e-8903-67e2ca09f404"}, {"id": "d9eb150a-0243-4f65-b1ce-a0572cb29bdc", "textEn": "Sip, I'll be there in a minute.", "textEs": "Sí, estaré allí en un minuto.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "ec543eb5-7ea1-4d0e-8903-67e2ca09f404"}]

flashcards.native_speech: ˈkɒnsɪkwəntli
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "52dfd22f-f137-411e-9d42-057894ab6131", "textEn": "He missed the bus; consequently, he was late for work.", "textEs": "Perdió el autobús; por consiguiente, llegó tarde al trabajo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "1376903d-c8fb-47ef-96c9-8b41de48c23a"}, {"id": "1f9f1961-31a9-46a6-9e46-ffd89e6e3e1e", "textEn": "The company lost revenue; consequently, they had to lay off staff.", "textEs": "La empresa perdió ingresos; por consiguiente, tuvieron que despedir personal.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "1376903d-c8fb-47ef-96c9-8b41de48c23a"}, {"id": "1b5438a5-60fd-4c94-a0d6-144c8cd595a4", "textEn": "He forgot to set his alarm; consequently, he missed the morning meeting.", "textEs": "Olvidó poner su alarma; en consecuencia, perdió la reunión de la mañana.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "1376903d-c8fb-47ef-96c9-8b41de48c23a"}]

flashcards.meaning: de ahí que, por lo tanto
flashcards.native_speech: hens
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "d008c242-8c01-4fad-910a-6c4f7c507e8b", "textEn": "The weather was terrible; hence, the picnic was canceled.", "textEs": "El clima era terrible; de ahí que se cancelara el picnic.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "56b5e84e-18f8-4772-8d3b-2be1224813a0"}, {"id": "0c52b2bb-222d-4745-aa88-1e7cc7686b36", "textEn": "She studied hard; hence, she passed the exam easily.", "textEs": "Estudió mucho; por lo tanto, aprobó el examen fácilmente.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "56b5e84e-18f8-4772-8d3b-2be1224813a0"}, {"id": "03a8ea80-f502-46ef-9e4e-dc6906922900", "textEn": "The project was completed ahead of schedule, hence the team received a bonus.", "textEs": "El proyecto se completó antes de lo previsto, por lo tanto el equipo recibió un bono.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "56b5e84e-18f8-4772-8d3b-2be1224813a0"}]

flashcards.native_speech: əˈkɔːrdɪŋli
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "24f8774b-67fd-4032-a284-a550f47050f1", "textEn": "The instructions were clear; accordingly, we followed them step by step.", "textEs": "Las instrucciones eran claras; en consecuencia, las seguimos paso a paso.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "759a7889-0335-4719-8ba7-0b1376a1e239"}, {"id": "12fa2585-6f36-4652-869f-d47ebbcace5e", "textEn": "The budget was reduced; accordingly, we cut unnecessary expenses.", "textEs": "El presupuesto se redujo; en consecuencia, recortamos gastos innecesarios.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "759a7889-0335-4719-8ba7-0b1376a1e239"}, {"id": "d877f186-10e6-48d3-9d22-b268daa196ed", "textEn": "The instructions were clear; accordingly, we completed the task ahead of schedule.", "textEs": "Las instrucciones eran claras; en consecuencia, completamos la tarea antes de lo previsto.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "759a7889-0335-4719-8ba7-0b1376a1e239"}]

flashcards.native_speech: ðʌs
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "7c702194-c9f7-4067-b352-33b93eb7410e", "textEn": "The project was completed ahead of schedule; thus, the team received a bonus.", "textEs": "El proyecto se completó antes de lo previsto; así que el equipo recibió un bono.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "6d1f652c-fef8-46f5-bc49-c4988c4b43ed"}, {"id": "e929c1d0-bb50-4c4b-bdce-ea999ab9e7ea", "textEn": "He forgot his keys; thus, he had to wait outside.", "textEs": "Olvidó sus llaves; por lo tanto, tuvo que esperar afuera.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "6d1f652c-fef8-46f5-bc49-c4988c4b43ed"}, {"id": "4cc50cab-7f3d-4cde-a894-d7cb35a899a6", "textEn": "She didn't study for the exam, thus she failed.", "textEs": "Ella no estudió para el examen, por lo tanto, reprobó.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "6d1f652c-fef8-46f5-bc49-c4988c4b43ed"}]

flashcards.native_speech: fər ðæt ˈriːzən
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "9603c0f0-c041-40a7-a008-73ae022d71ee", "textEn": "The road was closed; for that reason, we took a detour.", "textEs": "La carretera estaba cerrada; por esa razón, tomamos un desvío.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "6eb2b8ce-5db0-4f85-8208-af906b4e3e8d"}, {"id": "ede77fc2-a644-46d9-b2fd-a7df0f297d8f", "textEn": "She felt unwell; for that reason, she decided to stay home.", "textEs": "Se sentía mal; por esa razón, decidió quedarse en casa.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "6eb2b8ce-5db0-4f85-8208-af906b4e3e8d"}, {"id": "561caacd-84d7-42b7-a323-446443b5ee79", "textEn": "He was late for the meeting; for that reason, the presentation started without him.", "textEs": "Llegó tarde a la reunión; por esa razón, la presentación comenzó sin él.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "6eb2b8ce-5db0-4f85-8208-af906b4e3e8d"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to indicate carrying or transporting something to a location, often in commands or requests like 'bring me that book'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "fe08b7fc-4134-48dd-a3d2-2bd327691782", "textEn": "Please bring your book.", "textEs": "Por favor trae tu libro.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "be5720a6-4ca9-4b63-937a-ea66a688f30d"}, {"id": "55cf9b09-d59c-4211-9329-ae48e1e89f32", "textEn": "She will bring food to the party.", "textEs": "Ella traerá comida a la fiesta.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "be5720a6-4ca9-4b63-937a-ea66a688f30d"}, {"id": "caa80869-43aa-4cd8-a463-0622d38c5887", "textEn": "Could you bring me a glass of water?", "textEs": "¿Podrías traerme un vaso de agua?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "be5720a6-4ca9-4b63-937a-ea66a688f30d"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a group of students meeting for instruction, a social rank, or a category of things; often pronounced with a short 'a' sound in American English.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "033697af-1060-4880-a884-e21659237c38", "textEn": "The class starts at nine.", "textEs": "La clase empieza a las nueve.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "28f2b557-6292-4e90-9fbe-423f194e5b23"}, {"id": "4f95d637-9cee-4b48-bedb-d2025d534531", "textEn": "He is in my math class.", "textEs": "Él está en mi clase de matemáticas.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "28f2b557-6292-4e90-9fbe-423f194e5b23"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to indicate a smaller amount or degree, often in comparisons like 'less time' or 'less expensive'.
