flashcards.examples: [{"id": "c6bb3fd0-d4e9-4785-b344-9a83b7ede023", "textEn": "Eat less sugar.", "textEs": "Come menos azúcar.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "45049010-bd49-4cc3-ad95-fb85d2ae6ccb"}, {"id": "b031bb70-a32b-4d86-a78e-29619e688c9d", "textEn": "It costs less than ten dollars.", "textEs": "Cuesta menos de diez dólares.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "45049010-bd49-4cc3-ad95-fb85d2ae6ccb"}, {"id": "1d4dda1f-cd2b-443c-9454-4b1233edab99", "textEn": "Could you talk a little less loudly? I'm trying to concentrate.", "textEs": "¿Podrías hablar un poco menos fuerte? Estoy tratando de concentrarme.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "45049010-bd49-4cc3-ad95-fb85d2ae6ccb"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in everyday speech to mean moving past something, succeeding in a test, or giving something to someone, often with a quick, clipped pronunciation.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "66905c23-8fc8-4c86-a204-7717bb8e115f", "textEn": "Please pass the salt.", "textEs": "Por favor, pasa la sal.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "32c8e1ce-72e1-4276-9697-7933a90bd641"}, {"id": "b9e986f1-d63b-4a4d-ba0e-531e119c42ae", "textEn": "I need a bus pass.", "textEs": "Necesito un pase de autobús.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "32c8e1ce-72e1-4276-9697-7933a90bd641"}]

[{"id": "8030518a-b3cf-46b3-8457-66ab18aa1a8b", "textEn": "My sister lives in Boston.", "textEs": "Mi hermana vive en Boston.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "69dc40a4-00c2-4bd4-896d-f5a78d14a124"}, {"id": "514da4ec-5ed1-4810-8906-e3cf5b933384", "textEn": "She is my older sister.", "textEs": "Ella es mi hermana mayor.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "69dc40a4-00c2-4bd4-896d-f5a78d14a124"}, {"id": "4acd195c-e6bd-4e0b-8718-8e91b98e8b72", "textEn": "My sister and I used to share a room when we were kids.", "textEs": "Mi hermana y yo solíamos compartir habitación cuando éramos niños.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "69dc40a4-00c2-4bd4-896d-f5a78d14a124"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe a dark color like chocolate or wood, often in casual talk about hair, eyes, or objects.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "90e5c2ec-5acb-407e-bf7b-2ef0823fd58d", "textEn": "The dog is brown.", "textEs": "El perro es marrón.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "6b4fcb1c-58d5-45d4-b84d-571e5fcec779"}, {"id": "378927b3-fb20-4f86-b7ad-1b047935f853", "textEn": "I like brown shoes.", "textEs": "Me gustan los zapatos marrones.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "6b4fcb1c-58d5-45d4-b84d-571e5fcec779"}, {"id": "c9922587-11a8-4c4e-92fb-7fc6a94f328e", "textEn": "The steak was cooked until it was brown on the outside.", "textEs": "El bistec se cocinó hasta que estuvo dorado por fuera.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "6b4fcb1c-58d5-45d4-b84d-571e5fcec779"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in natural speech to state a fact or reality, often with emphasis in arguments or declarations.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "8f1f2361-9c3d-4690-bbec-ec948d5e191e", "textEn": "Always tell the truth.", "textEs": "Siempre di la verdad.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "65db3af3-0a83-40d0-95e7-c6ce116a4509"}, {"id": "68943501-5d72-4024-9116-31c44b4af9e4", "textEn": "The truth finally came out.", "textEs": "La verdad finalmente salió a la luz.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "65db3af3-0a83-40d0-95e7-c6ce116a4509"}, {"id": "8f841409-1ef7-4de7-bafb-283f630100da", "textEn": "To be honest, the truth is I never really liked that movie.", "textEs": "Para ser honesto, la verdad es que nunca me gustó esa película.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "65db3af3-0a83-40d0-95e7-c6ce116a4509"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to indicate making a selection or decision among options, often in everyday contexts like picking a meal or deciding on a course of action.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "dfd43af8-fc0f-4021-98b3-66f0c31a76b5", "textEn": "You need to choose a book to read.", "textEs": "Necesitas elegir un libro para leer.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "ad54b247-9bab-4136-bd46-33832011c197"}, {"id": "35139df1-cdfe-4317-a4fc-2592992bccd9", "textEn": "I choose the blue shirt over the red one.", "textEs": "Elijo la camisa azul en lugar de la roja.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "ad54b247-9bab-4136-bd46-33832011c197"}, {"id": "b6750697-cf10-4171-919b-8c17a31a5ecc", "textEn": "I can't decide which dress to buy, so I'll choose the blue one.", "textEs": "No puedo decidir qué vestido comprar, así que elegiré el azul.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "ad54b247-9bab-4136-bd46-33832011c197"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a generic term for a rugged, off-road vehicle, often referring to the brand but also any similar vehicle.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "3eced471-34e3-49fb-8348-9f2dcf522c02", "textEn": "We drove a jeep through the mountains.", "textEs": "Condujimos un jeep por las montañas.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "66a689ef-db69-4689-adab-fbc015371dce"}, {"id": "d2e95c56-5db8-4fdc-9f22-9885569ef520", "textEn": "The jeep got stuck in the mud.", "textEs": "El jeep se atascó en el barro.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "66a689ef-db69-4689-adab-fbc015371dce"}, {"id": "822908a7-6b66-4ca4-ad9c-c1651dabf31a", "textEn": "The jeep bounced along the rocky trail.", "textEs": "El jeep saltaba por el camino rocoso.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "66a689ef-db69-4689-adab-fbc015371dce"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to point to something specific, often with a slight emphasis in natural speech, like 'that one' or 'that thing'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "0a5c8caf-ce2a-4338-b839-e02be95fd72c", "textEn": "That is my book.", "textEs": "Ese es mi libro.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "0e0ff460-931d-4ec9-a922-f74bebd9f5e2"}, {"id": "40d3717f-b99c-41ec-9def-ca984419b527", "textEn": "I don't like that.", "textEs": "No me gusta eso.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "0e0ff460-931d-4ec9-a922-f74bebd9f5e2"}, {"id": "016284da-9220-4a43-9f98-e12599e203b3", "textEn": "That sounds like a great idea.", "textEs": "Eso suena como una gran idea.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "0e0ff460-931d-4ec9-a922-f74bebd9f5e2"}]

flashcards.native_speech: hɒ
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "617a19cb-0a6f-4357-8b91-2ac2123102a2", "textEn": "The coffee is very hot.", "textEs": "El café está muy caliente.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "05ac08db-93c7-4e3d-a9ef-6d4db0fada0f"}, {"id": "ce314cbd-60f6-4204-8bfb-388b4e50b257", "textEn": "It's hot outside today.", "textEs": "Hace calor afuera hoy.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "05ac08db-93c7-4e3d-a9ef-6d4db0fada0f"}, {"id": "4fd982fa-eaf5-4891-a1b8-9b5d1a54849a", "textEn": "The soup is hot, be careful not to burn your tongue.", "textEs": "La sopa está caliente, ten cuidado de no quemarte la lengua.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "05ac08db-93c7-4e3d-a9ef-6d4db0fada0f"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to negate a verb, adjective, or other adverb, often contracted in casual speech like 'don't' or 'isn't'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "9de47dfd-a112-4269-9cee-b6750d2c143a", "textEn": "I am not ready.", "textEs": "No estoy listo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "f0267fdf-11ca-4453-921f-79fb30aeafde"}, {"id": "50a50cc9-ed97-4785-bff8-ba9648824380", "textEn": "She does not know.", "textEs": "Ella no sabe.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "f0267fdf-11ca-4453-921f-79fb30aeafde"}, {"id": "d0ed0ffb-abaf-457a-8fce-68c6c93749a5", "textEn": "That's not what I meant.", "textEs": "Eso no es lo que quise decir.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "f0267fdf-11ca-4453-921f-79fb30aeafde"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a common noun for the Italian dish, often in casual contexts like ordering food or discussing meals.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "0682710d-f6e0-43a2-b91d-f5e1847ae39b", "textEn": "We ordered pizza for dinner.", "textEs": "Pedimos pizza para la cena.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "b837eb2e-d9a0-40d7-8725-a03547676939"}, {"id": "18c9b742-fd59-4fb0-9ef6-ff50b0e0c43d", "textEn": "This pizza tastes amazing.", "textEs": "Esta pizza sabe increíble.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "b837eb2e-d9a0-40d7-8725-a03547676939"}, {"id": "0e14d863-1259-4f49-aaee-d1e46df282c2", "textEn": "The pizza delivery guy just rang the doorbell.", "textEs": "El repartidor de pizza acaba de tocar el timbre.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "b837eb2e-d9a0-40d7-8725-a03547676939"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe riding waves on a surfboard, or casually browsing the internet.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "5ad28c8c-1d8a-4c2e-a616-5342f13a613f", "textEn": "They love to surf at the beach.", "textEs": "Les encanta surfear en la playa.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "ef3a7a9d-1ceb-4a4e-a659-c8b82313336b"}, {"id": "b26e0193-15af-40ab-bfc1-7e3529be243d", "textEn": "The surf was high this morning.", "textEs": "Las olas estaban altas esta mañana.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "ef3a7a9d-1ceb-4a4e-a659-c8b82313336b"}, {"id": "01fdf6f6-9405-478f-a643-8f4798516754", "textEn": "I love to surf the internet for new recipes.", "textEs": "Me encanta navegar por internet en busca de nuevas recetas.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "ef3a7a9d-1ceb-4a4e-a659-c8b82313336b"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to mean obtain, receive, or become; often in casual commands like 'get it' or 'get ready'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "7a97c942-d78c-49b3-acc2-6d6be6418cbf", "textEn": "I need to get some water.", "textEs": "Necesito obtener un poco de agua.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "df38735f-4eca-4895-989e-7213b5133bf5"}, {"id": "30ce0daf-dad8-4e21-9fd8-b469049045b1", "textEn": "Did you get the message?", "textEs": "¿Recibiste el mensaje?", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "df38735f-4eca-4895-989e-7213b5133bf5"}, {"id": "22efdc56-8f1a-4b87-950b-1098459ab38a", "textEn": "I need to get my car fixed before the weekend.", "textEs": "Necesito arreglar mi coche antes del fin de semana.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "df38735f-4eca-4895-989e-7213b5133bf5"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a small, simple shelter or house, often in a rural or wooded area, or the passenger compartment in an aircraft or ship.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "a39a0fb2-fada-4733-9c6d-17c8ff4b0e83", "textEn": "We stayed in a small cabin.", "textEs": "Nos quedamos en una pequeña cabaña.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "7add5758-6fc2-44ca-8d60-23443d6589e6"}, {"id": "24d61f4f-abf5-4b26-a9ac-2dcdc137839a", "textEn": "The cabin is in the woods.", "textEs": "La cabaña está en el bosque.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "7add5758-6fc2-44ca-8d60-23443d6589e6"}, {"id": "9e81e995-823e-4638-a60b-ee0da508a32f", "textEn": "The cabin creaked loudly as the wind howled outside.", "textEs": "La cabaña crujió fuertemente mientras el viento aullaba afuera.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "7add5758-6fc2-44ca-8d60-23443d6589e6"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe a difficult task or to invite someone to compete or prove something.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "2ff9a81b-6fb8-4af6-a6e2-0ede4d14d9e4", "textEn": "She accepted the challenge with enthusiasm.", "textEs": "Ella aceptó el desafío con entusiasmo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "6074438e-700d-48ca-a42b-54bd74379779"}, {"id": "0cad2e00-0ada-43c9-bbc0-4b949aa9e034", "textEn": "This math problem is a real challenge.", "textEs": "Este problema de matemáticas es un verdadero desafío.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "6074438e-700d-48ca-a42b-54bd74379779"}, {"id": "b8e4568e-e639-4dd8-b27f-8624f34038cb", "textEn": "I challenge you to a game of chess.", "textEs": "Te reto a una partida de ajedrez.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "6074438e-700d-48ca-a42b-54bd74379779"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe making something different, like swapping items or altering a situation.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "2195f821-6855-4b63-9729-19b566e1aeb1", "textEn": "We need to change our plans.", "textEs": "Necesitamos cambiar nuestros planes.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "1f7905c4-2aea-4273-9dfb-7b9ec5df4881"}, {"id": "46e39f1d-2379-44d2-8376-28e3bad2573d", "textEn": "Do you have change for a dollar?", "textEs": "¿Tienes cambio para un dólar?", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "1f7905c4-2aea-4273-9dfb-7b9ec5df4881"}, {"id": "4580d33a-e70d-45e6-91f0-e589f57c39c6", "textEn": "I need to change my clothes before the party.", "textEs": "Necesito cambiarme la ropa antes de la fiesta.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "1f7905c4-2aea-4273-9dfb-7b9ec5df4881"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to contrast or introduce an exception, often pronounced quickly and lightly in casual speech, sometimes reduced to /bət/.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "4fe2ad30-45c1-4484-a8bb-a30cf664d3ba", "textEn": "I want to go, but I can't.", "textEs": "Quiero ir, pero no puedo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "a1cc71d7-7391-4f4d-8d5d-0f410ec54dcb"}, {"id": "236c97c7-69f8-483c-bb5c-f4d1f1dbaa3e", "textEn": "It's small but nice.", "textEs": "Es pequeño pero bonito.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "a1cc71d7-7391-4f4d-8d5d-0f410ec54dcb"}, {"id": "18b3cf8e-cc2a-4471-8fde-2912785102e7", "textEn": "I wanted to go to the park, but it started raining.", "textEs": "Quería ir al parque, pero empezó a llover.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "a1cc71d7-7391-4f4d-8d5d-0f410ec54dcb"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the period of darkness between sunset and sunrise, often in casual conversation about time or activities.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "67251351-bc0a-4f13-82cf-8d4c068976f2", "textEn": "Good night, sleep well.", "textEs": "Buenas noches, duerme bien.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "6e30b9ab-c611-45f5-b8d9-8ea6eb51ad97"}, {"id": "b4b1dffb-8336-4db2-b581-bf0c43e88915", "textEn": "It was a long night.", "textEs": "Fue una noche larga.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "6e30b9ab-c611-45f5-b8d9-8ea6eb51ad97"}, {"id": "e0081dfc-064c-4371-94c9-82b6d2ddc30e", "textEn": "I can't sleep because the night is too quiet.", "textEs": "No puedo dormir porque la noche está demasiado silenciosa.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "6e30b9ab-c611-45f5-b8d9-8ea6eb51ad97"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a common noun for the dairy product, often said with emphasis in casual contexts like 'Say cheese!' for photos.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "2092b31c-7641-4870-a4f1-3dd6e8c7c2fc", "textEn": "I love cheese on my pizza.", "textEs": "Me encanta el queso en mi pizza.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "2578baa0-0c74-4f3c-8781-625e5d58fc63"}, {"id": "49fae5eb-2447-4653-a9f7-adc37d1d10af", "textEn": "She bought some cheese from the market.", "textEs": "Ella compró un poco de queso en el mercado.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "2578baa0-0c74-4f3c-8781-625e5d58fc63"}, {"id": "150d0c60-dac3-4fba-83d3-51e9f8a15ec3", "textEn": "Say cheese! Let me take a photo of you.", "textEs": "¡Di patata! Déjame tomarte una foto.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "2578baa0-0c74-4f3c-8781-625e5d58fc63"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something excessive or over-the-top, often in casual or slang contexts.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "39094e99-88e3-4f5b-ad70-525e6408b78a", "textEn": "Can I have an extra cookie?", "textEs": "¿Puedo tener una galleta extra?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "e0aaefe0-3d45-4426-8784-0da698239c20"}, {"id": "35523638-5359-4792-82eb-48cdbd0172a3", "textEn": "There is no extra charge for that.", "textEs": "No hay cargo extra por eso.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "e0aaefe0-3d45-4426-8784-0da698239c20"}, {"id": "b53c978b-2999-4af4-8c88-fedfcad01a11", "textEn": "I have an extra umbrella if you need one.", "textEs": "Tengo un paraguas extra si necesitas uno.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "e0aaefe0-3d45-4426-8784-0da698239c20"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the black-and-white bear native to China, often in casual conversation about animals or in contexts like 'panda express' for the fast-food chain.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "499a24cd-331f-42b6-9a84-d00b358f1f2c", "textEn": "The panda eats bamboo every day.", "textEs": "El panda come bambú todos los días.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "00d38c04-9f7d-4a03-889f-880ddb31a188"}, {"id": "0afafde5-5e9c-485a-8060-86aa97f8d95a", "textEn": "Look at that cute panda in the zoo.", "textEs": "Mira ese panda lindo en el zoológico.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "00d38c04-9f7d-4a03-889f-880ddb31a188"}, {"id": "b684f54a-fe1d-40bb-bae7-45909cea4b4a", "textEn": "The panda was munching on bamboo in its enclosure.", "textEs": "El panda estaba masticando bambú en su recinto.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "00d38c04-9f7d-4a03-889f-880ddb31a188"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a portable device for protection against rain or sun, often in casual conversation about weather or daily plans.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "f650368b-2842-4ea9-9e85-0f9b52f703eb", "textEn": "Take an umbrella; it might rain.", "textEs": "Lleva un paraguas; podría llover.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "321b8130-0c13-4b02-8b67-bfd360171184"}, {"id": "5783e3fc-547d-4c69-a38f-3fdf4ceb8f38", "textEn": "I forgot my umbrella at home.", "textEs": "Olvidé mi paraguas en casa.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "321b8130-0c13-4b02-8b67-bfd360171184"}, {"id": "60580a2d-6463-418c-9608-e333766cd309", "textEn": "I need an umbrella because it's raining outside.", "textEs": "Necesito un paraguas porque está lloviendo afuera.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "321b8130-0c13-4b02-8b67-bfd360171184"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a male parent, often in a respectful or affectionate tone.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "3d7937b7-3c20-4465-9460-c2a6630b2c21", "textEn": "My father is a teacher.", "textEs": "Mi padre es profesor.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "86c3c630-814f-47c8-9211-d235a1149416"}, {"id": "c0613cd4-f4c8-4be0-aeb1-4462be3e3984", "textEn": "His father works hard.", "textEs": "Su padre trabaja duro.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "86c3c630-814f-47c8-9211-d235a1149416"}, {"id": "c461e98a-11ae-42a7-8fd0-9cd0a610a30d", "textEn": "My father taught me how to ride a bike when I was six.", "textEs": "Mi padre me enseñó a andar en bicicleta cuando tenía seis años.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "86c3c630-814f-47c8-9211-d235a1149416"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a large number or amount, often in casual speech like 'a lot of' or 'lots of'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "aeff1b44-6826-4d6d-8696-fe317674dbc0", "textEn": "There is a lot of traffic.", "textEs": "Hay mucho tráfico.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "814e6e61-7942-4527-a47c-71efc01dc339"}, {"id": "0b665267-80fb-4611-937d-2aab8c5e861b", "textEn": "I have a lot to do.", "textEs": "Tengo mucho que hacer.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "814e6e61-7942-4527-a47c-71efc01dc339"}, {"id": "fd6a4cf5-777a-4aae-9a21-df01a447d824", "textEn": "The engine makes a lot of noise when it's cold.", "textEs": "El motor hace mucho ruido cuando está frío.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "814e6e61-7942-4527-a47c-71efc01dc339"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to confirm agreement, indicate correctness, or as a filler word in conversation, often with a rising or falling intonation.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "e4bb03bf-8be5-460e-80b6-c37ad97514e9", "textEn": "That is the right answer.", "textEs": "Esa es la respuesta correcta.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "e8200e55-17dc-4622-a42f-eefb8587444a"}, {"id": "97a0982d-1e53-4c75-85dd-f827db058faa", "textEn": "Turn right at the corner.", "textEs": "Gira a la derecha en la esquina.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "e8200e55-17dc-4622-a42f-eefb8587444a"}, {"id": "59764195-a9ba-499e-8d6d-eb8eda5f91dd", "textEn": "That sounds right to me.", "textEs": "Eso me suena bien.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "e8200e55-17dc-4622-a42f-eefb8587444a"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something that is not heavy, or to refer to illumination; also used informally to mean 'easy' or 'simple'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "2c7c9068-d78a-48a9-b67d-43830a7e1ef3", "textEn": "Please turn on the light.", "textEs": "Por favor, enciende la luz.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "d04f29a5-16eb-4125-a018-ad3c21b4ab5c"}, {"id": "16b33752-c68b-49f0-a0a7-243e77ef818f", "textEn": "This bag is very light.", "textEs": "Esta bolsa es muy liviana.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "d04f29a5-16eb-4125-a018-ad3c21b4ab5c"}, {"id": "62bf77f1-3254-42c8-b7f4-0e3eaec8f8ec", "textEn": "The room was so light and airy that I immediately felt at peace.", "textEs": "La habitación era tan clara y aireada que de inmediato me sentí en paz.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "d04f29a5-16eb-4125-a018-ad3c21b4ab5c"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to express enthusiasm, approval, or satisfaction, often as an exclamation or in casual agreement.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "73ba4f97-d1e5-4e57-b40c-91fca0a82eec", "textEn": "That's a great idea!", "textEs": "¡Esa es una gran idea!", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "e977462c-68b5-4615-95d7-01970397b963"}, {"id": "ebdc799e-ce72-4e09-902e-ab11599f3114", "textEn": "We had a great time.", "textEs": "Lo pasamos genial.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "e977462c-68b5-4615-95d7-01970397b963"}, {"id": "eb8dc4b7-1ed0-4d4f-a3ec-5caa94970611", "textEn": "That's a great idea, let's do it!", "textEs": "¡Esa es una gran idea, hagámoslo!", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "e977462c-68b5-4615-95d7-01970397b963"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a place for physical exercise, often in casual conversation like 'I'm heading to the gym' or 'Do you go to the gym?'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "0a442787-8808-493d-9d00-8bdb0773e0f6", "textEn": "I go to the gym every morning.", "textEs": "Voy al gimnasio cada mañana.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "970c8e28-9c24-4bcb-be62-ad8c1168467b"}, {"id": "7bff231c-cfa8-436a-b22d-ac29fb6ecb47", "textEn": "The gym was crowded today.", "textEs": "El gimnasio estaba lleno hoy.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "970c8e28-9c24-4bcb-be62-ad8c1168467b"}, {"id": "d807fa3e-a7fa-4131-84ce-0e7f61b09e30", "textEn": "I hit the gym after work every weekday.", "textEs": "Voy al gimnasio después del trabajo todos los días de semana.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "970c8e28-9c24-4bcb-be62-ad8c1168467b"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to possibility or opportunity, often in phrases like 'by chance' or 'take a chance'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "013ba222-0ddc-4591-9d0a-e2ac75f28619", "textEn": "Give me a chance to explain.", "textEs": "Dame una oportunidad para explicar.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "b98fa80c-43cd-4134-9a6c-5c83671b2393"}, {"id": "f95581bb-8d6c-40c8-9828-e165db940dd8", "textEn": "There is a good chance it will rain today.", "textEs": "Hay una buena oportunidad de que llueva hoy.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "b98fa80c-43cd-4134-9a6c-5c83671b2393"}, {"id": "daa99b46-f713-4668-9f6a-b7c9def2e069", "textEn": "I took a chance and applied for the job, even though I didn't meet all the requirements.", "textEs": "Me arriesgué y solicité el trabajo, aunque no cumplía con todos los requisitos.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "b98fa80c-43cd-4134-9a6c-5c83671b2393"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used after a time expression to indicate how far back in the past something happened, e.g., 'two days ago'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "9084b14e-3dd7-474a-ac2a-cb213e9880bf", "textEn": "I saw him a week ago.", "textEs": "Lo vi hace una semana.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "02c14578-b2e3-4e78-906f-aa70c032c3f5"}, {"id": "20c1ba63-fd45-467a-81c9-3b6c38d3c020", "textEn": "She left two hours ago.", "textEs": "Ella se fue hace dos horas.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "02c14578-b2e3-4e78-906f-aa70c032c3f5"}, {"id": "840c00e8-38ca-4b0c-848a-97a51e7561de", "textEn": "I visited Paris three years ago.", "textEs": "Visité París hace tres años.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "02c14578-b2e3-4e78-906f-aa70c032c3f5"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a long, upholstered seat for two or more people, common in living rooms.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "39b43920-f624-41da-9b16-5d990017af9d", "textEn": "The cat sleeps on the sofa.", "textEs": "El gato duerme en el sofá.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "d1002dea-b30d-433c-b94b-b51ee0cdd54e"}, {"id": "8963279c-1379-417c-b35c-1a497f82b309", "textEn": "We bought a new sofa yesterday.", "textEs": "Compramos un sofá nuevo ayer.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "d1002dea-b30d-433c-b94b-b51ee0cdd54e"}, {"id": "4a9d81f3-4f63-4a2c-b29b-850cd751efa7", "textEn": "Let's sit on the sofa and watch a movie.", "textEs": "Sentémonos en el sofá y veamos una película.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "d1002dea-b30d-433c-b94b-b51ee0cdd54e"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the punctuation mark, often in writing or dictation contexts like 'add a comma here'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "a2dcabfb-83f6-4f46-bbf9-73fcc00941bc", "textEn": "Don't forget the comma in that sentence.", "textEs": "No olvides la coma en esa oración.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "a1518cee-5718-40aa-832e-0fca977551eb"}, {"id": "c81541cb-df20-486d-bd46-f286783cc31f", "textEn": "A comma can change the meaning.", "textEs": "Una coma puede cambiar el significado.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "a1518cee-5718-40aa-832e-0fca977551eb"}, {"id": "291690d6-cc73-4a8a-a78a-422cc17c85b0", "textEn": "He said, comma, we need to leave now, comma, but I'm not ready.", "textEs": "Él dijo, coma, tenemos que irnos ahora, coma, pero no estoy listo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "a1518cee-5718-40aa-832e-0fca977551eb"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a carbonated soft drink, common in American English; often ordered at restaurants or asked for casually.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "a16cb777-1382-428a-9861-acac55f144e8", "textEn": "I'll have a soda with my meal.", "textEs": "Tomaré un refresco con mi comida.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "252c5457-a942-42eb-a2ef-30f497bb2285"}, {"id": "486e3f6d-fb1b-404e-a560-645cbcab98c5", "textEn": "She drinks soda every afternoon.", "textEs": "Ella bebe gaseosa cada tarde.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "252c5457-a942-42eb-a2ef-30f497bb2285"}, {"id": "a5be9bd1-a25f-4bb5-bb28-e2cf7609058f", "textEn": "Can you hear the soda fizzing when I open the can?", "textEs": "¿Puedes oír el burbujeo de la gaseosa cuando abro la lata?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "252c5457-a942-42eb-a2ef-30f497bb2285"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a proper noun for the country, or informally as a common noun for porcelain dishes, often with a slight emphasis on the first syllable.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "a4a28c74-19d5-4ae7-a00c-037869c30c75", "textEn": "She collects fine china plates.", "textEs": "Ella colecciona platos finos de porcelana.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "af0bb52c-d261-49fb-8a47-e973f82658d4"}, {"id": "dad0435e-8661-42bc-aa75-a0d9dc3a33cf", "textEn": "The china set is very old.", "textEs": "El juego de porcelana es muy antiguo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "af0bb52c-d261-49fb-8a47-e973f82658d4"}, {"id": "ea74df36-647b-407e-82f6-de3c76e65680", "textEn": "The china in that cabinet has been passed down for generations.", "textEs": "La porcelana en ese armario ha pasado de generación en generación.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "af0bb52c-d261-49fb-8a47-e973f82658d4"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to indicate the highest quality or most favorable option, often in comparisons or exclamations like 'the best' or 'best of luck'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "b57f338a-f555-40cc-8494-a031399f3491", "textEn": "This is the best pizza in town.", "textEs": "Esta es la mejor pizza de la ciudad.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "52e205e5-178c-4258-8bd2-c192837f11b1"}, {"id": "6efe41f5-96db-4248-849d-e8638f6e6854", "textEn": "Do your best on the exam.", "textEs": "Haz tu mejor esfuerzo en el examen.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "52e205e5-178c-4258-8bd2-c192837f11b1"}, {"id": "8640c7ba-fa69-4fb6-8535-943b0be39cb0", "textEn": "This is the best pizza I've ever had.", "textEs": "Esta es la mejor pizza que he probado.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "52e205e5-178c-4258-8bd2-c192837f11b1"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe a place for sports, concerts, or competitions; also metaphorically for a field of activity or conflict.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "3214773a-c476-4dbb-860c-97893e7f1d1d", "textEn": "The concert is in the arena.", "textEs": "El concierto es en la arena.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "58dd677b-b4d8-47b8-9a7f-503a3c5055ad"}, {"id": "29078bab-1e92-4140-912e-70aa47bbf8f7", "textEn": "They fought in the arena.", "textEs": "Ellos pelearon en la arena.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "58dd677b-b4d8-47b8-9a7f-503a3c5055ad"}, {"id": "5754e8cd-c394-4492-baee-ebe003ef5d36", "textEn": "The crowd roared in the arena as the game reached its climax.", "textEs": "La multitud rugió en la arena cuando el juego llegó a su clímax.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "58dd677b-b4d8-47b8-9a7f-503a3c5055ad"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the room where food is prepared, often in casual conversation about cooking or daily routines.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "04d0d9af-f7c7-40f0-bf6f-8ef786a52419", "textEn": "The kitchen is very clean.", "textEs": "La cocina está muy limpia.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "003e55d5-ffc4-4950-bfaf-757bc5d5d5c7"}, {"id": "0903546a-7c9e-4e95-8014-76735647d116", "textEn": "He cooked dinner in the kitchen.", "textEs": "Él cocinó la cena en la cocina.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "003e55d5-ffc4-4950-bfaf-757bc5d5d5c7"}, {"id": "42b1d13f-72fb-4eaf-9762-0632d95a98e0", "textEn": "I love the smell of fresh coffee brewing in the kitchen in the morning.", "textEs": "Me encanta el olor del café recién hecho en la cocina por la mañana.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "003e55d5-ffc4-4950-bfaf-757bc5d5d5c7"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe physically grabbing something in motion, like a ball, or understanding a concept, as in 'Did you catch that?'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "8a0d2513-92d5-4c4d-a7bb-17069cb8c2f6", "textEn": "Can you catch the ball?", "textEs": "¿Puedes atrapar la pelota?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "d52f79f3-6fc2-42a1-931d-9f205a69883a"}, {"id": "26f1403b-a627-4543-b34e-6a68edfe4cbf", "textEn": "I need to catch the bus at 8.", "textEs": "Necesito atrapar el autobús a las 8.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "d52f79f3-6fc2-42a1-931d-9f205a69883a"}, {"id": "4f9dbf46-5ffa-4124-93e1-745a4cff449c", "textEn": "I can't quite catch what you're saying over all this noise.", "textEs": "No logro captar bien lo que dices con todo este ruido.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "d52f79f3-6fc2-42a1-931d-9f205a69883a"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the midday meal, often in casual conversation like 'What's for lunch?' or 'Let's grab lunch.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "436588e5-bb73-43c3-a82a-d1389a8c8ef1", "textEn": "We had lunch at noon.", "textEs": "Almorzamos al mediodía.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "93d7ddb4-e0bb-4277-a73b-255dd52edf3e"}, {"id": "ce52d332-54a0-4be3-a6c5-873f66acf00d", "textEn": "She packed a lunch for the trip.", "textEs": "Ella preparó un almuerzo para el viaje.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "93d7ddb4-e0bb-4277-a73b-255dd52edf3e"}, {"id": "ec92f0b9-c33f-44f5-aecb-a5b4d61ec569", "textEn": "I usually grab a quick lunch at the deli near my office.", "textEs": "Normalmente como un almuerzo rápido en la delicatesen cerca de mi oficina.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "93d7ddb4-e0bb-4277-a73b-255dd52edf3e"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to indicate a large amount or degree, often in comparisons or negations like 'not much' or 'too much'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "b2c4a61d-a570-4244-b2cd-bea8b41dee12", "textEn": "I don't have much time.", "textEs": "No tengo mucho tiempo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "8ba56d89-da62-4f47-a6c3-9604b5ae801a"}, {"id": "68ef13b0-5b51-43d1-a060-96fa6a8adffd", "textEn": "Thank you very much.", "textEs": "Muchas gracias.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "8ba56d89-da62-4f47-a6c3-9604b5ae801a"}, {"id": "9f1b95c3-e493-4e8e-b4c6-c336d6b000ea", "textEn": "I don't like that movie much.", "textEs": "Esa película no me gusta mucho.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "8ba56d89-da62-4f47-a6c3-9604b5ae801a"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a noun for a sheet in a book or a digital screen, or as a verb meaning to call someone via a pager or public address system.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "0b7791af-7afc-48d5-a97f-bc28a52cb504", "textEn": "Turn to page 42 in your book.", "textEs": "Ve a la página 42 en tu libro.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "683663b9-5f6f-4a7b-9478-5d15046e28b4"}, {"id": "20488984-88fa-4168-87ce-ef94fcd2cef7", "textEn": "The page was torn.", "textEs": "La página estaba rota.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "683663b9-5f6f-4a7b-9478-5d15046e28b4"}, {"id": "7da708c8-1285-4291-9c5a-c31f6f576a4e", "textEn": "Could you page Dr. Smith to the emergency room, please?", "textEs": "¿Podría localizar al Dr. Smith en la sala de emergencias, por favor?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "683663b9-5f6f-4a7b-9478-5d15046e28b4"}]

flashcards.native_speech: dæns
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "bd4f33c9-5f13-40fb-975f-12e7d1eba5af", "textEn": "Let's dance all night.", "textEs": "Bailemos toda la noche.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "d1df92c3-0d5b-4418-b77d-57b901c5e40c"}, {"id": "6b4a4d64-ee7e-438e-b70a-4657f398d3f5", "textEn": "She loves to dance.", "textEs": "Ella ama bailar.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "d1df92c3-0d5b-4418-b77d-57b901c5e40c"}, {"id": "fb4fd836-25f1-4bd5-b2cd-ada00c3a19c0", "textEn": "The leaves dance in the autumn wind.", "textEs": "Las hojas bailan con el viento otoñal.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "d1df92c3-0d5b-4418-b77d-57b901c5e40c"}]

flashcards.native_speech: sʌdən
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "babe35a5-8201-4e53-bb8e-756cbb8cf6bd", "textEn": "It was a sudden change.", "textEs": "Fue un cambio repentino.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "3f8f8a7f-146c-4c37-8815-a8d9258b3554"}, {"id": "eec3f3a5-f14d-4230-944e-a626fbf680a7", "textEn": "The rain stopped sudden.", "textEs": "La lluvia paró de repente.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "3f8f8a7f-146c-4c37-8815-a8d9258b3554"}, {"id": "b626101e-e57d-4f5a-95c8-85af750e201e", "textEn": "I felt a sudden urge to call my mother.", "textEs": "Sentí un impulso repentino de llamar a mi madre.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "3f8f8a7f-146c-4c37-8815-a8d9258b3554"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something unclean or morally impure; often in casual speech to emphasize disgust or disapproval.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "4d802406-39e2-4526-bec4-f971e19410b5", "textEn": "The floor is dirty.", "textEs": "El piso está sucio.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "23c020ba-4422-406b-97b3-85f929b4fbc1"}, {"id": "6c1733ca-e739-429b-b92a-582728bf9c9f", "textEn": "Wash your dirty hands.", "textEs": "Lávate las manos sucias.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "23c020ba-4422-406b-97b3-85f929b4fbc1"}, {"id": "fd18dbc3-1829-427e-b453-04078ec6a512", "textEn": "The engine's making a dirty sound, like something's scraping inside.", "textEs": "El motor está haciendo un sonido sucio, como si algo estuviera raspando dentro.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "23c020ba-4422-406b-97b3-85f929b4fbc1"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the central point or position of something, often in phrases like 'in the middle of' or 'middle ground'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "f0ba7b27-aa71-4271-879a-a73b6efab9f5", "textEn": "He sat in the middle.", "textEs": "Él se sentó en el medio.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "3e6d95d5-494b-4559-820d-c37b42dee788"}, {"id": "80ee9821-2a9f-46b0-94f9-2c665688cc98", "textEn": "The middle of the road.", "textEs": "El medio del camino.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "3e6d95d5-494b-4559-820d-c37b42dee788"}, {"id": "2190f599-ac46-4fde-a3d5-e9530a1b2653", "textEn": "She stopped in the middle of her sentence.", "textEs": "Se detuvo en medio de su frase.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "3e6d95d5-494b-4559-820d-c37b42dee788"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a countable or uncountable noun for the food, and informally for money or livelihood.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "4579500e-d814-410f-84ef-bc27504b9391", "textEn": "I need some bread.", "textEs": "Necesito un poco de pan.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "2ee77286-043a-4dde-a5aa-3c4ae7a264b9"}, {"id": "2fcec728-e76b-450e-9060-1122adcc3460", "textEn": "The bread is fresh.", "textEs": "El pan está fresco.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "2ee77286-043a-4dde-a5aa-3c4ae7a264b9"}, {"id": "7abfcafe-f913-458d-aaaf-eef10ad5f9b7", "textEn": "This bread is so fresh and crusty.", "textEs": "Este pan está tan fresco y crujiente.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "2ee77286-043a-4dde-a5aa-3c4ae7a264b9"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to indicate position below something, or in phrases like 'under the weather' to mean feeling ill.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "5ba215c5-fefd-49bc-97dc-8a0134a08532", "textEn": "The cat is under the table.", "textEs": "El gato está debajo de la mesa.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "5587d8a3-1bba-4da1-a0c8-1e1e87d12ca1"}, {"id": "b0b7262f-ae4b-4c0b-a05b-8bc0d0195aca", "textEn": "Put it under the bed.", "textEs": "Ponlo debajo de la cama.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "5587d8a3-1bba-4da1-a0c8-1e1e87d12ca1"}, {"id": "705348ae-9cdb-4b6f-a2e4-720d5b9e39be", "textEn": "The cat is hiding under the bed.", "textEs": "El gato se esconde debajo de la cama.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "5587d8a3-1bba-4da1-a0c8-1e1e87d12ca1"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a percussion instrument or a cylindrical container; also used as a verb meaning to tap rhythmically.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "70904bfe-cd91-407a-bbb9-11a3c35c9380", "textEn": "He plays the drum.", "textEs": "Él toca el tambor.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "8d494717-919e-4863-81f5-bf65ac614000"}, {"id": "640b0cda-c749-4522-8002-ef7697a07020", "textEn": "The drum is loud.", "textEs": "El tambor es fuerte.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "8d494717-919e-4863-81f5-bf65ac614000"}, {"id": "63e0b217-8017-4657-b767-ec016dde1076", "textEn": "The rain drummed against the window all night.", "textEs": "La lluvia tamborileó contra la ventana toda la noche.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "8d494717-919e-4863-81f5-bf65ac614000"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe starting a process or activity, often to encourage action or begin a discussion.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "a0e3bb12-c1c0-4711-8c04-0842882ec685", "textEn": "Let's get the ball rolling on this project.", "textEs": "Pongamos en marcha este proyecto.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "e6a698e8-6f91-4c86-8e90-1993d48d5911"}, {"id": "d194509a-1b27-49d9-b8d0-b567eca1e9a3", "textEn": "I'll start the presentation to get the ball rolling.", "textEs": "Empezaré la presentación para ponerlo en marcha.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "e6a698e8-6f91-4c86-8e90-1993d48d5911"}, {"id": "5f835d62-f5ac-403e-999f-db56651de621", "textEn": "Let's get the ball rolling on this project by assigning tasks to each team member.", "textEs": "Pongamos en marcha este proyecto asignando tareas a cada miembro del equipo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "e6a698e8-6f91-4c86-8e90-1993d48d5911"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to express unhappiness or disappointment, often in a straightforward or empathetic tone.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "68a21fcd-0f69-4aa0-8394-60aae156b27b", "textEn": "She feels sad today.", "textEs": "Ella se siente triste hoy.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "71ce2309-6beb-40a2-a249-dc58e9733cc1"}, {"id": "c4154122-b5c6-4ef5-b3b2-ce852092fd8e", "textEn": "That movie was sad.", "textEs": "Esa película fue triste.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "71ce2309-6beb-40a2-a249-dc58e9733cc1"}, {"id": "8b41c988-3885-40f7-8ba5-ae4120a5d906", "textEn": "He gave a sad smile when he heard the news.", "textEs": "Él dio una sonrisa triste cuando escuchó la noticia.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "71ce2309-6beb-40a2-a249-dc58e9733cc1"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a sweet baked dessert, often in casual contexts like 'Let's have some cake' or idiomatically in phrases like 'a piece of cake' meaning something easy.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "ec27b51e-630f-453f-a202-cd2183adf189", "textEn": "She baked a chocolate cake.", "textEs": "Ella horneó un pastel de chocolate.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "aef446a8-dff3-455b-ac0f-6dbc4eeab3a8"}, {"id": "d0e4d6d9-3ea8-458b-ad37-c887c5229583", "textEn": "I want a slice of cake.", "textEs": "Quiero una rebanada de pastel.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "aef446a8-dff3-455b-ac0f-6dbc4eeab3a8"}, {"id": "3b8cfdcd-c21a-4ad8-bb8b-95bf41f3ec39", "textEn": "This math problem is a piece of cake.", "textEs": "Este problema de matemáticas es pan comido.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "aef446a8-dff3-455b-ac0f-6dbc4eeab3a8"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a plot of land for growing flowers, vegetables, or plants, often in a residential setting.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "8db2e611-3d5c-44c7-917b-9b3e7a67a9e6", "textEn": "The garden is beautiful.", "textEs": "El jardín es hermoso.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "2e984765-40d0-4c66-a8ee-cd311147613a"}, {"id": "1c77d2f5-a2b4-4862-af6c-e1e00c937ecb", "textEn": "Let's plant in the garden.", "textEs": "Plantemos en el jardín.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "2e984765-40d0-4c66-a8ee-cd311147613a"}, {"id": "7d650654-bcc3-40a0-abcb-011c8a1ea392", "textEn": "The birds are singing in the garden this morning.", "textEs": "Los pájaros están cantando en el jardín esta mañana.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "2e984765-40d0-4c66-a8ee-cd311147613a"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a 24-hour period or the time between sunrise and sunset; common in greetings like 'Have a good day' or in phrases like 'day and night'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "6e4db43e-d5f1-4a45-a4fc-619922e6796c", "textEn": "Have a nice day.", "textEs": "Ten un buen día.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "16902cc7-69e2-41c7-b329-a8026cc35a64"}, {"id": "069f564b-1d2e-482a-8615-0aae1d7b048c", "textEn": "It's a sunny day.", "textEs": "Es un día soleado.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "16902cc7-69e2-41c7-b329-a8026cc35a64"}, {"id": "edeed1e9-133f-4e1a-b85e-e26d042548cb", "textEn": "Day after day.", "textEs": "Día tras día.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "16902cc7-69e2-41c7-b329-a8026cc35a64"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally in casual conversation to mean 'want to', often expressing desire or intention, as in 'I wanna go home.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "a9da3998-aaca-418c-a2d4-65e689771136", "textEn": "Do you wanna grab coffee later?", "textEs": "¿Quieres tomar un café después?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "c8f0ab94-af1f-4532-a38f-c1c28951c7f9"}, {"id": "4f2b91a5-0a1b-41d3-b978-59b532eb89d7", "textEn": "I don't wanna miss the bus.", "textEs": "No quiero perder el autobús.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "c8f0ab94-af1f-4532-a38f-c1c28951c7f9"}, {"id": "628683c4-d9ef-4b1a-b713-bda7c1ddd762", "textEn": "I wanna go to the park later.", "textEs": "Quiero ir al parque más tarde.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "c8f0ab94-af1f-4532-a38f-c1c28951c7f9"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe a sudden sharp sound, a break or fissure, or informally, to joke or make a witty remark; also slang for a potent form of cocaine.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "30c00dd0-9db3-4fe9-93fc-0ffbb285663d", "textEn": "There is a crack in the wall.", "textEs": "Hay una grieta en la pared.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "7253cf40-e36c-46a5-85a4-76f50b4228ef"}, {"id": "2c771ba0-8349-47a7-bf40-65612e92f833", "textEn": "Don't crack the eggs too hard.", "textEs": "No rompas los huevos demasiado fuerte.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "7253cf40-e36c-46a5-85a4-76f50b4228ef"}, {"id": "e65c3a25-93a7-4690-a9eb-ea307106bac0", "textEn": "The branch made a loud crack when it broke.", "textEs": "La rama hizo un fuerte crujido cuando se rompió.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "7253cf40-e36c-46a5-85a4-76f50b4228ef"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to something said or done to provoke laughter, often in casual conversation or storytelling.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "bab09df5-1d14-4aff-9410-96028f9e648d", "textEn": "He told a funny joke.", "textEs": "Él contó un chiste divertido.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "f27db78f-2658-401a-8783-220b23a1c5cf"}, {"id": "e3087fb1-6959-4c2f-83d4-3952c21c24e7", "textEn": "That was just a joke, don't worry.", "textEs": "Eso fue solo una broma, no te preocupes.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "f27db78f-2658-401a-8783-220b23a1c5cf"}, {"id": "73f6c160-6eb7-4261-ad0f-ad2ce9dc9aea", "textEn": "You must be joking! I can't believe he said that.", "textEs": "¡Debes estar bromeando! No puedo creer que haya dicho eso.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "f27db78f-2658-401a-8783-220b23a1c5cf"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a genre of music with improvisation and syncopation, or informally to describe something as lively, flashy, or exaggerated.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "89ca0db2-d3cc-4f7f-bef7-c511377b94b8", "textEn": "She loves listening to jazz music.", "textEs": "A ella le encanta escuchar música jazz.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "a1a3c9b8-7847-4c4b-b3db-cc51871c1da4"}, {"id": "88ff1455-4a1e-4ecc-8e62-565490e63979", "textEn": "The jazz band played all night.", "textEs": "La banda de jazz tocó toda la noche.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "a1a3c9b8-7847-4c4b-b3db-cc51871c1da4"}, {"id": "3fdbd0f6-a69a-4457-a199-529021737134", "textEn": "I love the smooth sound of jazz playing in the background.", "textEs": "Me encanta el sonido suave del jazz sonando de fondo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "a1a3c9b8-7847-4c4b-b3db-cc51871c1da4"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something easily broken or damaged, often in a literal or emotional sense.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "f5ca80a6-276a-4764-9382-34d95a230b6a", "textEn": "Handle the glass with care; it's fragile.", "textEs": "Maneja el vidrio con cuidado; es frágil.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "192d9a02-5a1a-4a0f-aef2-3802b4454d76"}, {"id": "9d71d138-eb06-427b-963b-5915c5735ff4", "textEn": "The fragile ecosystem needs protection.", "textEs": "El ecosistema frágil necesita protección.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "192d9a02-5a1a-4a0f-aef2-3802b4454d76"}, {"id": "4e3d26ca-ecc1-4f2e-8d90-38b05f38ea0e", "textEn": "Be careful with that vase, it's very fragile.", "textEs": "Ten cuidado con ese jarrón, es muy frágil.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "192d9a02-5a1a-4a0f-aef2-3802b4454d76"}]

[{"id": "bd422251-f9b7-4710-b67e-821ea9ad5a06", "textEn": "That dress is absolutely fabulous.", "textEs": "Ese vestido es absolutamente fabuloso.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "358a6bc5-26d8-496c-a35d-8de912b3303e"}, {"id": "242e86f0-815b-40bd-82a9-a0fd607f8788", "textEn": "She told a fabulous story about her trip.", "textEs": "Ella contó una historia fabulosa sobre su viaje.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "358a6bc5-26d8-496c-a35d-8de912b3303e"}, {"id": "cf948753-43d2-48cc-9eef-c6e66990bae1", "textEn": "You look absolutely fabulous in that dress!", "textEs": "¡Te ves absolutamente fabulosa con ese vestido!", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "358a6bc5-26d8-496c-a35d-8de912b3303e"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe overcoming an opponent or obstacle, often in competition or conflict; can also refer to causing something to fail.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "3b19b0dc-f4aa-4823-8cc2-ec24eb153c20", "textEn": "The team suffered a crushing defeat.", "textEs": "El equipo sufrió una derrota aplastante.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "3810f6cc-7a3c-49a7-83fc-67b20faff521"}, {"id": "f5c210f3-11b5-4063-b850-114472ee4cb2", "textEn": "She refused to accept defeat and tried again.", "textEs": "Ella se negó a aceptar la derrota y lo intentó de nuevo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "3810f6cc-7a3c-49a7-83fc-67b20faff521"}, {"id": "cba68763-b615-4242-88da-0d60863a4d32", "textEn": "The team managed to defeat their rivals in a thrilling final match.", "textEs": "El equipo logró derrotar a sus rivales en un emocionante partido final.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "3810f6cc-7a3c-49a7-83fc-67b20faff521"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a noun or verb to describe something that counterbalances or compensates for something else, or to indicate a shift in position or timing.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "fd645ab2-65ea-4860-bd95-898a757cd415", "textEn": "The gains offset the losses.", "textEs": "Las ganancias compensan las pérdidas.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "dfb9fbdf-5282-44d5-b386-c12677f9fe47"}, {"id": "8325e39c-a19e-451e-b16c-6005cd08c887", "textEn": "We need to offset the carbon emissions.", "textEs": "Necesitamos compensar las emisiones de carbono.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "dfb9fbdf-5282-44d5-b386-c12677f9fe47"}, {"id": "27f73463-b36c-47c7-b731-eb22634553ec", "textEn": "The increased costs were offset by higher sales revenue.", "textEs": "Los costos aumentados fueron compensados por mayores ingresos por ventas.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "dfb9fbdf-5282-44d5-b386-c12677f9fe47"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something that happens often, like 'frequent flyer' or 'frequent visits'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "571aa00c-bd60-43da-9ef9-505ada45adfd", "textEn": "He is a frequent visitor to the library.", "textEs": "Él es un visitante frecuente de la biblioteca.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "fb82f5fd-0b4b-493c-b811-b2f6d0c51cba"}, {"id": "7f4a500e-d726-40e5-b2a5-5086cb1bb58b", "textEn": "Frequent exercise improves your health.", "textEs": "El ejercicio frecuente mejora tu salud.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "fb82f5fd-0b4b-493c-b811-b2f6d0c51cba"}, {"id": "d5a64d08-319a-4093-91fe-49ecd58f9cd6", "textEn": "She is a frequent visitor to the local library.", "textEs": "Ella es una visitante frecuente de la biblioteca local.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "fb82f5fd-0b4b-493c-b811-b2f6d0c51cba"}]

[{"id": "cfaf1eef-7c2f-4291-8b1e-a6be807061ea", "textEn": "Put more effort into your homework.", "textEs": "Pon más esfuerzo en tu tarea.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "c8ac0db8-42e8-4c20-852e-105ed6123096"}, {"id": "7d1ec072-1bc1-438d-8f0b-8b4549913c7a", "textEn": "It took a lot of effort to finish the race.", "textEs": "Tomó mucho esfuerzo terminar la carrera.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "c8ac0db8-42e8-4c20-852e-105ed6123096"}, {"id": "0cdef8c7-0b9f-48a1-9b99-6698ea16d64b", "textEn": "She put a lot of effort into organizing the event, and it turned out beautifully.", "textEs": "Ella puso mucho esfuerzo en organizar el evento, y resultó hermoso.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "c8ac0db8-42e8-4c20-852e-105ed6123096"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the condition of being protected from danger, risk, or injury, often in contexts like workplace safety, road safety, or personal security.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "f44e6167-66c2-451d-9367-9cfe874b1125", "textEn": "Safety is our top priority.", "textEs": "La seguridad es nuestra prioridad principal.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "9480b317-0eab-4c91-90e4-4f86c095daf2"}, {"id": "f0829434-ca72-41f1-9844-79aeb8e30fdb", "textEn": "Always wear a seatbelt for safety.", "textEs": "Siempre usa el cinturón de seguridad por seguridad.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "9480b317-0eab-4c91-90e4-4f86c095daf2"}, {"id": "5ca5bf45-f274-4a99-bce5-4461cb4ba697", "textEn": "The safety of the children is our top priority.", "textEs": "La seguridad de los niños es nuestra máxima prioridad.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "9480b317-0eab-4c91-90e4-4f86c095daf2"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used when asking for money back, like 'I'd like a refund.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "5f165b2b-5923-4626-b6fa-d9fee2c090dd", "textEn": "I asked for a refund on the defective item.", "textEs": "Pedí un reembolso por el artículo defectuoso.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "938ee5eb-2b96-4b96-bf7b-bc7bde4b5f9b"}, {"id": "0faa19fc-50f4-4a9d-a18a-342f7effdc55", "textEn": "The store offers a full refund within 30 days.", "textEs": "La tienda ofrece un reembolso completo dentro de 30 días.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "938ee5eb-2b96-4b96-bf7b-bc7bde4b5f9b"}, {"id": "6a45d132-6489-46c9-b8d1-28e64bae0729", "textEn": "I'd like to get a refund for this defective item.", "textEs": "Me gustaría obtener un reembolso por este artículo defectuoso.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "938ee5eb-2b96-4b96-bf7b-bc7bde4b5f9b"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the animal, often in farming or pastoral contexts, or metaphorically to describe someone who follows others without thinking.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "30702950-cc92-4161-917d-226edb52ce64", "textEn": "The sheep are grazing in the field.", "textEs": "Las ovejas están pastando en el campo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "35f7a1da-6e49-455e-8303-42e9808e2acb"}, {"id": "ed88dce0-49d3-46e5-8539-c3de545b6419", "textEn": "A sheep jumped over the fence.", "textEs": "Una oveja saltó sobre la cerca.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "35f7a1da-6e49-455e-8303-42e9808e2acb"}, {"id": "191d564f-272e-42ea-8dda-5c30d5fce7fb", "textEn": "The sheep were bleating loudly in the field.", "textEs": "Las ovejas estaban balando fuertemente en el campo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "35f7a1da-6e49-455e-8303-42e9808e2acb"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to indicate having enough money or resources for something, often in negative constructions like 'can't afford' to express inability.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "fc605567-cb13-4091-a886-6ba9fc3fc47b", "textEn": "I can't afford a new car right now.", "textEs": "No puedo permitirme un coche nuevo ahora.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "48ca8546-362c-40c3-b7fc-86f7e313e5f6"}, {"id": "d06c1822-b2b9-40c5-af9c-021a872b73f9", "textEn": "Can we afford to go on vacation this year?", "textEs": "¿Podemos permitirnos ir de vacaciones este año?", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "48ca8546-362c-40c3-b7fc-86f7e313e5f6"}, {"id": "0b60348e-6166-4428-898a-787dab0bbfa6", "textEn": "I can't afford to buy a new car right now.", "textEs": "No puedo permitirme comprar un coche nuevo ahora mismo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "48ca8546-362c-40c3-b7fc-86f7e313e5f6"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something with little thickness, like a thin slice of bread, or a person who is slender.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "c9a34be9-bf18-4947-94e6-91a14b0593b1", "textEn": "The ice is too thin to walk on.", "textEs": "El hielo es demasiado delgado para caminar sobre él.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "266c101a-0917-47d6-b712-9c146c9b2202"}, {"id": "6f359a97-15fa-4980-b89c-ec997072cbe6", "textEn": "She has thin hair.", "textEs": "Ella tiene el cabello fino.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "266c101a-0917-47d6-b712-9c146c9b2202"}, {"id": "c47a412e-2c66-4a55-8fe5-8c8172fce2b5", "textEn": "The soup is too thin; it needs more vegetables.", "textEs": "La sopa está muy aguada; necesita más verduras.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "266c101a-0917-47d6-b712-9c146c9b2202"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe the sharp side of a blade or a boundary, often in phrases like 'on edge' meaning nervous or tense.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "5ff6372f-20b1-445c-b036-dc5b04dfc6f3", "textEn": "Be careful near the edge of the cliff.", "textEs": "Ten cuidado cerca del borde del acantilado.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "d09fa96b-1577-465c-be6d-f77c5cb63094"}, {"id": "91c8fb9d-b69a-4ce6-a240-9d519f366774", "textEn": "He sat on the edge of the bed.", "textEs": "Él se sentó en el borde de la cama.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "d09fa96b-1577-465c-be6d-f77c5cb63094"}, {"id": "b39981a6-37a5-4c54-b765-0e39328f4a2c", "textEn": "I heard a sharp edge in his voice when he talked about the project.", "textEs": "Escuché un filo en su voz cuando habló del proyecto.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "d09fa96b-1577-465c-be6d-f77c5cb63094"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a plot of land for growing flowers, vegetables, or plants, often in a residential backyard.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "954af0a9-0c89-48d5-8ed1-a1d9a7e10339", "textEn": "I love spending time in my garden.", "textEs": "Me encanta pasar tiempo en mi jardín.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "a31cffec-43a1-4836-9d51-e801000b3305"}, {"id": "1360d3f2-ebd9-4ea8-b44b-1b779ae1cbfe", "textEn": "The garden is full of flowers.", "textEs": "El jardín está lleno de flores.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "a31cffec-43a1-4836-9d51-e801000b3305"}, {"id": "ceb0020a-500b-4150-acdf-88a42f9cd72a", "textEn": "I love the sound of birds in my garden every morning.", "textEs": "Me encanta el sonido de los pájaros en mi jardín cada mañana.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "a31cffec-43a1-4836-9d51-e801000b3305"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the stringed musical instrument, often in casual conversation about music or playing.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "414ea377-8956-49c3-897b-763418c81bfe", "textEn": "He plays the guitar every evening.", "textEs": "Él toca la guitarra cada tarde.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "e7df7ed0-1184-4c3f-9169-16be57086552"}, {"id": "37e8bbf1-a7df-4d80-b4af-a9f250be5abf", "textEn": "I bought a new guitar yesterday.", "textEs": "Compré una guitarra nueva ayer.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "e7df7ed0-1184-4c3f-9169-16be57086552"}, {"id": "62c94bfb-c60d-455e-8852-1fcb81f8364a", "textEn": "I've been practicing the guitar every evening for the past month.", "textEs": "He estado practicando la guitarra cada tarde durante el último mes.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "e7df7ed0-1184-4c3f-9169-16be57086552"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the body part at the end of the arm, or to indicate possession or control, e.g., 'Give me your hand' or 'He has a hand in the project.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "c4eb9190-499d-44cd-ad72-4ce7f4889dc5", "textEn": "Raise your hand if you know.", "textEs": "Levanta la mano si sabes.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "08477145-4717-4f51-98ab-dffc13006e57"}, {"id": "169941a5-2147-4202-9324-f199fd54832e", "textEn": "She hurt her hand.", "textEs": "Ella se lastimó la mano.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "08477145-4717-4f51-98ab-dffc13006e57"}, {"id": "2f81b759-9958-44da-9d17-a7e7cc37b197", "textEn": "Give me a hand with these bags, please.", "textEs": "Échame una mano con estas bolsas, por favor.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "08477145-4717-4f51-98ab-dffc13006e57"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something well-known or recognized from past experience, often in casual conversation like 'That sounds familiar.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "dc4a59f2-cc95-4962-901b-575ca2fe8967", "textEn": "That song sounds familiar to me.", "textEs": "Esa canción me suena familiar.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "0102a714-6954-4d77-ad28-8ce2a77a1379"}, {"id": "4a28b1c0-4dbd-4ff8-9e23-f36b3f138a4c", "textEn": "Are you familiar with this software?", "textEs": "¿Estás familiarizado con este software?", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "0102a714-6954-4d77-ad28-8ce2a77a1379"}, {"id": "890d642a-dc14-4ae0-80f6-67d3b42675eb", "textEn": "That melody sounds familiar, but I can't place the name.", "textEs": "Esa melodía suena familiar, pero no recuerdo el nombre.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "0102a714-6954-4d77-ad28-8ce2a77a1379"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to express happiness or relief about something, often in casual conversation like 'I'm glad you made it.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "47a485b3-3760-4c55-9db0-133093f754c1", "textEn": "I am glad to see you.", "textEs": "Estoy contento de verte.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "d84efe77-e734-40d8-9ab7-7a2556433b1f"}, {"id": "25c5c3ae-ca7c-45ea-8c1a-9b5f9bcf06eb", "textEn": "She felt glad about the news.", "textEs": "Ella se sintió alegre por la noticia.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "d84efe77-e734-40d8-9ab7-7a2556433b1f"}, {"id": "8d385445-b221-4d23-b4c3-63d9d82ac371", "textEn": "I'm so glad you could make it to the party!", "textEs": "¡Estoy tan contento de que hayas podido venir a la fiesta!", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "d84efe77-e734-40d8-9ab7-7a2556433b1f"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a present given to someone, or a natural talent or ability.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "e6a4e169-9a21-4477-9277-ef93592d639b", "textEn": "She gave me a beautiful gift.", "textEs": "Ella me dio un hermoso regalo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "dc6be4f5-64b7-40f7-801e-a833bc2e0390"}, {"id": "b99410d3-9fbb-47ec-a4aa-994801d19cc1", "textEn": "This gift is for you.", "textEs": "Este regalo es para ti.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "dc6be4f5-64b7-40f7-801e-a833bc2e0390"}, {"id": "021a4764-e396-4b35-a353-426d497376e6", "textEn": "She has a real gift for making people feel comfortable in awkward situations.", "textEs": "Ella tiene un verdadero don para hacer que la gente se sienta cómoda en situaciones incómodas.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "dc6be4f5-64b7-40f7-801e-a833bc2e0390"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in casual, fast speech as a contraction of 'give me', often when asking for something informally, like 'Gimme that!'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "dc3b08f7-0441-4c20-8438-31dc08982071", "textEn": "Gimme a minute, I'll be ready.", "textEs": "Dame un minuto, estaré listo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "cb45f073-b63c-4824-afdb-b58662f4310b"}, {"id": "1f44cd88-6e27-4dee-bad5-9260a50134f5", "textEn": "Gimme that book, please.", "textEs": "Dame ese libro, por favor.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "cb45f073-b63c-4824-afdb-b58662f4310b"}, {"id": "d8b5d5a1-f443-4581-9abf-2e6da7a435ce", "textEn": "Gimme a minute, I'm almost ready.", "textEs": "Dame un minuto, ya casi estoy listo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "cb45f073-b63c-4824-afdb-b58662f4310b"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe how someone acts or conducts themselves, often in a social or moral context, like telling a child to 'behave' or saying someone 'behaved badly'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "c1226183-6c9e-4f84-9760-9d9043b38856", "textEn": "Please behave yourself.", "textEs": "Por favor, compórtate.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "1d8b37d3-b951-4dfa-94b9-bfd13f737272"}, {"id": "6df4a5fa-b833-4808-ae48-38acd9f20891", "textEn": "Children should behave well.", "textEs": "Los niños deben comportarse bien.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "1d8b37d3-b951-4dfa-94b9-bfd13f737272"}, {"id": "cbec7f07-77df-4494-97e6-182a522a71e8", "textEn": "Please behave yourself at the dinner party tonight.", "textEs": "Por favor, pórtate bien en la cena de esta noche.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "1d8b37d3-b951-4dfa-94b9-bfd13f737272"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to urge someone to move or act quickly, often in a slightly impatient or urgent tone.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "96258904-6e90-458c-942e-1cf83f3e6419", "textEn": "We need to hurry up.", "textEs": "Necesitamos darnos prisa.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "dd24eb02-e017-4881-bfb4-e0e9a6b2d935"}, {"id": "2add5757-3944-420d-a297-1bfa37405621", "textEn": "Don't hurry, take your time.", "textEs": "No te apresures, tómate tu tiempo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "dd24eb02-e017-4881-bfb4-e0e9a6b2d935"}, {"id": "a47b108c-73a1-4e78-a252-b76a9d511411", "textEn": "Hurry up, we're going to miss the bus!", "textEs": "¡Date prisa, vamos a perder el autobús!", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "dd24eb02-e017-4881-bfb4-e0e9a6b2d935"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe swallowing quickly or audibly, often due to nervousness, surprise, or strong emotion, as in 'He took a gulp of water.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "4e28c815-4d33-4b49-8d59-670e741527f9", "textEn": "He took a big gulp of water.", "textEs": "Él dio un gran trago de agua.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "806c5c80-580e-462c-a1f6-f49b838ce5b0"}, {"id": "6912ebd6-2081-4060-9b33-f93421d3a974", "textEn": "Don't gulp your food; eat slowly.", "textEs": "No engullas tu comida; come despacio.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "806c5c80-580e-462c-a1f6-f49b838ce5b0"}, {"id": "3f8412ea-ef3f-4b65-b19a-74c1c9b6017e", "textEn": "I heard a loud gulp as he swallowed his drink.", "textEs": "Escuché un trago fuerte mientras bebía.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "806c5c80-580e-462c-a1f6-f49b838ce5b0"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe an event or occurrence, often in casual conversation about something that took place.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "50de92cc-fd76-4148-aa79-fed57bf18dbb", "textEn": "What will happen next?", "textEs": "¿Qué sucederá después?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "564db9cb-742b-497e-8f67-8e7dffeb0860"}, {"id": "55636f2c-1a6b-4fd5-9eae-19cefce9cc27", "textEn": "Accidents can happen anytime.", "textEs": "Los accidentes pueden ocurrir en cualquier momento.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "564db9cb-742b-497e-8f67-8e7dffeb0860"}, {"id": "b23a59d3-be92-4eab-851f-59bf93d7528f", "textEn": "I happen to know the answer to that question.", "textEs": "Resulta que sé la respuesta a esa pregunta.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "564db9cb-742b-497e-8f67-8e7dffeb0860"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something big in size, amount, or scale; common in everyday speech for physical objects, quantities, or abstract concepts.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "c6c3cf8c-8fc4-49c8-8957-cccbd0fd2db8", "textEn": "They live in a large house.", "textEs": "Ellos viven en una casa grande.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "93b4950b-6f5e-4dcf-b61a-402b7689bda3"}, {"id": "2a1373fb-6cd3-43cf-8eed-eec328c86002", "textEn": "I need a large coffee, please.", "textEs": "Necesito un café grande, por favor.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "93b4950b-6f5e-4dcf-b61a-402b7689bda3"}, {"id": "3af21afc-7aa6-4ab5-94ad-83d95ee1b3fd", "textEn": "The room was large enough to hold over 200 people.", "textEs": "La habitación era lo suficientemente grande para albergar a más de 200 personas.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "93b4950b-6f5e-4dcf-b61a-402b7689bda3"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe a brief, quick look at something, often implying it was partial or not fully seen.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "872feee7-d198-4e92-9378-6a3d088a5245", "textEn": "I caught a glimpse of the sunset.", "textEs": "Vislumbré la puesta de sol.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "346e122a-4635-45fe-b8a2-2376d076c80b"}, {"id": "42744206-3e5e-4fb9-9a86-2ab3c64dc67a", "textEn": "She only had a glimpse of the stranger.", "textEs": "Ella solo echó un vistazo al desconocido.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "346e122a-4635-45fe-b8a2-2376d076c80b"}, {"id": "685a453c-07e4-4479-a6bf-ae60e89556b3", "textEn": "I caught a glimpse of the celebrity as she hurried into the car.", "textEs": "Vi un vistazo de la celebridad cuando se apresuró a entrar al coche.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "346e122a-4635-45fe-b8a2-2376d076c80b"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to emphasize the absolute nature of something, like 'sheer luck' or 'sheer size,' often in informal or dramatic contexts.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "7277585f-a26b-44d1-82e8-2b833a446847", "textEn": "It was sheer luck.", "textEs": "Fue pura suerte.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "edc968ed-eafc-4226-aa12-0f08e38b1e1c"}, {"id": "834da449-a09b-49be-a3c8-75667308f3e3", "textEn": "The cliff has a sheer drop.", "textEs": "El acantilado tiene una caída vertical.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "edc968ed-eafc-4226-aa12-0f08e38b1e1c"}, {"id": "ab7246a3-083a-4ad4-9e14-0d5aafdf096e", "textEn": "The sheer size of the building was overwhelming.", "textEs": "El tamaño absoluto del edificio era abrumador.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "edc968ed-eafc-4226-aa12-0f08e38b1e1c"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a place that provides lodging, meals, and other services for travelers and tourists.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "b1d7498b-dddf-4937-aef7-b63b9add775b", "textEn": "We stayed at a nice hotel.", "textEs": "Nos quedamos en un hotel bonito.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "cb931170-5782-42fd-b97b-0fed2c4beebf"}, {"id": "e4464298-561a-436e-9400-1a0d99ab5920", "textEn": "The hotel has a pool.", "textEs": "El hotel tiene una piscina.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "cb931170-5782-42fd-b97b-0fed2c4beebf"}, {"id": "289cdd1b-0acd-48f0-914b-d360ee788095", "textEn": "I booked a hotel near the beach for our vacation.", "textEs": "Reservé un hotel cerca de la playa para nuestras vacaciones.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "cb931170-5782-42fd-b97b-0fed2c4beebf"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe connecting or becoming part of something, like joining a group or attaching two objects together.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "ebaa813b-fecd-49cc-be9f-26bc572bfd5c", "textEn": "Would you like to join us for dinner?", "textEs": "¿Te gustaría unirte a nosotros para cenar?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "44912816-49e9-4b76-b21d-0441310daa9a"}, {"id": "003d9230-9d8c-4431-8dbc-bd3f2f79686a", "textEn": "She decided to join the club.", "textEs": "Ella decidió unirse al club.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "44912816-49e9-4b76-b21d-0441310daa9a"}, {"id": "11c0a2d3-17e0-4a21-8075-3be51e176109", "textEn": "I'll join you for lunch tomorrow.", "textEs": "Te acompañaré a almorzar mañana.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "44912816-49e9-4b76-b21d-0441310daa9a"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally to mean take or seize something quickly, often in commands like 'grab a seat' or 'grab some food'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "d59216eb-2b7a-497d-a4e7-a2379bd2c3d8", "textEn": "He tried to grab the ball.", "textEs": "Él intentó agarrar la pelota.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "9eaafae2-7097-4b48-96f2-d59331a51a61"}, {"id": "11086135-b25e-4930-bd33-1617ba2bb268", "textEn": "Grab a seat before they're all taken.", "textEs": "Agarra un asiento antes de que se acaben.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "9eaafae2-7097-4b48-96f2-d59331a51a61"}, {"id": "db0a270c-ed95-4009-ae57-226baf6843df", "textEn": "I need to grab my keys before we leave.", "textEs": "Necesito agarrar mis llaves antes de que nos vayamos.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "9eaafae2-7097-4b48-96f2-d59331a51a61"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to emphasize something very large in size, amount, or degree, often in an enthusiastic or exaggerated way.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "b0e7f733-7269-4c07-b469-fae5c39613c7", "textEn": "That is a huge building.", "textEs": "Ese es un edificio enorme.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "a1e15097-1148-4b8c-ac40-6b190c13ef43"}, {"id": "21a0eac2-1c5e-455a-a204-2349555ca62e", "textEn": "She has a huge smile.", "textEs": "Ella tiene una sonrisa enorme.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "a1e15097-1148-4b8c-ac40-6b190c13ef43"}, {"id": "a1845b3b-7104-46f6-b283-da3d730a8777", "textEn": "That movie was a huge success at the box office.", "textEs": "Esa película fue un gran éxito en taquilla.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "a1e15097-1148-4b8c-ac40-6b190c13ef43"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe physical increase in size or development, like plants or children, or metaphorically for skills or relationships.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "fa7eada9-fd6f-48f5-9f4f-eda3a8129a03", "textEn": "Plants grow quickly in the sun.", "textEs": "Las plantas crecen rápido bajo el sol.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "8552cec3-034a-49bb-9c1d-faed1810a429"}, {"id": "78d97df8-77ac-4bac-9667-802e54569eef", "textEn": "Children grow so fast.", "textEs": "Los niños crecen tan rápido.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "8552cec3-034a-49bb-9c1d-faed1810a429"}, {"id": "f126b054-a9a3-4f39-bfd9-c85b019834c4", "textEn": "The sound of the baby's laughter made my heart grow.", "textEs": "El sonido de la risa del bebé hizo crecer mi corazón.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "8552cec3-034a-49bb-9c1d-faed1810a429"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to express a deep, persistent desire for something or someone, often with a sense of melancholy or nostalgia.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "4a7e909b-7930-4101-9e61-2a13d9a8fe26", "textEn": "She felt a deep longing for her homeland.", "textEs": "Sintió un profundo anhelo por su tierra natal.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "ba374356-89d8-42d7-b5a3-a522dc98ed89"}, {"id": "0c1c65aa-b313-4dce-9918-74d9e8c740d3", "textEn": "His longing for adventure grew stronger every day.", "textEs": "Su anhelo de aventura se hacía más fuerte cada día.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "ba374356-89d8-42d7-b5a3-a522dc98ed89"}, {"id": "f16b8e98-7ea2-41c7-8706-267a9b81ed30", "textEn": "She felt a deep longing for her childhood home.", "textEs": "Sintió un profundo anhelo por su hogar de la infancia.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "ba374356-89d8-42d7-b5a3-a522dc98ed89"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe collecting things or people coming together, often in casual contexts like 'gather your things' or 'we should gather for a meeting'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "b8646e43-d34e-4b5c-8f3e-454ae5fcf431", "textEn": "Let's gather some wood for the fire.", "textEs": "Reunamos algo de leña para el fuego.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "55112c06-be93-4816-9ed7-e1d6777e056a"}, {"id": "2b014d62-1f1e-4f17-a88e-d42d944347f9", "textEn": "They gather every Sunday for lunch.", "textEs": "Se reúnen cada domingo para almorzar.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "55112c06-be93-4816-9ed7-e1d6777e056a"}, {"id": "9d64e807-0877-408f-ae72-9f0954e0a6d4", "textEn": "The leaves gather in piles along the sidewalk in autumn.", "textEs": "Las hojas se acumulan en montones a lo largo de la acera en otoño.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "55112c06-be93-4816-9ed7-e1d6777e056a"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe a soft, steady light or a healthy radiance, often in contexts like skin, stars, or emotions.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "0c02a372-63e5-40b8-90c7-a2a1f9819fd1", "textEn": "The stars glow in the dark sky.", "textEs": "Las estrellas brillan en el cielo oscuro.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "6470faac-cd90-49b2-afd2-b8daa1a510c9"}, {"id": "2b0af0df-19ac-42e7-9803-f0fc196ba782", "textEn": "Her face had a healthy glow.", "textEs": "Su rostro tenía un brillo saludable.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "6470faac-cd90-49b2-afd2-b8daa1a510c9"}, {"id": "73341645-4e00-4c2f-bd11-542f337636ad", "textEn": "Her skin has a natural glow after using that new moisturizer.", "textEs": "Su piel tiene un brillo natural después de usar esa nueva crema hidratante.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "6470faac-cd90-49b2-afd2-b8daa1a510c9"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a casual, quick way to say 'let me,' often in requests or offers like 'Lemme help you' or 'Lemme see.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "b987b0ee-60ca-4073-95fc-0306b53e258b", "textEn": "Lemme think about it for a second.", "textEs": "Déjame pensar en eso un segundo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "144a4899-333f-406a-b7f1-5090dc66e79e"}, {"id": "382fad77-a652-4cbd-8ac8-05c91ca8f1a4", "textEn": "Lemme help you with that bag.", "textEs": "Déjame ayudarte con esa bolsa.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "144a4899-333f-406a-b7f1-5090dc66e79e"}, {"id": "85495e47-09a8-4e50-a8db-ca4e5e61ad39", "textEn": "Lemme see if I have any change in my pocket.", "textEs": "Déjame ver si tengo cambio en el bolsillo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "144a4899-333f-406a-b7f1-5090dc66e79e"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a noun or adjective to refer to people, often in contrast to animals or machines, e.g., 'We are all human.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "cfd08f8f-ce3a-4a39-9c80-5b73a67475aa", "textEn": "Every human has rights.", "textEs": "Todo humano tiene derechos.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "641c1007-d5c9-40db-99b7-9afe61539a4a"}, {"id": "aa3c7522-4725-4bd2-a91f-29da806e6f85", "textEn": "She is a kind human being.", "textEs": "Ella es un ser humano amable.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "641c1007-d5c9-40db-99b7-9afe61539a4a"}, {"id": "a511ca32-5bf6-4bc2-9d82-eb0c73cb466a", "textEn": "The human brain is incredibly complex.", "textEs": "El cerebro humano es increíblemente complejo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "641c1007-d5c9-40db-99b7-9afe61539a4a"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to indicate something in front or forward in position, time, or progress, often in phrases like 'go ahead' or 'ahead of schedule'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "84050a70-c22b-46e4-a6dc-88d9883e6509", "textEn": "Look straight ahead.", "textEs": "Mira directamente hacia adelante.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "2998af74-407c-460a-858e-64f205fb17f5"}, {"id": "e5f063e1-4d57-4f48-b129-aaac9ec36462", "textEn": "We have a long road ahead.", "textEs": "Tenemos un largo camino por delante.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "2998af74-407c-460a-858e-64f205fb17f5"}, {"id": "18316ca2-c5ec-4206-8940-984c95416b50", "textEn": "The project is running ahead of schedule.", "textEs": "El proyecto va adelantado al cronograma.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "2998af74-407c-460a-858e-64f205fb17f5"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to express uncertainty or possibility, often as a polite suggestion or hedge in conversation.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "ad3733e0-59e2-432e-9b28-f3af9891b5a6", "textEn": "Perhaps we can go tomorrow.", "textEs": "Quizás podamos ir mañana.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "20cc58cb-dd11-4ba4-b86a-65518f7b026c"}, {"id": "b56ffc3a-3950-43ab-af37-1e42165490a9", "textEn": "Perhaps he is right.", "textEs": "Tal vez él tenga razón.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "20cc58cb-dd11-4ba4-b86a-65518f7b026c"}, {"id": "002adb23-fe16-4725-b4e2-3ba4bb0e67af", "textEn": "Perhaps we should take a different route to avoid the traffic.", "textEs": "Quizás deberíamos tomar una ruta diferente para evitar el tráfico.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "20cc58cb-dd11-4ba4-b86a-65518f7b026c"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe making something different, swapping items, or getting money in smaller denominations; common in everyday talk about altering plans or exchanging currency.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "d0dd008f-4499-4aca-81b9-44fd03931baa", "textEn": "We need to change our plans.", "textEs": "Necesitamos cambiar nuestros planes.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "c997d7e9-223f-487d-b3a3-a79127cfe371"}, {"id": "ac00cd9e-6eb3-4ec1-903e-eab3b3860da7", "textEn": "Do you have change for a dollar?", "textEs": "¿Tienes cambio para un dólar?", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "c997d7e9-223f-487d-b3a3-a79127cfe371"}, {"id": "c54d03eb-266d-46cc-8846-ef4de431165c", "textEn": "Can you change a twenty-dollar bill for me?", "textEs": "¿Puedes cambiarme un billete de veinte dólares?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "c997d7e9-223f-487d-b3a3-a79127cfe371"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a verb for preparing food by heating, or as a noun for a person who does this; common in everyday conversation about meals and recipes.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "7689a7b6-4b65-4a0d-8a6e-df200ad50c77", "textEn": "I need to cook dinner tonight.", "textEs": "Necesito cocinar la cena esta noche.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "4a1b6e94-7365-44a2-9ad6-ac7517197469"}, {"id": "e68185f7-18ef-4700-bdf7-a6b93d4275d6", "textEn": "She can cook very well.", "textEs": "Ella cocina muy bien.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "4a1b6e94-7365-44a2-9ad6-ac7517197469"}, {"id": "44309591-57ab-4e78-aa6f-860b54acf9df", "textEn": "I can cook Italian food really well.", "textEs": "Puedo cocinar comida italiana muy bien.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "4a1b6e94-7365-44a2-9ad6-ac7517197469"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a toy flown in the wind on a string, or informally to describe someone who is very high or flying high, like on drugs or in a euphoric state.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "f8b21535-2f10-4eea-9d73-e219d5525965", "textEn": "The boy flew his kite in the park.", "textEs": "El niño voló su cometa en el parque.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "e1464514-f319-4264-8927-c298a148de05"}, {"id": "8fd62710-e434-473d-b78e-b191cc43206c", "textEn": "A red kite is high in the sky.", "textEs": "Una cometa roja está alta en el cielo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "e1464514-f319-4264-8927-c298a148de05"}, {"id": "c78ef17a-cea8-4bb9-97d7-6821c8702b22", "textEn": "The kids were flying a kite at the park.", "textEs": "Los niños estaban volando una cometa en el parque.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "e1464514-f319-4264-8927-c298a148de05"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a time-telling device, or informally as a verb meaning to hit or to notice something.
