flashcards.examples: [{"id": "44f219a0-4c6e-439a-b0c9-5410e2c3797d", "textEn": "The clock on the wall stopped.", "textEs": "El reloj en la pared se detuvo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "7362e4b5-3071-472b-9f94-760a26c35436"}, {"id": "6e651710-6518-45bc-95d1-eba73b17ee89", "textEn": "Check the clock before you go.", "textEs": "Revisa el reloj antes de irte.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "7362e4b5-3071-472b-9f94-760a26c35436"}, {"id": "54601d2a-2e80-4c46-a08a-c5d811981f00", "textEn": "I can hear the clock ticking in the library.", "textEs": "Puedo oír el tictac del reloj en la biblioteca.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "7362e4b5-3071-472b-9f94-760a26c35436"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a stone, a genre of music, or to describe something as stable or cool, often in casual conversation.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "c5e8dd28-36b0-4595-9132-5a3e6aea5d09", "textEn": "He threw a rock into the pond.", "textEs": "Él lanzó una roca al estanque.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "9add9739-c8a2-46f3-b612-49cf7aa07035"}, {"id": "d36fe886-67b0-43e6-b887-0908d444d4de", "textEn": "The rock is hot from the sun.", "textEs": "La roca está caliente por el sol.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "9add9739-c8a2-46f3-b612-49cf7aa07035"}, {"id": "d763ff5f-72df-4cc6-b553-f23b2d377feb", "textEn": "The baby was gently rocked to sleep in her mother's arms.", "textEs": "El bebé fue mecido suavemente para dormir en los brazos de su madre.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "9add9739-c8a2-46f3-b612-49cf7aa07035"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to choose or select something, often with a hand, or to pluck a fruit or flower.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "6ecd6cbe-528c-4b13-995a-649d23a8fc6b", "textEn": "Please pick a card from the deck.", "textEs": "Por favor, escoge una carta del mazo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "8450ff85-47f8-461d-8958-2526971fc010"}, {"id": "e0e9ccde-2b42-43fd-b5fc-f1c52f013d1a", "textEn": "I will pick you up at eight.", "textEs": "Te recogeré a las ocho.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "8450ff85-47f8-461d-8958-2526971fc010"}, {"id": "3dc9d01e-ba83-4a7a-b86a-685bb750e5cb", "textEn": "I'll pick you up at 7 PM.", "textEs": "Te recogeré a las 7 PM.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "8450ff85-47f8-461d-8958-2526971fc010"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a timekeeping device, or informally as a verb meaning to hit or to notice something.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "895882f8-6d2f-463d-84df-8bf1d8e5b6d4", "textEn": "The clock on the wall is broken.", "textEs": "El reloj en la pared está roto.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "4f389436-6f77-4c5a-8989-4ce5394224b3"}, {"id": "c870897c-013a-4e99-8635-f0f068f7111e", "textEn": "I need to clock in at nine.", "textEs": "Necesito marcar entrada a las nueve.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "4f389436-6f77-4c5a-8989-4ce5394224b3"}, {"id": "78ada89d-2166-40ac-9cd5-a99e20bf2748", "textEn": "The old grandfather clock chimed twelve times at midnight.", "textEs": "El viejo reloj de pie dio doce campanadas a medianoche.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "4f389436-6f77-4c5a-8989-4ce5394224b3"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe striking something with the foot, often in sports or casual talk about actions or reactions.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "1dd7e02b-d8f3-4352-a098-bf24a2577599", "textEn": "He tried to kick the ball far.", "textEs": "Él intentó patear la pelota lejos.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "dd522dae-bd7a-46b1-9044-2b492c80164a"}, {"id": "2bdc6639-59c6-4d57-8980-44dffc3818d0", "textEn": "Don't kick the chair.", "textEs": "No patees la silla.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "dd522dae-bd7a-46b1-9044-2b492c80164a"}, {"id": "d261b49f-784a-4f1e-91fc-1cb082f65906", "textEn": "I heard a loud kick coming from the other room.", "textEs": "Escuché una patada fuerte proveniente de la otra habitación.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "dd522dae-bd7a-46b1-9044-2b492c80164a"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a large bag for storing items, or informally to mean being fired from a job, as in 'get the sack'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "308a0525-3e8b-46b8-a47b-27a4905c08f5", "textEn": "He carried a sack of potatoes.", "textEs": "Él llevó un saco de papas.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "80fb238c-e923-4551-8453-364c6d659f3d"}, {"id": "91355aea-4615-4d13-b3e9-68e65d9603ea", "textEn": "The sack was heavy.", "textEs": "El saco estaba pesado.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "80fb238c-e923-4551-8453-364c6d659f3d"}, {"id": "e12d5612-f25a-4883-883e-73651d79ec48", "textEn": "I'm going to hit the sack; I'm exhausted.", "textEs": "Me voy a ir a la cama; estoy agotado.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "80fb238c-e923-4551-8453-364c6d659f3d"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a sandy or pebbly shore by the ocean, often in casual contexts like 'Let's go to the beach.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "ad428217-997a-413b-9820-d5f9cd9e3212", "textEn": "Let's go to the beach this weekend.", "textEs": "Vamos a la playa este fin de semana.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "8fb9224d-9ae0-4485-a9eb-80a656db60fe"}, {"id": "0e569d5e-528e-4bfd-ad8b-55c980f9ceab", "textEn": "The beach was crowded with tourists.", "textEs": "La playa estaba llena de turistas.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "8fb9224d-9ae0-4485-a9eb-80a656db60fe"}, {"id": "5b96e569-32b6-46ae-bc77-9c43ea18196b", "textEn": "Let's hit the beach this weekend and catch some waves.", "textEs": "Vamos a la playa este fin de semana y atrapemos algunas olas.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "8fb9224d-9ae0-4485-a9eb-80a656db60fe"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the part of a shirt that goes around the neck, or a band worn around an animal's neck, often in everyday contexts like getting dressed or walking a dog.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "2cf26925-a3a4-489f-bb40-3730efad700f", "textEn": "The dog has a red collar.", "textEs": "El perro tiene un collar rojo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "0dfb5d67-9558-4cb7-9c04-0d3ce2b24149"}, {"id": "1829bfd2-de66-4bca-b524-2cb1364f430f", "textEn": "He grabbed him by the collar.", "textEs": "Lo agarró por el collar.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "0dfb5d67-9558-4cb7-9c04-0d3ce2b24149"}, {"id": "0c1f4675-d5a1-4cc5-91fa-6fa2877f1aac", "textEn": "The dog's collar jingled as it ran across the yard.", "textEs": "El collar del perro tintineó mientras corría por el patio.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "0dfb5d67-9558-4cb7-9c04-0d3ce2b24149"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe a rectangular block of hard material, or informally to refer to a heavy, solid object or a reliable person.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "381a4a6d-2e9c-493b-b12d-81968af5f9db", "textEn": "The house is made of brick.", "textEs": "La casa está hecha de ladrillo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "e23e1804-0020-41c2-b314-92fdbe3ca08b"}, {"id": "2cb8c36b-5ed2-4598-82c8-a142ff262a29", "textEn": "He threw a brick through the window.", "textEs": "Él lanzó un ladrillo por la ventana.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "e23e1804-0020-41c2-b314-92fdbe3ca08b"}, {"id": "4a631074-f6e9-4335-be01-249173edbf2e", "textEn": "I nearly dropped my phone when I realized it was a brick after the update.", "textEs": "Casi se me cayó el teléfono cuando me di cuenta de que se había quedado inservible después de la actualización.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "e23e1804-0020-41c2-b314-92fdbe3ca08b"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the pointed end of something, a piece of advice, or a gratuity given for service.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "c9a95ffa-3936-4f49-97c1-20e41e0fc3f0", "textEn": "The tip of the pencil is sharp.", "textEs": "La punta del lápiz está afilada.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "90271623-382b-4b74-ba77-907db3d773c7"}, {"id": "5d4ea803-84d1-45bb-a37f-b16fea32c087", "textEn": "He left a tip for the waiter.", "textEs": "Dejó una propina para el mesero.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "90271623-382b-4b74-ba77-907db3d773c7"}, {"id": "afbf9d73-f81a-49e2-a0fd-917548a19f0b", "textEn": "Could you give me some tips on how to improve my Spanish?", "textEs": "¿Podrías darme algunos consejos sobre cómo mejorar mi español?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "90271623-382b-4b74-ba77-907db3d773c7"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to firmly command someone to cease an action, often with emphasis on 'stop' to convey urgency or frustration.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "473fc191-f796-40ff-a777-f079405be43c", "textEn": "You must stop at the red light.", "textEs": "Debes parar en el semáforo rojo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "50771daf-9e7a-4b53-ac91-cfe882e3e164"}, {"id": "de6e8ed4-9df2-4772-9960-9a71682f0995", "textEn": "The doctor said you must stop smoking.", "textEs": "El doctor dijo que debes dejar de fumar.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "50771daf-9e7a-4b53-ac91-cfe882e3e164"}, {"id": "43fdf79a-24e3-4658-a946-b5a76e763f24", "textEn": "You must stop eating so much junk food.", "textEs": "Debes dejar de comer tanta comida chatarra.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "50771daf-9e7a-4b53-ac91-cfe882e3e164"}]

[{"id": "a80de205-6202-4c30-a31b-0d057cf43144", "textEn": "She sang a soft lullaby to the baby.", "textEs": "Ella cantó una suave canción de cuna al bebé.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "48b78ed5-ff9f-44fd-b072-c9317c205a99"}, {"id": "2d2b4ba0-88f2-4fa2-8da3-b4cf3926c02a", "textEn": "The lullaby helped him fall asleep quickly.", "textEs": "La canción de cuna lo ayudó a dormirse rápidamente.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "48b78ed5-ff9f-44fd-b072-c9317c205a99"}, {"id": "e388ade2-4cbc-4b02-bc25-aa26c7386b0c", "textEn": "The mother sang a soft lullaby to her baby, who soon fell asleep.", "textEs": "La madre cantó una suave canción de cuna a su bebé, quien pronto se durmió.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "48b78ed5-ff9f-44fd-b072-c9317c205a99"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe staying away from something or preventing it from happening, often in everyday contexts like avoiding traffic or avoiding a topic.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "1b955368-5288-4ded-8e3b-b2eb622a0a22", "textEn": "Try to avoid eating too much sugar.", "textEs": "Trata de evitar comer demasiado azúcar.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "7ec15841-61f0-4361-a112-9637a1709385"}, {"id": "b226fa61-b114-499a-a1c2-0ae42f445629", "textEn": "He avoided the puddle on the sidewalk.", "textEs": "Él evitó el charco en la acera.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "7ec15841-61f0-4361-a112-9637a1709385"}, {"id": "31e76ab2-b9ec-4404-89bb-e71782451094", "textEn": "I always avoid eating too much sugar before bed.", "textEs": "Siempre evito comer demasiada azúcar antes de acostarme.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "7ec15841-61f0-4361-a112-9637a1709385"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe a flower opening or a person's health and beauty flourishing, often in phrases like 'in full bloom' or 'blooming with health'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "fb86463a-a0fe-4608-aa4e-5ef93f725b37", "textEn": "The flowers bloom in spring.", "textEs": "Las flores florecen en primavera.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "5335a119-eccf-477a-9a8e-0f613f0cd9c8"}, {"id": "14fc9995-2996-45ee-bcb2-0c7f6c86bccc", "textEn": "Her talent began to bloom after practice.", "textEs": "Su talento comenzó a florecer después de la práctica.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "5335a119-eccf-477a-9a8e-0f613f0cd9c8"}, {"id": "dd4f7b2e-23ce-4c79-b1f5-ea9f39bbb622", "textEn": "The roses in my garden bloom every spring without fail.", "textEs": "Las rosas en mi jardín florecen cada primavera sin falta.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "5335a119-eccf-477a-9a8e-0f613f0cd9c8"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in British English to refer to the act of washing in a tub or the tub itself; in American English, often pronounced with a short 'a' as /bæθ/.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "001ffd43-36e8-4621-bb04-2a03fde69909", "textEn": "The baby needs a warm bath.", "textEs": "El bebé necesita un baño tibio.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "ff138e4a-ef41-44aa-aaed-fd0ee977e925"}, {"id": "d3098519-4f60-4953-b411-d38d412f6a66", "textEn": "I take a bath every morning.", "textEs": "Me baño cada mañana.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "ff138e4a-ef41-44aa-aaed-fd0ee977e925"}, {"id": "82b69191-af61-4e13-aed5-dfbe07f75b25", "textEn": "I'm going to run a bath before dinner.", "textEs": "Voy a preparar un baño antes de la cena.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "ff138e4a-ef41-44aa-aaed-fd0ee977e925"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe a smooth, effortless movement, like a bird moving through air or someone moving gracefully.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "7b291e03-b3c1-4b1c-8509-508f65aed74e", "textEn": "The bird can glide through the air.", "textEs": "El pájaro puede deslizarse por el aire.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "0ceac89f-13a7-4b46-ac56-8dbb69c48955"}, {"id": "0f4044d4-40fc-4a74-87f2-a67505191e7b", "textEn": "He watched the skater glide across the ice.", "textEs": "Él observó al patinador deslizarse sobre el hielo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "0ceac89f-13a7-4b46-ac56-8dbb69c48955"}, {"id": "d9b608a6-32aa-4761-826e-969ffe4fe260", "textEn": "The skater began to glide gracefully across the ice.", "textEs": "El patinador comenzó a deslizarse con gracia sobre el hielo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "0ceac89f-13a7-4b46-ac56-8dbb69c48955"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a hot, bright stream of burning gas from a fire, or informally to describe a passionate or angry outburst, as in 'fan the flames'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "2d70f2a9-2eef-401e-824f-809e6b8acb88", "textEn": "The flame flickered in the wind.", "textEs": "La llama parpadeó en el viento.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "a763c2a9-0efd-4cc3-af9b-0b9b109c093c"}, {"id": "a6b908a9-5009-4430-8473-d796e1d9c33d", "textEn": "He blew out the candle's flame.", "textEs": "Él apagó la llama de la vela.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "a763c2a9-0efd-4cc3-af9b-0b9b109c093c"}, {"id": "d9d6d6c2-87e0-4017-97b8-0f5249a4ee8c", "textEn": "The flame flickered in the wind before dying out.", "textEs": "La llama parpadeó con el viento antes de apagarse.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "a763c2a9-0efd-4cc3-af9b-0b9b109c093c"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe an inclined surface, like a hill or a line on a graph, or informally to mean to leave or disappear.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "744de45b-6a02-4541-99f9-f9d3f064537c", "textEn": "The slope of the hill is very steep.", "textEs": "La pendiente de la colina es muy empinada.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "050bb4f3-4d3a-43b1-b362-a1f81dca356a"}, {"id": "e5ba5dca-39c4-45b0-9bdb-fb8c7f71fbd8", "textEn": "We walked down the gentle slope.", "textEs": "Caminamos por la pendiente suave.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "050bb4f3-4d3a-43b1-b362-a1f81dca356a"}, {"id": "68cb11d4-9e86-419c-99ef-90303d121bf5", "textEn": "The slope on this hiking trail is really steep.", "textEs": "La pendiente de este sendero de excursión es muy empinada.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "050bb4f3-4d3a-43b1-b362-a1f81dca356a"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a very brief period of time or a specific point in time, often in phrases like 'just a moment' or 'at that moment'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "3c259e67-e1d1-4efd-84f8-78355f878c46", "textEn": "Wait a moment.", "textEs": "Espera un momento.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "e57c1f8f-f191-4843-9d86-f9ef2e3f786b"}, {"id": "3f7f67e9-d506-40dc-9b22-9d48ed4fd9e8", "textEn": "This is a special moment.", "textEs": "Este es un momento especial.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "e57c1f8f-f191-4843-9d86-f9ef2e3f786b"}, {"id": "29c00f7d-4aa6-4340-9aa0-4f69c4785d0e", "textEn": "Hold on a moment, I'll be right with you.", "textEs": "Espera un momento, enseguida estoy contigo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "e57c1f8f-f191-4843-9d86-f9ef2e3f786b"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to prompt someone to visualize or consider a scenario, often in a reflective or persuasive tone.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "6e9ffe6d-a9fa-4837-b80b-345e24970002", "textEn": "Imagine a world without war.", "textEs": "Imagina un mundo sin guerra.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "41353769-08e8-4343-a853-4fece0547804"}, {"id": "fbcb783b-a9e0-425d-8b87-da91fb5c34a5", "textEn": "Can you imagine that?", "textEs": "¿Puedes imaginar eso?", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "41353769-08e8-4343-a853-4fece0547804"}, {"id": "0d27d44d-9084-4967-a62b-71b8d8c0a427", "textEn": "Imagine you're on a beach, listening to the waves.", "textEs": "Imagina que estás en una playa, escuchando las olas.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "41353769-08e8-4343-a853-4fece0547804"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in casual speech as a contraction of 'have to', often to express obligation or necessity, like 'I hafta go now'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "3e1a201b-c11c-4a67-ad8b-582dd763b575", "textEn": "I hafta finish this report by noon.", "textEs": "Tengo que terminar este informe al mediodía.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "2845a5f3-cedb-47a4-8efe-47621ef62c49"}, {"id": "57261e86-0192-4dfc-ad52-c8ff47d4bdd8", "textEn": "We hafta leave early tomorrow.", "textEs": "Tenemos que irnos temprano mañana.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "2845a5f3-cedb-47a4-8efe-47621ef62c49"}, {"id": "5e877c80-63a3-4a89-8118-8f5fa63bdb46", "textEn": "I hafta finish this report by noon.", "textEs": "Tengo que terminar este informe para el mediodía.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "2845a5f3-cedb-47a4-8efe-47621ef62c49"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe holding something tightly or fastening, often with hands or a device.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "2fcc20ab-b291-472b-9971-8184f0695882", "textEn": "She used a clasp to close the necklace.", "textEs": "Ella usó un broche para cerrar el collar.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "b79b2457-2c84-4d18-9940-79680a396760"}, {"id": "99e97011-3fc1-4778-9892-4ac615f5c4df", "textEn": "He clasped his hands together tightly.", "textEs": "Él apretó sus manos juntas fuertemente.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "b79b2457-2c84-4d18-9940-79680a396760"}, {"id": "39310220-7143-4a48-b234-47104bde0fbb", "textEn": "The clasp on her necklace broke, and it fell to the floor.", "textEs": "El broche de su collar se rompió y cayó al suelo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "b79b2457-2c84-4d18-9940-79680a396760"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the joint between the upper and lower arm, or to describe pushing someone aside with the elbow, often in crowded spaces.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "b70255da-ffef-4b7b-bb48-ac298fc55b18", "textEn": "He rested his elbow on the table.", "textEs": "Él apoyó su codo en la mesa.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "cc114e8b-4b7d-4375-b218-d8ad758216b7"}, {"id": "397e10f5-08aa-4a1c-8abc-047a3fb9b500", "textEn": "She hurt her elbow while playing tennis.", "textEs": "Ella se lastimó el codo mientras jugaba tenis.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "cc114e8b-4b7d-4375-b218-d8ad758216b7"}, {"id": "caa7c92f-7168-4681-b799-a34353e0b35e", "textEn": "She elbowed her way through the crowded market.", "textEs": "Se abrió paso a codazos por el abarrotado mercado.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "cc114e8b-4b7d-4375-b218-d8ad758216b7"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a paved path for vehicles, often in directions or travel contexts.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "677d35d1-721f-4a2a-92ad-4556872772db", "textEn": "The road is long and winding.", "textEs": "El camino es largo y sinuoso.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "c8e3653e-310f-4dcf-8578-701b5d3a6c82"}, {"id": "64bff550-cfa9-4878-ab50-d31474388dd4", "textEn": "They live on a quiet road.", "textEs": "Ellos viven en un camino tranquilo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "c8e3653e-310f-4dcf-8578-701b5d3a6c82"}, {"id": "5383632b-cc96-4b60-ae1d-7d143a71622c", "textEn": "The road was slick with rain, so he drove slowly.", "textEs": "El camino estaba resbaladizo por la lluvia, así que condujo despacio.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "c8e3653e-310f-4dcf-8578-701b5d3a6c82"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to indicate possession, membership, or fitting in a particular place or group, often in casual conversation like 'This book belongs to me' or 'You belong here.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "5964c073-ff9d-4e51-a1b4-0b3e1ef6d364", "textEn": "This book belongs to the library.", "textEs": "Este libro pertenece a la biblioteca.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "bddbd324-6082-4c9c-af50-d34a18ad33c8"}, {"id": "2a346a6e-667c-4c9a-9cbb-cbf80cb1bf32", "textEn": "They want to belong to the group.", "textEs": "Ellos quieren pertenecer al grupo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "bddbd324-6082-4c9c-af50-d34a18ad33c8"}, {"id": "c1ba7f84-618a-405a-aea1-6413639cac9d", "textEn": "This book belongs on the top shelf, not down here.", "textEs": "Este libro pertenece al estante superior, no aquí abajo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "bddbd324-6082-4c9c-af50-d34a18ad33c8"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe a smooth, soft fabric or anything with a similar texture; also used metaphorically for something that feels luxurious or goes smoothly.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "6e0f00ba-18ca-4a7d-810f-4926462943a2", "textEn": "The dress is made of fine silk.", "textEs": "El vestido está hecho de seda fina.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "a95650cc-4ce2-4dc4-acf3-8f41fe6de251"}, {"id": "22b3f513-c59c-4f26-b0b9-a338de573f41", "textEn": "She touched the soft silk fabric.", "textEs": "Ella tocó la suave tela de seda.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "a95650cc-4ce2-4dc4-acf3-8f41fe6de251"}, {"id": "3cf09c3c-a24f-47a5-b755-917b8dd35ac8", "textEn": "The fabric felt as smooth as silk against her skin.", "textEs": "La tela se sentía tan suave como la seda contra su piel.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "a95650cc-4ce2-4dc4-acf3-8f41fe6de251"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something living or full of energy, often in phrases like 'alive and well' or 'come alive'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "341528d2-9298-4274-9c50-f028d84c6cbc", "textEn": "The fish is still alive in the tank.", "textEs": "El pez todavía está vivo en el tanque.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "62901dda-4681-4c47-8d09-9b995dc7c225"}, {"id": "f9bca9dc-ab32-44b0-b172-34328f800988", "textEn": "She felt alive after the long run.", "textEs": "Ella se sintió viva después de la larga carrera.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "62901dda-4681-4c47-8d09-9b995dc7c225"}, {"id": "c16c84b6-0ce0-43b3-b867-3b61c8b94f99", "textEn": "The sound of the forest at night was alive with crickets and owls.", "textEs": "El sonido del bosque por la noche estaba vivo con grillos y búhos.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "62901dda-4681-4c47-8d09-9b995dc7c225"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Commonly used to intensify adjectives or adverbs, often pronounced with a quick, light 'r' sound in natural speech.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "5e83d3f3-ef8e-4360-a830-82a78a3e6686", "textEn": "It is very cold today.", "textEs": "Hace mucho frío hoy.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "8302944a-6e4e-4acc-8a71-c2a068cce053"}, {"id": "fcb8ad69-3d66-48dd-9f02-7f2d41c1ddf8", "textEn": "She is very happy.", "textEs": "Ella está muy feliz.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "8302944a-6e4e-4acc-8a71-c2a068cce053"}, {"id": "f9d59398-a7b5-4b2e-a4c6-a1a6f160f15d", "textEn": "I am very happy to see you.", "textEs": "Estoy muy feliz de verte.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "8302944a-6e4e-4acc-8a71-c2a068cce053"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in casual, fast speech as a contraction of 'could have', often in phrases like 'I coulda done that'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "0c0f2439-f97f-44d4-a060-567086646ccd", "textEn": "I coulda been a contender.", "textEs": "Podría haber sido un contendiente.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "a8a8cc03-645b-40d0-aab0-2fa135ee4af3"}, {"id": "899c193e-1bf0-4b3b-890b-76be5a7f9469", "textEn": "You coulda told me earlier.", "textEs": "Podrías habérmelo dicho antes.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "a8a8cc03-645b-40d0-aab0-2fa135ee4af3"}, {"id": "9cf49853-5df6-4d5f-84b9-6a37372ee2bd", "textEn": "I coulda been a contender if I had trained harder.", "textEs": "Podría haber sido un contendiente si hubiera entrenado más.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "a8a8cc03-645b-40d0-aab0-2fa135ee4af3"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something easy to understand or not complicated, often in casual conversation like 'It's simple, just follow the steps.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "ddeb678a-6d74-4e74-811f-e18bed5040b5", "textEn": "The answer is simple.", "textEs": "La respuesta es simple.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "7e7fa99c-21da-4480-a22a-390f6c11599f"}, {"id": "7a723c16-c7d7-4d46-b96d-805c7fb61556", "textEn": "Keep it simple.", "textEs": "Mantenlo simple.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "7e7fa99c-21da-4480-a22a-390f6c11599f"}, {"id": "2b052a05-b3e2-4ca1-8883-b5975c250755", "textEn": "This recipe is simple to follow, even for beginners.", "textEs": "Esta receta es sencilla de seguir, incluso para principiantes.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "7e7fa99c-21da-4480-a22a-390f6c11599f"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally to address or refer to one's mother, often in affectionate or casual contexts.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "e87a104c-de49-4d5a-ad49-50f56d01ba6d", "textEn": "Mama called me for dinner.", "textEs": "Mamá me llamó para cenar.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "eefd1bdf-dea7-4588-9e77-e67bf3be1963"}, {"id": "c9ee385a-3021-40df-823c-2577fc45ea04", "textEn": "I love my mama.", "textEs": "Amo a mi mamá.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "eefd1bdf-dea7-4588-9e77-e67bf3be1963"}, {"id": "22aaf17f-84ec-4b85-8365-0424cbacbc09", "textEn": "The baby said 'mama' for the first time today.", "textEs": "El bebé dijo 'mamá' por primera vez hoy.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "eefd1bdf-dea7-4588-9e77-e67bf3be1963"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in casual speech as a contraction of 'should have,' often in past regrets or missed obligations, like 'I shoulda gone.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "64067445-b2fe-45d4-837d-fd78f4c94ccc", "textEn": "I shoulda studied for the test.", "textEs": "Debería haber estudiado para el examen.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "b1566c9a-44da-4104-b614-4de75b324530"}, {"id": "7a035317-07f6-46e0-ad56-c58c32f22be4", "textEn": "We shoulda taken a different route.", "textEs": "Deberíamos haber tomado una ruta diferente.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "b1566c9a-44da-4104-b614-4de75b324530"}, {"id": "20127184-633c-4a25-af4b-d097047c5d54", "textEn": "I shoulda studied harder for the test.", "textEs": "Debería haber estudiado más para el examen.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "b1566c9a-44da-4104-b614-4de75b324530"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the ability to remember information or past experiences, often in phrases like 'good memory' or 'memory loss'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "70435f72-e854-409b-a067-d916aabf19fa", "textEn": "She has a good memory.", "textEs": "Ella tiene buena memoria.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "09aba083-f939-45b8-b134-5cd7d82c0a10"}, {"id": "3c0a67e9-ddc5-4d6e-b6ef-07b7bc7d46d5", "textEn": "This song brings back a memory.", "textEs": "Esta canción trae un recuerdo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "09aba083-f939-45b8-b134-5cd7d82c0a10"}, {"id": "763574b9-5d3d-4a58-a610-0ee6feba6af2", "textEn": "My memory of that summer is still so vivid.", "textEs": "Mi recuerdo de ese verano sigue siendo muy vívido.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "09aba083-f939-45b8-b134-5cd7d82c0a10"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something that happens often or is found frequently, like 'a common mistake' or 'common sense'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "9b8236e5-bc4a-4d0d-9349-b0d42b51d100", "textEn": "It's a common mistake.", "textEs": "Es un error común.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "b36c272f-6b70-4b8c-9005-8c59936c03b1"}, {"id": "9f084ced-c84b-4434-978a-dda8993389d8", "textEn": "They have common interests.", "textEs": "Tienen intereses comunes.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "b36c272f-6b70-4b8c-9005-8c59936c03b1"}, {"id": "b1be56b4-5c91-4e3b-9c95-c9821086f3c3", "textEn": "It's common for people to shake hands when they meet.", "textEs": "Es común que las personas se den la mano cuando se conocen.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "b36c272f-6b70-4b8c-9005-8c59936c03b1"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a large natural elevation of the earth's surface, often in contexts like hiking, geography, or metaphors for challenges.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "9b4b98f3-8f4f-4dfd-92ba-4bc4876c1cee", "textEn": "We climbed the mountain.", "textEs": "Escalamos la montaña.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "50e9206b-64a6-4432-87af-eec1a61be4e3"}, {"id": "76e3ac17-d847-4cb0-8b74-9d7396a54bae", "textEn": "The mountain is covered in snow.", "textEs": "La montaña está cubierta de nieve.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "50e9206b-64a6-4432-87af-eec1a61be4e3"}, {"id": "8c8a1ca7-e990-409a-88e8-44d0a5d88743", "textEn": "The mountain loomed in the distance, its peak shrouded in mist.", "textEs": "La montaña se erguía a lo lejos, su cima envuelta en niebla.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "50e9206b-64a6-4432-87af-eec1a61be4e3"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe someone or something widely known and recognized, often with a positive connotation.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "5614f728-dc21-4b0a-8405-576036b4c1ba", "textEn": "He is a famous actor.", "textEs": "Él es un actor famoso.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "1ad8d41d-08fc-4158-b8e7-72155395a467"}, {"id": "b8510ce7-5544-45a0-bd1f-1289a93f2286", "textEn": "That restaurant is famous for its pizza.", "textEs": "Ese restaurante es famoso por su pizza.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "1ad8d41d-08fc-4158-b8e7-72155395a467"}, {"id": "3bd8c481-e69c-44eb-9137-c7439a285c6d", "textEn": "She became famous overnight after her video went viral.", "textEs": "Se hizo famosa de la noche a la mañana después de que su video se volviera viral.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "1ad8d41d-08fc-4158-b8e7-72155395a467"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a noun or adjective to refer to people, often in contrast to animals or machines.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "e70e6424-17cd-49f1-96e3-6aeb48b0ad11", "textEn": "Every human has rights.", "textEs": "Todo humano tiene derechos.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "578f63ee-f5d4-4065-a1c7-1aa5b03d2377"}, {"id": "26919d2c-d547-463f-b53d-55231d937b02", "textEn": "She is a kind human.", "textEs": "Ella es un humano amable.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "578f63ee-f5d4-4065-a1c7-1aa5b03d2377"}, {"id": "1a4c7109-b2b9-474e-8e04-d430f4a13f87", "textEn": "The dog let out a low, human-like whine.", "textEs": "El perro emitió un gemido bajo, casi humano.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "578f63ee-f5d4-4065-a1c7-1aa5b03d2377"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a general term for sounds arranged in a pleasing or meaningful way, often referring to songs, instrumental pieces, or the art form itself.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "e320265e-6251-4257-83e4-3915936a41ac", "textEn": "I love listening to music.", "textEs": "Me encanta escuchar música.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "9525c19a-9e54-40b3-bb37-3ada39a22dfa"}, {"id": "81dfc543-04bd-4c5a-ac1c-2b9a3bcbe14c", "textEn": "This music is relaxing.", "textEs": "Esta música es relajante.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "9525c19a-9e54-40b3-bb37-3ada39a22dfa"}, {"id": "901f43f2-348c-400d-9db6-914290afc755", "textEn": "The music was so loud that the whole house was shaking.", "textEs": "La música estaba tan fuerte que toda la casa temblaba.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "9525c19a-9e54-40b3-bb37-3ada39a22dfa"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to tell someone to be quiet, often in a gentle or hushing manner, like putting a finger to your lips.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "691ba99e-fa1a-47a1-857a-114a03536482", "textEn": "The librarian had to shush the noisy students.", "textEs": "La bibliotecaria tuvo que pedir silencio a los estudiantes ruidosos.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "df694c87-5ba7-462d-8bc1-bf5a25af4fa3"}, {"id": "7542a228-6eaf-4a9d-85e5-2d716681ef33", "textEn": "She shushed her little brother during the movie.", "textEs": "Ella hizo callar a su hermanito durante la película.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "df694c87-5ba7-462d-8bc1-bf5a25af4fa3"}, {"id": "e2cb0f0e-fe7b-4661-ac8a-1a96db9b625f", "textEn": "She put her finger to her lips and said, 'Shush, the baby is sleeping.'", "textEs": "Se llevó el dedo a los labios y dijo: 'Shhh, el bebé está durmiendo.'", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "df694c87-5ba7-462d-8bc1-bf5a25af4fa3"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe a bend or smooth turn, often in roads, graphs, or shapes; also slang for something unexpected or surprising.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "80772ba2-0dd9-4932-86da-d029835dac61", "textEn": "The road has a sharp curve.", "textEs": "La carretera tiene una curva pronunciada.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "f66afd64-76bb-4ec1-a4cd-f97ea3a9295f"}, {"id": "bff4489f-29ab-4202-bb3b-0bf5eee99e50", "textEn": "She drew a curve on the paper.", "textEs": "Ella dibujó una curva en el papel.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "f66afd64-76bb-4ec1-a4cd-f97ea3a9295f"}, {"id": "157a8361-7fe4-4c83-9c3d-038d62d11409", "textEn": "The car made a sharp curve on the mountain road.", "textEs": "El coche hizo una curva cerrada en la carretera de montaña.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "f66afd64-76bb-4ec1-a4cd-f97ea3a9295f"}]

flashcards.native_speech: naɪt
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "41c54bb1-52a6-4556-91e4-4c315c76f158", "textEn": "I love walking at night.", "textEs": "Me encanta caminar de noche.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "cfc6e58f-5407-4b70-b19b-153f77a70cc1"}, {"id": "2454af41-8e09-4545-8529-073f896fe0ee", "textEn": "The night sky is beautiful.", "textEs": "El cielo nocturno es hermoso.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "cfc6e58f-5407-4b70-b19b-153f77a70cc1"}, {"id": "d5ea75e1-e9f9-464d-a0a9-2fd86b5c318a", "textEn": "The night was so quiet you could hear a pin drop.", "textEs": "La noche estaba tan silenciosa que se podía oír caer un alfiler.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "cfc6e58f-5407-4b70-b19b-153f77a70cc1"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a noun for the star at the center of our solar system, often in weather talk or daily life, like 'The sun is bright today.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "7301510a-ca8b-4264-845c-d4068f10b661", "textEn": "The sun rises early in the summer.", "textEs": "El sol sale temprano en el verano.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "8614d67a-c0e6-47c1-b00e-e2e659e9e0aa"}, {"id": "073a123e-0ff7-49a9-a01a-2f1199b560cc", "textEn": "We sat in the sun to get warm.", "textEs": "Nos sentamos al sol para calentarnos.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "8614d67a-c0e6-47c1-b00e-e2e659e9e0aa"}, {"id": "e1251a18-b6cb-4fc9-8f05-17cdd17317a8", "textEn": "I love the feel of the warm sun on my skin.", "textEs": "Me encanta la sensación del sol cálido en mi piel.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "8614d67a-c0e6-47c1-b00e-e2e659e9e0aa"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in casual speech as a contraction of 'would have', often in past hypotheticals like 'I woulda gone if I'd known'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "d13903fb-6696-4b7f-bd29-da45ebb81dd1", "textEn": "I woulda come if I'd known.", "textEs": "Habría venido si lo hubiera sabido.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "f87534c1-1f9c-453d-a9f0-07bb87b7e970"}, {"id": "7aaa330c-c31a-49f7-aee6-b9bc0922648c", "textEn": "She woulda loved this song.", "textEs": "A ella le habría encantado esta canción.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "f87534c1-1f9c-453d-a9f0-07bb87b7e970"}, {"id": "a64e0a2a-95ca-4830-942c-902a3693ce02", "textEn": "I woulda gone to the party if I hadn't been so tired.", "textEs": "Habría ido a la fiesta si no hubiera estado tan cansado.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "f87534c1-1f9c-453d-a9f0-07bb87b7e970"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something suspended from above, or informally to mean spending time casually, like 'hanging out'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "4b06429c-dd1c-4e01-b4f3-44d65a0aac70", "textEn": "The picture was hanging crooked on the wall.", "textEs": "El cuadro estaba colgando torcido en la pared.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "7232db82-5635-4f1f-b715-458f88d055b5"}, {"id": "68b5cdb9-beb1-46a9-8021-1abd9cb5925b", "textEn": "She was hanging the laundry out to dry.", "textEs": "Estaba colgando la ropa para que se secara.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "7232db82-5635-4f1f-b715-458f88d055b5"}, {"id": "960ff3d4-c7ff-4ae6-9352-5a7bcddcccda", "textEn": "The hanging chandelier swayed gently in the breeze.", "textEs": "La lámpara de araña colgante se balanceaba suavemente con la brisa.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "7232db82-5635-4f1f-b715-458f88d055b5"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the fruit, or informally to describe something desirable or excellent, like 'a plum job'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "a324ad1f-b694-4dae-922d-627d53933053", "textEn": "The plum was sweet and juicy.", "textEs": "La ciruela estaba dulce y jugosa.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "ed1cde04-039e-44aa-9997-35136d6353e8"}, {"id": "22633b8b-1077-43c5-8f33-e139bebebbf6", "textEn": "He picked a plum from the tree.", "textEs": "Recogió una ciruela del árbol.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "ed1cde04-039e-44aa-9997-35136d6353e8"}, {"id": "924707e9-b3d8-4235-961e-7ec6bfe8d31f", "textEn": "The ripe plum tasted sweet and juicy on a hot summer day.", "textEs": "La ciruela madura sabía dulce y jugosa en un caluroso día de verano.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "ed1cde04-039e-44aa-9997-35136d6353e8"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the sport played with rackets and a ball over a net, often in casual conversation about games, matches, or hobbies.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "af4998f5-d3e8-42e3-be2f-44f1ad8d6a2b", "textEn": "She plays tennis every Saturday.", "textEs": "Ella juega tenis cada sábado.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "530c8184-82b6-46b1-9b22-8bf2b05ad920"}, {"id": "b49a746c-25c8-42d3-a84d-2ea9e6948ee9", "textEn": "Tennis is a popular sport.", "textEs": "El tenis es un deporte popular.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "530c8184-82b6-46b1-9b22-8bf2b05ad920"}, {"id": "908f8f13-bcf3-4355-a06b-f552e69d0758", "textEn": "I'm playing tennis with my friends this weekend.", "textEs": "Voy a jugar al tenis con mis amigos este fin de semana.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "530c8184-82b6-46b1-9b22-8bf2b05ad920"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe water falling from clouds; often in weather talk or metaphorically, like 'rain on someone's parade'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "0d22a56f-ace8-42a9-89c4-65bde97f1d94", "textEn": "The rain stopped suddenly.", "textEs": "La lluvia se detuvo de repente.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "ede8a9f6-2fae-4f08-ba24-c239bc95d9e2"}, {"id": "3518e870-7749-4b93-832a-7d7d0ed5a978", "textEn": "I need an umbrella in the rain.", "textEs": "Necesito un paraguas bajo la lluvia.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "ede8a9f6-2fae-4f08-ba24-c239bc95d9e2"}, {"id": "e58ae770-c24b-4479-8008-b0f3b35b8020", "textEn": "Listen to the rain falling on the roof.", "textEs": "Escucha la lluvia cayendo sobre el techo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "ede8a9f6-2fae-4f08-ba24-c239bc95d9e2"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the number 9, often in counting, telling time, or indicating quantity.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "c6b489c9-368d-493c-b696-b82a3c5e0c7a", "textEn": "The meeting is at nine.", "textEs": "La reunión es a las nueve.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "af374c12-6491-4432-bb38-71e03c4be302"}, {"id": "2f324b17-9745-4452-961d-71d83bc22996", "textEn": "She has nine cats.", "textEs": "Ella tiene nueve gatos.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "af374c12-6491-4432-bb38-71e03c4be302"}, {"id": "0321909b-3cf7-44b8-a3ca-54a26eca2d00", "textEn": "The meeting is at nine, so don't be late.", "textEs": "La reunión es a las nueve, así que no llegues tarde.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "af374c12-6491-4432-bb38-71e03c4be302"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to mean continuing to follow a plan or goal without getting distracted or off course.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "bfcb2129-4f00-4e99-a146-9b69de9b0ea8", "textEn": "Let's stay on track and finish on time.", "textEs": "Mantengámonos en el tema y terminemos a tiempo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "b37b7f69-3b79-445c-993d-018972c32589"}, {"id": "8702ef89-9947-45e3-93ee-5e7e5d618ae7", "textEn": "We need to stay on track with the agenda.", "textEs": "Necesitamos mantenernos en el tema con la agenda.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "b37b7f69-3b79-445c-993d-018972c32589"}, {"id": "eefb4858-1fc5-4a70-a359-27548b7c586b", "textEn": "Let's set a timeline for each phase to help us stay on track.", "textEs": "Establezcamos un cronograma para cada fase para ayudarnos a mantener el rumbo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "b37b7f69-3b79-445c-993d-018972c32589"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to an object for children to play with, or informally to describe something trivial or a small gadget.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "b7ccdaa2-ee94-4293-af7f-4d1e98cc8183", "textEn": "The child played with a new toy all afternoon.", "textEs": "El niño jugó con un juguete nuevo toda la tarde.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "4ebb4662-75da-48ef-a976-9810c99567b0"}, {"id": "33c9525f-917a-47ef-bb6e-bb89eb0627b0", "textEn": "That toy is broken and needs to be fixed.", "textEs": "Ese juguete está roto y necesita ser arreglado.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "4ebb4662-75da-48ef-a976-9810c99567b0"}, {"id": "11efb07a-1635-4c34-b7fb-bf68f2f61464", "textEn": "The dog's favorite toy is a squeaky bone.", "textEs": "El juguete favorito del perro es un hueso que chirría.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "4ebb4662-75da-48ef-a976-9810c99567b0"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in casual, fast speech as a contraction of 'would you,' often in questions or requests like 'Wouldja like some coffee?'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "70b34478-bece-42fd-9c9e-89c2ec264fc7", "textEn": "Wouldja like some coffee?", "textEs": "¿Te gustaría un café?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "9f5a16f0-4758-4b60-b612-8101f5231fdc"}, {"id": "ef9cbbab-9caa-4623-9b9f-fba992480aa6", "textEn": "Wouldja help me with this?", "textEs": "¿Podrías ayudarme con esto?", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "9f5a16f0-4758-4b60-b612-8101f5231fdc"}, {"id": "4a4f82bb-8040-4628-986b-1148b1242180", "textEn": "Wouldja like a cup of coffee?", "textEs": "¿Te gustaría una taza de café?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "9f5a16f0-4758-4b60-b612-8101f5231fdc"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to indicate two times or double the amount, often in counting or comparing frequencies.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "c0612843-7c4c-4863-b6b4-5011dd366bb0", "textEn": "I called you twice.", "textEs": "Te llamé dos veces.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "8fe7708d-dd17-4c44-9829-86ee7c8098db"}, {"id": "a6ce89e2-abbe-4a09-9907-0ace0a63df2e", "textEn": "She checked the door twice.", "textEs": "Ella revisó la puerta dos veces.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "8fe7708d-dd17-4c44-9829-86ee7c8098db"}, {"id": "5948e5d9-7e8f-4535-8660-52743322e618", "textEn": "I've called him twice already, but he hasn't answered.", "textEs": "Ya lo he llamado dos veces, pero no ha contestado.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "8fe7708d-dd17-4c44-9829-86ee7c8098db"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a noun for the visible gas from burning, or as a verb meaning to inhale tobacco or other substances; common in casual and formal contexts.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "3792de9e-01d0-45e4-aeeb-032c30015bb3", "textEn": "Smoke rose from the chimney.", "textEs": "El humo subió de la chimenea.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "8b5bacbc-f661-4169-88bb-232c633e2b7c"}, {"id": "39573d40-eb77-4018-8314-f55ecc902ed5", "textEn": "There was a lot of smoke in the room.", "textEs": "Había mucho humo en la habitación.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "8b5bacbc-f661-4169-88bb-232c633e2b7c"}, {"id": "41b06792-6e46-4636-82a7-22db32ddaf21", "textEn": "I can hear the fire smoke from the chimney.", "textEs": "Puedo oír el humo del fuego de la chimenea.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "8b5bacbc-f661-4169-88bb-232c633e2b7c"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally to describe throwing or tossing something casually, or in phrases like 'slinging mud' for making accusations.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "ec6d216a-921f-49ae-8334-fded687dbac2", "textEn": "The worker was slinging bags of cement onto the truck.", "textEs": "El trabajador estaba tirando bolsas de cemento al camión.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "8c6cf058-b835-4696-92ba-cb0ca70fe843"}, {"id": "2e646e94-51e8-453a-bb24-f4fa0ace8864", "textEn": "He was slinging insults at the referee.", "textEs": "Estaba lanzando insultos al árbitro.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "8c6cf058-b835-4696-92ba-cb0ca70fe843"}, {"id": "4c9e2694-b89d-4a87-9b41-f3facb3136fa", "textEn": "I can hear the dishes slinging around in the kitchen sink from all the way upstairs.", "textEs": "Puedo escuchar los platos moviéndose ruidosamente en el fregadero de la cocina desde el piso de arriba.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "8c6cf058-b835-4696-92ba-cb0ca70fe843"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe intelligence or cleverness, often in a casual or approving way, like 'That's a smart idea.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "a523ee1e-7136-4612-9aa3-4afa5cc5813f", "textEn": "She is a very smart student.", "textEs": "Ella es una estudiante muy inteligente.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "b9e8d5e6-4c96-4ce7-a4fd-4695138ae6cd"}, {"id": "6bc53a0a-22a2-42f9-9ae6-e6346fd25f93", "textEn": "That was a smart decision.", "textEs": "Esa fue una decisión inteligente.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "b9e8d5e6-4c96-4ce7-a4fd-4695138ae6cd"}, {"id": "3423a139-0583-45fa-9ce6-587c10c40fcf", "textEn": "She's really smart; she figured out the puzzle in just five minutes.", "textEs": "Ella es muy inteligente; resolvió el rompecabezas en solo cinco minutos.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "b9e8d5e6-4c96-4ce7-a4fd-4695138ae6cd"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something that has turned into ice or is extremely cold, often in weather or food contexts.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "e894d8e6-e33b-4578-a32f-89515ce17706", "textEn": "The lake is frozen in winter.", "textEs": "El lago está congelado en invierno.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "69a2a427-468c-45cc-a004-61cd32f628e7"}, {"id": "3bd47e9c-a6d7-4f76-bd98-51f3a4b085cc", "textEn": "I bought frozen vegetables for the soup.", "textEs": "Compré verduras congeladas para la sopa.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "69a2a427-468c-45cc-a004-61cd32f628e7"}, {"id": "9a1ba913-3f12-40e3-8871-8342bd0a92c4", "textEn": "The lake is frozen solid, so we can go ice skating.", "textEs": "El lago está congelado sólido, así que podemos ir a patinar sobre hielo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "69a2a427-468c-45cc-a004-61cd32f628e7"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in fast, casual speech as a contraction of 'could you,' often in requests or questions like 'Couldja pass the salt?'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "4cf44f1e-6e16-40d2-968e-2eff1aae95e1", "textEn": "Couldja pass the salt?", "textEs": "¿Podrías pasar la sal?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "55761711-a7e4-4b00-aa7d-1ce57c937cb6"}, {"id": "4be7da17-1b26-4272-8c53-ba6c10d0b9d0", "textEn": "Couldja tell me the time?", "textEs": "¿Podrías decirme la hora?", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "55761711-a7e4-4b00-aa7d-1ce57c937cb6"}, {"id": "dea0521f-f725-4b04-82d6-a2e5fe32c7ff", "textEn": "Couldja pass me the salt, please?", "textEs": "¿Podrías pasarme la sal, por favor?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "55761711-a7e4-4b00-aa7d-1ce57c937cb6"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to indicate a place or location, often with a slight emphasis in natural speech, like 'over there' or 'there it is'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "75bc046f-670e-4e3d-bd9c-1e4480106c49", "textEn": "There is a book on the table.", "textEs": "Hay un libro en la mesa.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "787b4fa5-afc3-4642-b206-9a787e3b3f98"}, {"id": "3a52b51b-34ed-4d7c-9504-a20cd7f87052", "textEn": "She lives over there.", "textEs": "Ella vive por allá.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "787b4fa5-afc3-4642-b206-9a787e3b3f98"}, {"id": "b621e91d-19d1-4616-aa69-e19357ec639d", "textEn": "There you are, I've been looking for you everywhere.", "textEs": "Ahí estás, te he estado buscando por todas partes.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "787b4fa5-afc3-4642-b206-9a787e3b3f98"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to express reluctant agreement, mild uncertainty, or a tentative opinion, often with a slight pause or falling intonation.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "4a42aed6-5e57-4bc8-a925-8b2b5ca95183", "textEn": "I suppose that's true.", "textEs": "Supongo que eso es verdad.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "da6f4132-3576-4dea-865f-eaa16f08c9aa"}, {"id": "aef18024-c490-4fbf-814b-3bbb3221f2ee", "textEn": "I suppose we could try again.", "textEs": "Supongo que podríamos intentarlo de nuevo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "da6f4132-3576-4dea-865f-eaa16f08c9aa"}, {"id": "a8da3cf5-999d-4b79-85ed-1dfd572ea1a6", "textEn": "I suppose we could try that new restaurant for dinner.", "textEs": "Supongo que podríamos probar ese nuevo restaurante para cenar.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "da6f4132-3576-4dea-865f-eaa16f08c9aa"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe someone holding tightly to something or someone, often emotionally or physically, like 'She's clinging to her childhood memories.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "1e2a806f-def8-48c6-b9d9-e1b779e36752", "textEn": "The baby was clinging to her mother's hand.", "textEs": "El bebé se aferraba a la mano de su madre.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "e97517f6-b75e-4f83-94ba-aa67594c1ba2"}, {"id": "cb713eac-4213-40c0-b222-285551aa6a4f", "textEn": "He was clinging to the hope of a better future.", "textEs": "Se aferraba a la esperanza de un futuro mejor.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "e97517f6-b75e-4f83-94ba-aa67594c1ba2"}, {"id": "e57f5919-2fd5-4be1-85b6-1369a6aca598", "textEn": "The sound of wet clothes clinging together as she pulled them apart was oddly satisfying.", "textEs": "El sonido de la ropa mojada pegándose al separarla era extrañamente satisfactorio.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "e97517f6-b75e-4f83-94ba-aa67594c1ba2"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a long, continuous thread of fibers, often for knitting or weaving, or informally to mean a long, involved story or tale.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "cbf182a9-5cb6-44a2-9aa0-e6973e67eb1b", "textEn": "She knitted a scarf with blue yarn.", "textEs": "Tejió una bufanda con hilo azul.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "8960d712-b9fe-404b-b7df-242d4b9901e4"}, {"id": "9da236cd-dded-4b9c-a723-2a10e0507a6b", "textEn": "He told a long yarn about his travels.", "textEs": "Contó un largo cuento sobre sus viajes.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "8960d712-b9fe-404b-b7df-242d4b9901e4"}, {"id": "f4a37b57-9be8-4cdc-a11d-faa590d324f0", "textEn": "Grandma would spin yarn by the fireplace every evening.", "textEs": "La abuela solía hilar lana junto a la chimenea cada tarde.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "8960d712-b9fe-404b-b7df-242d4b9901e4"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in casual, fast speech as a contraction of 'should you', often in questions or suggestions like 'shouldja go?'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "b98a60fc-b1ff-4ad7-93be-e0dfa9d20d2a", "textEn": "Shouldja call her now?", "textEs": "¿Deberías llamarla ahora?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "3b9dc02c-207f-47f3-bf77-ccf2f942f202"}, {"id": "92c8a350-0756-44db-92f7-46c0d6f1a7bd", "textEn": "Shouldja bring an umbrella?", "textEs": "¿Deberías traer un paraguas?", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "3b9dc02c-207f-47f3-bf77-ccf2f942f202"}, {"id": "921627e5-6aba-400d-847b-7d2402a65387", "textEn": "Shouldja bring an umbrella? It might rain later.", "textEs": "¿Deberías traer un paraguas? Podría llover más tarde.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "3b9dc02c-207f-47f3-bf77-ccf2f942f202"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally to acknowledge understanding or agreement, often in casual conversation.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "79260928-d0a8-420b-9ba6-3426f1253170", "textEn": "Gotcha! I'll meet you at five.", "textEs": "¡Entendido! Te veré a las cinco.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "fe8ac73b-f980-4d43-ad74-297158fb19c5"}, {"id": "a5cbc84d-ad60-42d2-b5a4-659a19278c42", "textEn": "I gotcha covered, don't worry.", "textEs": "Te tengo cubierto, no te preocupes.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "fe8ac73b-f980-4d43-ad74-297158fb19c5"}, {"id": "98a293d2-ac47-46ca-9203-9c7f5bbfa19a", "textEn": "Gotcha, I'll meet you at the cafe at 3.", "textEs": "Entendido, te veo en el café a las 3.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "fe8ac73b-f980-4d43-ad74-297158fb19c5"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a verb meaning to go to a place or see someone, or as a noun for an instance of doing so; common in both casual and formal contexts.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "6ae637b7-f382-4f08-89f6-27c52b15b5d8", "textEn": "I want to visit my family this weekend.", "textEs": "Quiero visitar a mi familia este fin de semana.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "ed4b9406-512f-4d9b-a8b0-7f76cb52df52"}, {"id": "c0f9f1ec-baf8-4ed2-b799-82c93c6731d7", "textEn": "We will visit the museum tomorrow.", "textEs": "Visitaremos el museo mañana.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "ed4b9406-512f-4d9b-a8b0-7f76cb52df52"}, {"id": "4317a9da-e1c0-4153-9aa1-aef9a7dbd305", "textEn": "I'm going to visit my grandmother this weekend.", "textEs": "Voy a visitar a mi abuela este fin de semana.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "ed4b9406-512f-4d9b-a8b0-7f76cb52df52"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the rear part of something, to return to a previous place or state, or to support someone or something.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "9c77ba0f-2490-48a8-91cf-b298fc279623", "textEn": "He hurt his back while lifting the box.", "textEs": "Se lastimó la espalda al levantar la caja.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "c9703372-240d-4ba3-8532-33b7ca369736"}, {"id": "d17a9148-9623-4088-a0a8-15d56f19084b", "textEn": "Please go back to the starting point.", "textEs": "Por favor, vuelve atrás al punto de inicio.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "c9703372-240d-4ba3-8532-33b7ca369736"}, {"id": "92d22cb9-d09a-43bb-ba02-c56cd32a8273", "textEn": "I'll be back in a minute.", "textEs": "Vuelvo en un minuto.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "c9703372-240d-4ba3-8532-33b7ca369736"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something full of energy, life, or bright colors, like a vibrant city or a vibrant personality.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "902e5102-e47b-4af8-9c1f-c959e218941d", "textEn": "The market was full of vibrant colors.", "textEs": "El mercado estaba lleno de colores vibrantes.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "afadad32-88b7-4bc5-985b-23ab2c5db8dc"}, {"id": "05c85bc9-29e2-4678-a72b-5ec9ee95bdc2", "textEn": "She has a vibrant personality.", "textEs": "Ella tiene una personalidad vibrante.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "afadad32-88b7-4bc5-985b-23ab2c5db8dc"}, {"id": "39d124c9-0750-4522-846d-0879875d4f30", "textEn": "The market was vibrant with the sounds of vendors calling out their fresh produce.", "textEs": "El mercado estaba vibrante con los sonidos de los vendedores anunciando sus productos frescos.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "afadad32-88b7-4bc5-985b-23ab2c5db8dc"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a female sibling, often in casual or familial contexts.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "2eff26a5-ba43-4e9c-9cd5-1512c12ebf2c", "textEn": "My sister lives in Boston.", "textEs": "Mi hermana vive en Boston.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "de8b541c-7c15-490e-95f5-5601d91359f6"}, {"id": "df2aec9b-aff8-42e3-ab3f-20f122948f81", "textEn": "She is my older sister.", "textEs": "Ella es mi hermana mayor.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "de8b541c-7c15-490e-95f5-5601d91359f6"}, {"id": "4d51c1fb-820a-4285-9a17-8aa8ea32690a", "textEn": "My sister is coming to visit me this weekend.", "textEs": "Mi hermana viene a visitarme este fin de semana.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "de8b541c-7c15-490e-95f5-5601d91359f6"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something that is owned by someone or a feeling of being part of a group, often in phrases like 'a sense of belonging'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "6d852104-3fbf-49e2-a9fa-b21be6f10a66", "textEn": "The group gave her a sense of belonging.", "textEs": "El grupo le dio un sentido de pertenencia.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "8bbbce80-b333-4705-9abe-98ef09f8ed1e"}, {"id": "abde9239-12a9-4b12-b7e5-2fa656745a9f", "textEn": "He questioned his belonging in the new city.", "textEs": "Cuestionó su pertenencia en la nueva ciudad.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "8bbbce80-b333-4705-9abe-98ef09f8ed1e"}, {"id": "da20319c-2c06-42f2-bfce-58f7ecb43b76", "textEn": "I finally found a sense of belonging in this community.", "textEs": "Finalmente encontré un sentido de pertenencia en esta comunidad.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "8bbbce80-b333-4705-9abe-98ef09f8ed1e"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to introduce a specific instance or case when explaining or illustrating a point, often in a conversational or explanatory tone.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "4768c85c-fc1f-45ed-9136-f3f96953bf5b", "textEn": "One example is the use of solar panels in homes.", "textEs": "Un ejemplo es el uso de paneles solares en hogares.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "b973f43c-0f19-48b6-89ef-d3e93e382b74"}, {"id": "01432954-8162-4ff3-a23b-2b2b677d2c6d", "textEn": "One example is how bees pollinate flowers.", "textEs": "Un ejemplo es cómo las abejas polinizan las flores.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "b973f43c-0f19-48b6-89ef-d3e93e382b74"}, {"id": "4ff2034d-74df-4304-a555-c4ff2f1e47fe", "textEn": "There are many types of renewable energy; one example is solar power.", "textEs": "Hay muchos tipos de energía renovable; un ejemplo es la energía solar.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "b973f43c-0f19-48b6-89ef-d3e93e382b74"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Commonly used in everyday conversation to refer to a fermented dairy product, often eaten for breakfast or as a snack.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "9d14bfda-067b-4005-899b-2c62187e6dca", "textEn": "I eat yogurt for breakfast.", "textEs": "Como yogur en el desayuno.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "62868e28-d8b8-425d-a9f2-14881a2f0b1e"}, {"id": "a4f39053-74c6-49ec-8686-ecd202da3abf", "textEn": "This yogurt is strawberry-flavored.", "textEs": "Este yogur es de sabor a fresa.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "62868e28-d8b8-425d-a9f2-14881a2f0b1e"}, {"id": "54d0adc1-b62b-4fac-9f01-8ff00a28645e", "textEn": "I love eating yogurt with granola for breakfast.", "textEs": "Me encanta comer yogur con granola para el desayuno.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "62868e28-d8b8-425d-a9f2-14881a2f0b1e"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a casual contraction of 'won't you' in questions, often to sound friendly or informal, like 'Wontcha come with us?'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "fa4ff263-491a-4736-9338-a49de98748aa", "textEn": "Wontcha come to the party?", "textEs": "¿No quieres venir a la fiesta?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "e3fa0885-8083-46dd-bb6d-1f65d6ac49d9"}, {"id": "6da9a8ae-1b5b-4ca5-ae0e-6b51d3106554", "textEn": "Wontcha give me a chance?", "textEs": "¿No me darás una oportunidad?", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "e3fa0885-8083-46dd-bb6d-1f65d6ac49d9"}, {"id": "dcf11987-c979-41ee-a94d-885655e48374", "textEn": "Wontcha come to the party with me?", "textEs": "¿No quieres venir a la fiesta conmigo?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "e3fa0885-8083-46dd-bb6d-1f65d6ac49d9"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a wax cylinder with a wick that is burned to provide light, often in casual or everyday contexts like 'light a candle' or 'candle holder'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "ddc4957c-e77c-482a-99ec-2d03708e8189", "textEn": "Light the candle on the cake.", "textEs": "Enciende la vela en el pastel.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "5e6291f6-619e-45bb-a03e-22ee64229aa4"}, {"id": "dd4a0b3b-27dd-4fd5-b8b8-7daac666f8ab", "textEn": "The candle burned all night.", "textEs": "La vela ardió toda la noche.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "5e6291f6-619e-45bb-a03e-22ee64229aa4"}, {"id": "40879b3e-c416-44ed-9d0a-c1c2c7f912cc", "textEn": "The candle flickered in the dark room.", "textEs": "La vela parpadeaba en la habitación oscura.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "5e6291f6-619e-45bb-a03e-22ee64229aa4"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in tech contexts for programming instructions, or in general speech for a system of rules or symbols.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "e607810e-af30-41b6-a323-d056580e63e5", "textEn": "The code is easy to understand.", "textEs": "El código es fácil de entender.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "d6499fb7-37cf-42b1-9042-f534b905aaa1"}, {"id": "f7fac4fa-2470-447c-8c9c-31ce862b74c4", "textEn": "Enter the code to unlock the door.", "textEs": "Ingresa el código para abrir la puerta.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "d6499fb7-37cf-42b1-9042-f534b905aaa1"}, {"id": "37825527-920c-4767-b70d-200b4f1da1df", "textEn": "Can you hear the code in the distance? It sounds like a wolf howling.", "textEs": "¿Puedes oír el aullido a lo lejos? Suena como un lobo aullando.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "d6499fb7-37cf-42b1-9042-f534b905aaa1"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe a sudden shock or surprise, often in informal contexts like 'That news really stunned me.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "8d1f782b-9c51-4376-bfd6-53804b94d858", "textEn": "The loud noise stunned everyone in the room.", "textEs": "El ruido fuerte aturdió a todos en la habitación.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "e50daf3a-21e7-468a-9e4c-b3117836b03f"}, {"id": "0574ef53-5a8b-42cb-beef-404d8ea011c1", "textEn": "She was stunned by the unexpected news.", "textEs": "Ella quedó aturdida por las noticias inesperadas.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "e50daf3a-21e7-468a-9e4c-b3117836b03f"}, {"id": "bfcc18e0-d43e-4e36-baa0-2845ff2a436a", "textEn": "The loud crash from the kitchen stunned everyone in the house.", "textEs": "El fuerte estruendo de la cocina dejó atónitos a todos en la casa.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "e50daf3a-21e7-468a-9e4c-b3117836b03f"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in everyday conversation for a flat dish or a serving of food, often in contexts like 'a plate of pasta' or 'clean your plate'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "61173991-68e0-4180-b6a7-5aa234b3a024", "textEn": "She put the food on a clean plate.", "textEs": "Ella puso la comida en un plato limpio.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "1032c87e-cb17-4040-83e1-0b8ab7d45a7d"}, {"id": "b30e7fdc-279a-42f7-b964-a7254a444fa8", "textEn": "The plate broke when it fell.", "textEs": "El plato se rompió cuando cayó.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "1032c87e-cb17-4040-83e1-0b8ab7d45a7d"}, {"id": "8cfed13f-381f-4d7d-95d2-1db41a1d045e", "textEn": "I heard a plate break in the kitchen.", "textEs": "Escuché romperse un plato en la cocina.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "1032c87e-cb17-4040-83e1-0b8ab7d45a7d"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in casual, fast speech as a contraction of 'don't you,' often in questions or exclamations like 'Dontcha know?'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "c1dc5c17-d466-406d-ba7a-c124e5ae6d7f", "textEn": "Dontcha think it's too late?", "textEs": "¿No crees que es demasiado tarde?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "a84c8dbf-fe5e-434e-b194-f1b3138b2904"}, {"id": "095685e1-a9ea-4acc-bdb6-75f3e0e9c5e5", "textEn": "Dontcha worry about a thing.", "textEs": "No te preocupes por nada.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "a84c8dbf-fe5e-434e-b194-f1b3138b2904"}, {"id": "401c948f-5c7b-4630-85c3-74dc5bdfcdd7", "textEn": "Dontcha know that already?", "textEs": "¿No sabes eso ya?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "a84c8dbf-fe5e-434e-b194-f1b3138b2904"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to smoothly shift focus in a conversation or presentation, often in formal or structured speech.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "62a75a77-2993-4f41-b3e2-6c03185aaaa0", "textEn": "Turning our attention to the next slide, we see the quarterly results.", "textEs": "Dirigiendo nuestra atención a la siguiente diapositiva, vemos los resultados trimestrales.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "6670797b-8ed0-4246-94b0-611720ebdf47"}, {"id": "584177d6-3090-42ba-81bd-5b29ca923b1a", "textEn": "Let's start turning our attention to the main challenges ahead.", "textEs": "Empecemos a dirigir nuestra atención a los principales desafíos que tenemos por delante.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "6670797b-8ed0-4246-94b0-611720ebdf47"}, {"id": "b92a760c-424c-4852-90ba-22f3611dd90d", "textEn": "Turning our attention to the next topic, let's discuss the budget proposals.", "textEs": "Dirigiendo nuestra atención al siguiente tema, discutamos las propuestas presupuestarias.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "6670797b-8ed0-4246-94b0-611720ebdf47"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe water falling from clouds; often in weather talk, like 'It's raining' or 'Rain is coming.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "3b966e59-360f-4a18-acc1-0dcf73b41ad8", "textEn": "Rain is expected tomorrow.", "textEs": "Se espera lluvia mañana.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "969342ef-97db-463d-8e4d-1b146fa41cd5"}, {"id": "2443fef5-19b3-49a6-a364-35df5934b842", "textEn": "She loves the sound of rain.", "textEs": "Ella ama el sonido de la lluvia.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "969342ef-97db-463d-8e4d-1b146fa41cd5"}, {"id": "c49f8f4d-f260-4bc2-9388-cb4eab1dc1de", "textEn": "I can hear the rain tapping on the window.", "textEs": "Puedo oír la lluvia golpeando la ventana.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "969342ef-97db-463d-8e4d-1b146fa41cd5"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a soft pad for sitting or leaning, or metaphorically to describe something that absorbs shock or provides a buffer.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "c595d143-f3a7-429d-8db7-c7c82fef3207", "textEn": "She placed a soft cushion on the chair for comfort.", "textEs": "Ella colocó un cojín suave en la silla para mayor comodidad.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "112c727a-0fdc-4c21-9a9d-ba815390a4a4"}, {"id": "2a29d109-62d4-42dc-909c-6e85217269dc", "textEn": "The thick grass cushioned his fall from the tree.", "textEs": "El pasto espeso amortiguó su caída del árbol.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "112c727a-0fdc-4c21-9a9d-ba815390a4a4"}, {"id": "8d31286e-e0c3-4348-9046-1399be4ef40b", "textEn": "I can hear the air cushion when I sit on this sofa.", "textEs": "Puedo oír el colchón de aire cuando me siento en este sofá.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "112c727a-0fdc-4c21-9a9d-ba815390a4a4"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in casual, fast speech as a contraction of 'did you', often in questions like 'Didja see that?'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "8b700f8f-edca-4d5d-bbb0-096b63a05e08", "textEn": "Didja see that movie?", "textEs": "¿Viste esa película?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "1cda26bc-4562-4cfe-8911-e035299901a8"}, {"id": "79686926-c619-485e-8b28-b5eebfbe2cc9", "textEn": "Didja eat lunch already?", "textEs": "¿Ya almorzaste?", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "1cda26bc-4562-4cfe-8911-e035299901a8"}, {"id": "a6ebdf8e-20d1-41d0-81f0-b4d73b736cd2", "textEn": "Didja see that movie last night?", "textEs": "¿Viste esa película anoche?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "1cda26bc-4562-4cfe-8911-e035299901a8"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a verb to mean staying in place or pausing, or as an interjection to ask someone to stop or hold on.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "540309fb-731f-425e-848c-17e0b6e608e6", "textEn": "Please wait for me.", "textEs": "Por favor, espérame.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "09e2016f-6c63-41d7-a979-a5660debbc94"}, {"id": "a74e6a93-0b5b-4c73-aaf8-2c3f5626115b", "textEn": "We can't wait any longer.", "textEs": "No podemos esperar más.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "09e2016f-6c63-41d7-a979-a5660debbc94"}, {"id": "08c53ff7-5c20-455a-9fb9-66a055bc92a6", "textEn": "Wait, I need to tie my shoe before we go.", "textEs": "Espera, necesito atarme el zapato antes de irnos.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "09e2016f-6c63-41d7-a979-a5660debbc94"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a definite article to refer to a specific noun, often unstressed in rapid speech.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "e7191bf1-359c-4917-aa7d-83d69ee428dc", "textEn": "The cat is sleeping.", "textEs": "El gato está durmiendo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "f4e3a1d4-bb39-4b5c-bbf7-cb5f729d2375"}, {"id": "a565e1a5-efa5-4427-a3dc-08441c87868b", "textEn": "The apple is red.", "textEs": "La manzana es roja.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "f4e3a1d4-bb39-4b5c-bbf7-cb5f729d2375"}, {"id": "2d44dd82-784d-460a-b47d-abe99225de27", "textEn": "The sun is shining brightly today.", "textEs": "El sol brilla intensamente hoy.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "f4e3a1d4-bb39-4b5c-bbf7-cb5f729d2375"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe a curved or spiral shape, or the action of forming something into such a shape, like curling hair or a smile curling at the corners.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "1fc8cd75-8e85-4d6d-8124-b05fc88d2109", "textEn": "Her hair has a natural curl.", "textEs": "Su cabello tiene un rizo natural.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "d8a2f764-b547-475c-b0a7-2cae0085b137"}, {"id": "ca139d76-dab7-49b7-80c0-adb32f2361df", "textEn": "The cat curled up on the sofa.", "textEs": "El gato se enroscó en el sofá.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "d8a2f764-b547-475c-b0a7-2cae0085b137"}, {"id": "7aaad07b-b44d-4454-817f-a7626c2cdca8", "textEn": "The baby let out a soft curl of laughter as I tickled her.", "textEs": "El bebé soltó un suave gorjeo de risa mientras le hacía cosquillas.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "d8a2f764-b547-475c-b0a7-2cae0085b137"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to tell someone to rise from bed or a seated position, often said quickly with the 't' in 'get' becoming a soft flap or dropped in fast speech.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "b2d7fda6-38c7-4c68-9895-aaca20320dfd", "textEn": "I need to get up early tomorrow.", "textEs": "Necesito levantarme temprano mañana.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "d81d9d82-61c0-4ce1-bbec-033ad319b478"}, {"id": "3068cade-3e34-40c4-8c3a-6a538911b8f0", "textEn": "Get up and stretch your legs.", "textEs": "Levántate y estira las piernas.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "d81d9d82-61c0-4ce1-bbec-033ad319b478"}, {"id": "84659d01-d7f2-4ce4-9393-7d5e340af8d9", "textEn": "I usually get up at seven on weekdays.", "textEs": "Normalmente me levanto a las siete entre semana.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "d81d9d82-61c0-4ce1-bbec-033ad319b478"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a writing instrument with ink, or a small enclosed area for animals, often pronounced with a clear, short vowel sound.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "cc70760c-8354-41e4-8124-6186010f8981", "textEn": "I need a pen to write this note.", "textEs": "Necesito un bolígrafo para escribir esta nota.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "36e30eb4-7e22-4a80-88a3-c83e66e44daa"}, {"id": "688fd04d-d896-4c88-bd02-04a3b3a64225", "textEn": "The pen ran out of ink during the test.", "textEs": "El bolígrafo se quedó sin tinta durante el examen.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "36e30eb4-7e22-4a80-88a3-c83e66e44daa"}, {"id": "5cd8d17f-cc42-4bfa-989f-5a6f602a7d86", "textEn": "I need to use a pen to sign this document.", "textEs": "Necesito usar un bolígrafo para firmar este documento.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "36e30eb4-7e22-4a80-88a3-c83e66e44daa"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe a fruit preserve, a traffic congestion, or a musical improvisation session; also a verb meaning to forcefully insert something.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "fe43b89e-02e4-48bb-a565-93a413704d5a", "textEn": "She spread strawberry jam on her toast.", "textEs": "Ella untó mermelada de fresa en su tostada.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "c6432b18-7ef5-4939-8e08-38ddcc5275bb"}, {"id": "ab4b27dd-a915-4fb6-8cc5-edf3f28f0344", "textEn": "The printer jammed and stopped working.", "textEs": "La impresora se atascó y dejó de funcionar.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "c6432b18-7ef5-4939-8e08-38ddcc5275bb"}, {"id": "a8a6f0eb-2875-433c-9bed-e85b9fd6bc45", "textEn": "I was stuck in a traffic jam for two hours this morning.", "textEs": "Estuve atrapado en un atasco de tráfico durante dos horas esta mañana.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "c6432b18-7ef5-4939-8e08-38ddcc5275bb"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a verb to feel the absence of someone or something, or as a title for an unmarried woman, often in polite address.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "24912984-9ece-47a1-b87d-bf44b2d9bc2b", "textEn": "I miss my family when I travel.", "textEs": "Extraño a mi familia cuando viajo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "6f4a38ec-1414-4afb-a9ef-d86cccf0ccb2"}, {"id": "590b23a7-9ac2-46ad-a405-166fdbbdff24", "textEn": "Don't miss the bus or you'll be late.", "textEs": "No pierdas el autobús o llegarás tarde.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "6f4a38ec-1414-4afb-a9ef-d86cccf0ccb2"}, {"id": "8e259428-4653-45e2-a369-7ca4fe7be46b", "textEn": "I miss the sound of rain on the roof at night.", "textEs": "Extraño el sonido de la lluvia en el techo por la noche.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "6f4a38ec-1414-4afb-a9ef-d86cccf0ccb2"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in everyday conversation for exchanging goods, services, or ideas, often in business contexts or casual talk about swapping items.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "6e03099b-a905-4516-81e8-96b99d244562", "textEn": "International trade is important for the economy.", "textEs": "El comercio internacional es importante para la economía.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "12070c72-d4d7-4846-8533-93a4d91a6fcf"}, {"id": "1724a75a-c3fc-458c-bd52-f1ac8596049c", "textEn": "They traded their old car for a new one.", "textEs": "Intercambiaron su coche viejo por uno nuevo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "12070c72-d4d7-4846-8533-93a4d91a6fcf"}, {"id": "49b1a6c4-d53d-4b0c-b98b-6207579287d1", "textEn": "I'll trade you my apple for your orange.", "textEs": "Te cambio mi manzana por tu naranja.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "12070c72-d4d7-4846-8533-93a4d91a6fcf"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a verb meaning to move a liquid or gas with a pump, or as a noun for the device itself; also slang for a vigorous handshake or a type of shoe.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "dbfaf93c-3c40-4f85-9652-40d7bf7e97d3", "textEn": "He used a pump to fill the tire with air.", "textEs": "Usó una bomba para llenar el neumático de aire.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "294997d4-f3de-431f-94c2-be4a90a6f826"}, {"id": "c242bf0e-02c1-4f18-bb5f-12d1061108fb", "textEn": "The water pump broke in the middle of the night.", "textEs": "La bomba de agua se rompió en medio de la noche.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "294997d4-f3de-431f-94c2-be4a90a6f826"}, {"id": "81c8b06f-a8c9-41a4-b100-44919c5b1520", "textEn": "I could hear my heart pump with excitement as I waited for the results.", "textEs": "Podía oír cómo mi corazón bombeaba de emoción mientras esperaba los resultados.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "294997d4-f3de-431f-94c2-be4a90a6f826"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in fast, connected speech where 'in a' often blends together, with the 'n' linking smoothly to the schwa sound, common in phrases like 'in a minute' or 'in a way'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "1439af40-9e17-464f-b892-fffa2e7d3963", "textEn": "She lives in a small town.", "textEs": "Ella vive en un pueblo pequeño.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "819428de-2ce0-4eb8-8cd0-c17710ea0278"}, {"id": "6f0c4061-7561-4382-bc6f-2e68a9f12d14", "textEn": "He arrived in a hurry.", "textEs": "Llegó con prisa.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "819428de-2ce0-4eb8-8cd0-c17710ea0278"}, {"id": "ee1e56e0-4c9c-4296-bafd-dc624d6075b7", "textEn": "I'll be there in a minute.", "textEs": "Estaré allí en un minuto.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "819428de-2ce0-4eb8-8cd0-c17710ea0278"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a device that produces light, often with a shade, commonly found in homes or offices.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "c6a5b62a-066f-4f03-b1e4-a35f78347ed1", "textEn": "The lamp on the desk provides good light for reading.", "textEs": "La lámpara en el escritorio proporciona buena luz para leer.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "0f788ada-f2d5-49d5-b4da-e5952724cfaa"}, {"id": "171bad57-0eba-444c-a3ea-da4b2d22137a", "textEn": "I turned off the lamp before going to sleep.", "textEs": "Apagué la lámpara antes de ir a dormir.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "0f788ada-f2d5-49d5-b4da-e5952724cfaa"}, {"id": "a16980cb-84c5-4a00-a08d-9884ab480a61", "textEn": "The lamp flickered before going out completely.", "textEs": "La lámpara parpadeó antes de apagarse por completo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "0f788ada-f2d5-49d5-b4da-e5952724cfaa"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to introduce a contrasting point or emphasize a caveat, often softening or clarifying a previous statement.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "cd0ba2b4-5c50-40e3-b280-e4fff19211a7", "textEn": "It's cheap, mind you, but not good.", "textEs": "Es barato, eso sí, pero no bueno.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "4a0ff758-0d5d-436d-9c6e-476b293bfb87"}, {"id": "aa15ab14-495a-4f72-a3f2-c36cb8c83234", "textEn": "Mind you, I'm not complaining.", "textEs": "Eso sí, no me estoy quejando.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "4a0ff758-0d5d-436d-9c6e-476b293bfb87"}, {"id": "63d5c127-a4d1-42b1-898c-73fe73cde7e0", "textEn": "I don't really like spicy food, mind you, but I'll try this dish.", "textEs": "La verdad no me gusta mucho la comida picante, pero probaré este plato.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "4a0ff758-0d5d-436d-9c6e-476b293bfb87"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the reptile, often in casual conversation about pets, nature, or slow movement.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "d25cd535-4686-4a9c-8936-09bae2f599c3", "textEn": "The turtle moves slowly.", "textEs": "La tortuga se mueve lentamente.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "7e80f88f-bdc6-46e3-b5b7-a6a7a3342051"}, {"id": "523b594d-931f-4a31-97fd-c21e0ec25013", "textEn": "I saw a turtle in the pond.", "textEs": "Vi una tortuga en el estanque.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "7e80f88f-bdc6-46e3-b5b7-a6a7a3342051"}, {"id": "3024824a-ffb4-4a9a-a595-a17438e776a5", "textEn": "The turtle slowly crossed the road after the rain.", "textEs": "La tortuga cruzó lentamente la carretera después de la lluvia.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "7e80f88f-bdc6-46e3-b5b7-a6a7a3342051"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe pushing something or someone roughly, often with physical force or urgency, like in 'shove it in the bag' or 'don't shove me.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "5fddf2f2-72f1-4ea4-be0e-3a47ae53aa54", "textEn": "Don't shove; wait your turn in line.", "textEs": "No empujes; espera tu turno en la fila.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "b00210c7-1b51-4e92-ac6f-24dd5b620f42"}, {"id": "1623a885-3407-4786-93bf-d653d8ea8396", "textEn": "He shoved the heavy box into the corner of the room.", "textEs": "Él empujó la caja pesada hacia la esquina de la habitación.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "b00210c7-1b51-4e92-ac6f-24dd5b620f42"}, {"id": "42d3b0fc-00d9-4f3e-a00c-6932f05e6d76", "textEn": "He shoved the book onto the shelf without looking.", "textEs": "Empujó el libro en el estante sin mirar.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "b00210c7-1b51-4e92-ac6f-24dd5b620f42"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a polite response to thanks, meaning 'you're welcome,' or to emphasize a strong negative, like 'no way.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "48f5a233-bc53-4edf-94da-dbc8a8486eca", "textEn": "I'm not at all tired.", "textEs": "No estoy cansado para nada.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "42325d7d-75f5-41ed-b3e6-5f697cf1bfea"}, {"id": "ee04dc12-3b86-46f1-bfb6-1f5a1ec25d53", "textEn": "That's not at what I meant.", "textEs": "Eso no es para nada lo que quise decir.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "42325d7d-75f5-41ed-b3e6-5f697cf1bfea"}, {"id": "78b52589-87bb-46e0-b00d-f759801c5f17", "textEn": "I'm not at all tired after the long hike.", "textEs": "No estoy nada cansado después de la larga caminata.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "42325d7d-75f5-41ed-b3e6-5f697cf1bfea"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to encourage, urge, or express disbelief, often said quickly and informally.
