flashcards.examples: [{"id": "61aaab13-8c48-4e4e-ae4c-f9e32fba29bc", "textEn": "Come on, let's go!", "textEs": "¡Vamos, vámonos!", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "b5d23b73-29b5-4b86-a3ba-52cf4f3f3579"}, {"id": "daf3e05d-74ad-4beb-a8b6-dc1f6cfb3e64", "textEn": "Come on, you can do it.", "textEs": "Vamos, tú puedes hacerlo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "b5d23b73-29b5-4b86-a3ba-52cf4f3f3579"}, {"id": "3441a381-c6c0-4ce7-b268-494fa7439388", "textEn": "Come on, we're going to be late!", "textEs": "¡Vamos, vamos a llegar tarde!", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "b5d23b73-29b5-4b86-a3ba-52cf4f3f3579"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Commonly used as a verb meaning to cause something to go or be taken to a destination, often in casual commands like 'Send it to me' or in digital contexts like 'Send a message.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "8ae2ac81-8915-44a0-8d32-a97d97820d63", "textEn": "Please send me the file by email.", "textEs": "Por favor, envíame el archivo por correo electrónico.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "effd0cbb-051f-4ca5-b0a9-03e80dba052c"}, {"id": "c9d101a1-15e1-4cc6-af41-91687f394b67", "textEn": "They will send a package tomorrow.", "textEs": "Enviarán un paquete mañana.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "effd0cbb-051f-4ca5-b0a9-03e80dba052c"}, {"id": "fbca604d-5fba-4e7b-aede-b6d3da3b5092", "textEn": "Can you send me the file by email?", "textEs": "¿Puedes enviarme el archivo por correo electrónico?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "effd0cbb-051f-4ca5-b0a9-03e80dba052c"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the soft, curly hair from sheep or other animals, often in contexts like clothing, knitting, or textiles.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "8a19fd83-103b-4a54-930b-a0bc0baba3f9", "textEn": "This sweater is made of wool.", "textEs": "Este suéter está hecho de lana.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "d947972f-aeea-4628-bc4e-8d4914677bf7"}, {"id": "a06000f2-910f-4fd4-bb27-a2fa40467999", "textEn": "She knitted a scarf with wool.", "textEs": "Ella tejió una bufanda con lana.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "d947972f-aeea-4628-bc4e-8d4914677bf7"}, {"id": "268603b2-26bc-4268-a1dd-e7429b7ff535", "textEn": "The sheep's wool is so thick and fluffy this season.", "textEs": "La lana de la oveja está tan espesa y esponjosa esta temporada.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "d947972f-aeea-4628-bc4e-8d4914677bf7"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something solid or unyielding, like a handshake or a decision; also common in business contexts meaning a company.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "8fe04f82-37fa-4f02-9600-8298cd3ea493", "textEn": "The ground is firm.", "textEs": "El suelo está firme.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "c1afe169-af58-4f75-bc3c-d350706b53ae"}, {"id": "f2faeba3-99c9-428c-bd96-c6eb0a30f1c7", "textEn": "He works at a law firm.", "textEs": "Él trabaja en un bufete de abogados.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "c1afe169-af58-4f75-bc3c-d350706b53ae"}, {"id": "39ec3565-2b3d-4de7-9dfa-4c34c2f7c259", "textEn": "The ground felt firm under my feet after the rain stopped.", "textEs": "El suelo se sentía firme bajo mis pies después de que dejó de llover.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "c1afe169-af58-4f75-bc3c-d350706b53ae"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the hard parts inside a body, or informally to indicate a basic or essential part of something, like 'the bare bones'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "3e14e0b4-e188-4e67-834e-663eae46a941", "textEn": "The dog buried a bone in the yard.", "textEs": "El perro enterró un hueso en el jardín.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "add2112a-4438-47e3-87e1-266946068f4b"}, {"id": "aed64085-ac93-4769-8859-8d9d419ec69a", "textEn": "He broke a bone in his arm.", "textEs": "Se rompió un hueso en el brazo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "add2112a-4438-47e3-87e1-266946068f4b"}, {"id": "eabf1194-3c61-42e6-8949-91fc51632a4d", "textEn": "I have a bone to pick with you about the dishes.", "textEs": "Tengo un hueso que pelar contigo sobre los platos.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "add2112a-4438-47e3-87e1-266946068f4b"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe a soft, steady light or a brief flash of brightness, often in poetic or descriptive contexts, like 'a gleam of hope' or 'the gleam of polished metal'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "123ae7c2-e8fa-4546-8308-b08f68c62049", "textEn": "The stars gleam brightly in the night sky.", "textEs": "Las estrellas brillan intensamente en el cielo nocturno.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "80a4fd2a-7cdb-46c7-932a-73504771e6bf"}, {"id": "9f2167c6-da01-457a-8785-a84a102aa4eb", "textEn": "A gleam of hope appeared in his eyes.", "textEs": "Un destello de esperanza apareció en sus ojos.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "80a4fd2a-7cdb-46c7-932a-73504771e6bf"}, {"id": "f2f415ba-c622-4740-bce0-6a738c1dea6a", "textEn": "Her eyes gleamed with excitement when she saw the surprise.", "textEs": "Sus ojos brillaron de emoción cuando vio la sorpresa.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "80a4fd2a-7cdb-46c7-932a-73504771e6bf"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to indicate a brief written record, a musical tone, or to draw attention to something important in conversation.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "86182605-22d8-4af2-aa42-28c3adc0c52b", "textEn": "Please take a note of this.", "textEs": "Por favor, toma nota de esto.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "870bf669-d09e-4b38-a8f8-f7bef51a823d"}, {"id": "cb602bc0-d9df-4483-84c9-b536b3ccc111", "textEn": "She left a note on the table.", "textEs": "Ella dejó una nota en la mesa.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "870bf669-d09e-4b38-a8f8-f7bef51a823d"}, {"id": "9027d03e-5fb8-4b7e-a4ec-537b6a67cbda", "textEn": "Did you note the time of the explosion in your report?", "textEs": "¿Anotaste la hora de la explosión en tu informe?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "870bf669-d09e-4b38-a8f8-f7bef51a823d"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a noun for a visual representation of an area, or as a verb meaning to plan or chart something, like mapping out a route.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "b43170ca-0cf6-4921-a75e-532dea5ba65f", "textEn": "I have a map of the city.", "textEs": "Tengo un mapa de la ciudad.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "3b0f5136-4a68-4657-9c33-446048c57dc9"}, {"id": "177933bb-f465-4fde-a2ce-608531a3c653", "textEn": "Read the map carefully.", "textEs": "Lee el mapa con cuidado.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "3b0f5136-4a68-4657-9c33-446048c57dc9"}, {"id": "90afc501-07b5-4959-af62-4057b0bbe376", "textEn": "The map shows all the hiking trails in the national park.", "textEs": "El mapa muestra todos los senderos para caminatas en el parque nacional.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "3b0f5136-4a68-4657-9c33-446048c57dc9"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to indicate separation, departure, or disconnection, e.g., 'turn off the light' or 'I'm off to work'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "9146e299-cb0b-4523-b0aa-547ff205a9b5", "textEn": "Turn off the lights before leaving.", "textEs": "Apaga las luces antes de irte.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "a95ec8b8-1a4e-4dd7-ba52-743ede9d742f"}, {"id": "89deac5d-e934-4a18-beab-e60276996b0c", "textEn": "He took the day off from work.", "textEs": "Él se tomó el día libre del trabajo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "a95ec8b8-1a4e-4dd7-ba52-743ede9d742f"}, {"id": "85af9c96-d022-4843-8c21-ef8007fe8cda", "textEn": "The milk smells a bit off, I think it's gone bad.", "textEs": "La leche huele un poco rara, creo que se echó a perder.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "a95ec8b8-1a4e-4dd7-ba52-743ede9d742f"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to show evidence or demonstrate the truth of something, often in arguments or scientific contexts.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "e9facacf-44cb-4d27-99e5-b5d01dcbf2fe", "textEn": "Can you prove your theory?", "textEs": "¿Puedes probar tu teoría?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "56a3ad5f-bd59-48b0-b4a0-6b9aa88b8f26"}, {"id": "b69bad43-6f1e-43d9-81e6-fa1fb8cd9364", "textEn": "The test will prove his innocence.", "textEs": "La prueba demostrará su inocencia.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "56a3ad5f-bd59-48b0-b4a0-6b9aa88b8f26"}, {"id": "a66cb863-ff46-40c1-ad2a-8a774f2608cb", "textEn": "I need to prove to my boss that I can handle this project on my own.", "textEs": "Necesito demostrarle a mi jefe que puedo manejar este proyecto por mi cuenta.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "56a3ad5f-bd59-48b0-b4a0-6b9aa88b8f26"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something in a clear, strong, or detailed way, often when recalling memories or describing images.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "3eb6151d-b2a2-4817-a3e3-ace30d2fb783", "textEn": "I remember that day vividly.", "textEs": "Recuerdo ese día vívidamente.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "73c7be58-c38c-43c8-9db6-b3884b9fd1f2"}, {"id": "ba988f7d-7ed0-4a71-a35e-49d0cbc2e226", "textEn": "She described the scene vividly.", "textEs": "Ella describió la escena vívidamente.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "73c7be58-c38c-43c8-9db6-b3884b9fd1f2"}, {"id": "5261984f-0468-4e2a-bd1f-6469f7137d1b", "textEn": "I vividly remember the day we first met.", "textEs": "Recuerdo vívidamente el día que nos conocimos.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "73c7be58-c38c-43c8-9db6-b3884b9fd1f2"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe acquiring knowledge or skill, often in casual contexts like 'I need to learn this.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "5f345636-3806-4d51-b852-7031a697cdec", "textEn": "I want to learn Spanish.", "textEs": "Quiero aprender español.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "31ef4030-8aa0-4006-ae41-6466755fa31f"}, {"id": "e12ea00d-9244-4f90-82cc-6b14188a690b", "textEn": "She learned to play the guitar.", "textEs": "Ella aprendió a tocar la guitarra.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "31ef4030-8aa0-4006-ae41-6466755fa31f"}, {"id": "2da7b477-1a2b-4c30-b0c6-be5672989a17", "textEn": "I need to learn how to cook Italian food.", "textEs": "Necesito aprender a cocinar comida italiana.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "31ef4030-8aa0-4006-ae41-6466755fa31f"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to add extra information or items, often in lists or comparisons, meaning 'in addition to'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "fb7f175a-4679-4b00-b6c0-1b779c31298a", "textEn": "He speaks French as well as Spanish.", "textEs": "Él habla francés además de español.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "4f1613da-7c34-4c7f-adcc-600d69d845d2"}, {"id": "6df5ef31-89c9-489c-ae5c-e6134968fee4", "textEn": "The course covers theory as well as practical skills.", "textEs": "El curso cubre teoría así como habilidades prácticas.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "4f1613da-7c34-4c7f-adcc-600d69d845d2"}, {"id": "4e7db6ee-5688-4fa8-ae04-df73d16c1b34", "textEn": "She enjoys painting as well as drawing.", "textEs": "Ella disfruta pintar así como dibujar.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "4f1613da-7c34-4c7f-adcc-600d69d845d2"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something happening before the expected or usual time, often in casual conversation about schedules or timing.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "f625c934-9222-4be5-96c9-fa0f173e7af3", "textEn": "We arrived early for the meeting.", "textEs": "Llegamos temprano a la reunión.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "ed7a6d31-e728-4ebb-9746-d03556482103"}, {"id": "59da28ba-07c6-46c1-85f9-9fa545b06469", "textEn": "Early birds catch the worm.", "textEs": "A quien madruga, Dios le ayuda.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "ed7a6d31-e728-4ebb-9746-d03556482103"}, {"id": "120f2a84-00a2-42ae-800f-c08295bc2fe2", "textEn": "I need to leave early tomorrow for my flight.", "textEs": "Necesito salir temprano mañana para mi vuelo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "ed7a6d31-e728-4ebb-9746-d03556482103"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to suggest changing the topic or approach in a conversation or activity, often to introduce a new idea or focus.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "9e89346b-6b3d-49b5-9c3b-b62090a745c4", "textEn": "Now let's shift gears and talk about our marketing strategy.", "textEs": "Ahora cambiemos de tema y hablemos de nuestra estrategia de marketing.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "22f88080-f3c7-4071-a799-6322054a014d"}, {"id": "64bd8880-56d1-4734-9581-da3290e03de7", "textEn": "Let's shift gears to the customer feedback section.", "textEs": "Cambiemos de enfoque a la sección de comentarios de clientes.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "22f88080-f3c7-4071-a799-6322054a014d"}, {"id": "d615e2ac-eb23-47f0-aced-1177268f3446", "textEn": "Let's shift gears and talk about the marketing strategy for next quarter.", "textEs": "Cambiemos de tema y hablemos de la estrategia de marketing para el próximo trimestre.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "22f88080-f3c7-4071-a799-6322054a014d"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe the color, or to indicate inexperience or environmental friendliness.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "d1fc4801-4386-41ff-bd47-c914a65ab343", "textEn": "The grass is very green after the rain.", "textEs": "El pasto está muy verde después de la lluvia.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "9cf4a48f-3f28-4b96-ae27-7c93ac5ce485"}, {"id": "b078922b-1935-4695-a2e3-e7b3fdcb5535", "textEn": "She wore a green dress to the party.", "textEs": "Ella usó un vestido verde a la fiesta.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "9cf4a48f-3f28-4b96-ae27-7c93ac5ce485"}, {"id": "801ea3db-c0a8-43d1-93e8-42f6fbdcfe36", "textEn": "The leaves are so green after the rain.", "textEs": "Las hojas están tan verdes después de la lluvia.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "9cf4a48f-3f28-4b96-ae27-7c93ac5ce485"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally to mean 'cool' or 'awesome', often with emphasis; also literally means ill.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "5f007002-d4d4-4556-b700-8d2f19ce366f", "textEn": "He feels sick after eating too much.", "textEs": "Él se siente enfermo después de comer demasiado.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "03098b49-fe57-45c3-b29c-595578b7c5dd"}, {"id": "50e1535a-2055-4029-b392-8ff31efad34f", "textEn": "She is sick with a cold.", "textEs": "Ella está enferma con un resfriado.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "03098b49-fe57-45c3-b29c-595578b7c5dd"}, {"id": "4441667e-e71f-483b-83f2-56c74db86518", "textEn": "That skateboard trick was sick, dude!", "textEs": "¡Ese truco de skate fue increíble, tío!", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "03098b49-fe57-45c3-b29c-595578b7c5dd"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to mean 'minimal' or 'just enough,' as in 'the bare essentials,' or informally to emphasize something obvious, like 'it’s bare cold outside.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "88c96175-1088-4f38-a77f-7e1726a94a79", "textEn": "His feet were bare on the cold floor.", "textEs": "Sus pies estaban desnudos en el suelo frío.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "56a66eaa-a9b8-483d-9304-cfbe92631041"}, {"id": "6c967448-ca46-43c1-abc1-7d73a60f9f94", "textEn": "The tree branches are bare in winter.", "textEs": "Las ramas del árbol están desnudas en invierno.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "56a66eaa-a9b8-483d-9304-cfbe92631041"}, {"id": "693770a2-8c78-47d7-a436-5a7af1db4655", "textEn": "The fridge is completely bare, we need to go grocery shopping.", "textEs": "El refrigerador está completamente vacío, tenemos que ir a hacer la compra.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "56a66eaa-a9b8-483d-9304-cfbe92631041"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe throwing something with force or carelessness, often in a quick or energetic manner.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "b65f20d7-0c8e-403f-ba61-27a906c387dc", "textEn": "The boy was flinging stones into the river.", "textEs": "El niño estaba lanzando piedras al río.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "26eced1f-a003-4403-a6a5-55dfd052e12a"}, {"id": "f2cfdb88-5269-4fdd-a194-a84d8d989764", "textEn": "She was flinging her arms around in excitement.", "textEs": "Estaba lanzando los brazos por la emoción.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "26eced1f-a003-4403-a6a5-55dfd052e12a"}, {"id": "1f5de738-9a27-4990-8ba8-841a6e57e16b", "textEn": "She was flinging her clothes all over the room in a hurry.", "textEs": "Estaba tirando su ropa por toda la habitación apresuradamente.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "26eced1f-a003-4403-a6a5-55dfd052e12a"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to something said or done to provoke laughter, often in casual conversation or storytelling.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "eabd0bd9-e77f-4244-872c-27aef71af731", "textEn": "He told a funny joke at the party.", "textEs": "Él contó una broma graciosa en la fiesta.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "bdc81746-e2c9-4202-ad3b-528f063de8f4"}, {"id": "4b240579-3719-4b7c-8317-9c3a30078c5c", "textEn": "Don't take it seriously, it's just a joke.", "textEs": "No lo tomes en serio, es solo una broma.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "bdc81746-e2c9-4202-ad3b-528f063de8f4"}, {"id": "98b70439-5370-43fc-a8da-203a2c3dae94", "textEn": "Stop joking around and get back to work.", "textEs": "Deja de bromear y vuelve al trabajo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "bdc81746-e2c9-4202-ad3b-528f063de8f4"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Often contracted to 'what's' in casual speech, used to ask for information or clarification.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "56759ca9-af9f-4c41-943d-b44fc213fc1e", "textEn": "What is that noise?", "textEs": "¿Qué es ese ruido?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "117cac0f-afa9-4177-a053-d8fc29125589"}, {"id": "2247fbe0-1737-4b0f-ae7c-8574710b6cc0", "textEn": "What is your name?", "textEs": "¿Cuál es tu nombre?", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "117cac0f-afa9-4177-a053-d8fc29125589"}, {"id": "4f8ad0a1-6095-4096-ae50-2f11cb74c596", "textEn": "What is that noise outside?", "textEs": "¿Qué es ese ruido afuera?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "117cac0f-afa9-4177-a053-d8fc29125589"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the large wild cat, often in contexts of wildlife, strength, or as a metaphor for fierceness.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "641686d7-c75f-43d8-9135-ebd66eb30a8a", "textEn": "The tiger is a wild animal.", "textEs": "El tigre es un animal salvaje.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "d045a503-db4b-46bd-b27a-3fc886db33d7"}, {"id": "d0e23154-2be8-4c43-9ec2-3f7fdc5c1d0e", "textEn": "She saw a tiger at the zoo.", "textEs": "Ella vio un tigre en el zoológico.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "d045a503-db4b-46bd-b27a-3fc886db33d7"}, {"id": "e0d87eb8-e5cf-45fa-a1d9-a629f1f2316e", "textEn": "The tiger roared loudly in the jungle.", "textEs": "El tigre rugió fuertemente en la selva.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "d045a503-db4b-46bd-b27a-3fc886db33d7"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in everyday conversation when referring to a proof of purchase, often pronounced with a silent 'p'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "84b3f69b-742e-4d03-8b72-0c46261f7e7d", "textEn": "Keep the receipt for your purchase.", "textEs": "Guarda el recibo de tu compra.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "052fa3ea-67e5-4202-8bd9-29675ec1ea9d"}, {"id": "92efd22c-4fdd-4a42-a640-3f393f18a283", "textEn": "I need a receipt for the refund.", "textEs": "Necesito un recibo para el reembolso.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "052fa3ea-67e5-4202-8bd9-29675ec1ea9d"}, {"id": "bea7c04a-55c4-498a-9946-b83867e926cf", "textEn": "Could I have a receipt, please?", "textEs": "¿Me podría dar un recibo, por favor?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "052fa3ea-67e5-4202-8bd9-29675ec1ea9d"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the hard, white structures in the mouth for biting and chewing, often in phrases like 'brush your teeth' or 'sweet tooth' for a craving for sugary foods.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "92795bdc-503c-40d4-9eda-f899d3833833", "textEn": "I need to brush my tooth every day.", "textEs": "Necesito cepillarme el diente todos los días.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "559fbf45-3cd7-47e9-b207-a3c770c2d32a"}, {"id": "dc91ed5f-f563-4c7e-8382-1f7a4eaaf634", "textEn": "She lost a tooth last night.", "textEs": "Ella perdió un diente anoche.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "559fbf45-3cd7-47e9-b207-a3c770c2d32a"}, {"id": "008b9b3e-9dc5-48fe-a868-9e0f1e7442fc", "textEn": "The baby's first tooth finally came in last week.", "textEs": "El primer diente del bebé finalmente salió la semana pasada.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "559fbf45-3cd7-47e9-b207-a3c770c2d32a"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to mean 'every one of' or 'the entire amount of', often contracted to 'all of' in casual speech, like 'all of us' or 'all of the time'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "1f4416f8-dd29-47e2-b6db-f536aeefdb80", "textEn": "All of the students passed.", "textEs": "Todos los estudiantes aprobaron.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "1c72c324-a0fe-441e-9ed7-1102a6478ec4"}, {"id": "982f878b-a5a4-4e6c-9a1e-36b1035a1129", "textEn": "I ate all of the cake.", "textEs": "Me comí todo el pastel.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "1c72c324-a0fe-441e-9ed7-1102a6478ec4"}, {"id": "bef0f08c-5fab-4133-b920-bfab77356be8", "textEn": "All of the students passed the exam.", "textEs": "Todos los estudiantes aprobaron el examen.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "1c72c324-a0fe-441e-9ed7-1102a6478ec4"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe achieving victory or success in a competition, game, or argument; often said with emphasis or excitement in casual conversation.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "f239a382-d309-4b1a-8ac7-46918dd95def", "textEn": "They hope to win the game.", "textEs": "Ellos esperan ganar el partido.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "0d233de2-8413-41ee-8479-dd767c609ee6"}, {"id": "bcd5de89-dccf-4403-b406-12aaf9a354e0", "textEn": "She always wins at chess.", "textEs": "Ella siempre gana al ajedrez.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "0d233de2-8413-41ee-8479-dd767c609ee6"}, {"id": "7a2eff5f-36ea-443c-a254-f4f6f7851455", "textEn": "I hope we win the game tonight.", "textEs": "Espero que ganemos el partido esta noche.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "0d233de2-8413-41ee-8479-dd767c609ee6"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a floor mat or carpet, often in casual conversation about home decor or cleaning.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "045e3ad9-dd8a-4da8-88e1-33c7d19f64ac", "textEn": "She bought a new rug for the living room.", "textEs": "Compró una alfombra nueva para la sala.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "320541e8-1ffc-4827-baf0-0c613c1a7733"}, {"id": "3646fb9c-6cae-4c51-bf2a-526885889cbb", "textEn": "The cat is sleeping on the rug.", "textEs": "El gato está durmiendo en la alfombra.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "320541e8-1ffc-4827-baf0-0c613c1a7733"}, {"id": "d34c8d0f-3c57-4c78-b0a9-3f8b6b6f51b9", "textEn": "The cat is sleeping on the rug by the fireplace.", "textEs": "El gato está durmiendo en la alfombra junto a la chimenea.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "320541e8-1ffc-4827-baf0-0c613c1a7733"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a noun to refer to a tall plant with a trunk and branches, often in everyday contexts like pointing one out or discussing nature.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "65aed4cf-4903-469f-b6fc-777cd28ef661", "textEn": "The tall tree swayed in the wind.", "textEs": "El árbol alto se balanceaba con el viento.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "ed5e4a66-427b-4823-b64a-fb8541f6a98f"}, {"id": "865996a8-bf2a-42e3-88c3-3ef713cbac6a", "textEn": "We planted a new tree in the garden.", "textEs": "Plantamos un árbol nuevo en el jardín.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "ed5e4a66-427b-4823-b64a-fb8541f6a98f"}, {"id": "b77a6896-8043-47e2-b006-ee62dfa1b0f6", "textEn": "The wind rustled through the leaves of the old oak tree.", "textEs": "El viento susurraba entre las hojas del viejo roble.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "ed5e4a66-427b-4823-b64a-fb8541f6a98f"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a verb meaning to put items into a container, or as a noun for a bundle or group of items.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "f7e9f146-3056-4a9d-8980-b20366d473f5", "textEn": "I need to pack my suitcase for the trip.", "textEs": "Necesito empacar mi maleta para el viaje.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "742e818f-d7f6-4142-9f05-e46426df5e74"}, {"id": "ef780199-517b-40da-bb12-ebdd5f2a193a", "textEn": "He bought a pack of gum at the store.", "textEs": "Él compró un paquete de chicle en la tienda.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "742e818f-d7f6-4142-9f05-e46426df5e74"}, {"id": "07ccdddb-0b97-437b-b424-3a365bdf2040", "textEn": "I need to pack my suitcase before the trip tomorrow.", "textEs": "Necesito hacer mi maleta antes del viaje de mañana.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "742e818f-d7f6-4142-9f05-e46426df5e74"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the highest point or best position, often in casual contexts like 'top of the class' or 'top shelf'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "b1dc9da8-92a4-4116-919f-9c59acb9425e", "textEn": "Put it on the top shelf.", "textEs": "Ponlo en el estante superior.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "cfe6e7f2-7e0f-4e90-bcd7-c3922d857cb9"}, {"id": "b54eadf6-111b-4c66-a45f-1628f3180f08", "textEn": "He climbed to the top of the mountain.", "textEs": "Él escaló hasta la cima de la montaña.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "cfe6e7f2-7e0f-4e90-bcd7-c3922d857cb9"}, {"id": "54981fb0-d6a5-4e42-b3f3-99ddd5bc76ef", "textEn": "I'm going to top up my gas tank before the road trip.", "textEs": "Voy a llenar el tanque de gasolina antes del viaje por carretera.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "cfe6e7f2-7e0f-4e90-bcd7-c3922d857cb9"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to any mode of transport like a car, truck, or bus; often pronounced with a slight glide between the 'i' and 'k' sounds.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "1c1b55b6-12b0-4a01-88b1-b7349db42369", "textEn": "This vehicle runs on electricity.", "textEs": "Este vehículo funciona con electricidad.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "751b0ec9-1d03-483f-aa61-89188a8f896b"}, {"id": "d58d6219-75c8-4c6f-9cf2-b98c94242a6d", "textEn": "We need a larger vehicle for the trip.", "textEs": "Necesitamos un vehículo más grande para el viaje.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "751b0ec9-1d03-483f-aa61-89188a8f896b"}, {"id": "7a837ae0-1dab-4df5-ab15-88a44e7eb0bd", "textEn": "The vehicle in front of us suddenly stopped.", "textEs": "El vehículo delante de nosotros se detuvo de repente.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "751b0ec9-1d03-483f-aa61-89188a8f896b"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to express gratitude, often in quick, casual exchanges like 'thanks' or 'thank you'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "2d2bff22-e2fe-4532-a01d-62a9bebbbe07", "textEn": "I want to thank you for your help.", "textEs": "Quiero agradecerte por tu ayuda.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "05e02e6d-1606-434f-a7ee-12e2063aa48c"}, {"id": "c0f61e96-f297-47f3-9921-0604214313a3", "textEn": "She thanked him with a smile.", "textEs": "Ella le agradeció con una sonrisa.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "05e02e6d-1606-434f-a7ee-12e2063aa48c"}, {"id": "e38d5e27-e47e-4efa-abac-bf3eccefcb00", "textEn": "Thank you for your help with the project.", "textEs": "Gracias por tu ayuda con el proyecto.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "05e02e6d-1606-434f-a7ee-12e2063aa48c"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a verb meaning to say hello or welcome someone, often in casual or formal interactions.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "18ad1b9c-3a17-4582-8c83-d8a80fe9d10e", "textEn": "He will greet the guests at the door.", "textEs": "Él saludará a los invitados en la puerta.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "40369518-a5e3-4307-93c8-5a8ffbd2f0bc"}, {"id": "b19360d0-f6fe-4454-90ca-5b7cdb721f08", "textEn": "They greet each other with a warm smile.", "textEs": "Se saludan mutuamente con una sonrisa cálida.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "40369518-a5e3-4307-93c8-5a8ffbd2f0bc"}, {"id": "afcbbd30-71b3-4d71-bd66-d9e7ce073728", "textEn": "I always greet my neighbors with a smile when I see them in the morning.", "textEs": "Siempre saludo a mis vecinos con una sonrisa cuando los veo por la mañana.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "40369518-a5e3-4307-93c8-5a8ffbd2f0bc"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a place where drinks are served, a long piece of metal or wood, or a unit of pressure; often pronounced with a clear, open 'a' sound in American English.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "ac01de8b-8c8f-4049-a81f-c9a0657299dc", "textEn": "Let's meet at the bar after work.", "textEs": "Encontrémonos en el bar después del trabajo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "6745b374-99be-4dc0-b257-e192f8745a67"}, {"id": "8bfe3f88-0911-4f5c-a48a-5095fda0f12c", "textEn": "He ordered a drink at the bar.", "textEs": "Él pidió una bebida en el bar.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "6745b374-99be-4dc0-b257-e192f8745a67"}, {"id": "d4855f10-c405-4b15-95ea-8a8655677d46", "textEn": "The dog started to bar loudly when the mailman arrived.", "textEs": "El perro empezó a ladrar fuerte cuando llegó el cartero.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "6745b374-99be-4dc0-b257-e192f8745a67"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe a secure room for storing valuables, or as a verb meaning to jump over something using hands or a pole.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "078b52e6-2352-48ff-b77d-6ca1e300b9b7", "textEn": "The bank keeps money in a vault.", "textEs": "El banco guarda dinero en una bóveda.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "4a80acfd-1c1c-42a9-b33f-40cd86075179"}, {"id": "128eb786-6b73-43e9-a1b2-5bb1b77ab460", "textEn": "He vaulted over the fence easily.", "textEs": "Él saltó la cerca fácilmente.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "4a80acfd-1c1c-42a9-b33f-40cd86075179"}, {"id": "2a696bb2-859f-4cd2-a4ee-fe5258c61612", "textEn": "The heavy door of the vault clicked shut behind us.", "textEs": "La pesada puerta de la bóveda se cerró de golpe detrás de nosotros.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "4a80acfd-1c1c-42a9-b33f-40cd86075179"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to introduce a contrasting or alternative perspective, often in casual conversation or informal writing.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "7a44a9ef-f0bb-4800-a695-bd9f47b24439", "textEn": "Working from home offers flexibility. On the flip side, it can be isolating.", "textEs": "Trabajar desde casa ofrece flexibilidad. Por otro lado, puede ser aislante.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "96173c41-e6c4-4bde-87d9-c0b78b65d643"}, {"id": "38d7a95a-560e-4c50-9ad5-67ff119e4707", "textEn": "The new phone has a great camera. On the flip side, the battery life is poor.", "textEs": "El nuevo teléfono tiene una gran cámara. Por otro lado, la duración de la batería es mala.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "96173c41-e6c4-4bde-87d9-c0b78b65d643"}, {"id": "a5bd7d2c-e93b-44a1-ab21-c463d730f2f3", "textEn": "On the flip side, working from home gives you more flexibility with your schedule.", "textEs": "Por otro lado, trabajar desde casa te da más flexibilidad con tu horario.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "96173c41-e6c4-4bde-87d9-c0b78b65d643"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Commonly used to refer to a plot of land for growing flowers, vegetables, or plants; in natural speech, it can also mean a backyard or yard, especially in British English.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "42994e0b-a438-40ad-a81d-2d556aad0a0d", "textEn": "The garden is full of flowers.", "textEs": "El jardín está lleno de flores.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "530bc0a6-6864-4c3f-92df-ea91db62d50e"}, {"id": "9d312f71-93ec-49f7-ae3b-90fe2ce9263f", "textEn": "He waters the garden every morning.", "textEs": "Él riega el jardín cada mañana.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "530bc0a6-6864-4c3f-92df-ea91db62d50e"}, {"id": "676f2c5a-af4d-47d9-931a-c1ce542ae2d1", "textEn": "I spent the whole morning weeding the garden.", "textEs": "Pasé toda la mañana desyerbando el jardín.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "530bc0a6-6864-4c3f-92df-ea91db62d50e"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Often reduced in fast speech to 'lookit' or 'look at' with a quick, connected sound, used to direct attention or express surprise.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "fae8b670-7a4f-4f8d-a850-a44198bd8ca2", "textEn": "Look at that bird!", "textEs": "¡Mira ese pájaro!", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "16e23c05-227d-49a8-b05c-c5ed6854d7ff"}, {"id": "1422d87b-6a51-471e-9d5c-f88f9c5abf4c", "textEn": "Look at the time, it's late.", "textEs": "Mira la hora, es tarde.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "16e23c05-227d-49a8-b05c-c5ed6854d7ff"}, {"id": "ac640a90-999e-4f01-b6ab-341008fd35d7", "textEn": "Look at that sunset!", "textEs": "¡Mira ese atardecer!", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "16e23c05-227d-49a8-b05c-c5ed6854d7ff"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the short, thick digit on the hand, often in phrases like 'thumb through' (to flip pages) or 'rule of thumb' (a general principle).
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "9604e5fe-c1b7-4f7d-bfa3-04bd35dba36f", "textEn": "He hit his thumb with the hammer.", "textEs": "Se golpeó el pulgar con el martillo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "3f442918-27ec-4cff-85c7-c97b1e9c313e"}, {"id": "1f34c23f-5f3d-47df-9e5f-a5590ad827d9", "textEn": "She gave a thumbs up to show approval.", "textEs": "Hizo un gesto de pulgar arriba para mostrar aprobación.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "3f442918-27ec-4cff-85c7-c97b1e9c313e"}, {"id": "b43b9a6d-336c-4141-b795-c547d4d8e472", "textEn": "She gave the performance a thumbs up.", "textEs": "Ella le dio un pulgar arriba a la actuación.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "3f442918-27ec-4cff-85c7-c97b1e9c313e"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally to express that food tastes good, often in a playful or childlike tone.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "5b70c46f-e152-49ba-ade0-b09c80a75bc1", "textEn": "This cake is really yummy.", "textEs": "Este pastel está realmente delicioso.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "dbc618d2-6070-4d96-a226-747fcc4a829b"}, {"id": "4553a199-973a-40c6-87e2-78a2cd2310e0", "textEn": "The kids said the pizza was yummy.", "textEs": "Los niños dijeron que la pizza estaba deliciosa.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "dbc618d2-6070-4d96-a226-747fcc4a829b"}, {"id": "358b843f-4944-4ca5-a7a8-71f4babd1471", "textEn": "This pizza is so yummy! I could eat it every day.", "textEs": "¡Esta pizza está tan deliciosa! Podría comerla todos los días.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "dbc618d2-6070-4d96-a226-747fcc4a829b"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a verb meaning to abandon, or as a noun for a dry, barren area; the verb is stressed on the second syllable, while the noun is often pronounced /ˈdɛzərt/.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "0e511990-2dd0-4da6-a320-2b9dfc20a345", "textEn": "The Sahara is a huge desert.", "textEs": "El Sahara es un desierto enorme.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "aaa7762d-ebbf-45f1-b4e3-71a99f3578f1"}, {"id": "1edb19be-87f1-4510-91b0-661753c65a68", "textEn": "Camels can survive in the desert.", "textEs": "Los camellos pueden sobrevivir en el desierto.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "aaa7762d-ebbf-45f1-b4e3-71a99f3578f1"}, {"id": "6ba7e873-136b-40f8-a05f-284bf4b06d41", "textEn": "The desert stretches for miles under the scorching sun.", "textEs": "El desierto se extiende por millas bajo el sol abrasador.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "aaa7762d-ebbf-45f1-b4e3-71a99f3578f1"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe a sudden loud noise, a collision, or a failure, like a computer crash or a car accident.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "395724af-cb21-4c67-b449-87937cd6ee3a", "textEn": "The car crash caused a major traffic jam.", "textEs": "El choque de autos causó un gran atasco de tráfico.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "25970703-68ab-412d-8389-86328bce985b"}, {"id": "46eb4350-b9d9-4747-9a75-0ec7cc0cac39", "textEn": "The waves crash against the rocks with great force.", "textEs": "Las olas se estrellan contra las rocas con gran fuerza.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "25970703-68ab-412d-8389-86328bce985b"}, {"id": "5b4a2999-0b20-4eb7-bbc8-5ece264a8929", "textEn": "I heard a loud crash in the kitchen and ran to see what fell.", "textEs": "Escuché un fuerte estrépito en la cocina y corrí a ver qué se cayó.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "25970703-68ab-412d-8389-86328bce985b"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to indicate that a supply of something has been completely used up or exhausted, often in everyday situations like 'We've run out of milk.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "d9649ea3-4555-4f3a-9025-3ca37c83acfc", "textEn": "We ran out of milk.", "textEs": "Nos quedamos sin leche.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "8fb58100-7472-4215-8d1b-da0de6a8712f"}, {"id": "905bb6ed-99c4-4363-aa9e-d46fd0d90fbb", "textEn": "Time is running out.", "textEs": "El tiempo se está agotando.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "8fb58100-7472-4215-8d1b-da0de6a8712f"}, {"id": "a3f4f738-ab1f-4299-a0f2-c2d892d623e6", "textEn": "I ran out of milk, so I need to go to the store.", "textEs": "Me quedé sin leche, así que necesito ir a la tienda.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "8fb58100-7472-4215-8d1b-da0de6a8712f"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to good fortune or chance, often in casual greetings like 'Good luck!' or in phrases like 'Just my luck.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "b38eccad-61a7-44ea-b941-fd1258d6466e", "textEn": "Good luck with your exam tomorrow!", "textEs": "¡Buena suerte con tu examen mañana!", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "4e2a21f1-305a-46b5-acab-19b4078a2ad8"}, {"id": "9fa85168-c405-4924-bcc9-8ce7b14cecae", "textEn": "He had no luck finding his keys.", "textEs": "No tuvo suerte encontrando sus llaves.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "4e2a21f1-305a-46b5-acab-19b4078a2ad8"}, {"id": "df9654fb-5388-459f-a95d-2400ba45281a", "textEn": "I wish you the best of luck on your exam tomorrow.", "textEs": "Te deseo mucha suerte en tu examen de mañana.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "4e2a21f1-305a-46b5-acab-19b4078a2ad8"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a noun for a man about to be married or as a verb meaning to clean or prepare oneself or an animal.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "7760a983-629c-43bc-a279-48cf6e7df256", "textEn": "The groom looked nervous at the altar.", "textEs": "El novio se veía nervioso en el altar.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "fb78a7e4-1d59-420e-a8a9-8edf3ff6422e"}, {"id": "1f1f841f-16db-44d9-86d7-c862e3ed5425", "textEn": "She needs to groom her dog every week.", "textEs": "Ella necesita acicalar a su perro cada semana.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "fb78a7e4-1d59-420e-a8a9-8edf3ff6422e"}, {"id": "67487f77-4b2f-424e-8004-c5b376fda81a", "textEn": "The horse was calm as the groom brushed its mane.", "textEs": "El caballo estaba tranquilo mientras el mozo le cepillaba la crin.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "fb78a7e4-1d59-420e-a8a9-8edf3ff6422e"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe a sudden burst of light, emotion, or widening shape, often in contexts like anger flaring up or a skirt with flare.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "e3666135-117d-4c27-a8d5-f01e35b8122f", "textEn": "The match produced a sudden flare.", "textEs": "El fósforo produjo una llamarada repentina.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "3c78bbc2-0a94-40f0-a3f5-54d24001b349"}, {"id": "00454b34-60c2-4f8f-ba82-421d4e4c90b9", "textEn": "Her skirt flares out at the bottom.", "textEs": "Su falda se ensancha en la parte inferior.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "3c78bbc2-0a94-40f0-a3f5-54d24001b349"}, {"id": "bf50c8bf-f3cc-4059-bdeb-284032c6ea7c", "textEn": "When the match flared, it lit up the entire room.", "textEs": "Cuando la cerilla se encendió, iluminó toda la habitación.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "3c78bbc2-0a94-40f0-a3f5-54d24001b349"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a container for cooking or storing things, or informally as a verb meaning to shoot or to put a plant in a pot.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "9809d771-9417-4230-b398-709266553c61", "textEn": "She cooked soup in a big pot.", "textEs": "Ella cocinó sopa en una olla grande.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "a9bf2651-bb36-45c1-9580-330950b31dd9"}, {"id": "a9d69b6d-dfd7-4696-84e0-9aed3a0b1768", "textEn": "The pot is hot, so be careful.", "textEs": "La olla está caliente, así que ten cuidado.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "a9bf2651-bb36-45c1-9580-330950b31dd9"}, {"id": "af4c21d2-b84f-401f-b7ce-937778318b72", "textEn": "I put the pot of water on the stove to boil.", "textEs": "Puse la olla de agua en la estufa para hervir.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "a9bf2651-bb36-45c1-9580-330950b31dd9"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a group of twelve items, often in casual contexts like buying eggs or describing quantities.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "cc501e32-2507-4dc7-aa74-279ab45c4ef5", "textEn": "Please buy a dozen eggs from the store.", "textEs": "Por favor, compra una docena de huevos en la tienda.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "962e88c5-233c-405a-99a4-ad8913b9bf5a"}, {"id": "4a06bac4-5343-48e6-bd7a-00a25e3babe2", "textEn": "There were a dozen people at the party.", "textEs": "Había una docena de personas en la fiesta.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "962e88c5-233c-405a-99a4-ad8913b9bf5a"}, {"id": "3e1a9745-8cc4-4380-a438-71029ebe34c4", "textEn": "I bought a dozen eggs from the market.", "textEs": "Compré una docena de huevos en el mercado.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "962e88c5-233c-405a-99a4-ad8913b9bf5a"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a general term for items worn on the body, like shirts, pants, and dresses; common in everyday conversation about attire or fashion.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "d5dd526d-e9ed-405d-ab1c-3e3af215dd13", "textEn": "She bought new clothing.", "textEs": "Ella compró ropa nueva.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "ef2a37c5-db3c-4f12-a358-b63ad48977e6"}, {"id": "87e54c0c-e9e5-4e31-8516-cce05a8bd424", "textEn": "Warm clothing is needed in winter.", "textEs": "Se necesita ropa abrigada en invierno.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "ef2a37c5-db3c-4f12-a358-b63ad48977e6"}, {"id": "03fa4dca-1dd8-449e-af9e-94aa4a7e8bc3", "textEn": "I need to buy some new clothing for the job interview.", "textEs": "Necesito comprar algo de ropa nueva para la entrevista de trabajo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "ef2a37c5-db3c-4f12-a358-b63ad48977e6"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a direct request or demand, often shortened to 'gimme' in casual speech.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "cf714750-a9dd-4313-9ca7-5446db0ef158", "textEn": "Give me a hand with this.", "textEs": "Dame una mano con esto.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "c0ec0f18-07d8-4a79-8dfc-0c88ea0e80e8"}, {"id": "b684c60b-90a9-4918-8519-b9f12b99b6e7", "textEn": "Give me your phone number.", "textEs": "Dame tu número de teléfono.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "c0ec0f18-07d8-4a79-8dfc-0c88ea0e80e8"}, {"id": "b39ead3c-2d0e-4e9f-9b42-ae516095340b", "textEn": "Give me a minute, I'll be right there.", "textEs": "Dame un minuto, ya voy.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "c0ec0f18-07d8-4a79-8dfc-0c88ea0e80e8"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe being occupied or having a lot to do, often in casual conversation like 'I'm busy right now' or 'It's a busy day.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "20695cb1-3814-4397-8c05-0492e5936a66", "textEn": "I am very busy with work today.", "textEs": "Estoy muy ocupado con el trabajo hoy.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "d290b0c5-02c0-49c5-b28d-fd746a9802e3"}, {"id": "2711a7fb-da9b-4940-9871-04d5a2b660b0", "textEn": "The streets are always busy in the city.", "textEs": "Las calles siempre están ocupadas en la ciudad.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "d290b0c5-02c0-49c5-b28d-fd746a9802e3"}, {"id": "1098fe49-7d5b-45a1-a962-d494e1febbb7", "textEn": "I'm busy with work this week, so I can't make it to the party.", "textEs": "Estoy ocupado con el trabajo esta semana, así que no puedo ir a la fiesta.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "d290b0c5-02c0-49c5-b28d-fd746a9802e3"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to either a place of worship or the side of the head, often in contexts like 'go to the temple' or 'temple of the head'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "18d75070-0b22-45fe-b003-33107759628d", "textEn": "They visited an ancient temple.", "textEs": "Visitaron un templo antiguo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "426ddacf-c9be-419d-8e95-b62b81ed1563"}, {"id": "4a5e7202-f2fd-4c45-8729-58083283e2fb", "textEn": "The temple is made of stone.", "textEs": "El templo está hecho de piedra.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "426ddacf-c9be-419d-8e95-b62b81ed1563"}, {"id": "7ff6a7f9-9156-48a4-a761-63e0fd637d2b", "textEn": "The temple bells rang softly in the morning breeze.", "textEs": "Las campanas del templo sonaron suavemente con la brisa matutina.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "426ddacf-c9be-419d-8e95-b62b81ed1563"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a large fortified building, often in historical contexts or fairy tales.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "d13970ac-fb65-46d2-be64-df984eb6da40", "textEn": "The old castle stood on the hill.", "textEs": "El viejo castillo se alzaba en la colina.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "5a92d9d9-63c6-478a-991b-13e3476086ad"}, {"id": "b7e14138-ff8c-4ca2-a14d-426917996c36", "textEn": "We visited a castle in Scotland.", "textEs": "Visitamos un castillo en Escocia.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "5a92d9d9-63c6-478a-991b-13e3476086ad"}, {"id": "a883f6a8-9416-400a-b180-684dc471031e", "textEn": "The children built a sandcastle on the beach.", "textEs": "Los niños construyeron un castillo de arena en la playa.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "5a92d9d9-63c6-478a-991b-13e3476086ad"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to suggest considering or reflecting on something, often in casual conversation or when giving advice.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "736d7e72-ebf9-43f7-8e75-b0bae5513fb8", "textEn": "Think about your future.", "textEs": "Piensa en tu futuro.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "860896ab-2989-42b3-979b-458982af9b13"}, {"id": "6193f693-58b5-47b7-82d0-097af368ccbb", "textEn": "I'll think about it.", "textEs": "Lo pensaré.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "860896ab-2989-42b3-979b-458982af9b13"}, {"id": "4f2e55fc-4290-40f8-aeb2-843939928f6b", "textEn": "I need to think about your offer before I decide.", "textEs": "Necesito pensar en tu oferta antes de decidir.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "860896ab-2989-42b3-979b-458982af9b13"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe a large area covered chiefly with trees and undergrowth, often in contexts like hiking, nature, or environmental discussions.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "3e69c6a7-bf78-47d8-bf7b-355bc26100e9", "textEn": "The forest is dense and dark.", "textEs": "El bosque es denso y oscuro.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "ef97f2ea-2e02-4222-8d8b-5b5506a849ab"}, {"id": "01726515-4db0-463b-ba99-9bf6568abbc4", "textEn": "We hiked through the forest.", "textEs": "Caminamos por el bosque.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "ef97f2ea-2e02-4222-8d8b-5b5506a849ab"}, {"id": "f3a81f4b-bb3a-497c-b455-8accc936dd7c", "textEn": "I love walking through the forest and listening to the birds sing.", "textEs": "Me encanta caminar por el bosque y escuchar cantar a los pájaros.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "ef97f2ea-2e02-4222-8d8b-5b5506a849ab"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something sugary, pleasant, or endearing; also a casual exclamation of approval or delight.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "4d3d685e-4bbb-4258-bf42-2639115be8e0", "textEn": "This candy is very sweet.", "textEs": "Este caramelo es muy dulce.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "e7dbf7db-637d-44ba-9b7b-b29ad7067a9d"}, {"id": "18608459-bc95-45eb-8390-559e8ae2f471", "textEn": "She has a sweet smile.", "textEs": "Ella tiene una sonrisa dulce.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "e7dbf7db-637d-44ba-9b7b-b29ad7067a9d"}, {"id": "1f9382f2-d3e7-432f-ac86-a1bb502591bf", "textEn": "That's a sweet car you've got there!", "textEs": "¡Qué carro tan bonito tienes!", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "e7dbf7db-637d-44ba-9b7b-b29ad7067a9d"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a seed with a hard shell, or informally to describe someone as crazy or eccentric.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "18c58d9f-1884-4bd2-bb24-e1c204be14e1", "textEn": "She cracked the nut with a tool.", "textEs": "Partió la nuez con una herramienta.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "21987e00-8816-425d-a934-d716c108c9d8"}, {"id": "686bbc85-d63a-4ef7-afbb-73d67e3921b4", "textEn": "I added some nuts to the salad.", "textEs": "Añadí algunas nueces a la ensalada.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "21987e00-8816-425d-a934-d716c108c9d8"}, {"id": "4262194f-6ba8-4808-89b0-55ae02f1a0fc", "textEn": "The toddler's laugh sounded like a happy little nut.", "textEs": "La risa del niño pequeño sonaba como una nuez feliz.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "21987e00-8816-425d-a934-d716c108c9d8"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Commonly used in everyday conversation to refer to a small bag carried by women for personal items.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "95465efb-6a94-4140-9ee6-6d40e7559998", "textEn": "I left my handbag on the bus.", "textEs": "Dejé mi bolso de mano en el autobús.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "bd685d0e-57bf-4cf5-9244-b3a3d7b0d875"}, {"id": "841c6504-f8b9-4763-81fd-04eda0151e2a", "textEn": "She bought a new handbag yesterday.", "textEs": "Ella compró un bolso de mano nuevo ayer.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "bd685d0e-57bf-4cf5-9244-b3a3d7b0d875"}, {"id": "755f2ce9-decc-4a13-afea-f657678bd8af", "textEn": "She left her handbag on the bus this morning.", "textEs": "Ella dejó su bolso en el autobús esta mañana.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "bd685d0e-57bf-4cf5-9244-b3a3d7b0d875"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe a brief, involuntary shaking movement, often due to fear, cold, or a strong emotional reaction.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "bfee98c0-08c4-47ae-a295-436d19ef8e9c", "textEn": "A cold shudder ran down her spine when she heard the noise.", "textEs": "Un escalofrío frío le recorrió la espalda cuando escuchó el ruido.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "cc6fb98c-c92f-4126-999d-99d9a4bbb6ff"}, {"id": "c6110bf4-c3b3-42fe-b768-6f474591a667", "textEn": "The old house shuddered during the strong wind.", "textEs": "La casa vieja se estremeció durante el fuerte viento.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "cc6fb98c-c92f-4126-999d-99d9a4bbb6ff"}, {"id": "31411a57-c8d5-4a00-ae09-ef1d5b7cbaad", "textEn": "I shudder every time I think about that horror movie we watched last night.", "textEs": "Me estremezco cada vez que pienso en esa película de terror que vimos anoche.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "cc6fb98c-c92f-4126-999d-99d9a4bbb6ff"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to talk about the state of the atmosphere, like rain, sun, or wind; often in small talk like 'How's the weather?'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "4ed0b0f6-1d49-4014-ad2e-88863695f23d", "textEn": "The weather is nice today.", "textEs": "El clima está agradable hoy.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "6f893777-d101-433b-b4c3-d1aae2450018"}, {"id": "fe597056-5faa-41e7-b0f4-48f54c01b4ab", "textEn": "I don't like cold weather.", "textEs": "No me gusta el clima frío.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "6f893777-d101-433b-b4c3-d1aae2450018"}, {"id": "2e08c4e5-b3d0-47fc-8f31-8cac1f9d15d0", "textEn": "The weather is so nice today, let's go for a walk.", "textEs": "El clima está muy agradable hoy, vamos a dar un paseo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "6f893777-d101-433b-b4c3-d1aae2450018"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe extended duration or length, often in phrases like 'a long time' or 'long way'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "da0a93b2-875e-4c11-83e9-9779d742ce9d", "textEn": "The movie was too long.", "textEs": "La película fue demasiado larga.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "7ee5af40-efc8-48c1-b7f5-3f2ec0f4ed2b"}, {"id": "9a53dad1-caf5-40c5-84ad-f83df27a8d27", "textEn": "How long will you stay here?", "textEs": "¿Cuánto tiempo te quedarás aquí?", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "7ee5af40-efc8-48c1-b7f5-3f2ec0f4ed2b"}, {"id": "1ded8a8e-b4fa-4673-a925-12b8d2d0c5b7", "textEn": "That song feels really long when you're not enjoying it.", "textEs": "Esa canción se siente muy larga cuando no la estás disfrutando.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "7ee5af40-efc8-48c1-b7f5-3f2ec0f4ed2b"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to express curiosity or doubt, often in phrases like 'I wonder if...' or as a noun meaning amazement.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "5a5d0349-cddf-44f3-9824-749b93024db6", "textEn": "I wonder what she will say.", "textEs": "Me pregunto qué dirá ella.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "debdc413-5d8e-47d3-8fbd-813574cde0ff"}, {"id": "a50d6b36-a0a3-414c-aabd-e67553da77ad", "textEn": "It's a wonder he survived.", "textEs": "Es una maravilla que haya sobrevivido.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "debdc413-5d8e-47d3-8fbd-813574cde0ff"}, {"id": "0f7deee0-90e1-4c1f-9209-39d42063d9ad", "textEn": "I wonder what the weather will be like tomorrow.", "textEs": "Me pregunto cómo estará el clima mañana.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "debdc413-5d8e-47d3-8fbd-813574cde0ff"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a hard-shelled fruit or seed, or informally to describe someone as eccentric or crazy.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "e7ebef72-9ec5-4deb-a0d4-5b499413cc28", "textEn": "She cracked the nut with a hammer.", "textEs": "Ella partió la nuez con un martillo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "f0a296c9-2264-4a96-924a-519ba6e9b797"}, {"id": "019c3c68-8c9d-4c45-b55e-a04c7a9bdcca", "textEn": "The squirrel hid a nut in the tree.", "textEs": "La ardilla escondió una nuez en el árbol.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "f0a296c9-2264-4a96-924a-519ba6e9b797"}, {"id": "b92ddf6d-abb1-4ee8-9210-c9c27e394388", "textEn": "The engine made a strange nut sound before it stopped working.", "textEs": "El motor hizo un sonido extraño de golpe seco antes de dejar de funcionar.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "f0a296c9-2264-4a96-924a-519ba6e9b797"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in formal or written contexts to mean 'as a result' or 'therefore,' often linking a cause to its effect in a logical sequence.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "951952ad-69b4-4e50-bf75-102669872dd2", "textEn": "He ignored the warning; in consequence, he got lost.", "textEs": "Ignoró la advertencia; en consecuencia, se perdió.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "55d00bfe-72bc-437b-88f5-b4f169652242"}, {"id": "ccdf8c34-7b16-4245-93ef-83d15f1b087d", "textEn": "The team worked late, and in consequence, finished the project.", "textEs": "El equipo trabajó hasta tarde y, en consecuencia, terminó el proyecto.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "55d00bfe-72bc-437b-88f5-b4f169652242"}, {"id": "25ddcba7-218b-4a43-9194-de8ab34284e4", "textEn": "He skipped several meetings; in consequence, he was fired from his job.", "textEs": "Faltó a varias reuniones; en consecuencia, fue despedido de su trabajo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "55d00bfe-72bc-437b-88f5-b4f169652242"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a noun for a public green space or as a verb meaning to leave a vehicle in a place.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "f74168dd-d782-424c-990a-6146f0f6b258", "textEn": "We walked through the park yesterday.", "textEs": "Caminamos por el parque ayer.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "aab7ae3d-1b83-4bbb-adc3-3170e5cbdd72"}, {"id": "c64080e3-262e-47b2-8444-ddb7f1cd67a7", "textEn": "Please park the car in the garage.", "textEs": "Por favor, estaciona el coche en el garaje.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "aab7ae3d-1b83-4bbb-adc3-3170e5cbdd72"}, {"id": "0909f075-f881-4c52-b1b5-c0019197f249", "textEn": "I need to park the car before we go into the store.", "textEs": "Necesito estacionar el coche antes de que entremos a la tienda.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "aab7ae3d-1b83-4bbb-adc3-3170e5cbdd72"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to express strong approval or admiration, often with emphasis on the first syllable in excited speech.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "a44648ae-020f-4bf3-b69f-ad2c266683d7", "textEn": "The view from the mountain was amazing.", "textEs": "La vista desde la montaña era asombrosa.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "3423b4f5-3539-42f3-9674-8b51e099d87d"}, {"id": "90dd782d-8282-42fd-9410-41252f9f3fa8", "textEn": "She gave an amazing performance last night.", "textEs": "Ella dio una actuación asombrosa anoche.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "3423b4f5-3539-42f3-9674-8b51e099d87d"}, {"id": "ae05ab5c-44a4-4837-ab40-383ad4cd0ee6", "textEn": "That view from the top of the mountain was absolutely amazing.", "textEs": "Esa vista desde la cima de la montaña fue absolutamente increíble.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "3423b4f5-3539-42f3-9674-8b51e099d87d"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to instruct or inform someone, often in casual conversation, like 'Tell me what happened.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "01c1ef2b-8638-4b57-af5e-75e1f6afaf8d", "textEn": "Tell me a story before bed.", "textEs": "Cuéntame un cuento antes de dormir.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "e6976963-ac45-4c68-8784-34ce9f2570bc"}, {"id": "d2699a8b-461d-43da-97e6-94f4a292ff2a", "textEn": "Can you tell the difference between these two colors?", "textEs": "¿Puedes decir la diferencia entre estos dos colores?", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "e6976963-ac45-4c68-8784-34ce9f2570bc"}, {"id": "6e5a4409-5797-4172-97c6-79e66ba5f404", "textEn": "Can you tell me what time it is?", "textEs": "¿Puedes decirme qué hora es?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "e6976963-ac45-4c68-8784-34ce9f2570bc"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to indicate that the examples given are just a small selection, often at the end of a list, implying there are more.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "b74d2615-c4ac-445e-b14c-2ff6acd147cd", "textEn": "He enjoys classical music, jazz, and blues, to name a few.", "textEs": "Él disfruta la música clásica, el jazz y el blues, por nombrar algunos.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "a2837b50-2642-4132-ba26-5a593ede92f8"}, {"id": "6dcb6c56-e55b-4ce0-8cee-b0c8c7df33b7", "textEn": "The store sells electronics, furniture, and clothing, to name a few.", "textEs": "La tienda vende electrónicos, muebles y ropa, por nombrar algunos.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "a2837b50-2642-4132-ba26-5a593ede92f8"}, {"id": "62404336-757e-4e25-bae2-0e81fc6cb1ec", "textEn": "There are many great parks in the city, like Central Park, Prospect Park, and Liberty Park, to name a few.", "textEs": "Hay muchos parques excelentes en la ciudad, como Central Park, Prospect Park y Liberty Park, por mencionar algunos.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "a2837b50-2642-4132-ba26-5a593ede92f8"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a pronoun for a group of people or things, often unstressed in fast speech, sounding like 'em'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "b19c0d9c-705e-40ac-af76-7099fcb7fc9f", "textEn": "I gave them the keys.", "textEs": "Les di las llaves.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "b438a700-a719-4498-9f56-ff8f30bc0367"}, {"id": "2c542867-697b-49af-98cb-1967fa075ce9", "textEn": "Can you see them?", "textEs": "¿Puedes verlos?", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "b438a700-a719-4498-9f56-ff8f30bc0367"}, {"id": "1c14d661-1313-4efb-9fa9-f59c79b29e0f", "textEn": "I saw them at the park yesterday.", "textEs": "Los vi en el parque ayer.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "b438a700-a719-4498-9f56-ff8f30bc0367"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to express disappointment or regret, often in phrases like 'What a shame!' or 'Shame on you!'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "e1f7c3bc-de88-4b1b-99df-fe91d4426b18", "textEn": "It's a shame you couldn't come to the party.", "textEs": "Es una lástima que no pudieras venir a la fiesta.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "df77e373-c300-4705-8396-9d5084085286"}, {"id": "81ec6701-6be0-44c0-b2e5-6c4b1d1c377f", "textEn": "He felt shame for his rude behavior.", "textEs": "Sintió vergüenza por su comportamiento grosero.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "df77e373-c300-4705-8396-9d5084085286"}, {"id": "95a82ace-0ff1-4640-ba8d-30513502df0b", "textEn": "What a shame that you couldn't make it to the party.", "textEs": "Qué lástima que no pudiste venir a la fiesta.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "df77e373-c300-4705-8396-9d5084085286"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a number, often in counting, telling time, or indicating quantity, with a clear, short vowel sound.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "ccae74d5-c770-483b-8f0e-42cb40ad1fb0", "textEn": "There are ten apples in the basket.", "textEs": "Hay diez manzanas en la canasta.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "59c55ab7-1be6-4508-a6cb-2d8902ff39ef"}, {"id": "518eb84e-89b2-4e26-8c7a-eab21cd41a23", "textEn": "Count to ten before you speak.", "textEs": "Cuenta hasta diez antes de hablar.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "59c55ab7-1be6-4508-a6cb-2d8902ff39ef"}, {"id": "363ff89b-b385-4517-8f7c-a8c3beb57c53", "textEn": "The baby has ten tiny fingers.", "textEs": "El bebé tiene diez deditos.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "59c55ab7-1be6-4508-a6cb-2d8902ff39ef"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe a feeling of unhappiness or sorrow, often in a straightforward, emotional tone.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "852e9e66-02f7-4367-8337-f9c7d3183a1b", "textEn": "She felt sad after the movie.", "textEs": "Ella se sintió triste después de la película.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "3ac795fd-a3b6-4de5-8fb7-35ab23752d97"}, {"id": "35936304-7722-4ab1-bcb1-6e601516518d", "textEn": "It's a sad story.", "textEs": "Es una historia triste.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "3ac795fd-a3b6-4de5-8fb7-35ab23752d97"}, {"id": "a1ce2fc6-b7c1-40a1-81e5-bcd40c929857", "textEn": "That's sad news about the closing of the local library.", "textEs": "Es triste la noticia del cierre de la biblioteca local.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "3ac795fd-a3b6-4de5-8fb7-35ab23752d97"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a place where goods are sold, or as a verb meaning to buy things; common in everyday conversation.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "a8a2c9b5-bc8d-48be-8fdf-506a5533cfbc", "textEn": "We went to the shop to buy a lock.", "textEs": "Fuimos a la tienda a comprar un candado.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "c57c4a4d-69cc-4b63-b8a1-40b93292952e"}, {"id": "2604a7d1-cf1e-4077-8b76-0e5910c057f7", "textEn": "The shop closes at six.", "textEs": "La tienda cierra a las seis.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "c57c4a4d-69cc-4b63-b8a1-40b93292952e"}, {"id": "0b1b92a0-ab0e-47c8-9b89-69fa805ad104", "textEn": "I need to shop for groceries before the store closes.", "textEs": "Necesito comprar víveres antes de que cierre la tienda.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "c57c4a4d-69cc-4b63-b8a1-40b93292952e"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to someone of equal status, age, or ability, like in 'peer review' or 'teenagers often seek approval from their peers.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "b5d27ec8-572d-4287-b2a8-e67464174b43", "textEn": "He peered into the darkness.", "textEs": "Él miró fijamente en la oscuridad.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "7941ef77-984e-4570-8fac-5bc81fb63f63"}, {"id": "8d5d9484-1751-4b66-b924-12e610916507", "textEn": "She is respected by her peers.", "textEs": "Ella es respetada por sus pares.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "7941ef77-984e-4570-8fac-5bc81fb63f63"}, {"id": "54bc84d5-a7a4-4846-8ed9-99e3289bc842", "textEn": "I could hear my peers whispering behind me during the presentation.", "textEs": "Podía oír a mis compañeros susurrando detrás de mí durante la presentación.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "7941ef77-984e-4570-8fac-5bc81fb63f63"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to place something somewhere, often in commands or simple statements like 'Put it there.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "c67f6651-d4a6-4619-b19c-a5c634a41d2a", "textEn": "Please put the book on the table.", "textEs": "Por favor, pon el libro en la mesa.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "f91fc823-72ee-4416-9556-ed7e7423d1a1"}, {"id": "12145e75-e6e9-4464-83fe-d97d4bd55a71", "textEn": "She put her coat on the chair.", "textEs": "Ella puso su abrigo en la silla.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "f91fc823-72ee-4416-9556-ed7e7423d1a1"}, {"id": "b5fd4038-f28c-4656-a285-322186385f27", "textEn": "Can you put the book on the shelf?", "textEs": "¿Puedes poner el libro en el estante?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "f91fc823-72ee-4416-9556-ed7e7423d1a1"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe shouting loudly, often in anger, excitement, or to get someone's attention from a distance.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "48dae565-9b86-4459-a3c6-f923b5ab97e5", "textEn": "Don't yell at me.", "textEs": "No me grites.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "ae06cc74-31e1-40a9-a762-bc2f3f0e7d15"}, {"id": "92b79ecd-b77e-480a-8bf2-b324c7c5671f", "textEn": "The fans yell loudly at the game.", "textEs": "Los aficionados gritan fuerte en el partido.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "ae06cc74-31e1-40a9-a762-bc2f3f0e7d15"}, {"id": "ffddf5cd-d9e3-4081-941e-abaad5a53e75", "textEn": "The crowd started to yell when their team scored the winning goal.", "textEs": "La multitud comenzó a gritar cuando su equipo anotó el gol de la victoria.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "ae06cc74-31e1-40a9-a762-bc2f3f0e7d15"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to express uncertainty or lack of belief, often in phrases like 'I doubt it' or 'no doubt'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "12ff5b89-e1aa-4da1-859d-8196fb839cd8", "textEn": "I doubt he will come.", "textEs": "Dudo que él venga.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "7d90cd49-ede0-4355-94d4-2a98b0e30690"}, {"id": "837430da-2240-4a34-9d08-335a0f2b0156", "textEn": "She had no doubt about it.", "textEs": "Ella no tenía ninguna duda al respecto.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "7d90cd49-ede0-4355-94d4-2a98b0e30690"}, {"id": "29e5b931-a525-42d8-8a9d-fc726330fb88", "textEn": "I doubt he'll show up on time.", "textEs": "Dudo que llegue a tiempo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "7d90cd49-ede0-4355-94d4-2a98b0e30690"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe removing the outer skin of fruits or vegetables, or the outer layer of something, often in casual contexts like 'peel a banana'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "87e807fb-54f4-49c4-be9b-924fd4bff5aa", "textEn": "She used a knife to peel the apple.", "textEs": "Ella usó un cuchillo para pelar la manzana.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "1b8ef0cb-5f1c-4d39-bdbb-1cb0f74daa6b"}, {"id": "801641e0-9de8-4ee0-bafc-ec557806f4aa", "textEn": "The orange peel was thrown into the bin.", "textEs": "La cáscara de naranja fue tirada a la basura.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "1b8ef0cb-5f1c-4d39-bdbb-1cb0f74daa6b"}, {"id": "c3bf28fe-e33e-40be-8f94-b598cd30e4bd", "textEn": "I heard the orange peel as she tore it away from the fruit.", "textEs": "Escuché la cáscara de naranja mientras la desprendía de la fruta.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "1b8ef0cb-5f1c-4d39-bdbb-1cb0f74daa6b"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something without cost, unrestricted, or liberated; often in casual contexts like 'It's free!' or 'Feel free to ask.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "490ddbc6-efe3-40f3-b780-78934427c60a", "textEn": "The birds are free to fly anywhere.", "textEs": "Los pájaros son libres de volar a cualquier lugar.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "9f4a6a30-e03e-4788-9ccb-9c908f4ffea1"}, {"id": "54ca8523-08f8-43eb-90f8-da118e8d3c29", "textEn": "This sample is free of charge.", "textEs": "Esta muestra es gratis.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "9f4a6a30-e03e-4788-9ccb-9c908f4ffea1"}, {"id": "87a4cf6e-abfc-4723-907e-9b4ca8ad249d", "textEn": "I got a free ticket to the concert from a friend.", "textEs": "Conseguí una entrada gratis al concierto de un amigo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "9f4a6a30-e03e-4788-9ccb-9c908f4ffea1"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used for a slip of paper or digital record granting entry or travel, often pronounced quickly with a soft 't' at the end in casual speech.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "8ed1f14b-b39b-4013-b289-d0cdecbbb8e8", "textEn": "I need a ticket for the concert.", "textEs": "Necesito un boleto para el concierto.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "50a2615e-efb6-4fda-ba8d-cd6a33def15e"}, {"id": "2ca63a0b-c9be-4100-967e-0f006d9dcd89", "textEn": "She bought two tickets to the movie.", "textEs": "Ella compró dos boletos para la película.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "50a2615e-efb6-4fda-ba8d-cd6a33def15e"}, {"id": "b7edabc7-fc60-4c4d-b0d0-77745b37cc0c", "textEn": "I need to buy a ticket for the concert before they sell out.", "textEs": "Necesito comprar un boleto para el concierto antes de que se agoten.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "50a2615e-efb6-4fda-ba8d-cd6a33def15e"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a liquid food, often served hot, made by boiling ingredients like meat, vegetables, or grains in water or stock.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "62bfbc45-79e4-4522-b4af-ad8667193588", "textEn": "I want a bowl of hot soup.", "textEs": "Quiero un tazón de sopa caliente.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "32d80243-2b0b-464e-8533-7186dce08e7b"}, {"id": "f1945772-cfe2-49df-b48e-17819eef5179", "textEn": "This soup tastes delicious.", "textEs": "Esta sopa sabe deliciosa.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "32d80243-2b0b-464e-8533-7186dce08e7b"}, {"id": "1361f11a-15c1-4394-aaf1-cb32fb7d877c", "textEn": "I love the sound of soup simmering on the stove.", "textEs": "Me encanta el sonido de la sopa hirviendo a fuego lento en la estufa.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "32d80243-2b0b-464e-8533-7186dce08e7b"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the flower or the past tense of 'rise', often in casual conversation about gardening or time.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "f123b00d-e455-475f-8e85-af32cf47666d", "textEn": "She gave me a red rose.", "textEs": "Ella me dio una rosa roja.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "1d455dfe-87da-429b-a840-cc18e5388cee"}, {"id": "c35ca9d1-e123-460e-a9f1-1abf8443fac8", "textEn": "The rose smells wonderful.", "textEs": "La rosa huele maravilloso.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "1d455dfe-87da-429b-a840-cc18e5388cee"}, {"id": "445e0c0c-c9a1-494b-9359-974a7b7cf367", "textEn": "The baby's laugh was a sweet, clear rose in the quiet room.", "textEs": "La risa del bebé era una rosa dulce y clara en la habitación silenciosa.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "1d455dfe-87da-429b-a840-cc18e5388cee"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe separating something into pieces, interrupting an activity, or a pause in work.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "77d0da5b-a264-46e8-bc49-42b2fdb18321", "textEn": "Don't break the glass.", "textEs": "No rompas el vidrio.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "b6c57a5b-1b8f-4845-8629-9cca9c6a51cd"}, {"id": "f2138e19-6cff-4374-8bd6-892b3873d2da", "textEn": "She needs a break from work.", "textEs": "Ella necesita un descanso del trabajo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "b6c57a5b-1b8f-4845-8629-9cca9c6a51cd"}, {"id": "32c4212f-d07c-488a-8988-76a33cb635d5", "textEn": "I heard a branch break in the forest.", "textEs": "Escuché romperse una rama en el bosque.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "b6c57a5b-1b8f-4845-8629-9cca9c6a51cd"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe moving something toward yourself, like pulling a door open, or to attract attention, as in 'pull someone aside.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "e6e57521-6507-4321-8273-be6d8f94282c", "textEn": "Pull the door to open it.", "textEs": "Tira de la puerta para abrirla.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "acf9909a-8055-49c9-929a-cca16837021b"}, {"id": "1f9529c1-2e84-4114-981e-5e509ba512c3", "textEn": "He pulled the rope hard.", "textEs": "Él jaló la cuerda con fuerza.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "acf9909a-8055-49c9-929a-cca16837021b"}, {"id": "b6f7eb0f-c962-4960-a2d8-6d470193e1ae", "textEn": "Can you pull the door open? It's stuck.", "textEs": "¿Puedes tirar de la puerta para abrirla? Está atascada.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "acf9909a-8055-49c9-929a-cca16837021b"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally to refer to one's grandmother, often in family settings or when speaking affectionately.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "c9c362cc-924a-45de-9eff-5c212428a7e0", "textEn": "Grandma is coming for dinner tonight.", "textEs": "La abuela viene a cenar esta noche.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "26577918-3bf6-4277-8570-697197cd9236"}, {"id": "85b8aea7-64a2-4eba-87e1-0f407f357658", "textEn": "I called grandma to say happy birthday.", "textEs": "Llamé a la abuela para felicitarla por su cumpleaños.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "26577918-3bf6-4277-8570-697197cd9236"}, {"id": "80aa8f61-e990-4cde-a741-30fb95f4fdaf", "textEn": "I'm going to visit my grandma this weekend.", "textEs": "Voy a visitar a mi abuela este fin de semana.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "26577918-3bf6-4277-8570-697197cd9236"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe absence of light, a deep color, or a mysterious mood; often stressed with a drawn-out vowel for emphasis.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "ce4bca83-bf7d-4dd9-aae2-9a4243842760", "textEn": "The room was very dark at night.", "textEs": "La habitación estaba muy oscura por la noche.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "7973b3ff-162d-4134-8376-30c0921c08af"}, {"id": "a7de7763-bfc3-4b20-90da-3d51e31d06f7", "textEn": "He wore a dark blue jacket.", "textEs": "Él llevaba una chaqueta azul oscuro.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "7973b3ff-162d-4134-8376-30c0921c08af"}, {"id": "3636993c-3fdc-4869-af8c-09157deb8f10", "textEn": "The sky was getting dark, so we decided to head home.", "textEs": "El cielo se estaba oscureciendo, así que decidimos irnos a casa.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "7973b3ff-162d-4134-8376-30c0921c08af"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a question word for time, or as a conjunction to link events, often reduced to 'wen' in fast speech.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "a64747b1-0906-4952-b91a-8cc7c3c17c52", "textEn": "When will you arrive?", "textEs": "¿Cuándo llegarás?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "7e3db7ae-7a44-486e-a48a-3be4a39d0c13"}, {"id": "a619dd5a-f00b-4b4a-8db3-a391f7d7799a", "textEn": "I'll call when I'm ready.", "textEs": "Llamaré cuando esté listo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "7e3db7ae-7a44-486e-a48a-3be4a39d0c13"}, {"id": "053f0b18-8ca1-4157-b366-1f12f3d2f3c7", "textEn": "When I saw the sunset, I knew everything would be okay.", "textEs": "Cuando vi el atardecer, supe que todo estaría bien.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "7e3db7ae-7a44-486e-a48a-3be4a39d0c13"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Commonly used for any food item between two slices of bread, often shortened to 'sando' in casual speech.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "db42382f-d162-42c6-bb41-66caeb91cc24", "textEn": "Can you make me a sandwich?", "textEs": "¿Puedes hacerme un sándwich?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "5945c67b-279e-41ad-8b8f-c99d27434016"}, {"id": "fa4f1791-431f-4809-9e38-908eb39e5416", "textEn": "He ate a sandwich for lunch.", "textEs": "Él comió un sándwich para el almuerzo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "5945c67b-279e-41ad-8b8f-c99d27434016"}, {"id": "d14de1d5-1ddb-4d53-b2b3-66ad4a453fcc", "textEn": "I need to make a sandwich for lunch.", "textEs": "Necesito hacer un sándwich para el almuerzo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "5945c67b-279e-41ad-8b8f-c99d27434016"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe someone or something that moves slowly and stealthily, or as a noun for a person who makes others feel uncomfortable or uneasy.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "2e5b28ce-aac1-49d4-8af7-c3617aa63565", "textEn": "The cat began to creep toward the mouse.", "textEs": "El gato comenzó a arrastrarse hacia el ratón.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "cfd2a269-a058-4693-9976-857bd446dd5b"}, {"id": "606edd62-a816-469b-a0cb-22351ad27c15", "textEn": "Don't let the cold creep into the house.", "textEs": "No dejes que el frío se cuele en la casa.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "cfd2a269-a058-4693-9976-857bd446dd5b"}, {"id": "982bede1-70df-411a-a94f-af1402bc0033", "textEn": "I heard a strange creeping sound coming from the basement.", "textEs": "Escuché un extraño sonido de arrastre que venía del sótano.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "cfd2a269-a058-4693-9976-857bd446dd5b"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe making something less hard or firm, or to make something less harsh or severe, often in emotional or physical contexts.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "fa08c416-abaa-4430-aca3-91acbe2b5ddd", "textEn": "The butter will soften at room temperature.", "textEs": "La mantequilla se suavizará a temperatura ambiente.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "5b5e183f-49cd-4762-8a18-52bd2ac5210c"}, {"id": "28251fc5-8447-4993-a3e2-644f14c5cbe1", "textEn": "She tried to soften her voice.", "textEs": "Ella intentó suavizar su voz.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "5b5e183f-49cd-4762-8a18-52bd2ac5210c"}, {"id": "6db2dd43-0783-4c1f-83e0-00a5186293d2", "textEn": "Could you soften your tone? You're sounding a bit harsh.", "textEs": "¿Podrías suavizar tu tono? Estás sonando un poco duro.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "5b5e183f-49cd-4762-8a18-52bd2ac5210c"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a transition phrase to introduce a new point or topic, often in presentations or discussions.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "0381561f-40ef-4232-bb8f-381b6940e38d", "textEn": "That brings us to the final point of today's presentation.", "textEs": "Eso nos lleva al punto final de la presentación de hoy.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "11304260-4714-402b-851f-1b955b76328c"}, {"id": "4f57ceba-b0c7-43d6-8c34-d16452bf4872", "textEn": "That brings us to the question of budget allocation.", "textEs": "Eso nos lleva a la cuestión de la asignación presupuestaria.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "11304260-4714-402b-851f-1b955b76328c"}, {"id": "425b1e82-72dc-4f9b-9ee9-3000884ab08d", "textEn": "That brings us to the next point on our agenda.", "textEs": "Eso nos lleva al siguiente punto de nuestra agenda.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "11304260-4714-402b-851f-1b955b76328c"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to physical area, outer space, or a gap; often in phrases like 'give me some space' or 'space out'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "a92f4a21-f36e-431b-acef-37f8bb712c9a", "textEn": "There is not enough space in this room.", "textEs": "No hay suficiente espacio en esta habitación.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "1bd44976-cda0-4fdd-bd51-010c0271bb25"}, {"id": "4e47ee21-c765-490c-bd5e-7f252bbdb573", "textEn": "The rocket flew into outer space.", "textEs": "El cohete voló al espacio exterior.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "1bd44976-cda0-4fdd-bd51-010c0271bb25"}, {"id": "69d5b4e2-6753-434c-a148-951254dfce0d", "textEn": "I need some space to think clearly.", "textEs": "Necesito algo de espacio para pensar con claridad.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "1bd44976-cda0-4fdd-bd51-010c0271bb25"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a level of quality, size, or rank, often in school or work contexts, like 'What grade did you get on the test?'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "881aa2d5-0caf-46cb-bde1-2f0a6e3890f2", "textEn": "She got a good grade on the exam.", "textEs": "Ella obtuvo una buena calificación en el examen.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "8a7496ea-f283-44c4-a1da-4debd8e21f4d"}, {"id": "d7743683-294a-4ef6-9491-deb98baf13ff", "textEn": "He is in the fifth grade.", "textEs": "Él está en el quinto grado.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "8a7496ea-f283-44c4-a1da-4debd8e21f4d"}, {"id": "3bc4d078-2d62-44df-bfae-c0ed69de0bdd", "textEn": "I need to grade these essays before the end of the week.", "textEs": "Necesito calificar estos ensayos antes de que termine la semana.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "8a7496ea-f283-44c4-a1da-4debd8e21f4d"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a long strip of cloth or a digital advertisement, often in contexts like protests, websites, or events.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "4134c516-f3ca-4379-b7b4-8c62a2152dd7", "textEn": "The banner hung from the ceiling.", "textEs": "La bandera colgaba del techo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "a3de9925-9df4-4b15-8917-072c6ccbc748"}, {"id": "bd5a9005-2689-46af-a8cc-f4287b877c47", "textEn": "They made a banner for the parade.", "textEs": "Hicieron una bandera para el desfile.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "a3de9925-9df4-4b15-8917-072c6ccbc748"}, {"id": "56cf9a97-a1eb-406f-862c-ca1b8d06c1c7", "textEn": "That's a banner day for our team!", "textEs": "¡Ese es un día excepcional para nuestro equipo!", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "a3de9925-9df4-4b15-8917-072c6ccbc748"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the top layer of earth in which plants grow, often in gardening, farming, or environmental contexts.
