flashcards.examples: [{"id": "40f5bd96-2eb5-4214-8119-bae6253d6ca9", "textEn": "The soil in this garden is very rich.", "textEs": "El suelo en este jardín es muy fértil.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "70ee777a-63a3-4f6e-9cf0-ac77a9e4d7aa"}, {"id": "376b1b7a-5252-4b35-8d12-9e4a739cd989", "textEn": "Don't soil your new shirt with mud.", "textEs": "No manches tu camisa nueva con barro.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "70ee777a-63a3-4f6e-9cf0-ac77a9e4d7aa"}, {"id": "a79dbb75-eca8-4ec4-b782-245b5bb872b4", "textEn": "The rain-soaked soil smelled fresh and earthy after the storm.", "textEs": "El suelo empapado por la lluvia olía fresco y a tierra después de la tormenta.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "70ee777a-63a3-4f6e-9cf0-ac77a9e4d7aa"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe someone or something that avoids effort or activity, often with a mildly critical or humorous tone.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "05f9ed25-f8c6-481c-a495-78601a253b4d", "textEn": "He is too lazy to clean his room.", "textEs": "Él es demasiado perezoso para limpiar su habitación.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "306fd1aa-cd8e-4731-817b-691308d4ffd7"}, {"id": "7fbee45b-7cf0-4f8a-896d-ab05c2e15fdd", "textEn": "I feel lazy on Sunday mornings.", "textEs": "Me siento perezoso los domingos por la mañana.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "306fd1aa-cd8e-4731-817b-691308d4ffd7"}, {"id": "16ab2a82-225c-4ae4-b627-6db6d7e5f7c8", "textEn": "He's too lazy to even walk to the store, so he orders everything online.", "textEs": "Es demasiado vago para siquiera caminar hasta la tienda, así que pide todo en línea.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "306fd1aa-cd8e-4731-817b-691308d4ffd7"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to tell someone to pay attention or hear something, often as a command or in conversation to emphasize a point.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "34d928ea-9d97-48dc-8df1-239cb4c32995", "textEn": "Listen to the music carefully.", "textEs": "Escucha la música con atención.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "8ddc983f-f50a-4e7f-97ed-0c72ce5fe7d5"}, {"id": "6d6de2bb-425f-40e5-9dad-8123138cd28e", "textEn": "I like to listen to podcasts.", "textEs": "Me gusta escuchar podcasts.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "8ddc983f-f50a-4e7f-97ed-0c72ce5fe7d5"}, {"id": "fd1a37c9-69c2-4a94-a9c5-38731f939c94", "textEn": "Listen, I don't think that's a good idea.", "textEs": "Escucha, no creo que sea una buena idea.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "8ddc983f-f50a-4e7f-97ed-0c72ce5fe7d5"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as the past tense of 'take', often in casual storytelling or describing past actions.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "d20cbb04-771a-4cae-8fa9-d25313f14017", "textEn": "He took the bus to work.", "textEs": "Él tomó el autobús al trabajo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "7a878f2f-ce15-4f36-b0f1-06c4891674df"}, {"id": "f4e7fb44-ff13-4137-9130-b7e651c83ac5", "textEn": "She took a photo of the sunset.", "textEs": "Ella tomó una foto del atardecer.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "7a878f2f-ce15-4f36-b0f1-06c4891674df"}, {"id": "b572f4f4-aa08-4512-887d-37b00f895fb2", "textEn": "He took the book from the shelf and started reading.", "textEs": "Él tomó el libro del estante y empezó a leer.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "7a878f2f-ce15-4f36-b0f1-06c4891674df"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a healthcare professional, or as a verb meaning to care for someone or something; often pronounced with a slight rhotic 'r' in American English.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "549f2c00-3dad-44b3-8b63-3026fa4c434f", "textEn": "The nurse helped the patient.", "textEs": "La enfermera ayudó al paciente.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "ec665e05-6508-4502-b837-5a9bf8460c10"}, {"id": "4be2161c-2030-48e2-b786-3c4702fe0083", "textEn": "She works as a nurse.", "textEs": "Ella trabaja como enfermera.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "ec665e05-6508-4502-b837-5a9bf8460c10"}, {"id": "accb27be-3b14-4e2b-9345-f49bb50676bc", "textEn": "The baby nurses for about 20 minutes every three hours.", "textEs": "El bebé mama durante unos 20 minutos cada tres horas.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "ec665e05-6508-4502-b837-5a9bf8460c10"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe the act of crying or a drop of water from the eye, often in emotional contexts like 'She shed a tear.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "c0801e8d-9107-4b66-bc45-3b58eeaaa516", "textEn": "A tear rolled down her cheek.", "textEs": "Una lágrima rodó por su mejilla.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "4902f8b5-d4a5-42da-801b-dfc8f9e3f599"}, {"id": "43e34f1b-8158-4102-991d-78075909669b", "textEn": "He wiped a tear from his eye.", "textEs": "Él se secó una lágrima del ojo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "4902f8b5-d4a5-42da-801b-dfc8f9e3f599"}, {"id": "eb86c47b-b5a2-40e1-8be0-3bf095844b25", "textEn": "She couldn't hold back a tear as she watched the emotional wedding scene.", "textEs": "No pudo contener una lágrima mientras veía la emotiva escena de la boda.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "4902f8b5-d4a5-42da-801b-dfc8f9e3f599"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a verb for preparing food by heating, or as a noun for a person who does this; common in everyday conversation about meals and recipes.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "9fcab3f5-6e88-425c-9304-c483e808e174", "textEn": "I love to cook pasta.", "textEs": "Me encanta cocinar pasta.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "90bef9ef-e6e4-4f56-8dea-f63711eb0b1c"}, {"id": "9a35419b-5839-4572-b390-f2b48f325969", "textEn": "She cooked dinner for us.", "textEs": "Ella cocinó la cena para nosotros.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "90bef9ef-e6e4-4f56-8dea-f63711eb0b1c"}, {"id": "a6e220ae-eb31-42ae-89ed-2c104c8a481c", "textEn": "I'll cook dinner tonight if you set the table.", "textEs": "Yo cocinaré la cena esta noche si tú pones la mesa.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "90bef9ef-e6e4-4f56-8dea-f63711eb0b1c"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a shrub or thicket, or informally to describe something unkempt or wild, like 'bushy hair'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "14cafbb9-ac26-4761-a491-2eb8aa45fb35", "textEn": "A rabbit hid behind the bush.", "textEs": "Un conejo se escondió detrás del arbusto.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "5157f152-94af-43f5-9301-2f07ce6bfd11"}, {"id": "ffaaaf1a-4200-4010-9b6f-a19e133d0703", "textEn": "The garden has many green bushes.", "textEs": "El jardín tiene muchos arbustos verdes.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "5157f152-94af-43f5-9301-2f07ce6bfd11"}, {"id": "318367cf-02a9-4dab-ae89-804fee1c91b4", "textEn": "The bush rustled as a small animal darted through it.", "textEs": "El arbusto crujió cuando un pequeño animal pasó rápidamente a través de él.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "5157f152-94af-43f5-9301-2f07ce6bfd11"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a noun for the bird or as a verb meaning to lower the head or avoid something; also an informal term of address.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "89ae9315-1430-490c-ae64-660f83efd69c", "textEn": "A duck swam across the pond.", "textEs": "Un pato nadó a través del estanque.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "68fe55d5-ea68-401c-abfb-8b9984ed3092"}, {"id": "26754224-4961-4934-94b9-2e475515a416", "textEn": "The children fed bread to the duck.", "textEs": "Los niños le dieron pan al pato.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "68fe55d5-ea68-401c-abfb-8b9984ed3092"}, {"id": "c80d76b0-f1cb-4a0b-a9fa-35b5562c7a85", "textEn": "The duck quacked loudly as we threw bread into the pond.", "textEs": "El pato graznó fuerte mientras tirábamos pan al estanque.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "68fe55d5-ea68-401c-abfb-8b9984ed3092"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe someone who shows courage or is willing to face danger, often in everyday situations like 'That was brave of you.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "db9ebf4b-4aee-4ece-b9b8-4eae407ce180", "textEn": "The brave firefighter saved the child.", "textEs": "El valiente bombero salvó al niño.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "0c768411-c14c-4348-b993-50bc1bb7ea3d"}, {"id": "2a580801-3e5c-41ff-aaaa-cda72d2b2875", "textEn": "It was brave of you to speak up.", "textEs": "Fue valiente de tu parte hablar.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "0c768411-c14c-4348-b993-50bc1bb7ea3d"}, {"id": "ba4b6bef-7433-4f22-9185-1d3e424c81da", "textEn": "She was brave enough to speak up against the injustice.", "textEs": "Ella fue lo suficientemente valiente para alzar la voz contra la injusticia.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "0c768411-c14c-4348-b993-50bc1bb7ea3d"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to indicate frequency, often pronounced with a silent 't' in natural speech.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "546b9c13-a154-48e6-a4a3-e9b521884744", "textEn": "I often go for a walk in the park.", "textEs": "A menudo salgo a caminar al parque.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "48a41f74-97fe-4c64-839a-f76e6cbbed4b"}, {"id": "c539394b-3603-4d12-acf0-cb05d0696928", "textEn": "She often reads before bed.", "textEs": "Ella a menudo lee antes de dormir.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "48a41f74-97fe-4c64-839a-f76e6cbbed4b"}, {"id": "120c81e8-0ffb-49eb-8d3f-ced221155ac3", "textEn": "I often go for a run in the morning.", "textEs": "A menudo salgo a correr por la mañana.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "48a41f74-97fe-4c64-839a-f76e6cbbed4b"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe the act of speaking or having a conversation, often in casual or informal contexts.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "2fd00758-f009-48db-8be0-4c9f5d2550b3", "textEn": "We need to talk about your plans.", "textEs": "Necesitamos hablar sobre tus planes.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "953f80b7-5b8e-4ea9-88b0-093674ff0f4c"}, {"id": "befe0318-e10e-4b4b-a005-0c0aa42cfdf6", "textEn": "She gave a long talk at the meeting.", "textEs": "Ella dio una larga conversación en la reunión.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "953f80b7-5b8e-4ea9-88b0-093674ff0f4c"}, {"id": "c73cc30d-90da-4fac-b047-9a1deea1a4fd", "textEn": "I need to talk to you about something important.", "textEs": "Necesito hablar contigo sobre algo importante.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "953f80b7-5b8e-4ea9-88b0-093674ff0f4c"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a plot of land for growing flowers, vegetables, or plants, often in a residential setting.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "1b07fe1e-58dc-432d-b62f-e482b7892a9a", "textEn": "The flowers in the garden are beautiful.", "textEs": "Las flores en el jardín son hermosas.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "43a292d0-f3c0-4179-b2fb-46c872405bf5"}, {"id": "3f943712-e715-4a3e-bbca-6990a13485be", "textEn": "We planted tomatoes in the garden.", "textEs": "Plantamos tomates en el jardín.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "43a292d0-f3c0-4179-b2fb-46c872405bf5"}, {"id": "e0ee6efc-350c-47a4-964c-900e106701c7", "textEn": "I love the sound of birds in the garden early in the morning.", "textEs": "Me encanta el sonido de los pájaros en el jardín temprano en la mañana.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "43a292d0-f3c0-4179-b2fb-46c872405bf5"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to assign responsibility for a fault or wrong, often in casual conversation like 'Don't blame me' or 'I blame the weather.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "95cdb151-ccaf-4c66-b9c5-08af9fd97c04", "textEn": "Don't blame me for the mistake.", "textEs": "No me culpes por el error.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "777256dc-c5f7-47ea-be4c-79fa29cbadc2"}, {"id": "aa2a3e93-8b1c-4e95-a5d3-08785440d9a2", "textEn": "She blamed the rain for the delay.", "textEs": "Ella culpó a la lluvia por la demora.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "777256dc-c5f7-47ea-be4c-79fa29cbadc2"}, {"id": "694d7962-013c-4198-b5bb-a7738b1a038d", "textEn": "Don't blame me if it rains tomorrow.", "textEs": "No me eches la culpa si llueve mañana.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "777256dc-c5f7-47ea-be4c-79fa29cbadc2"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to indicate that something is completed earlier than planned, often in work or project contexts.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "c9256b99-66c2-40fe-9540-c680ed635763", "textEn": "The project finished ahead of schedule.", "textEs": "El proyecto terminó antes de lo previsto.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "662af11b-974b-43f0-a85a-382a4847abb0"}, {"id": "e9ff5419-7dd6-4c28-88e4-4b5961dd2592", "textEn": "She arrived ahead of schedule for the meeting.", "textEs": "Llegó antes de lo previsto para la reunión.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "662af11b-974b-43f0-a85a-382a4847abb0"}, {"id": "6306021e-8827-46c8-90d6-85f4f42c8d02", "textEn": "We finished the project three weeks ahead of schedule.", "textEs": "Terminamos el proyecto tres semanas antes de lo previsto.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "662af11b-974b-43f0-a85a-382a4847abb0"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to enthusiastically begin a topic or activity, often in meetings or discussions.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "491a63b1-d66a-40e6-b752-5112a88e51e3", "textEn": "Let's dive into the data from last quarter.", "textEs": "Profundicemos en los datos del último trimestre.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "02c33fc5-eaf1-4ac1-be89-8fe23aa6f167"}, {"id": "1b3ab8d7-1ebc-4344-afd3-6a14b2034beb", "textEn": "Now let's dive into the specifics of the new product launch.", "textEs": "Ahora profundicemos en los detalles del lanzamiento del nuevo producto.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "02c33fc5-eaf1-4ac1-be89-8fe23aa6f167"}, {"id": "b4bb3050-aa4a-4a5a-8c0d-4bbbf9881550", "textEn": "Let's dive into the details of the project.", "textEs": "Vamos a sumergirnos en los detalles del proyecto.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "02c33fc5-eaf1-4ac1-be89-8fe23aa6f167"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe wet, soft earth, often after rain, or figuratively for something messy or unclear.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "b3ac94a5-fb78-41f2-a43a-a48eb282a925", "textEn": "The kids played in the mud after the rain.", "textEs": "Los niños jugaron en el barro después de la lluvia.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "e15a167d-f575-4a55-a512-80676c786bfb"}, {"id": "0edfb5b8-8dcb-42f2-8599-cb33567f5694", "textEn": "My boots got stuck in the thick mud.", "textEs": "Mis botas se atascaron en el barro espeso.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "e15a167d-f575-4a55-a512-80676c786bfb"}, {"id": "7aba3a32-6136-4d80-b427-fe33601347ac", "textEn": "The car got stuck in the mud after the heavy rain.", "textEs": "El coche se quedó atascado en el barro después de la fuerte lluvia.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "e15a167d-f575-4a55-a512-80676c786bfb"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something that is physically even and free of bumps, or figuratively to mean effortless, suave, or well-executed, like a smooth transition or a smooth talker.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "423d0ae4-49dd-40fe-ba70-654d49c17a41", "textEn": "The sauce is very smooth.", "textEs": "La salsa es muy suave.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "524b7dc8-90cf-4be8-a942-dead0fe1df3d"}, {"id": "03707fed-9515-4342-9c28-c7192872a2ad", "textEn": "Her voice was smooth and calm.", "textEs": "Su voz era suave y tranquila.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "524b7dc8-90cf-4be8-a942-dead0fe1df3d"}, {"id": "9dfb0e5b-7d3a-47fa-9d16-87d96c0eb2c5", "textEn": "That presentation was so smooth, I didn't even notice any mistakes.", "textEs": "Esa presentación fue tan fluida que ni siquiera noté ningún error.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "524b7dc8-90cf-4be8-a942-dead0fe1df3d"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something big in size, amount, or scale; common in everyday conversation.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "16e7dc3a-dd26-4ec6-8491-7dd55dd16030", "textEn": "They live in a large house.", "textEs": "Ellos viven en una casa grande.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "87d66ce3-831b-400f-94f5-a5e05789cfde"}, {"id": "2181fb2e-89cf-4b73-a1d5-2d9d5a7e771a", "textEn": "I need a large coffee, please.", "textEs": "Necesito un café grande, por favor.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "87d66ce3-831b-400f-94f5-a5e05789cfde"}, {"id": "1b8c5854-e808-4408-9e81-9edad22ab9a1", "textEn": "The company made a large profit this quarter.", "textEs": "La empresa obtuvo una gran ganancia este trimestre.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "87d66ce3-831b-400f-94f5-a5e05789cfde"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as the past tense of 'catch', often in contexts like 'I caught a cold' or 'She caught the ball'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "e40a5a50-f387-46e4-868a-96043a95ecff", "textEn": "I caught a fish yesterday.", "textEs": "Atrapé un pez ayer.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "cca50183-821f-416f-bf11-33563a7777fa"}, {"id": "cfdb144f-db50-4bc7-b6b1-05b27949d3e9", "textEn": "She caught the bus just in time.", "textEs": "Ella cogió el autobús justo a tiempo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "cca50183-821f-416f-bf11-33563a7777fa"}, {"id": "0e5dec4f-89c7-46f1-8626-4ee5e25dd357", "textEn": "I was so caught up in the movie that I didn't hear my phone ringing.", "textEs": "Estaba tan envuelto en la película que no escuché sonar mi teléfono.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "cca50183-821f-416f-bf11-33563a7777fa"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe a cold, empty, or hopeless situation, often in weather, landscapes, or emotional states.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "1c558af4-81ff-4d8c-a223-c2522786e1b7", "textEn": "The landscape looked bleak in the winter.", "textEs": "El paisaje se veía sombrío en el invierno.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "4fc84861-b022-456c-8778-e5158597e98a"}, {"id": "4ebca983-7647-4606-902b-09161115ceb5", "textEn": "His future seemed bleak after the accident.", "textEs": "Su futuro parecía desolado después del accidente.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "4fc84861-b022-456c-8778-e5158597e98a"}, {"id": "d613d5fa-2405-4e19-b28f-ae0370e501ce", "textEn": "The future looks bleak for the company after the financial losses.", "textEs": "El futuro se ve sombrío para la empresa después de las pérdidas financieras.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "4fc84861-b022-456c-8778-e5158597e98a"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe damage from fire or heat, or metaphorically for a sharp insult or criticism.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "cf3d6c14-1808-4213-80fc-95d3b0687c7a", "textEn": "Don't burn the toast.", "textEs": "No quemes la tostada.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "fa19767a-fa1c-415a-b976-e34fc62cae77"}, {"id": "e70a27d3-cee8-4c85-ab1e-8728d6f248c1", "textEn": "The fire burned all night.", "textEs": "El fuego ardió toda la noche.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "fa19767a-fa1c-415a-b976-e34fc62cae77"}, {"id": "828f953f-5d01-4006-bed6-83fda2a57d2e", "textEn": "The toast is burning in the kitchen.", "textEs": "La tostada se está quemando en la cocina.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "fa19767a-fa1c-415a-b976-e34fc62cae77"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe a light, quick strike or to draw liquid from a container, often in casual contexts like 'tap the table' or 'tap a keg'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "2058943c-0868-42c9-b17a-79e97ecfe7af", "textEn": "Please tap the table to get my attention.", "textEs": "Por favor, golpea suavemente la mesa para llamar mi atención.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "7c6c31b0-9b61-4cbb-addd-0cea695788e6"}, {"id": "07994561-4ae1-464a-a3e5-462443e2c578", "textEn": "The water dripped from the tap all night.", "textEs": "El agua goteó del grifo toda la noche.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "7c6c31b0-9b61-4cbb-addd-0cea695788e6"}, {"id": "ee1edadf-f4c9-4748-9ced-7345530fa92a", "textEn": "I can hear the tap of rain against the window.", "textEs": "Puedo oír el golpeteo de la lluvia contra la ventana.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "7c6c31b0-9b61-4cbb-addd-0cea695788e6"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe someone with good judgment or knowledge, often in casual advice or compliments like 'That was wise.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "04c3bbaf-6cef-42ce-8aef-7afce64e42c7", "textEn": "My grandmother is very wise.", "textEs": "Mi abuela es muy sabia.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "2c06e9a9-6665-4f75-bf17-284b9b2c9cd5"}, {"id": "48e5be15-da60-4a32-a576-b592433719d5", "textEn": "It is wise to save money for emergencies.", "textEs": "Es sabio ahorrar dinero para emergencias.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "2c06e9a9-6665-4f75-bf17-284b9b2c9cd5"}, {"id": "86d6e79c-d9f9-454a-8da8-766103b5b0f5", "textEn": "She's wise beyond her years, always giving thoughtful advice.", "textEs": "Ella es sabia más allá de su edad, siempre dando consejos reflexivos.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "2c06e9a9-6665-4f75-bf17-284b9b2c9cd5"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to express challenge or encouragement, as in 'I dare you to try it,' or to indicate boldness, as in 'How dare you!'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "6f84e5be-baf7-4a5e-a95b-6ac5261c7e50", "textEn": "I dare you to jump over the puddle.", "textEs": "Te reto a saltar sobre el charco.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "229e381b-4dc6-4caa-b266-b3322b04ec4c"}, {"id": "6a50c19d-2ea5-418f-9b5f-aaf3d5b0c4fe", "textEn": "She didn't dare to speak up.", "textEs": "Ella no se atrevió a hablar.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "229e381b-4dc6-4caa-b266-b3322b04ec4c"}, {"id": "cb9cc4a0-d71c-48f6-8e39-8ca232c4ab9c", "textEn": "I dare you to jump into the pool.", "textEs": "Te reto a que te tires a la piscina.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "229e381b-4dc6-4caa-b266-b3322b04ec4c"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something not closed or accessible, often in commands like 'open the door' or in contexts like 'the store is open'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "6029a154-a121-45a6-8c77-08e1a832224e", "textEn": "Please open the door.", "textEs": "Por favor, abre la puerta.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "57af7090-e848-4348-9689-9902e576a741"}, {"id": "8f75864b-dc75-4def-b514-2219b1e49a66", "textEn": "The store is open now.", "textEs": "La tienda está abierta ahora.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "57af7090-e848-4348-9689-9902e576a741"}, {"id": "3f466456-400c-40c8-b32e-90816ec356a7", "textEn": "The door creaked open in the middle of the night, giving me chills.", "textEs": "La puerta se abrió chirriando en medio de la noche, dándome escalofríos.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "57af7090-e848-4348-9689-9902e576a741"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a noun to refer to a planned piece of work or task, often with emphasis on the first syllable in natural speech.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "e99b5a86-3f51-4f41-b673-3bd6e3b95ea7", "textEn": "The science project is due next week.", "textEs": "El proyecto de ciencias se entrega la próxima semana.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "bbb4ae60-20ca-4461-a9cd-0628442df0df"}, {"id": "55aff649-18f6-4436-a734-7298e7a6420b", "textEn": "Our team worked hard on this project.", "textEs": "Nuestro equipo trabajó duro en este proyecto.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "bbb4ae60-20ca-4461-a9cd-0628442df0df"}, {"id": "af93fc4a-4d8a-4175-b510-525d868b1aa2", "textEn": "I need to finish this PROject by Friday.", "textEs": "Necesito terminar este proyecto para el viernes.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "bbb4ae60-20ca-4461-a9cd-0628442df0df"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a medical professional who cares for patients, or as a verb meaning to care for someone or something gently.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "c37d02fc-59f1-49ac-94b1-2cec59c47421", "textEn": "The nurse checked my temperature.", "textEs": "La enfermera me tomó la temperatura.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "091a1456-6b23-4041-8483-57b91312472f"}, {"id": "47ffe35e-d923-43ef-bd75-79ff935f9be5", "textEn": "He wants to become a nurse next year.", "textEs": "Él quiere ser enfermero el próximo año.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "091a1456-6b23-4041-8483-57b91312472f"}, {"id": "bdf7b45b-2f62-4395-922d-0f83f86ff970", "textEn": "The cat began to nurse her newborn kittens.", "textEs": "La gata comenzó a amamantar a sus gatitos recién nacidos.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "091a1456-6b23-4041-8483-57b91312472f"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to express pleasure or satisfaction, often in casual contexts like 'Enjoy your meal!' or 'I really enjoy this song.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "ac6ed8e7-4129-44c7-b92f-e1a214ab15f7", "textEn": "I enjoy listening to music in the car.", "textEs": "Disfruto escuchar música en el coche.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "aa9abe5a-ddf2-4f16-93a5-bbf976f0f883"}, {"id": "839d81fe-4e2f-4c96-b2ce-5d1f104e073f", "textEn": "They enjoyed the movie last night.", "textEs": "Ellos disfrutaron la película anoche.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "aa9abe5a-ddf2-4f16-93a5-bbf976f0f883"}, {"id": "00dfb032-bbf4-4ffa-b33c-68394cfd1c93", "textEn": "I really enjoy spending time with my family on weekends.", "textEs": "Realmente disfruto pasar tiempo con mi familia los fines de semana.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "aa9abe5a-ddf2-4f16-93a5-bbf976f0f883"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a large fortified building, often from medieval times, or in chess to describe the rook.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "77c5b319-5cfc-46e0-9003-ff65929273d3", "textEn": "We visited a castle in Scotland.", "textEs": "Visitamos un castillo en Escocia.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "11e6a449-05c1-47f6-b49e-0fd1d6936f99"}, {"id": "51375b63-415f-4ceb-b9b6-cbd9f602f737", "textEn": "The castle was built in the 12th century.", "textEs": "El castillo fue construido en el siglo XII.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "11e6a449-05c1-47f6-b49e-0fd1d6936f99"}, {"id": "8dc2da3e-81c1-49c9-adf6-eb64409f80cf", "textEn": "The knight defended the castle from the invaders.", "textEs": "El caballero defendió el castillo de los invasores.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "11e6a449-05c1-47f6-b49e-0fd1d6936f99"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a large farm building for storing hay, grain, or housing livestock; often used in rural contexts or idioms like 'couldn't hit the broad side of a barn'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "951ca5a8-ed65-4527-81a5-e9dec264865d", "textEn": "The horse is in the barn.", "textEs": "El caballo está en el granero.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "78666d2d-6fee-43fe-9a36-26bc3483027c"}, {"id": "f33f4d1e-1fc3-4e1f-8df5-dbac19090b9b", "textEn": "They stored hay in the old barn.", "textEs": "Almacenaron heno en el viejo granero.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "78666d2d-6fee-43fe-9a36-26bc3483027c"}, {"id": "fc77e806-9764-4bfb-9099-58f705882b89", "textEn": "The old barn creaked in the wind, its doors swinging open and shut.", "textEs": "El viejo granero crujía con el viento, sus puertas abriéndose y cerrándose.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "78666d2d-6fee-43fe-9a36-26bc3483027c"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe someone or something very unusual or extreme, often in a surprised or negative way, like 'He's a freak at math' or 'Don't be such a freak.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "7f2b1403-76be-4d2a-8cd3-84b315c35fd1", "textEn": "That storm was a freak of nature.", "textEs": "Esa tormenta fue un fenómeno de la naturaleza.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "c5523ee7-b8d3-4430-af47-b7aa2aa16a30"}, {"id": "fd28207d-cbf1-4c33-864e-f834efe89742", "textEn": "He's a fitness freak who works out every day.", "textEs": "Es un fanático del fitness que hace ejercicio todos los días.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "c5523ee7-b8d3-4430-af47-b7aa2aa16a30"}, {"id": "c67e4762-f033-4a4b-b2e4-d5f690bf7bae", "textEn": "Don't freak out, but I accidentally broke your favorite mug.", "textEs": "No te asustes, pero sin querer rompí tu taza favorita.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "c5523ee7-b8d3-4430-af47-b7aa2aa16a30"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a place providing protection from weather or danger, or the act of seeking such protection.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "ac152f1b-5aa9-4602-86bc-8ed76ce780c3", "textEn": "They found shelter from the storm in a small cave.", "textEs": "Encontraron refugio de la tormenta en una pequeña cueva.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "e388f606-3460-49d6-89f8-7f6f3962bade"}, {"id": "4ad2f3da-a130-4b9d-ae6c-90d839a1976f", "textEn": "The animal shelter takes care of abandoned pets.", "textEs": "El albergue de animales cuida de las mascotas abandonadas.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "e388f606-3460-49d6-89f8-7f6f3962bade"}, {"id": "f0c58366-62b5-47a5-8d5d-348e8dea9c9e", "textEn": "The trees provide shelter from the wind.", "textEs": "Los árboles proporcionan refugio del viento.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "e388f606-3460-49d6-89f8-7f6f3962bade"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to indicate a quick, downward movement of the head, often to show agreement, acknowledgment, or a silent 'yes' in conversation.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "74ab8191-5f9a-428b-bc18-8dda00ad31cc", "textEn": "She gave a nod to show she agreed.", "textEs": "Ella asintió con la cabeza para mostrar que estaba de acuerdo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "0af7ce6e-293e-4b8d-9861-d3c7a5d16e0f"}, {"id": "20d78274-fc20-4a30-a7e4-912d8d82a97b", "textEn": "He nodded when I asked about the job.", "textEs": "Él asintió cuando pregunté sobre el trabajo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "0af7ce6e-293e-4b8d-9861-d3c7a5d16e0f"}, {"id": "999bbab6-1114-47c1-841f-744608cf9e2e", "textEn": "He nodded in agreement when I suggested we leave early.", "textEs": "Él asintió con la cabeza cuando sugerí que nos fuéramos temprano.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "0af7ce6e-293e-4b8d-9861-d3c7a5d16e0f"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe a bend or smooth turn, often in geometry, roads, or graphs; also slang for something unexpected or surprising.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "a47d20ce-58dd-4fbc-ab8c-e78828733b14", "textEn": "The road has a sharp curve ahead.", "textEs": "La carretera tiene una curva pronunciada más adelante.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "dd9a2859-39e1-41e2-835e-212559dd0389"}, {"id": "2400b2a2-ba1c-4628-be8c-3ea0dc76b0f6", "textEn": "She drew a perfect curve on the paper.", "textEs": "Ella dibujó una curva perfecta en el papel.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "dd9a2859-39e1-41e2-835e-212559dd0389"}, {"id": "f5fd50c4-436f-426f-bd1b-83d88e7df904", "textEn": "The ball curved around the defender and into the goal.", "textEs": "La pelota curvó alrededor del defensor y entró en la portería.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "dd9a2859-39e1-41e2-835e-212559dd0389"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe mixing something with a circular motion, often in cooking, or to indicate movement or slight change in position.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "16e2f91a-d4cb-474d-842c-54fc4638a584", "textEn": "Stir the soup slowly with a spoon.", "textEs": "Revuelve la sopa lentamente con una cuchara.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "fd7ac2d9-2091-4a9c-bfdd-fcacbf78a2f2"}, {"id": "a3edf71a-3e77-4d9d-b0ce-5ed1891e68cf", "textEn": "Don't stir the pot too much.", "textEs": "No revuelvas demasiado la olla.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "fd7ac2d9-2091-4a9c-bfdd-fcacbf78a2f2"}, {"id": "907aa218-ee79-4e84-95ce-bc1b3bf77e24", "textEn": "Could you stir the soup while I answer the phone?", "textEs": "¿Puedes revolver la sopa mientras contesto el teléfono?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "fd7ac2d9-2091-4a9c-bfdd-fcacbf78a2f2"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a small thin piece of metal with a sharp point, or as a verb meaning to hold something in place.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "85481026-0f99-493f-a63e-07caa31b3f10", "textEn": "She used a pin to fix her dress.", "textEs": "Ella usó un alfiler para arreglar su vestido.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "989bf936-c26d-4e66-b3f0-16f7457749e9"}, {"id": "a3adefdc-88f2-499c-b20d-ae7c993f9132", "textEn": "The map has a pin on the capital city.", "textEs": "El mapa tiene un alfiler en la ciudad capital.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "989bf936-c26d-4e66-b3f0-16f7457749e9"}, {"id": "ed22779f-915b-44a8-b662-48c1f8f9bad6", "textEn": "The children were so quiet you could hear a pin drop.", "textEs": "Los niños estaban tan callados que se podía oír caer un alfiler.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "989bf936-c26d-4e66-b3f0-16f7457749e9"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally, especially in British and Australian English, to mean 'I think' or 'I suppose,' often when giving an opinion or making a guess.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "97e1f6a7-d7dc-446c-862a-de928345250d", "textEn": "I reckon it's going to rain.", "textEs": "Creo que va a llover.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "65d06bc5-db7f-49e9-8cd9-69430e0292da"}, {"id": "086d000e-e738-4ed6-aa1a-c8e8d10b9e4b", "textEn": "I reckon we should leave now.", "textEs": "Creo que deberíamos irnos ahora.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "65d06bc5-db7f-49e9-8cd9-69430e0292da"}, {"id": "3526014e-f0a1-4183-bd58-62472f6e56c3", "textEn": "I reckon we'll have to leave early to beat the traffic.", "textEs": "Calculo que tendremos que salir temprano para evitar el tráfico.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "65d06bc5-db7f-49e9-8cd9-69430e0292da"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe a sudden break or sharp sound, or informally to express agreement or excitement, like 'Snap! That's cool!'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "2a2c4323-e8fa-498e-a88f-4d8f376e486c", "textEn": "The branch snapped under the weight of the snow.", "textEs": "La rama se rompió bajo el peso de la nieve.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "44b0841c-a998-4429-a8e9-aa4b8e4063e7"}, {"id": "5ea4cd36-555d-471b-b363-1ab64325d2ab", "textEn": "He gave a snap of his fingers to get the waiter's attention.", "textEs": "Dio un chasquido de dedos para llamar la atención del camarero.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "44b0841c-a998-4429-a8e9-aa4b8e4063e7"}, {"id": "ff1564cc-4478-4bcf-a512-1cd912dae0f0", "textEn": "I heard a loud snap when the tree branch broke.", "textEs": "Escuché un fuerte chasquido cuando se rompió la rama del árbol.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "44b0841c-a998-4429-a8e9-aa4b8e4063e7"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a response to a question or solution to a problem, often in casual conversation like 'What's the answer?'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "8ff4c014-b8ae-4c81-aaae-b531fae31762", "textEn": "Do you know the answer?", "textEs": "¿Sabes la respuesta?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "b513eb18-8649-4a77-b089-ff558fd009dc"}, {"id": "a04f3a63-b07d-453e-bad0-6c228106f5bd", "textEn": "She answered the phone.", "textEs": "Ella contestó el teléfono.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "b513eb18-8649-4a77-b089-ff558fd009dc"}, {"id": "94b8476f-acb0-4559-946e-7c8148056690", "textEn": "I can't answer that question right now, but I'll get back to you later.", "textEs": "No puedo responder esa pregunta ahora mismo, pero te responderé más tarde.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "b513eb18-8649-4a77-b089-ff558fd009dc"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Often pronounced with a silent 'd', as 'Wenz-day', used to refer to the third day of the week.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "3d3d5722-9c5d-4c39-b205-4e630b0ed492", "textEn": "The meeting is on Wednesday.", "textEs": "La reunión es el miércoles.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "57f2e240-4b4d-4b0b-89f1-798f05470135"}, {"id": "790c0433-898a-45d8-a422-56ea193b0e20", "textEn": "Wednesday is my favorite day.", "textEs": "El miércoles es mi día favorito.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "57f2e240-4b4d-4b0b-89f1-798f05470135"}, {"id": "e432bfd0-e2ac-4335-9de8-2aff3558a47d", "textEn": "I'll see you on Wednesday, right?", "textEs": "Te veo el miércoles, ¿verdad?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "57f2e240-4b4d-4b0b-89f1-798f05470135"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe heating a liquid until it bubbles, or informally for being very angry or hot.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "230f3055-5591-4681-bf77-275ea96e847a", "textEn": "Boil the water before adding the pasta.", "textEs": "Hierve el agua antes de añadir la pasta.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "235640c6-1e0e-4e6c-a33b-e8cc2474d9f6"}, {"id": "b15fe849-afb9-4ab1-b438-395829816df0", "textEn": "The pot started to boil over on the stove.", "textEs": "La olla empezó a hervirse en la estufa.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "235640c6-1e0e-4e6c-a33b-e8cc2474d9f6"}, {"id": "16af9953-5611-47e7-9885-5694c1aabf20", "textEn": "The kettle started to boil, so I turned off the stove.", "textEs": "La tetera empezó a hervir, así que apagué la estufa.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "235640c6-1e0e-4e6c-a33b-e8cc2474d9f6"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to resume a point after an interruption or digression, often with a slight pause before it.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "9b898f08-f78f-4aa6-a2be-7589c891a98f", "textEn": "As I was saying, the team has made significant progress.", "textEs": "Como estaba diciendo, el equipo ha hecho un progreso significativo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "2b9604a0-dee3-4941-8f49-fbad6edd0f70"}, {"id": "15032b5e-0d0e-420f-a232-336e7d5a984d", "textEn": "As I was saying before the break, we need to focus on efficiency.", "textEs": "Como estaba diciendo antes del descanso, necesitamos enfocarnos en la eficiencia.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "2b9604a0-dee3-4941-8f49-fbad6edd0f70"}, {"id": "3b7fdee9-0202-487d-80e3-490a58a15989", "textEn": "As I was saying, we need to finalize the budget before the end of the week.", "textEs": "Como decía, necesitamos finalizar el presupuesto antes de que termine la semana.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "2b9604a0-dee3-4941-8f49-fbad6edd0f70"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something that produces strong, clear, and detailed images in the mind, like a vivid memory or a vivid description.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "5cdb0e3d-f32f-4476-b02b-fc2ab39cb2bf", "textEn": "She had a vivid imagination.", "textEs": "Ella tenía una imaginación vívida.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "c6df22d3-fa1c-4dff-adb3-cf15c5381b9b"}, {"id": "7e687ee2-7e52-40e5-8777-e916c5cce2e3", "textEn": "The colors in the painting are very vivid.", "textEs": "Los colores en la pintura son muy vívidos.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "c6df22d3-fa1c-4dff-adb3-cf15c5381b9b"}, {"id": "1ee125c2-f07a-4ce5-9ff7-79d12144bfeb", "textEn": "The colors in the sunset were so vivid they looked like a painting.", "textEs": "Los colores del atardecer eran tan vívidos que parecían un cuadro.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "c6df22d3-fa1c-4dff-adb3-cf15c5381b9b"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe a sharp incline, like a hill or price, or informally to mean 'very' as in 'that's steep' for something excessive.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "23cc78d7-6604-433a-9395-97f48b5e4b10", "textEn": "The hill was too steep to climb easily.", "textEs": "La colina era demasiado empinada para subir fácilmente.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "4af10dde-aa43-458b-b415-01df88cc9d3e"}, {"id": "ffb35b15-d45c-4a0f-b81f-92514b0d4253", "textEn": "They walked up the steep path to the castle.", "textEs": "Caminaron por el sendero empinado hacia el castillo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "4af10dde-aa43-458b-b415-01df88cc9d3e"}, {"id": "4a45e9a2-e9c6-45ea-b2e2-49a8bd9d6295", "textEn": "The price of that new phone is a bit steep for me.", "textEs": "El precio de ese teléfono nuevo es un poco elevado para mí.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "4af10dde-aa43-458b-b415-01df88cc9d3e"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the sweet fruit, often in casual conversation about food or grocery shopping.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "299b8761-0378-4581-b9f4-f279019cf6ca", "textEn": "This pear is very sweet and juicy.", "textEs": "Esta pera es muy dulce y jugosa.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "4a3e5bb3-83f3-4ac6-a7bf-5a65b1673b5f"}, {"id": "76c53471-c826-474e-8826-a029a2dad74c", "textEn": "I bought a pear from the market.", "textEs": "Compré una pera en el mercado.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "4a3e5bb3-83f3-4ac6-a7bf-5a65b1673b5f"}, {"id": "382f6057-b7ef-40a7-b2a9-fcee2d1022e5", "textEn": "The pear is sweet and juicy.", "textEs": "La pera es dulce y jugosa.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "4a3e5bb3-83f3-4ac6-a7bf-5a65b1673b5f"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a verb meaning to lead or direct, often in formal or professional contexts like conducting an orchestra or an experiment.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "051c7f6f-7c71-49ac-af60-0ca8c34347fc", "textEn": "They will conduct an experiment tomorrow.", "textEs": "Ellos conducirán un experimento mañana.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "d42a89de-1842-4920-9f0a-21cc525d3d08"}, {"id": "93496776-b1b6-4178-9858-b1745f8a5fd2", "textEn": "She conducts the orchestra with passion.", "textEs": "Ella dirige la orquesta con pasión.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "d42a89de-1842-4920-9f0a-21cc525d3d08"}, {"id": "48c24a5b-03bb-4eda-b234-b68a7386db60", "textEn": "The orchestra will conduct a special performance tonight.", "textEs": "La orquesta dirigirá una actuación especial esta noche.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "d42a89de-1842-4920-9f0a-21cc525d3d08"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe wet, soft earth, often after rain, or figuratively for something messy or unclear.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "e9129d27-fbd3-4d97-bc92-8c75dca52ccd", "textEn": "The kids played in the mud after the rain.", "textEs": "Los niños jugaron en el barro después de la lluvia.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "58e5efa3-f821-4019-9519-655a6c6e6a12"}, {"id": "690f45c3-3c65-4b56-b9e9-24824c28d10a", "textEn": "His boots were covered in thick mud.", "textEs": "Sus botas estaban cubiertas de barro espeso.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "58e5efa3-f821-4019-9519-655a6c6e6a12"}, {"id": "ceb0f1fb-b700-4829-9b67-deef8672314d", "textEn": "The car got stuck in the mud after the heavy rain.", "textEs": "El coche se quedó atascado en el barro después de la fuerte lluvia.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "58e5efa3-f821-4019-9519-655a6c6e6a12"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a verb meaning to challenge or dispute something, often in formal or competitive contexts.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "31307c8c-6343-47ab-803d-a64a5fab0613", "textEn": "They plan to contest the election results.", "textEs": "Planean impugnar los resultados electorales.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "19926af5-6c0c-4395-870f-be4dabf5410b"}, {"id": "8122200e-dce6-4882-9e8e-1214ecfbbbcb", "textEn": "The lawyer will contest the will.", "textEs": "El abogado impugnará el testamento.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "19926af5-6c0c-4395-870f-be4dabf5410b"}, {"id": "632d364d-4007-40f5-abd5-9722d1309bc9", "textEn": "The teacher announced a spelling conTEST for next Friday.", "textEs": "La maestra anunció un concurso de ortografía para el próximo viernes.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "19926af5-6c0c-4395-870f-be4dabf5410b"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a verb meaning to inhale and exhale air, often in contexts of relaxation, life, or emphasis on calmness.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "11b6572f-df34-4ae6-81ff-c78382b3a03e", "textEn": "Breathe deeply and relax.", "textEs": "Respira profundamente y relájate.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "8acc1a7e-b8c5-412c-99e8-45941256676c"}, {"id": "5be32627-cf6d-4601-90bc-81591641ca16", "textEn": "Fish breathe through gills.", "textEs": "Los peces respiran por branquias.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "8acc1a7e-b8c5-412c-99e8-45941256676c"}, {"id": "217464b9-4e66-40e4-8374-4bcecc205731", "textEn": "Stop shouting and just breathe for a moment.", "textEs": "Deja de gritar y solo respira un momento.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "8acc1a7e-b8c5-412c-99e8-45941256676c"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a landmass surrounded by water, often in geography or travel contexts.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "4ff806ea-f824-4994-8597-ce3e46d4bc33", "textEn": "We took a ferry to the island.", "textEs": "Tomamos un ferry a la isla.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "8ace6826-97ba-468e-9dca-3996dea10782"}, {"id": "a0e30fd3-3696-462f-a339-00cf9e8945b3", "textEn": "The island has beautiful beaches.", "textEs": "La isla tiene playas hermosas.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "8ace6826-97ba-468e-9dca-3996dea10782"}, {"id": "b4f9115e-81f6-4290-8a65-5d2390ad968a", "textEn": "The sound of waves crashing on the island is very relaxing.", "textEs": "El sonido de las olas rompiendo en la isla es muy relajante.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "8ace6826-97ba-468e-9dca-3996dea10782"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something physically firm, difficult, or requiring effort; often in phrases like 'hard work' or 'hard to believe'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "959ca631-ac69-4dc7-a9d4-8a1fdb68f511", "textEn": "This exam is very hard.", "textEs": "Este examen es muy difícil.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "8b661474-6604-42c6-b764-1728afa87022"}, {"id": "82653ff7-0b3a-4391-ae7f-e12ea9aad083", "textEn": "The rock is hard to break.", "textEs": "La roca es dura de romper.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "8b661474-6604-42c6-b764-1728afa87022"}, {"id": "ec1c9fa9-eb2c-4b3e-8206-eaf4a0a3a55f", "textEn": "This exam is really hard.", "textEs": "Este examen es realmente difícil.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "8b661474-6604-42c6-b764-1728afa87022"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a public road in a city or town, often in casual conversation about locations or directions.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "bef73953-e8cf-42ca-8614-e045a35da240", "textEn": "The street is busy during rush hour.", "textEs": "La calle está ocupada durante la hora punta.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "8088e5e6-917f-49b4-a609-104b521ec8b9"}, {"id": "b242b0cc-eb6e-4589-b5c8-fb8f2e3bb85f", "textEn": "We live on a quiet street.", "textEs": "Vivimos en una calle tranquila.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "8088e5e6-917f-49b4-a609-104b521ec8b9"}, {"id": "e92f85b3-c85f-4d2d-81a7-f587dced9eef", "textEn": "The street was quiet after midnight.", "textEs": "La calle estaba tranquila después de la medianoche.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "8088e5e6-917f-49b4-a609-104b521ec8b9"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to express approval, agreement, or admiration; often a casual, positive response to something good or interesting.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "089b5432-970a-444d-ac7d-a50c604d2be8", "textEn": "The water is cool and refreshing.", "textEs": "El agua está fresca y refrescante.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "2ae13b6a-0dab-4d8d-ac1e-f148b8b95361"}, {"id": "fe7fa912-d346-43bd-9837-3dcfe66e7153", "textEn": "That's a cool idea!", "textEs": "¡Esa es una idea genial!", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "2ae13b6a-0dab-4d8d-ac1e-f148b8b95361"}, {"id": "0aa0b21c-3055-4dca-aa0e-7b993cead189", "textEn": "That's a really cool jacket, where did you get it?", "textEs": "Esa chaqueta es muy chévere, ¿dónde la conseguiste?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "2ae13b6a-0dab-4d8d-ac1e-f148b8b95361"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to emphasize the verb form, as in 'We need to import these goods,' with stress on the second syllable.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "1cb95579-651c-4f3b-a8f2-79bf3a173b2f", "textEn": "We import coffee from Brazil.", "textEs": "Importamos café de Brasil.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "2c3be9c5-9bee-4533-a8b6-4e6f719a0d28"}, {"id": "6732bd71-26b6-4b93-9d29-2129e1ac75a6", "textEn": "They import cars from Germany.", "textEs": "Importan autos de Alemania.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "2c3be9c5-9bee-4533-a8b6-4e6f719a0d28"}, {"id": "922b8227-9d56-4589-8d36-43b2eea2fb83", "textEn": "The imPORT of these goods has increased significantly this year.", "textEs": "La importación de estos bienes ha aumentado significativamente este año.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "2c3be9c5-9bee-4533-a8b6-4e6f719a0d28"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something disappearing suddenly or completely, often in a mysterious or unexpected way.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "a8b34d07-bd5a-4571-abb1-f473fee8fa25", "textEn": "The magician made the coin vanish.", "textEs": "El mago hizo desaparecer la moneda.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "1e641fb4-9101-4849-a062-1151a13436f2"}, {"id": "917fc255-de7b-4b7e-8468-a0a534b9091f", "textEn": "All my worries vanish when I listen to music.", "textEs": "Todas mis preocupaciones desaparecen cuando escucho música.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "1e641fb4-9101-4849-a062-1151a13436f2"}, {"id": "69fb3f4e-4b7f-444b-af8e-7cebfea5f6f9", "textEn": "The magician made the rabbit vanish in a puff of smoke.", "textEs": "El mago hizo desaparecer al conejo en una nube de humo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "1e641fb4-9101-4849-a062-1151a13436f2"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as the past tense of 'fall,' often in storytelling or describing an accident, e.g., 'He fell down the stairs.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "830cbbdc-89d5-48e5-b9d1-470f17b497e9", "textEn": "He fell off his bike yesterday.", "textEs": "Se cayó de su bicicleta ayer.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "5c851997-d4b6-49e7-85d6-18ec3cc8e3f7"}, {"id": "ce9b3afb-b2b4-4968-87fc-59011a453dbb", "textEn": "The leaves fell from the tree in autumn.", "textEs": "Las hojas cayeron del árbol en otoño.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "5c851997-d4b6-49e7-85d6-18ec3cc8e3f7"}, {"id": "2829362e-2286-4416-a120-c3bc452025fd", "textEn": "The rain fell steadily throughout the night, drumming on the roof.", "textEs": "La lluvia cayó constantemente durante toda la noche, tamborileando en el tejado.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "5c851997-d4b6-49e7-85d6-18ec3cc8e3f7"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as an exclamation to express mild frustration or disappointment, similar to 'darn' or 'oh no', often in casual conversation.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "8df04c1e-7b43-4905-9c2a-4cc5e7c336d7", "textEn": "Don't shoot the gun indoors.", "textEs": "No dispares el arma en interiores.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "9558c6c2-729e-49a0-8a01-b3989b61cb16"}, {"id": "bd608ec8-e2fc-457c-9c2f-020886393bd2", "textEn": "They will shoot the movie next month.", "textEs": "Ellos filmarán la película el próximo mes.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "9558c6c2-729e-49a0-8a01-b3989b61cb16"}, {"id": "60cbffb1-7ebb-41c3-ba19-6e0e1790241d", "textEn": "Shoot, I forgot my keys inside the car.", "textEs": "Rayos, olvidé mis llaves dentro del auto.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "9558c6c2-729e-49a0-8a01-b3989b61cb16"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in conversations to indicate returning to a previously mentioned topic or idea, often after a digression.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "1d44dcd9-6efc-4615-b394-e4e099a5bb12", "textEn": "To circle back to the earlier point, our costs are rising.", "textEs": "Para volver al punto anterior, nuestros costos están aumentando.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "ac3edd20-ddbc-49d8-93fc-8670d92d7812"}, {"id": "ca53ce35-0e35-41c4-8a2a-c99c33ababbf", "textEn": "I'd like to circle back to the revenue forecast.", "textEs": "Me gustaría volver a la previsión de ingresos.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "ac3edd20-ddbc-49d8-93fc-8670d92d7812"}, {"id": "d10162b6-fee5-4666-b7b3-3bd035da8bc3", "textEn": "Let's circle back to that point after we finish the budget discussion.", "textEs": "Volvamos a ese punto después de que terminemos la discusión del presupuesto.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "ac3edd20-ddbc-49d8-93fc-8670d92d7812"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a small, hard, non-metallic mineral material, often found on the ground, or informally to mean 'very' as in 'stone cold'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "551f6a52-e30e-4dd3-94ac-d67fc239e38e", "textEn": "He threw a stone into the lake.", "textEs": "Él lanzó una piedra al lago.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "1e5a4c43-4bbc-4154-b77a-578eefddd2a3"}, {"id": "9f9879ed-c955-47fb-833f-92b20f9d929f", "textEn": "The path was made of flat stones.", "textEs": "El camino estaba hecho de piedras planas.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "1e5a4c43-4bbc-4154-b77a-578eefddd2a3"}, {"id": "c34fb390-6677-4852-9d89-b55dfe1c2afa", "textEn": "The stone made a soft thud as it hit the grass.", "textEs": "La piedra hizo un suave golpe sordo al golpear el césped.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "1e5a4c43-4bbc-4154-b77a-578eefddd2a3"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to allow or permit something, or as part of suggestions like 'let's go'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "864d25a7-ebce-4f9e-97f2-d16cd97f798f", "textEn": "Let me help you with that bag.", "textEs": "Déjame ayudarte con esa bolsa.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "c76d2899-aa70-4ab3-9dd8-2a87aeb1c3d9"}, {"id": "e18c849a-9f4e-4d1c-ae43-ea4c2708271e", "textEn": "They won't let us enter without a ticket.", "textEs": "No nos dejarán entrar sin boleto.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "c76d2899-aa70-4ab3-9dd8-2a87aeb1c3d9"}, {"id": "85e374c8-2074-40a2-b98e-6ac7723d1aa2", "textEn": "Let me help you with that heavy bag.", "textEs": "Déjame ayudarte con esa bolsa pesada.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "c76d2899-aa70-4ab3-9dd8-2a87aeb1c3d9"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a floor mat or carpet, often in casual conversation about home decor or cleaning.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "ec0ac703-a90a-4fe2-85bf-6fc9d3ab6c40", "textEn": "She bought a colorful rug for the living room.", "textEs": "Compró una alfombra colorida para la sala.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "1b18b100-dc91-4d5f-aad0-4115b8a9d18e"}, {"id": "2c8b168e-eaa6-4417-8ced-73c36d7d9bca", "textEn": "The cat slept on the soft rug by the fire.", "textEs": "El gato durmió en la alfombra suave junto al fuego.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "1b18b100-dc91-4d5f-aad0-4115b8a9d18e"}, {"id": "5310d613-5aee-4db2-abac-7ab716e7d5fa", "textEn": "The cat is sleeping on the rug in front of the fireplace.", "textEs": "El gato está durmiendo en la alfombra frente a la chimenea.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "1b18b100-dc91-4d5f-aad0-4115b8a9d18e"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something moving back and forth or side to side, often in a rhythmic or playful manner; also slang for being lively, exciting, or engaging in a carefree social scene.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "40f4215c-2d30-4cca-8ba3-c619b5ac078d", "textEn": "The children were swinging on the playground.", "textEs": "Los niños se balanceaban en el patio de juegos.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "27cb4c38-9385-450f-bac3-96c567634fcf"}, {"id": "c69435c9-7887-4b4c-bb8f-793e4fedb75d", "textEn": "She kept swinging the bat but missed the ball.", "textEs": "Siguió balanceando el bate pero falló la pelota.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "27cb4c38-9385-450f-bac3-96c567634fcf"}, {"id": "f9fa8eb2-705f-4374-bc3b-f32e2755308b", "textEn": "I love the sound of a hammock swinging gently in the breeze.", "textEs": "Me encanta el sonido de una hamaca meciéndose suavemente con la brisa.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "27cb4c38-9385-450f-bac3-96c567634fcf"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the fleshy edge of the mouth, often in phrases like 'bite your lip' to show restraint or 'lip service' for insincere agreement.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "ade91a5a-ccc5-4e59-bc9b-ede32cb1f7d8", "textEn": "She bit her lip nervously.", "textEs": "Ella se mordió el labio nerviosamente.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "d7261445-3db0-47fb-8d9c-6fc1f72a19a0"}, {"id": "10663e3b-c8bb-402e-b4d5-eebc8cbee467", "textEn": "He has a cut on his lip.", "textEs": "Él tiene un corte en el labio.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "d7261445-3db0-47fb-8d9c-6fc1f72a19a0"}, {"id": "bad1289a-5396-483d-8786-7c8feeffc3a6", "textEn": "He smacked his lips after tasting the delicious soup.", "textEs": "Chasqueó los labios después de probar la deliciosa sopa.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "d7261445-3db0-47fb-8d9c-6fc1f72a19a0"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a noun, meaning behavior or management, with stress on the first syllable.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "7e072fbf-a996-47da-b362-8cce3d7b6fd6", "textEn": "His conduct in class was excellent.", "textEs": "Su conducta en clase fue excelente.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "6fa09bc5-6981-430e-9749-2ad4fe3770ea"}, {"id": "0ea3fe26-0282-490b-91a5-0105b124bc4d", "textEn": "The teacher praised the student's conduct.", "textEs": "El profesor elogió la conducta del estudiante.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "6fa09bc5-6981-430e-9749-2ad4fe3770ea"}, {"id": "0b714169-f4d1-4f63-9b9f-ff3fde55307e", "textEn": "Please maintain proper CONduct during the ceremony.", "textEs": "Por favor, mantenga una conducta adecuada durante la ceremonia.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "6fa09bc5-6981-430e-9749-2ad4fe3770ea"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally to mean 'understand' or 'like,' as in 'I dig that song,' or literally to excavate.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "ffd0ad3e-13a4-4eaf-b192-e088012daa18", "textEn": "They dig a hole in the garden.", "textEs": "Ellos cavan un hoyo en el jardín.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "8f00864d-a899-4b23-bd5f-dcde02206356"}, {"id": "5db2b9bd-bb05-4a7a-95df-7b514f561f12", "textEn": "The dog digs for bones.", "textEs": "El perro cava en busca de huesos.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "8f00864d-a899-4b23-bd5f-dcde02206356"}, {"id": "d781c6aa-6772-4b5a-9f43-98b2ffd36e22", "textEn": "I really dig your new haircut, it looks great on you.", "textEs": "Me encanta tu nuevo corte de pelo, te queda genial.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "8f00864d-a899-4b23-bd5f-dcde02206356"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to indicate the following item in a sequence or the immediate future, often pronounced with a clear 'k' sound before the 's'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "2b431950-1895-4a60-8464-bd9eafe57be6", "textEn": "The next bus arrives in five minutes.", "textEs": "El próximo autobús llega en cinco minutos.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "ccc35ba3-142f-4df8-bdea-7dd0ff8de97e"}, {"id": "c79da041-c797-4c27-868d-cc9d1d59d815", "textEn": "What's the next step in the process?", "textEs": "¿Cuál es el siguiente paso en el proceso?", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "ccc35ba3-142f-4df8-bdea-7dd0ff8de97e"}, {"id": "00084f69-f3c8-4b8e-9f92-7d12af4aa666", "textEn": "What are you doing next?", "textEs": "¿Qué haces después?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "ccc35ba3-142f-4df8-bdea-7dd0ff8de97e"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a period of time extending into the future, emphasizing long-term results or effects rather than immediate ones.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "1d9e6378-340a-4c63-8bad-50eb91b8180a", "textEn": "Over the long haul, this investment will pay off.", "textEs": "A largo plazo, esta inversión dará resultados.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "cc805cbd-f39e-47f5-aaaf-c43f5696ffb5"}, {"id": "0517a5be-4f77-4928-b4a8-bc93a650a66d", "textEn": "Consistency matters over the long haul.", "textEs": "La constancia importa a largo plazo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "cc805cbd-f39e-47f5-aaaf-c43f5696ffb5"}, {"id": "f7e4f7b0-06cf-444f-a716-9096d5686a96", "textEn": "You need to be patient and consistent if you want to succeed over the long haul.", "textEs": "Necesitas ser paciente y constante si quieres tener éxito a largo plazo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "cc805cbd-f39e-47f5-aaaf-c43f5696ffb5"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to indicate location, movement in a circle, or approximation; often reduced in fast speech to 'round'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "16cb169b-ebb7-4427-b804-17666f3b493f", "textEn": "We walked around the park.", "textEs": "Caminamos alrededor del parque.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "778cbdc6-290c-4416-8400-5cddec570974"}, {"id": "3da9c27b-3005-4a3e-9772-f8e36d923571", "textEn": "There are trees around the house.", "textEs": "Hay árboles alrededor de la casa.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "778cbdc6-290c-4416-8400-5cddec570974"}, {"id": "0620f0d5-a472-44d2-bc9e-2424c9eec498", "textEn": "Let's meet around 7 PM for dinner.", "textEs": "Quedemos alrededor de las 7 PM para cenar.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "778cbdc6-290c-4416-8400-5cddec570974"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a noun for a pointed weapon or as a verb meaning to pierce or thrust through something.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "f550ff32-4a0d-42dc-b5de-55897b06f5d2", "textEn": "He threw the spear at the target.", "textEs": "Él lanzó la lanza al objetivo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "3fd62fcc-6f1b-4e68-88c7-41f879882bf7"}, {"id": "8c58a8e3-d67e-47bf-b6ea-c9ad28f2df0a", "textEn": "The warrior carried a spear.", "textEs": "El guerrero llevaba una lanza.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "3fd62fcc-6f1b-4e68-88c7-41f879882bf7"}, {"id": "9e386935-0a0e-4485-a0ff-89506778aba1", "textEn": "The spear whistled through the air before striking its target.", "textEs": "La lanza silbó en el aire antes de golpear su objetivo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "3fd62fcc-6f1b-4e68-88c7-41f879882bf7"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a possessive or object pronoun, often unstressed and reduced to /ər/ in rapid speech.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "3ffaca11-8241-4d53-a34b-d5459e11118b", "textEn": "Her dress is beautiful.", "textEs": "Su vestido es hermoso.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "53412542-1494-4f13-93c1-c43222afeddf"}, {"id": "af9fd5bf-58c8-4626-9002-5679c7e4069e", "textEn": "I saw her at the store.", "textEs": "La vi en la tienda.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "53412542-1494-4f13-93c1-c43222afeddf"}, {"id": "c6a7679d-51ac-4aae-9de0-ada55fc13636", "textEn": "Her smile lit up the entire room.", "textEs": "Su sonrisa iluminó toda la habitación.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "53412542-1494-4f13-93c1-c43222afeddf"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a route or track, or figuratively to a course of action or direction in life.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "888580e6-0b4c-46b9-98fd-9eb142fe94d4", "textEn": "We followed a narrow path through the forest.", "textEs": "Seguimos un camino estrecho a través del bosque.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "720d6f3d-b2bb-47f1-8bd9-5dadf3ccfe31"}, {"id": "d469da95-3bdf-4e46-92f4-13a74a4e700c", "textEn": "She chose a new path in her career.", "textEs": "Ella eligió un nuevo camino en su carrera.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "720d6f3d-b2bb-47f1-8bd9-5dadf3ccfe31"}, {"id": "3dfde99e-6b23-4de9-ae44-343e4c864921", "textEn": "I decided to take a different path in my career.", "textEs": "Decidí tomar un camino diferente en mi carrera.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "720d6f3d-b2bb-47f1-8bd9-5dadf3ccfe31"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the time between two events or periods, often in formal or business contexts.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "39fa92da-dbb2-4d13-a1f6-b912f29c79d1", "textEn": "In the interim, we can use temporary staff.", "textEs": "En el ínterin, podemos usar personal temporal.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "0e0053c9-e87a-4f0e-a7d8-007d8f840dda"}, {"id": "b0eba18c-fa4a-48a6-a51f-d4adfbd1e4bf", "textEn": "The report is due next week; in the interim, prepare the data.", "textEs": "El informe debe entregarse la próxima semana; en el ínterin, prepara los datos.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "0e0053c9-e87a-4f0e-a7d8-007d8f840dda"}, {"id": "237d5fa0-81c2-4cb6-aa1b-0f386a719c00", "textEn": "We need a new manager, but in the interim, Sarah will handle the team.", "textEs": "Necesitamos un nuevo gerente, pero mientras tanto, Sarah se encargará del equipo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "0e0053c9-e87a-4f0e-a7d8-007d8f840dda"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally to refer to a child or young person, often in casual conversation or when addressing someone younger.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "4680c006-18da-44b0-a300-55eee166e5e5", "textEn": "The kid is playing in the park.", "textEs": "El niño está jugando en el parque.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "98cda3b2-b1be-4420-b2ff-69e5a27dc341"}, {"id": "e2978ce2-82ae-4404-9f2d-0e9effd59c2f", "textEn": "I'm just kidding, don't worry.", "textEs": "Solo estoy bromeando, no te preocupes.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "98cda3b2-b1be-4420-b2ff-69e5a27dc341"}, {"id": "124076f5-196f-4efd-8e43-2929bfa59454", "textEn": "The kids are playing in the backyard.", "textEs": "Los niños están jugando en el patio trasero.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "98cda3b2-b1be-4420-b2ff-69e5a27dc341"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a container, often with a lid, or in phrases like 'think outside the box' to mean creative thinking.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "788671e5-016f-4d63-aeb0-2ecaba043dc9", "textEn": "Put the toys in the box.", "textEs": "Pon los juguetes en la caja.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "ed5dfee2-3c27-49da-a4dc-647830ff583c"}, {"id": "fec70478-5ca0-4485-aebc-0d81a311dacb", "textEn": "I need a box for the clock.", "textEs": "Necesito una caja para el reloj.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "ed5dfee2-3c27-49da-a4dc-647830ff583c"}, {"id": "ab52fedf-be6d-4819-b8f7-e225e6bc94a4", "textEn": "The machine goes 'box' when it stops.", "textEs": "La máquina hace 'box' cuando se detiene.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "ed5dfee2-3c27-49da-a4dc-647830ff583c"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to introduce a result or outcome, often in formal or academic contexts, similar to 'therefore' or 'as a result'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "e47e2b4c-29e5-45e9-b2e4-abac2f6a89c9", "textEn": "He didn't study, and as a consequence, he failed the exam.", "textEs": "No estudió y, como consecuencia, reprobó el examen.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "aa509611-6665-4ac1-8ecf-6e2495ab6ecc"}, {"id": "ed6d3318-83e2-49c9-87c0-dfe85536de34", "textEn": "The river flooded as a consequence of heavy rain.", "textEs": "El río se desbordó como consecuencia de las fuertes lluvias.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "aa509611-6665-4ac1-8ecf-6e2495ab6ecc"}, {"id": "ab6ad5c0-e2f5-418b-9bb7-566fcdd981fe", "textEn": "He missed the deadline, and as a consequence, the project was delayed.", "textEs": "Perdió la fecha límite y, como consecuencia, el proyecto se retrasó.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "aa509611-6665-4ac1-8ecf-6e2495ab6ecc"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a small open container for drinking, or as a unit of measurement in cooking.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "95b0ed30-ec91-4617-8964-338e16116266", "textEn": "She drank tea from a blue cup.", "textEs": "Ella bebió té de una taza azul.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "003d2647-b548-4136-8e4c-b42e31a85476"}, {"id": "020dd899-e598-48a2-97e2-81eb52adc3b0", "textEn": "He filled the cup with water.", "textEs": "Llenó la taza con agua.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "003d2647-b548-4136-8e4c-b42e31a85476"}, {"id": "a02fff59-24df-49f8-8dd0-d3fd3b558d33", "textEn": "I heard a cup clatter in the kitchen.", "textEs": "Escuché una taza traquetear en la cocina.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "003d2647-b548-4136-8e4c-b42e31a85476"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe someone who is faithful and committed, often in relationships, friendships, or to a cause.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "323d8b21-df95-4e28-b347-d75183fccb68", "textEn": "She is a loyal friend who always helps.", "textEs": "Ella es una amiga leal que siempre ayuda.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "76f00ba0-ad64-42c6-bca0-d761d27d0ce4"}, {"id": "29ea7389-7e95-4c5c-a72c-c27205ff2a46", "textEn": "The dog remained loyal to its owner.", "textEs": "El perro se mantuvo leal a su dueño.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "76f00ba0-ad64-42c6-bca0-d761d27d0ce4"}, {"id": "6489f74c-6962-49c7-af1c-bc29740ba26e", "textEn": "She has been a loyal friend for over twenty years, never missing my birthday.", "textEs": "Ella ha sido una amiga leal por más de veinte años, nunca se ha perdido mi cumpleaños.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "76f00ba0-ad64-42c6-bca0-d761d27d0ce4"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe a turning or rotating motion, often metaphorically for a surprising change in a story or situation.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "002192b4-29b6-4a31-80d2-b29b6209d768", "textEn": "Twist the cap to open it.", "textEs": "Gira la tapa para abrirlo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "f1a81fbd-fa70-40fa-967b-ca41207a68ab"}, {"id": "90bd920b-4f73-4a2f-827b-806244068d5b", "textEn": "The story has a twist.", "textEs": "La historia tiene un giro.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "f1a81fbd-fa70-40fa-967b-ca41207a68ab"}, {"id": "2fd07bb3-7b70-49dc-9f3f-34862aa6849b", "textEn": "The road twists and turns through the mountains.", "textEs": "El camino serpentea y gira a través de las montañas.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "f1a81fbd-fa70-40fa-967b-ca41207a68ab"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something related to the voice, or someone who expresses opinions freely and loudly.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "31db362b-911b-4414-a47b-ffb8adade315", "textEn": "She is a vocal supporter of the cause.", "textEs": "Ella es una defensora vocal de la causa.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "af17cd8d-fe9b-4ae0-8d2b-6ebc9dffacec"}, {"id": "bab237aa-011c-4f7a-8daa-076e7bd0d09e", "textEn": "The singer has a powerful vocal range.", "textEs": "El cantante tiene un rango vocal poderoso.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "af17cd8d-fe9b-4ae0-8d2b-6ebc9dffacec"}, {"id": "201549a9-7ab0-4784-bdfc-be6843866aca", "textEn": "She is very vocal about her opinions during meetings.", "textEs": "Ella es muy vocal acerca de sus opiniones durante las reuniones.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "af17cd8d-fe9b-4ae0-8d2b-6ebc9dffacec"}]

flashcards.native_speech: yoo people
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "ed0cc3df-9d71-4379-81bf-ed647e61006a", "textEn": "You people are always late.", "textEs": "Ustedes siempre llegan tarde.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "204639d2-1c24-4d21-9403-0885fb2821ff"}, {"id": "40f9644d-7bdc-4c24-9dfa-70eea580b3d2", "textEn": "What do you people want from me?", "textEs": "¿Qué quieren ustedes de mí?", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "204639d2-1c24-4d21-9403-0885fb2821ff"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to transition to a new topic or continue a conversation, often after a pause or awkward moment, implying 'let's move on'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "5c8702a3-f92d-47a5-a9c1-26eac5cb1e05", "textEn": "Moving right along, let's look at the next chart.", "textEs": "Continuando rápidamente, veamos el siguiente gráfico.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "bbca74d8-457d-4d8f-a5fc-8978feade391"}, {"id": "95292389-66d4-4f67-bc39-912e8174e943", "textEn": "Moving right along, I'll introduce our new team member.", "textEs": "Continuando rápidamente, presentaré a nuestro nuevo miembro del equipo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "bbca74d8-457d-4d8f-a5fc-8978feade391"}, {"id": "e08a7885-0ce8-4116-91d5-9701e3399844", "textEn": "Moving right along, let's discuss the next item on our agenda.", "textEs": "Continuando, discutamos el siguiente punto de nuestra agenda.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "bbca74d8-457d-4d8f-a5fc-8978feade391"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a verb for forming letters or words on a surface, often in contexts of composing text or recording information.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "5f415377-1403-486b-9a21-2472db513496", "textEn": "Please write your name here.", "textEs": "Por favor, escribe tu nombre aquí.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "7f59fb40-8b18-469c-af76-d2f8507ab080"}, {"id": "dcec194b-ce31-4ebe-be95-e2a7a2c85308", "textEn": "I need to write a letter.", "textEs": "Necesito escribir una carta.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "7f59fb40-8b18-469c-af76-d2f8507ab080"}, {"id": "dffc2db0-cc10-4da8-84f1-c54511748174", "textEn": "The pen writes smoothly on this paper.", "textEs": "El bolígrafo escribe suavemente en este papel.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "7f59fb40-8b18-469c-af76-d2f8507ab080"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe moving on foot at a moderate pace, often in casual conversation about daily activities or directions.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "52adfd30-840f-461a-9a8d-78c7589b547f", "textEn": "Let's walk to the park together.", "textEs": "Vamos a caminar al parque juntos.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "8e16e016-ed87-4c09-b5a9-7e03d0027c4b"}, {"id": "704c7438-72ff-4316-a115-66d46283171a", "textEn": "He takes a walk every morning.", "textEs": "Él da un paseo cada mañana.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "8e16e016-ed87-4c09-b5a9-7e03d0027c4b"}, {"id": "400adfd2-3060-411b-bed2-4d0238c80889", "textEn": "I love to walk in the park every morning.", "textEs": "Me encanta caminar en el parque cada mañana.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "8e16e016-ed87-4c09-b5a9-7e03d0027c4b"}]

flashcards.native_speech: all uv yoo
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "35ddebe3-ad39-4d83-9c04-afbaf15d29d8", "textEn": "All of you need to sit down.", "textEs": "Todos ustedes necesitan sentarse.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "d222e66d-a777-4bcc-9c56-3e1be1323e62"}, {"id": "0f67b734-4086-479f-9add-615a4b8293ba", "textEn": "I'm talking to all of you.", "textEs": "Les estoy hablando a todos ustedes.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "d222e66d-a777-4bcc-9c56-3e1be1323e62"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe receiving money or something valuable in exchange for work or effort, often in contexts like 'earn a living' or 'earn respect'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "4a4106a3-ddd6-4481-a1f9-979395544528", "textEn": "She earns a good salary at her job.", "textEs": "Ella gana un buen salario en su trabajo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "94d1c921-f140-40cf-bdc4-17f2d7daefb9"}, {"id": "458ba5fd-f9d5-4988-beb3-c0edbbf40f65", "textEn": "You need to earn their trust first.", "textEs": "Necesitas ganarte su confianza primero.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "94d1c921-f140-40cf-bdc4-17f2d7daefb9"}, {"id": "39c3e58d-71f5-4a0f-92fa-ff641d56622f", "textEn": "She works hard to earn a living for her family.", "textEs": "Ella trabaja duro para ganarse la vida para su familia.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "94d1c921-f140-40cf-bdc4-17f2d7daefb9"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to express mild to moderate irritation, often in casual conversation like 'That noise really annoys me.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "d41481dd-595e-4861-b2ca-50ed952903e9", "textEn": "The noise from the construction site really annoys me.", "textEs": "El ruido de la obra realmente me molesta.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "36199e65-0b97-442c-b70e-b54c5069419d"}, {"id": "2d2f89eb-f039-4b8d-8d69-dabe8dd8453b", "textEn": "Don't annoy your sister while she's studying.", "textEs": "No molestes a tu hermana mientras estudia.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "36199e65-0b97-442c-b70e-b54c5069419d"}, {"id": "d1f48326-5252-4cb2-9445-6c7b8070ac63", "textEn": "The constant buzzing of the mosquito really started to annoy me while I was trying to sleep.", "textEs": "El zumbido constante del mosquito realmente empezó a molestarme mientras intentaba dormir.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "36199e65-0b97-442c-b70e-b54c5069419d"}]

flashcards.native_speech: yuh guyses
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "9a8b0c5f-8713-4532-bdec-18f939d5aa47", "textEn": "Is this you guyses car?", "textEs": "¿Este es el carro de ustedes?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "bd82239f-549e-4331-a45c-2a19cdbd9846"}, {"id": "2bac9b94-eb52-4304-b021-8407793b1fc9", "textEn": "That's you guyses problem.", "textEs": "Ese es el problema de ustedes.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "bd82239f-549e-4331-a45c-2a19cdbd9846"}, {"id": "18e0d985-aa82-4cc5-b3a1-6d2a878a964d", "textEn": "I need you guyses opinions on this project.", "textEs": "Necesito las opiniones de ustedes sobre este proyecto.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "bd82239f-549e-4331-a45c-2a19cdbd9846"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a future point in time, often implying later in a process or sequence.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "23e80652-56d2-4a81-8999-0231782a61e4", "textEn": "We might need to expand the team down the line.", "textEs": "Podríamos necesitar expandir el equipo más adelante.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "dd835138-d4fc-4f04-94d8-0a960382a2ea"}, {"id": "29a781ed-fc9b-40e1-9c96-610d190886eb", "textEn": "These issues could cause problems down the line.", "textEs": "Estos problemas podrían causar dificultades más adelante.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "dd835138-d4fc-4f04-94d8-0a960382a2ea"}, {"id": "4b8770f0-bc20-477f-a539-46e33406372a", "textEn": "We'll need to make this decision now, but the consequences will only become clear down the line.", "textEs": "Necesitaremos tomar esta decisión ahora, pero las consecuencias solo se aclararán más adelante.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "dd835138-d4fc-4f04-94d8-0a960382a2ea"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in casual speech as a contraction of 'got to', indicating necessity or obligation, like in 'I gotta go'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "ee5f0632-fcb5-4103-9895-997fc270922b", "textEn": "I gotta finish this report by noon.", "textEs": "Tengo que terminar este informe para el mediodía.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "d8c0eef3-6f1d-4044-9a85-c9d0a462f163"}, {"id": "fdcb2877-c987-43fb-a88a-619285c4472f", "textEn": "You gotta try this pizza, it's amazing.", "textEs": "Tienes que probar esta pizza, es increíble.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "d8c0eef3-6f1d-4044-9a85-c9d0a462f163"}, {"id": "670c1fed-61b0-425f-a739-be3cc227b185", "textEn": "We gotta leave now or we'll miss the bus.", "textEs": "Tenemos que irnos ahora o perderemos el autobús.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "d8c0eef3-6f1d-4044-9a85-c9d0a462f163"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally to refer to a psychiatrist or psychologist, as in 'I need to see my shrink.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "9b39f45e-8ec6-4e65-98f8-b447c75a528e", "textEn": "Wool sweaters can shrink if you wash them in hot water.", "textEs": "Los suéteres de lana pueden encogerse si los lavas con agua caliente.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "8cd6ed42-2d5b-4484-adfd-e9c21ce9aadf"}, {"id": "050d4616-96f0-4c46-83f0-0346604dc5dc", "textEn": "The company's profits began to shrink after the crisis.", "textEs": "Las ganancias de la empresa comenzaron a reducirse después de la crisis.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "8cd6ed42-2d5b-4484-adfd-e9c21ce9aadf"}, {"id": "1268579a-a33b-4ba4-8115-71f3bfd65903", "textEn": "The sweater shrank in the wash, so it doesn't fit anymore.", "textEs": "El suéter se encogió en el lavado, por lo que ya no queda.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "8cd6ed42-2d5b-4484-adfd-e9c21ce9aadf"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Often pronounced as 'kloʊz' in fast, casual speech, dropping the 'th' sound.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "3e985f64-ac25-4711-b5b1-8a54b08807b0", "textEn": "I need to buy new clothes.", "textEs": "Necesito comprar ropa nueva.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "9692aea0-7735-4de8-bc9a-17a5834168d9"}, {"id": "a1636572-d766-41dd-a9ab-fd31a611f0be", "textEn": "Her clothes are always stylish.", "textEs": "Su ropa siempre es elegante.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "9692aea0-7735-4de8-bc9a-17a5834168d9"}, {"id": "fb42cf28-c074-4fd8-a65c-d0935efafbaa", "textEn": "I need to buy some new clothes for the job interview.", "textEs": "Necesito comprar ropa nueva para la entrevista de trabajo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "9692aea0-7735-4de8-bc9a-17a5834168d9"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to indicate one of two equal parts of something, often in measurements or time, like 'half an hour' or 'half the cake'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "f5cbbbb1-7c79-4ebd-8312-f9f9298d5adb", "textEn": "She ate half of the pizza.", "textEs": "Ella se comió la mitad de la pizza.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "adc50215-4133-443f-a6be-2c56a7b40fd9"}, {"id": "5090ee4c-49a5-4401-9869-b1a0bf907de4", "textEn": "Half the class was absent.", "textEs": "La mitad de la clase faltó.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "adc50215-4133-443f-a6be-2c56a7b40fd9"}, {"id": "1791c372-eef8-4b56-838f-14edfdca8a59", "textEn": "She only ate half of her sandwich.", "textEs": "Ella solo se comió la mitad de su sándwich.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "adc50215-4133-443f-a6be-2c56a7b40fd9"}]

flashcards.native_speech: yoo too
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "50948dc4-050f-4d54-92bb-42229c85de58", "textEn": "You two need to stop fighting.", "textEs": "Ustedes dos necesitan dejar de pelear.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "d85a76e1-4d0f-4eb7-938c-fb4387870184"}, {"id": "03be79a5-47cf-41f6-b292-7c63d433915e", "textEn": "I saw you two at the mall.", "textEs": "Los vi a ustedes dos en el centro comercial.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "d85a76e1-4d0f-4eb7-938c-fb4387870184"}, {"id": "562dfd1f-57d9-47bf-afa3-9c054a067a08", "textEn": "You two need to stop arguing and work this out.", "textEs": "Ustedes dos necesitan dejar de discutir y resolver esto.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "d85a76e1-4d0f-4eb7-938c-fb4387870184"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a noun meaning an official document allowing something, often stressed on the first syllable.
