flashcards.examples: [{"id": "62a18c1d-f916-4d75-8376-6aba5fc7b589", "textEn": "You need a permit to park here.", "textEs": "Necesitas un permiso para estacionar aquí.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "a2067023-5613-4f58-9388-f16ab504757f"}, {"id": "f84df86d-99c7-48f2-aa05-52b14140a9e3", "textEn": "The building permit was approved.", "textEs": "El permiso de construcción fue aprobado.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "a2067023-5613-4f58-9388-f16ab504757f"}, {"id": "b84b69e6-32f9-44f1-b696-1b6411dc363a", "textEn": "I need a permit to park here, or I'll get a ticket.", "textEs": "Necesito un permiso para estacionar aquí, o me multarán.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "a2067023-5613-4f58-9388-f16ab504757f"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the flying mammal or a piece of sports equipment; also a verb meaning to hit with a bat.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "c8954c1f-b7ad-45f6-a4d8-b41d9b0a1f72", "textEn": "The bat flew out of the cave at dusk.", "textEs": "El murciélago voló fuera de la cueva al anochecer.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "28cd9f5b-929d-4c66-b03c-0734ba8888d3"}, {"id": "6502f15a-9657-42fc-a2b2-db7bb9cf4af7", "textEn": "I saw a bat hanging upside down in the tree.", "textEs": "Vi un murciélago colgado boca abajo en el árbol.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "28cd9f5b-929d-4c66-b03c-0734ba8888d3"}, {"id": "b7cf34c0-f345-4e7e-ab45-f51c0a5d63d3", "textEn": "The bat flapped its wings and flew into the night sky.", "textEs": "El murciélago batió sus alas y voló hacia el cielo nocturno.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "28cd9f5b-929d-4c66-b03c-0734ba8888d3"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to introduce a conclusion or action based on previously stated information, often in discussions or planning.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "c1842257-a635-4792-8a41-0a6fa9f7be89", "textEn": "With that in mind, let's explore the next opportunity.", "textEs": "Teniendo eso en cuenta, exploremos la siguiente oportunidad.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "f567c49f-074d-4534-952e-ec442416f542"}, {"id": "4bc4d777-80c1-45a3-8857-2b5bf7df21f5", "textEn": "With that in mind, I propose we adjust our timeline.", "textEs": "Teniendo eso en cuenta, propongo que ajustemos nuestro cronograma.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "f567c49f-074d-4534-952e-ec442416f542"}, {"id": "d1bc2c82-378a-41a4-80bf-b42e278eac29", "textEn": "We need to cut costs. With that in mind, I suggest we reduce our travel budget.", "textEs": "Necesitamos reducir costos. Con eso en mente, sugiero que reduzcamos nuestro presupuesto de viajes.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "f567c49f-074d-4534-952e-ec442416f542"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a casual, fast pronunciation of 'let me', often in requests or offers like 'lemme help you' or 'lemme see'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "3f5ca77f-e71e-4a9b-94ac-e98d71c2814a", "textEn": "Lemme check my schedule.", "textEs": "Déjame revisar mi horario.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "e0c22a1c-1084-440c-b197-4c453f62f80e"}, {"id": "624e0207-3730-4ef0-8f53-6bf1aee41d69", "textEn": "Lemme know if you need help.", "textEs": "Dime si necesitas ayuda.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "e0c22a1c-1084-440c-b197-4c453f62f80e"}, {"id": "f20aa1bc-6821-4ff4-8f45-f1aba5279760", "textEn": "Lemme see if I can find your keys.", "textEs": "Déjame ver si puedo encontrar tus llaves.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "e0c22a1c-1084-440c-b197-4c453f62f80e"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to indicate direction, increase, or completion, often in casual commands like 'stand up' or 'time's up'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "9e64c794-bec0-40aa-94f6-00073d24499b", "textEn": "Look up at the sky.", "textEs": "Mira hacia arriba al cielo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "78265bc1-aa5b-4f4f-bf56-21973c643f38"}, {"id": "710835c2-4d6a-4693-98ae-26a2f8149dd0", "textEn": "He stood up quickly.", "textEs": "Se levantó rápidamente.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "78265bc1-aa5b-4f4f-bf56-21973c643f38"}, {"id": "676c775b-c4c6-4dc4-a650-b3bf3063a02d", "textEn": "I need to go up to the third floor.", "textEs": "Necesito subir al tercer piso.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "78265bc1-aa5b-4f4f-bf56-21973c643f38"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a noun for a device that moves fluids or air, or as a verb meaning to move something forcefully or rhythmically, like pumping gas or pumping a fist.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "f2e6aece-ec7b-460d-be9a-6e52a0bdca7a", "textEn": "He used a pump to inflate the tire.", "textEs": "Usó una bomba para inflar la llanta.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "39830124-43e3-436d-93bc-5de99ef1bbbc"}, {"id": "2c66fc4e-f3ec-4b3d-afb0-cfa6b0ef88ab", "textEn": "The water pump broke down yesterday.", "textEs": "La bomba de agua se averió ayer.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "39830124-43e3-436d-93bc-5de99ef1bbbc"}, {"id": "0d74f218-a151-45a4-ba88-d6cfbdcc6927", "textEn": "I could hear my heart pump faster as I waited for the test results.", "textEs": "Podía oír cómo mi corazón bombeaba más rápido mientras esperaba los resultados de la prueba.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "39830124-43e3-436d-93bc-5de99ef1bbbc"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to express a relatable feeling or vibe, often in casual conversation or on social media.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "784efde8-0ed5-4d6c-bccd-a6946629bb98", "textEn": "She is in a good mood today.", "textEs": "Ella está de buen humor hoy.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "daaec28f-371a-4bb9-bbcb-da92a52bff54"}, {"id": "0efdf805-24d7-4acb-9cf3-c3b8954028b1", "textEn": "The music set a romantic mood.", "textEs": "La música creó un ambiente romántico.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "daaec28f-371a-4bb9-bbcb-da92a52bff54"}, {"id": "1daf247d-106e-4dbc-a15f-463f22ac8c5a", "textEn": "That test was so hard, I'm literally in a mood right now.", "textEs": "Ese examen fue tan difícil, literalmente estoy de mal humor ahora mismo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "daaec28f-371a-4bb9-bbcb-da92a52bff54"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe a strong, often short-lived romantic infatuation with someone, or to express the act of physically compressing something.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "b58672f1-5c71-469c-af0c-784c2d0bf1e7", "textEn": "Don't crush the box when you stack it.", "textEs": "No aplastes la caja cuando la apiles.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "78fb8baf-88d4-43a3-b901-e16747b18023"}, {"id": "1f07f2d0-9216-4b05-8a6d-b2c6a7c823ea", "textEn": "He crushed the can with his foot.", "textEs": "Aplastó la lata con el pie.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "78fb8baf-88d4-43a3-b901-e16747b18023"}, {"id": "612de011-61c2-4c8e-a730-5fc889c6aedd", "textEn": "I have a huge crush on my coworker, but I'm too shy to tell her.", "textEs": "Tengo un gran flechazo por mi compañera de trabajo, pero soy demasiado tímido para decírselo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "78fb8baf-88d4-43a3-b901-e16747b18023"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a naturally raised area of land, often smaller than a mountain, in everyday conversation about geography or directions.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "ca9083b4-0e0f-4821-a835-bc4b9e3b2522", "textEn": "We walked up the hill slowly.", "textEs": "Caminamos lentamente colina arriba.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "c026fcd0-41d9-4e9a-9fec-b3b9394b8f81"}, {"id": "09700b4f-0ad3-42a2-a9bb-53cfcf6cb994", "textEn": "The house is on top of a hill.", "textEs": "La casa está en la cima de una colina.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "c026fcd0-41d9-4e9a-9fec-b3b9394b8f81"}, {"id": "a9c224d9-7abb-4749-b478-b5db82c64d56", "textEn": "The kids love rolling down the hill in the park.", "textEs": "A los niños les encanta rodar colina abajo en el parque.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "c026fcd0-41d9-4e9a-9fec-b3b9394b8f81"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something sugary, pleasant, or endearing; also commonly used as an informal exclamation of approval or delight.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "c94693d0-d69a-49b6-bd6d-5742969d9731", "textEn": "This cake is very sweet.", "textEs": "Este pastel es muy dulce.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "8d8379bd-3764-4858-ab97-9f8b4cf20ca6"}, {"id": "5c4e043a-d57d-4f36-b9aa-47675cfb5e85", "textEn": "She has a sweet smile.", "textEs": "Ella tiene una sonrisa dulce.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "8d8379bd-3764-4858-ab97-9f8b4cf20ca6"}, {"id": "b52e58b9-33e1-442b-b7da-37512701228b", "textEn": "That's a sweet car you've got there.", "textEs": "Ese es un auto bonito que tienes.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "8d8379bd-3764-4858-ab97-9f8b4cf20ca6"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a mesh fabric, a sports goal, or the internet; often in phrases like 'net income' or 'net result' to mean final amount.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "4ffad54a-96b3-40e8-a3f4-b6915ba6ebd2", "textEn": "The fish got caught in the net.", "textEs": "El pez quedó atrapado en la red.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "7826bb1b-a457-4b1f-9385-4e3013f04ee8"}, {"id": "af6632dd-a4dc-4de4-92b3-c225ab2f89fb", "textEn": "He hit the ball over the net.", "textEs": "Él golpeó la pelota por encima de la red.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "7826bb1b-a457-4b1f-9385-4e3013f04ee8"}, {"id": "7fa3ec42-6d4d-4ba4-8430-64ef5a6fb3fe", "textEn": "The net income this quarter is much higher than we expected.", "textEs": "El ingreso neto de este trimestre es mucho más alto de lo que esperábamos.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "7826bb1b-a457-4b1f-9385-4e3013f04ee8"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to show empathy or understanding, often in response to someone sharing feelings or frustrations, meaning 'I understand your point or emotion'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "b0bb7f79-adac-4e4a-bb98-1992dca5b899", "textEn": "I hear you, that's a tough situation.", "textEs": "Te entiendo, esa es una situación difícil.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "f56186bc-71b2-47b6-8b88-7898c10b19fd"}, {"id": "91af6c6c-e895-4fd3-b124-42bdacd1fe3e", "textEn": "I hear you, let's figure it out together.", "textEs": "Te escucho, resolvámoslo juntos.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "f56186bc-71b2-47b6-8b88-7898c10b19fd"}, {"id": "34da2e23-d3e2-4eec-ae5e-ed76f09e9a44", "textEn": "I hear you, but I still think we should go with the original plan.", "textEs": "Te escucho, pero aún así creo que deberíamos seguir con el plan original.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "f56186bc-71b2-47b6-8b88-7898c10b19fd"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Often pronounced with a slight simplification, like 'twelth' or 'twelf', especially in fast speech.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "5927f95c-a892-4473-8a88-0acd820f2f5f", "textEn": "It's his twelfth birthday today.", "textEs": "Hoy es su duodécimo cumpleaños.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "21e58a0f-e0b6-4835-9a2e-8448d09df499"}, {"id": "a35e8bf4-8db2-4aa3-920d-46e95c9f935b", "textEn": "She finished in twelfth place.", "textEs": "Ella terminó en el duodécimo lugar.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "21e58a0f-e0b6-4835-9a2e-8448d09df499"}, {"id": "815759c6-eee4-4260-8415-ee658da84e65", "textEn": "I'll see you on the twelfth.", "textEs": "Te veré el doce.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "21e58a0f-e0b6-4835-9a2e-8448d09df499"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something breaking open suddenly, like a pipe or bubble, or a sudden intense action like bursting into laughter or tears.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "bd384416-eb5a-4e4e-b17f-3f8f59ddfdf9", "textEn": "The balloon burst with a loud noise.", "textEs": "El globo estalló con un ruido fuerte.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "f38a763f-cf3f-4d63-b779-a8e276044bb8"}, {"id": "cf59c11a-cace-4e7d-aa25-3ccc3aa162cc", "textEn": "A burst of laughter filled the room.", "textEs": "Una explosión de risa llenó la habitación.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "f38a763f-cf3f-4d63-b779-a8e276044bb8"}, {"id": "750760ce-186f-4cbb-a906-87b17e2b3ff9", "textEn": "The balloon burst with a loud pop, scaring the cat.", "textEs": "El globo estalló con un fuerte chasquido, asustando al gato.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "f38a763f-cf3f-4d63-b779-a8e276044bb8"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally in place of 'kind of' to soften statements or express approximation, like 'I'm kinda tired.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "8afced56-9df3-4d47-94a6-82ffd13303af", "textEn": "It's kinda cold outside.", "textEs": "Hace un poco de frío afuera.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "00d4c582-3344-4725-b84a-d128569a6ab3"}, {"id": "f76d864b-e4f8-489c-8c05-456e75ee223c", "textEn": "I'm kinda tired today.", "textEs": "Estoy algo cansado hoy.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "00d4c582-3344-4725-b84a-d128569a6ab3"}, {"id": "61c35c58-cde3-4dab-8cbf-286b6d43f676", "textEn": "I'm kinda tired after the long walk.", "textEs": "Estoy un poco cansado después de la larga caminata.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "00d4c582-3344-4725-b84a-d128569a6ab3"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe shouting loudly, often in anger, excitement, or to get someone's attention from a distance.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "51997ad3-b1c2-45d2-b1d4-1919b9885335", "textEn": "Don't yell at me.", "textEs": "No me grites.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "0921f1f4-fb18-4326-9730-7fd1c20290b6"}, {"id": "d191a3db-acb4-4e76-b379-8664beab3b21", "textEn": "The fans yell loudly at the game.", "textEs": "Los aficionados gritan fuerte en el partido.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "0921f1f4-fb18-4326-9730-7fd1c20290b6"}, {"id": "dc314b8a-9188-4b46-82e7-3f2636f90f02", "textEn": "The baby started to yell when his toy was taken away.", "textEs": "El bebé empezó a gritar cuando le quitaron su juguete.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "0921f1f4-fb18-4326-9730-7fd1c20290b6"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in casual speech as a contraction of 'going to' to express future intention or prediction.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "1732a6df-54aa-4ce4-b2d8-e3cb64bbf4f0", "textEn": "I'm gonna call you later.", "textEs": "Te voy a llamar más tarde.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "ef6a2772-d542-4046-9629-482a1d8b3770"}, {"id": "13a8e0a6-56ba-4ee1-a942-db5eb57f023c", "textEn": "She's gonna be here soon.", "textEs": "Ella va a estar aquí pronto.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "ef6a2772-d542-4046-9629-482a1d8b3770"}, {"id": "e54df45f-a785-4293-8edc-566b3ba45ec6", "textEn": "I'm gonna grab some coffee after the meeting.", "textEs": "Voy a tomar un café después de la reunión.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "ef6a2772-d542-4046-9629-482a1d8b3770"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe the act of forming letters or words on a surface, often in contexts like 'write a letter' or 'write down notes'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "db221485-4712-43c8-912d-1351f60a15c5", "textEn": "Please write your name here.", "textEs": "Por favor, escribe tu nombre aquí.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "5d6fc7a7-09e2-411e-a1e5-cb69eeb63568"}, {"id": "e41d8de7-b41c-4080-a497-ecbb0c77c098", "textEn": "He likes to write stories.", "textEs": "A él le gusta escribir historias.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "5d6fc7a7-09e2-411e-a1e5-cb69eeb63568"}, {"id": "eef9220b-0e9b-4efb-a75e-2f834fd4d77a", "textEn": "I write in my journal every night before bed.", "textEs": "Escribo en mi diario todas las noches antes de dormir.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "5d6fc7a7-09e2-411e-a1e5-cb69eeb63568"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally in casual conversation as a contraction of 'want to', often to express desire or intention.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "4567d335-6749-4db5-b6f5-b21ca11079b3", "textEn": "Do you wanna grab coffee?", "textEs": "¿Quieres tomar un café?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "7324dbc9-af0e-4505-9783-4324dca85c3b"}, {"id": "d25dd75e-8e1f-4b6a-9d7c-877eac3a35f4", "textEn": "I don't wanna go there.", "textEs": "No quiero ir allí.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "7324dbc9-af0e-4505-9783-4324dca85c3b"}, {"id": "c7a2f59a-fe1c-4614-92c3-aea6cf611e06", "textEn": "I wanna go to the beach this weekend.", "textEs": "Quiero ir a la playa este fin de semana.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "7324dbc9-af0e-4505-9783-4324dca85c3b"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in casual speech as a contraction of 'got to', expressing necessity or obligation, e.g., 'I gotta go now.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "fedd4b47-e3d9-4685-b710-4249eba87390", "textEn": "I gotta finish this report.", "textEs": "Tengo que terminar este informe.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "fda53d4a-f8f5-4efb-887b-e4c1464f3697"}, {"id": "2984bd5a-5f39-4a3e-941a-3f16084cf843", "textEn": "You gotta see that movie.", "textEs": "Tienes que ver esa película.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "fda53d4a-f8f5-4efb-887b-e4c1464f3697"}, {"id": "23033d98-e800-469d-bbb2-be97ac6bbcbc", "textEn": "I gotta go now, or I'll miss my bus.", "textEs": "Me tengo que ir ahora, o perderé el autobús.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "fda53d4a-f8f5-4efb-887b-e4c1464f3697"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to mean 'live in a place' or, more often in natural speech, 'think or talk about something for too long,' as in 'Don't dwell on it.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "4c6eb0b9-346e-45b6-a112-9a9b96bfdaea", "textEn": "Don't dwell on the past.", "textEs": "No te detengas en el pasado.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "f2436804-d0af-4026-8013-9fef5661b925"}, {"id": "39384315-7dd3-44d1-ac17-85620312ee76", "textEn": "They dwell in a small village.", "textEs": "Ellos moran en un pequeño pueblo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "f2436804-d0af-4026-8013-9fef5661b925"}, {"id": "b9d623a7-2b8c-4ef2-92b6-29577e542e6f", "textEn": "He tends to dwell on past mistakes rather than focusing on the present.", "textEs": "Él tiende a detenerse en los errores del pasado en lugar de concentrarse en el presente.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "f2436804-d0af-4026-8013-9fef5661b925"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a group of people working together, often in sports or work contexts, like 'our team won' or 'join the team'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "4b951c67-6b62-4f68-98ec-d9d79422b66f", "textEn": "Our team won the championship.", "textEs": "Nuestro equipo ganó el campeonato.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "ef270ec9-ae7b-46d3-9ed5-b97f05c7c758"}, {"id": "817db341-94a3-458b-b4fa-039611ddcbc3", "textEn": "She is a key member of the team.", "textEs": "Ella es un miembro clave del equipo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "ef270ec9-ae7b-46d3-9ed5-b97f05c7c758"}, {"id": "b3b1e09c-a52f-4ddf-bc3b-c260dde5ad29", "textEn": "I'm glad you're on my team for this project.", "textEs": "Me alegra que estés en mi equipo para este proyecto.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "ef270ec9-ae7b-46d3-9ed5-b97f05c7c758"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to indicate the direction opposite east, or to describe regions, winds, or cultural references associated with that direction.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "8bfd3c91-5819-4afb-b184-a6ccc931ceff", "textEn": "The sun sets in the west.", "textEs": "El sol se pone en el oeste.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "aefded47-e420-4cae-8f4e-18d263eb32b0"}, {"id": "9e21d037-5758-4109-a992-fdeba9115ba7", "textEn": "They moved to the west coast.", "textEs": "Se mudaron a la costa oeste.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "aefded47-e420-4cae-8f4e-18d263eb32b0"}, {"id": "44f5fce5-0880-4d78-b8fb-78ad85ed6dd3", "textEn": "The sun sets in the west.", "textEs": "El sol se pone en el oeste.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "aefded47-e420-4cae-8f4e-18d263eb32b0"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in casual speech as a contraction of 'could have', often in phrases like 'coulda been' or 'coulda done'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "58009534-74ba-419d-a14c-1f491f12bda4", "textEn": "I coulda been a winner.", "textEs": "Podría haber sido un ganador.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "692614e5-30cf-42a7-8a7d-87d48707ac0b"}, {"id": "603a0830-6abb-4f4d-bcd9-615a38c0c218", "textEn": "You coulda told me earlier.", "textEs": "Podrías habérmelo dicho antes.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "692614e5-30cf-42a7-8a7d-87d48707ac0b"}, {"id": "8998bf21-abb6-4c6c-a88f-999ff9d3cce6", "textEn": "I coulda been there on time if the traffic wasn't so bad.", "textEs": "Podría haber llegado a tiempo si el tráfico no hubiera sido tan malo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "692614e5-30cf-42a7-8a7d-87d48707ac0b"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in casual speech as a contraction of 'should have,' often in past regrets or missed obligations.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "80596bf2-af80-4cd0-88a2-4906faacad01", "textEn": "I shoulda called you.", "textEs": "Debería haberte llamado.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "905f17d5-5863-4074-9dc6-62978aa4f707"}, {"id": "f2f138a4-f6c1-4215-b0bc-3799754707f2", "textEn": "We shoulda left earlier.", "textEs": "Deberíamos habernos ido antes.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "905f17d5-5863-4074-9dc6-62978aa4f707"}, {"id": "0082d44e-7ab3-4b94-8322-cd99dfec5849", "textEn": "I shoulda studied harder for the test.", "textEs": "Debería haber estudiado más para el examen.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "905f17d5-5863-4074-9dc6-62978aa4f707"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to one's place of residence, often with a sense of comfort or belonging, as in 'I'm going home' or 'Make yourself at home.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "ca6a4582-31a2-4507-9795-d9b0042ea655", "textEn": "I'm going back home now.", "textEs": "Voy a casa ahora.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "da34a6e7-59c7-482e-9ec0-be1b601e0382"}, {"id": "91a51568-a342-4741-b2f2-16be7e82233c", "textEn": "Home is where the heart is.", "textEs": "El hogar está donde está el corazón.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "da34a6e7-59c7-482e-9ec0-be1b601e0382"}, {"id": "bad1eced-b457-4ba9-aa28-ff6b03af14de", "textEn": "The old house creaked and groaned, but it felt like home.", "textEs": "La vieja casa crujía y gemía, pero se sentía como en casa.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "da34a6e7-59c7-482e-9ec0-be1b601e0382"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something uncommon or infrequent, often in casual conversation like 'That's a rare sight!'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "f0626ed7-1a42-41f0-ad65-a2349d49dc3f", "textEn": "That is a rare bird in this area.", "textEs": "Ese es un pájaro raro en esta área.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "f7c0f669-7076-4b9f-bcb8-cf0c79dac42b"}, {"id": "4d2feb09-2402-4259-959a-0a54f15f7287", "textEn": "I like my steak rare.", "textEs": "Me gusta mi bistec poco cocido.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "f7c0f669-7076-4b9f-bcb8-cf0c79dac42b"}, {"id": "9f665987-f933-4770-a9b9-487312e60f11", "textEn": "It's rare to see such a beautiful sunset in the middle of winter.", "textEs": "Es raro ver un atardecer tan hermoso en pleno invierno.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "f7c0f669-7076-4b9f-bcb8-cf0c79dac42b"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the body part at the end of the leg, or as a unit of measurement (12 inches). In natural speech, it's often used in phrases like 'on foot' (walking) or 'put your foot down' (be firm).
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "fbf1ecea-93c4-4c39-a031-b71b66a39a5a", "textEn": "He hurt his foot while running.", "textEs": "Se lastimó el pie mientras corría.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "1b5fc891-81ed-4a06-a014-fa0cbf4f8057"}, {"id": "86249cac-253a-4fb4-b363-5bae5c71ba17", "textEn": "The baby has tiny feet.", "textEs": "El bebé tiene pies pequeños.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "1b5fc891-81ed-4a06-a014-fa0cbf4f8057"}, {"id": "c588b94a-e65a-4165-a33a-bcd1e71b0b77", "textEn": "I put my foot down and said no more video games until homework is done.", "textEs": "Me planté y dije que no más videojuegos hasta que terminen la tarea.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "1b5fc891-81ed-4a06-a014-fa0cbf4f8057"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to express surprise, disbelief, or amazement about something unexpected or extreme.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "097e7c71-2723-4830-aaee-3e7c47bafc45", "textEn": "That's wild, I can't believe he did that.", "textEs": "Eso es una locura, no puedo creer que hiciera eso.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "689a9359-7835-47ca-b57c-072c49c2e09d"}, {"id": "2cfc8909-5242-418c-a51c-7adce81fa93e", "textEn": "That's wild, how did you even find out?", "textEs": "Eso es una locura, ¿cómo te enteraste?", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "689a9359-7835-47ca-b57c-072c49c2e09d"}, {"id": "670eff4d-4d4e-4ffe-b2b2-2285c93eb040", "textEn": "That's wild that you ran into your old teacher in Tokyo of all places.", "textEs": "Es una locura que te hayas topado con tu antiguo profesor en Tokio, de todos los lugares.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "689a9359-7835-47ca-b57c-072c49c2e09d"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in casual conversation as a quick, informal way to say 'I don't know', often when shrugging or showing uncertainty.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "f79b9334-3278-4e1b-9bf6-dbbf2d4ec058", "textEn": "I dunno what to do.", "textEs": "No sé qué hacer.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "15ab4179-ffe3-4b3d-9518-9dd2ac773063"}, {"id": "7911e79c-ae73-4c0b-974e-3aea6a6f39e7", "textEn": "She dunno the answer.", "textEs": "Ella no sabe la respuesta.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "15ab4179-ffe3-4b3d-9518-9dd2ac773063"}, {"id": "557539f5-3e6f-40c0-aed4-80cbd54d8201", "textEn": "I dunno what to do about this problem.", "textEs": "No sé qué hacer con este problema.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "15ab4179-ffe3-4b3d-9518-9dd2ac773063"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in everyday speech to refer to fabric or material, often in contexts like cleaning or clothing.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "3d167fe0-fc52-4442-9bab-240dfa63f359", "textEn": "He wiped the table with a cloth.", "textEs": "Limpió la mesa con un paño.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "c86761b0-53fa-4aef-b7b4-508d0b13ef13"}, {"id": "dbb18e7a-b590-46db-bfca-8c6f5f250a5f", "textEn": "The cloth feels soft and smooth.", "textEs": "La tela se siente suave y lisa.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "c86761b0-53fa-4aef-b7b4-508d0b13ef13"}, {"id": "eb1e5f59-e219-4c31-a419-bb650db16f17", "textEn": "The cloth feels soft against my skin.", "textEs": "La tela se siente suave contra mi piel.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "c86761b0-53fa-4aef-b7b4-508d0b13ef13"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally to mean 'kind of' or 'somewhat,' often to soften a statement or express uncertainty.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "0615af3f-9a76-4914-9eb8-3cdd707cd128", "textEn": "It's sorta like that.", "textEs": "Es más o menos así.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "49f3f416-d025-4f06-ada5-dee5e01db468"}, {"id": "ed5c3bd3-4c1a-4e76-aa3e-29a12868c3bf", "textEn": "I sorta understand.", "textEs": "Más o menos entiendo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "49f3f416-d025-4f06-ada5-dee5e01db468"}, {"id": "94f146cc-9bb2-4572-a56d-2c1f95688352", "textEn": "I sorta like that movie, but it's not my favorite.", "textEs": "Me gusta un poco esa película, pero no es mi favorita.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "49f3f416-d025-4f06-ada5-dee5e01db468"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to express urgency or necessity in departing, often with stress on 'leave' to emphasize the action.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "23fd5237-97d6-4f6e-91b8-fc204fd7001e", "textEn": "I need to leave before it gets dark.", "textEs": "Necesito irme antes de que oscurezca.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "26c58920-8ec8-49ba-817b-b79deadc880e"}, {"id": "9252c2e2-c5bf-433f-b8b2-53cdd38b42fd", "textEn": "She said I need to leave now.", "textEs": "Ella dijo que necesito irme ahora.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "26c58920-8ec8-49ba-817b-b79deadc880e"}, {"id": "076d5627-6202-49cd-8626-c7a63cade453", "textEn": "I need to leave now, or I'll miss my train.", "textEs": "Necesito irme ahora, o perderé mi tren.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "26c58920-8ec8-49ba-817b-b79deadc880e"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe crying softly, often from sadness or strong emotion; common in both literal and figurative contexts like 'weep for joy'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "0440dbc8-b158-4028-9a9e-439d3c95328f", "textEn": "She began to weep when she heard the news.", "textEs": "Ella comenzó a llorar cuando escuchó las noticias.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "00f7b7ba-4991-4010-9fb7-66310abf603b"}, {"id": "a53ef891-2952-43a5-9e06-19faefe625da", "textEn": "The child would weep for his lost toy.", "textEs": "El niño lloraba por su juguete perdido.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "00f7b7ba-4991-4010-9fb7-66310abf603b"}, {"id": "9eb597fa-a902-41a8-a715-30e0c607d6dd", "textEn": "The baby began to weep loudly when she dropped her toy.", "textEs": "El bebé comenzó a llorar ruidosamente cuando dejó caer su juguete.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "00f7b7ba-4991-4010-9fb7-66310abf603b"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a celestial body, a famous person, or to describe something excellent, often with emphasis on the 'r' sound in American English.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "325db8f3-4c6b-47a3-934b-1cfd319082bc", "textEn": "The star shines brightly tonight.", "textEs": "La estrella brilla intensamente esta noche.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "2ffa035e-786a-4fb8-ab3b-0c5ffca3366c"}, {"id": "3fd25950-39de-4293-81fa-544e0b4448a5", "textEn": "She is a famous movie star.", "textEs": "Ella es una famosa estrella de cine.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "2ffa035e-786a-4fb8-ab3b-0c5ffca3366c"}, {"id": "1e7bef04-eaca-475e-aa5a-e294ff287c4c", "textEn": "The star of the show was the young pianist.", "textEs": "La estrella del espectáculo fue el joven pianista.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "2ffa035e-786a-4fb8-ab3b-0c5ffca3366c"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally in casual conversation to mean 'I don't know', often when shrugging or showing uncertainty.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "5d5410a0-cf79-4dcd-b2db-6930233b9e23", "textEn": "I dunno what to do.", "textEs": "No sé qué hacer.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "16a0f2dc-5ff6-4f84-ac39-dbd7c3073b39"}, {"id": "cbf4a141-2b68-4a17-95e6-edd7be5ec4a2", "textEn": "She dunno the answer.", "textEs": "Ella no sabe la respuesta.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "16a0f2dc-5ff6-4f84-ac39-dbd7c3073b39"}, {"id": "f871b176-1195-4dce-bd17-7e7d9568c18b", "textEn": "I dunno what to do about this problem.", "textEs": "No sé qué hacer con este problema.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "16a0f2dc-5ff6-4f84-ac39-dbd7c3073b39"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to emphasize a suggestion or encouragement, often with a slight stress on 'try' to convey that the effort itself is important.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "a29773ad-1dde-49e9-8e3e-c4db6107cc4e", "textEn": "You should try the new restaurant downtown.", "textEs": "Deberías probar el nuevo restaurante en el centro.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "ca90af15-6454-4dc3-9936-8ad8e96a7f01"}, {"id": "d5dbb131-8230-45f4-972e-53b9e6362536", "textEn": "If you're unsure, you should try asking for help.", "textEs": "Si no estás seguro, deberías intentar pedir ayuda.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "ca90af15-6454-4dc3-9936-8ad8e96a7f01"}, {"id": "fe2a8d97-e7fb-419c-969c-c678752f78e4", "textEn": "You should try this new restaurant; the food is amazing.", "textEs": "Deberías probar este nuevo restaurante; la comida es increíble.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "ca90af15-6454-4dc3-9936-8ad8e96a7f01"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the utensil for eating or serving food, often in casual contexts like 'pass me a spoon' or idiomatically in 'born with a silver spoon in your mouth'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "7f12eb7f-5f77-4d06-bb38-48b314d5c13e", "textEn": "Can you pass me a spoon?", "textEs": "¿Puedes pasarme una cuchara?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "d93a595c-efbb-499c-a5b4-231a6642354d"}, {"id": "36a80f7a-4f11-4c4a-9790-b4dc0b65669c", "textEn": "He stirred the coffee with a spoon.", "textEs": "Removió el café con una cuchara.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "d93a595c-efbb-499c-a5b4-231a6642354d"}, {"id": "c6e4fd3f-abb7-428a-a684-8aa439a7bf07", "textEn": "Can you spoon me tonight? I need comfort.", "textEs": "¿Puedes abrazarme por detrás esta noche? Necesito consuelo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "d93a595c-efbb-499c-a5b4-231a6642354d"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in casual, fast speech as a contraction of 'have to', indicating obligation or necessity.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "cb3e2bed-be18-46b6-a194-1e1d3757c624", "textEn": "I hafta leave now.", "textEs": "Tengo que irme ahora.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "db0a0676-9807-4d60-93c9-7b508a4a5261"}, {"id": "372d27bb-7067-4e1e-a35e-f9b87449e1a3", "textEn": "You hafta try this cake.", "textEs": "Tienes que probar este pastel.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "db0a0676-9807-4d60-93c9-7b508a4a5261"}, {"id": "99e4b30d-fdfc-4627-a8e8-4979e3484cdb", "textEn": "I hafta finish this report by noon.", "textEs": "Tengo que terminar este informe para el mediodía.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "db0a0676-9807-4d60-93c9-7b508a4a5261"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to express sympathy or acknowledgment that a situation is difficult or unfortunate, often in a casual or empathetic tone.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "18a2d483-d9f9-4988-bad7-ff60711efb5a", "textEn": "That's rough, I'm sorry you had to go through that.", "textEs": "Eso es duro, lamento que tuvieras que pasar por eso.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "405a98ff-113a-47be-a710-da4540e95db0"}, {"id": "738e4847-48ea-4e42-b1f2-35cb3756de63", "textEn": "That's rough, but you'll get through it.", "textEs": "Qué mal, pero lo superarás.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "405a98ff-113a-47be-a710-da4540e95db0"}, {"id": "f5c76c34-978a-4d5d-8b2c-ec6031e6c2d1", "textEn": "I heard you lost your job, that's rough, buddy.", "textEs": "Escuché que perdiste tu trabajo, eso es duro, amigo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "405a98ff-113a-47be-a710-da4540e95db0"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in casual speech as a contraction of 'got to', expressing necessity or obligation, e.g., 'I gotta go now.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "b1c2809d-eb4f-44c2-be39-f746a5aac5c0", "textEn": "I gotta go now, see you later.", "textEs": "Tengo que irme ahora, nos vemos luego.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "5a634d8b-2b73-4e2a-9d33-dd77eccd74e8"}, {"id": "138c5b61-35df-4773-8da1-ed494512dac1", "textEn": "You gotta try this pizza, it's amazing.", "textEs": "Tienes que probar esta pizza, es increíble.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "5a634d8b-2b73-4e2a-9d33-dd77eccd74e8"}, {"id": "497abe94-9f2f-4445-9265-768495ad5218", "textEn": "I gotta go to the store before it closes.", "textEs": "Tengo que ir a la tienda antes de que cierre.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "5a634d8b-2b73-4e2a-9d33-dd77eccd74e8"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a young dog, often in an affectionate or cute tone.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "70a17f91-0187-448e-a302-2ec5816ce5af", "textEn": "The puppy is very cute.", "textEs": "El cachorro es muy lindo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "2ff6dec7-8d8a-4004-a9c7-b9114ac961f5"}, {"id": "be901ebb-1435-471d-8b2e-c9dd302b0649", "textEn": "She played with her puppy.", "textEs": "Ella jugó con su cachorro.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "2ff6dec7-8d8a-4004-a9c7-b9114ac961f5"}, {"id": "b03f5cd7-fd89-4670-a5af-66370538f0a8", "textEn": "My new puppy chewed up all my shoes.", "textEs": "Mi nuevo cachorro masticó todos mis zapatos.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "2ff6dec7-8d8a-4004-a9c7-b9114ac961f5"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something or someone as foolish, playful, or lacking seriousness, often in a lighthearted or affectionate way.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "9fbed9aa-bd50-4bdf-9ea7-390882b2db9a", "textEn": "That was a silly joke.", "textEs": "Ese fue un chiste tonto.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "4e85f12c-7191-4888-ad4c-96b32ffef539"}, {"id": "c148f971-2ac5-4a6e-acd0-321b6e355517", "textEn": "Don't be silly, it's safe.", "textEs": "No seas bobo, es seguro.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "4e85f12c-7191-4888-ad4c-96b32ffef539"}, {"id": "55f46ffe-4289-41ea-be44-c042cb342848", "textEn": "Don't be silly, of course I'll help you with your homework.", "textEs": "No seas tonto, por supuesto que te ayudaré con la tarea.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "4e85f12c-7191-4888-ad4c-96b32ffef539"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe a tall structure, often in contexts like 'the Eiffel Tower' or 'a cell phone tower.' In natural speech, it's pronounced with a clear diphthong and a slight r-coloring at the end.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "01104dd2-9158-4dbb-ad70-9f3026dff0c3", "textEn": "The tower is very tall.", "textEs": "La torre es muy alta.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "dfcc8c49-6415-4d40-8807-fff8001787f8"}, {"id": "9e0c8300-82de-4d7d-a2a6-7b39be689886", "textEn": "We can see the tower from here.", "textEs": "Podemos ver la torre desde aquí.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "dfcc8c49-6415-4d40-8807-fff8001787f8"}, {"id": "2cd96746-02ed-4861-9a7d-dcdb7c1ece5f", "textEn": "I can hear the church tower bells ringing from my apartment.", "textEs": "Puedo oír las campanas de la torre de la iglesia sonando desde mi apartamento.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "dfcc8c49-6415-4d40-8807-fff8001787f8"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a verb meaning to plan, estimate, or display something; often stressed on the second syllable in natural speech.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "bcf7a14d-0bf5-4462-a2e0-8e66a905f5bd", "textEn": "They will project the movie onto the wall.", "textEs": "Proyectarán la película en la pared.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "2b95b133-922b-49dc-8db9-51f7f47f6b4b"}, {"id": "29aafd13-7730-4846-bd92-645489fd2c25", "textEn": "She can project her voice across the room.", "textEs": "Ella puede proyectar su voz a través de la sala.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "2b95b133-922b-49dc-8db9-51f7f47f6b4b"}, {"id": "55cb6d32-f49f-4d76-aca4-ff59121344fa", "textEn": "I need to proJECT my voice so everyone in the back can hear me.", "textEs": "Necesito proyectar mi voz para que todos al fondo puedan oírme.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "2b95b133-922b-49dc-8db9-51f7f47f6b4b"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in casual conversation as a quick, informal way to say 'I don't know', often when shrugging or showing uncertainty.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "7ff5ad34-87ac-4fc3-bcb3-feac54d663a8", "textEn": "I dunno where he went.", "textEs": "No sé a dónde fue.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "e0618eaf-1c8e-4d78-9290-3e87e2f06e10"}, {"id": "c335357d-5055-4ad3-8fd9-449eaaa4be00", "textEn": "She dunno how to fix it.", "textEs": "Ella no sabe cómo arreglarlo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "e0618eaf-1c8e-4d78-9290-3e87e2f06e10"}, {"id": "566c2f5a-fe64-4db8-a01b-8255705b9e69", "textEn": "I dunno what to do about it.", "textEs": "No sé qué hacer al respecto.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "e0618eaf-1c8e-4d78-9290-3e87e2f06e10"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in casual speech as a contraction of 'ought to', expressing obligation or expectation, like 'You oughta try it.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "603f6902-f67c-45b0-85bb-4a23d9c22ecb", "textEn": "You oughta call your mom.", "textEs": "Deberías llamar a tu mamá.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "8dca4f9c-db0b-49b3-b2a7-5b417fcc8b11"}, {"id": "b734923d-9ee4-4896-9210-cd11007a22a7", "textEn": "We oughta leave early.", "textEs": "Deberíamos irnos temprano.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "8dca4f9c-db0b-49b3-b2a7-5b417fcc8b11"}, {"id": "14232a7e-677d-45fc-8f29-80851717a0d8", "textEn": "You oughta try this new restaurant downtown.", "textEs": "Deberías probar este nuevo restaurante en el centro.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "8dca4f9c-db0b-49b3-b2a7-5b417fcc8b11"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in casual speech as a contraction of 'trying to', often to express intention or desire, e.g., 'I'm tryna go to the store.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "3991003d-fbf4-45b8-b332-bb227c6d337c", "textEn": "I'm tryna finish this book.", "textEs": "Estoy intentando terminar este libro.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "e3b44de8-edab-4d04-aa43-c86e0742fef0"}, {"id": "ed4e95be-aa86-482b-8e23-79e2fc389f62", "textEn": "What are you tryna do?", "textEs": "¿Qué estás intentando hacer?", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "e3b44de8-edab-4d04-aa43-c86e0742fef0"}, {"id": "6fd2ba9f-385d-417c-9d31-c51e49457b08", "textEn": "I'm tryna finish this report before the deadline.", "textEs": "Estoy intentando terminar este informe antes de la fecha límite.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "e3b44de8-edab-4d04-aa43-c86e0742fef0"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in casual speech as a contraction of 'out of', often in phrases like 'get outta here' or 'outta my way'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "e4cb3b24-ae4f-437a-81ce-d62c3f7a6146", "textEn": "I gotta get outta here.", "textEs": "Tengo que salir de aquí.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "0a99f167-d57b-4131-a134-d9fd545c7fa3"}, {"id": "f70448d9-6605-4a30-b8b6-4cec8a9630cf", "textEn": "He ran outta time.", "textEs": "Se le acabó el tiempo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "0a99f167-d57b-4131-a134-d9fd545c7fa3"}, {"id": "906482be-dfb0-48f7-bdc4-f698bbf90b4b", "textEn": "I'm outta here, this party is too boring.", "textEs": "Me voy de aquí, esta fiesta es demasiado aburrida.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "0a99f167-d57b-4131-a134-d9fd545c7fa3"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a medium-sized sailing or motor boat, often associated with leisure or luxury, as in 'We spent the weekend on a yacht.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "fca69c2f-eb5e-448d-9d4b-1923b013cebe", "textEn": "They sailed their yacht to the island.", "textEs": "Navegaron su yate hasta la isla.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "ad0b04ff-bf80-4105-83de-f7cbedb64148"}, {"id": "0c2f2b8f-62a5-423e-bf24-31a3d635a11f", "textEn": "A white yacht is anchored in the bay.", "textEs": "Un yate blanco está anclado en la bahía.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "ad0b04ff-bf80-4105-83de-f7cbedb64148"}, {"id": "8b78d99b-7f9a-41b3-a5e9-fa42e6311246", "textEn": "We spent the weekend sailing on my friend's yacht.", "textEs": "Pasamos el fin de semana navegando en el yate de mi amigo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "ad0b04ff-bf80-4105-83de-f7cbedb64148"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a casual, fast way to say 'let me', often in requests or offers like 'lemme see' or 'lemme help you'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "c37c7d82-f5e1-4cd6-ac25-0f8d0f473378", "textEn": "Lemme see that.", "textEs": "Déjame ver eso.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "2dcb933b-a154-478f-a000-0a8ef2269a3d"}, {"id": "df2d618d-bfca-40a1-826b-0c5052b9cc8f", "textEn": "Lemme think about it.", "textEs": "Déjame pensar en ello.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "2dcb933b-a154-478f-a000-0a8ef2269a3d"}, {"id": "01b24c6d-4915-492e-99d8-0c89182faf94", "textEn": "Lemme check if I locked the door.", "textEs": "Déjame revisar si cerré la puerta.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "2dcb933b-a154-478f-a000-0a8ef2269a3d"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in casual speech as a contraction of 'got to', indicating necessity or obligation, e.g., 'I gotta go now.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "6182d613-284e-444e-be8f-052f40d0da9c", "textEn": "We gotta finish this today.", "textEs": "Tenemos que terminar esto hoy.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "4cdae4ad-e75e-42c5-990c-69d518b327c4"}, {"id": "71e87096-dbbd-4507-8512-a6b486531c70", "textEn": "I gotta go now.", "textEs": "Me tengo que ir ahora.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "4cdae4ad-e75e-42c5-990c-69d518b327c4"}, {"id": "d398be55-738a-4cb8-88e5-b6475608eb81", "textEn": "I gotta go now, or I'll miss the bus.", "textEs": "Tengo que irme ahora, o perderé el autobús.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "4cdae4ad-e75e-42c5-990c-69d518b327c4"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a device for opening locks, a crucial element, or a button on a keyboard; often stressed in sentences like 'the key to success'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "2b7a8c1b-dcd1-4c2b-9f0b-8b43bb685ec2", "textEn": "I lost my key this morning.", "textEs": "Perdí mi llave esta mañana.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "5813bf7f-0751-4383-82bb-ed1a85945c73"}, {"id": "0503a19a-5104-4853-86f9-bdd47f99dc6f", "textEn": "She used the key to open the door.", "textEs": "Ella usó la llave para abrir la puerta.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "5813bf7f-0751-4383-82bb-ed1a85945c73"}, {"id": "c3b49698-1bac-41a3-ac8d-3ca0d1b15e5f", "textEn": "The key to success is consistency.", "textEs": "La clave del éxito es la constancia.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "5813bf7f-0751-4383-82bb-ed1a85945c73"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally in casual conversation to mean 'want to', often expressing desire or intention, like 'I wanna go home'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "4061c693-9c48-4a23-9af8-f2fb4846ae31", "textEn": "Do you wanna come with us?", "textEs": "¿Quieres venir con nosotros?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "149d638f-df2d-499b-a6a2-216ccc19fc1b"}, {"id": "0584087d-a84a-48ef-98ab-6bf01ff04a7d", "textEn": "I wanna learn Spanish.", "textEs": "Quiero aprender español.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "149d638f-df2d-499b-a6a2-216ccc19fc1b"}, {"id": "7b5784b9-5dcc-4bd3-908c-3c83da6a1fe9", "textEn": "I wanna go to the beach this weekend.", "textEs": "Quiero ir a la playa este fin de semana.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "149d638f-df2d-499b-a6a2-216ccc19fc1b"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the scientific study of the mind and behavior, often in academic or casual contexts like discussing mental health or human actions.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "61c81c21-038f-4d9d-8f35-73389f24da7d", "textEn": "She studies psychology at university.", "textEs": "Ella estudia psicología en la universidad.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "f633d81e-6564-4734-b15f-8bccc78e6eeb"}, {"id": "57af47ac-adc6-4dff-9f1e-bab9c45c4071", "textEn": "Psychology helps understand behavior.", "textEs": "La psicología ayuda a entender el comportamiento.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "f633d81e-6564-4734-b15f-8bccc78e6eeb"}, {"id": "a449b86b-1330-4f27-8e29-c542f6f9c486", "textEn": "I took a psychology course in college to understand human behavior better.", "textEs": "Tomé un curso de psicología en la universidad para entender mejor el comportamiento humano.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "f633d81e-6564-4734-b15f-8bccc78e6eeb"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to indicate the reason or cause of something, often in formal or written contexts, but also common in casual speech.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "9c60c403-c975-4b54-88e2-9a08242b012a", "textEn": "The flight was canceled due to bad weather.", "textEs": "El vuelo fue cancelado debido al mal tiempo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "b76f61b7-d63e-478b-92a3-d737210d1581"}, {"id": "79611c13-df42-4c68-b2df-b0c5a4101248", "textEn": "Due to his hard work, he got promoted.", "textEs": "Debido a su arduo trabajo, fue ascendido.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "b76f61b7-d63e-478b-92a3-d737210d1581"}, {"id": "d35b88ee-149b-406a-ba17-ccce5aa199d6", "textEn": "The flight was delayed due to bad weather.", "textEs": "El vuelo se retrasó debido al mal tiempo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "b76f61b7-d63e-478b-92a3-d737210d1581"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a casual, friendly contraction of 'bet you', often in informal conversation to express agreement, challenge, or certainty.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "88dac291-4fb8-43f5-ba97-ba833b874b0b", "textEn": "Betcha can't finish that pizza.", "textEs": "Apuesto a que no puedes terminar esa pizza.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "4593c546-9dc6-4343-b8a9-7f79203aaf1c"}, {"id": "bcf1a62e-ff36-471d-97a3-7c2437e87fb3", "textEn": "I betcha he's late again.", "textEs": "Apuesto a que llega tarde otra vez.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "4593c546-9dc6-4343-b8a9-7f79203aaf1c"}, {"id": "726e75d3-2b60-476d-87c1-c265f88f0d1a", "textEn": "Betcha didn't know I could do that.", "textEs": "Apuesto a que no sabías que podía hacer eso.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "4593c546-9dc6-4343-b8a9-7f79203aaf1c"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a casual contraction of 'can you' in questions, often in fast or informal speech, like 'Canya help me?'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "7323c11b-475c-41bb-b554-b30c528d99b9", "textEn": "Canya open this jar for me?", "textEs": "¿Puedes abrir este frasco para mí?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "fa7eebe3-45df-47d9-9158-a6141853a9dc"}, {"id": "1ba4e519-203f-41fd-8eb2-a90790c769a9", "textEn": "Canya believe it?", "textEs": "¿Puedes creerlo?", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "fa7eebe3-45df-47d9-9158-a6141853a9dc"}, {"id": "14375087-a735-4241-8051-b5182aa6346e", "textEn": "I can do it if I try.", "textEs": "Puedo hacerlo si lo intento.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "fa7eebe3-45df-47d9-9158-a6141853a9dc"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to mean collect something or someone, or to learn something informally, often with a casual tone.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "bdba7703-0d84-4c5d-aa6f-314f44ab7963", "textEn": "I'll pick you up at 8.", "textEs": "Te recogeré a las 8.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "3ab2d353-ea4f-40c1-b395-4d2874a59b62"}, {"id": "13c11891-ead7-405e-a720-f3644cba32be", "textEn": "She picked up Spanish quickly.", "textEs": "Ella aprendió español rápidamente.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "3ab2d353-ea4f-40c1-b395-4d2874a59b62"}, {"id": "75e7ac17-788d-4d26-a21b-a3356ee9b94f", "textEn": "Things are picking up at work.", "textEs": "Las cosas están mejorando en el trabajo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "3ab2d353-ea4f-40c1-b395-4d2874a59b62"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a farm vehicle for pulling equipment, often said with a clear 't' sound at the start.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "730743a6-1b73-4e8a-b9b0-4a313dc703fa", "textEn": "The farmer drives a tractor.", "textEs": "El granjero conduce un tractor.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "3aa70a4b-fac5-476a-838f-1a4fb02a738e"}, {"id": "0e14b4ed-d2a0-4c8b-972b-b253282cc0b1", "textEn": "The tractor is in the field.", "textEs": "El tractor está en el campo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "3aa70a4b-fac5-476a-838f-1a4fb02a738e"}, {"id": "62eb6fef-36a2-4cb1-9e2c-e23891a1805e", "textEn": "The old tractor sputtered to life after sitting in the barn all winter.", "textEs": "El viejo tractor cobró vida después de estar en el granero todo el invierno.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "3aa70a4b-fac5-476a-838f-1a4fb02a738e"}]

flashcards.meaning: esto lleva a / esto conduce a
flashcards.native_speech: Used to introduce a result or consequence, often in explanations or arguments, with a slight pause after 'this' for emphasis.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "5b824f78-9ba0-4a6f-8053-8bb2ab12861c", "textEn": "Poor time management this leads to stress.", "textEs": "La mala gestión del tiempo lleva al estrés.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "236fa156-29c6-4ef7-9d0c-b4f5f65f9e0b"}, {"id": "ff3e681c-3835-413d-b788-15397d14ec08", "textEn": "Regular exercise this leads to better health.", "textEs": "El ejercicio regular conduce a una mejor salud.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "236fa156-29c6-4ef7-9d0c-b4f5f65f9e0b"}, {"id": "de220597-cec1-4a52-80b6-042f06196703", "textEn": "Poor time management this leads to missed deadlines and increased stress.", "textEs": "La mala gestión del tiempo lleva a incumplir plazos y a un mayor estrés.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "236fa156-29c6-4ef7-9d0c-b4f5f65f9e0b"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a casual, fast pronunciation of 'what are you' or 'what do you', often in greetings like 'Whatcha doing?'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "ee70256c-9085-4718-a8b9-60324f1ee81e", "textEn": "Whatcha doing later?", "textEs": "¿Qué haces más tarde?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "e4654295-2c45-4e14-a728-6250e2f0f494"}, {"id": "ec30cdda-48cf-473d-b919-b77013561a61", "textEn": "Whatcha think about this plan?", "textEs": "¿Qué piensas de este plan?", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "e4654295-2c45-4e14-a728-6250e2f0f494"}, {"id": "85bd3c19-4f97-455e-8f9c-51fb16cac527", "textEn": "Whatcha doing later?", "textEs": "¿Qué haces más tarde?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "e4654295-2c45-4e14-a728-6250e2f0f494"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to express strong certainty or agreement, often as a quick, emphatic response in conversation.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "c6eb34bf-2886-43b3-85f5-a70b227e5366", "textEn": "No doubt, that was the best movie this year.", "textEs": "Sin duda, esa fue la mejor película del año.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "86365852-a53c-4c21-8379-897df0560343"}, {"id": "33b9b884-680e-4292-b070-c83eda64ab0f", "textEn": "No doubt, I'll be there on time.", "textEs": "Claro que sí, estaré allí a tiempo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "86365852-a53c-4c21-8379-897df0560343"}, {"id": "849c7cd3-5b79-4502-9c9c-e14ae3e85f9e", "textEn": "No doubt, she's the best candidate for the job.", "textEs": "Sin duda, ella es la mejor candidata para el puesto.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "86365852-a53c-4c21-8379-897df0560343"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to express willingness or agreement to participate in an activity, often casually in response to a suggestion or invitation.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "e7bcdca7-6e96-47d7-ad83-42b5483e00fe", "textEn": "I'm down to grab some pizza later.", "textEs": "Me apunto a comer pizza más tarde.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "7a2666fe-5c4e-4774-917b-7e1b1da32da3"}, {"id": "ceea96c4-24f9-4432-ba81-6a08b6605800", "textEn": "I'm down for a hike this weekend.", "textEs": "Estoy de acuerdo para una caminata este fin de semana.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "7a2666fe-5c4e-4774-917b-7e1b1da32da3"}, {"id": "5f2bd732-52d1-438a-92a0-514557f40721", "textEn": "I'm down to grab some pizza after work if you are.", "textEs": "Estoy dispuesto a ir por una pizza después del trabajo si tú también.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "7a2666fe-5c4e-4774-917b-7e1b1da32da3"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe a flower opening up or a person's healthy, vibrant appearance; also common in phrases like 'in full bloom' for peak condition or beauty.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "da9a1496-697c-4e76-a340-0b1716cdc907", "textEn": "The roses bloom in spring.", "textEs": "Las rosas florecen en primavera.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "2d6e3419-203f-4274-be50-7a6b8aa1ccb8"}, {"id": "ac5cea5f-6939-4f44-9998-c2d44dfcf1d2", "textEn": "The garden is in full bloom.", "textEs": "El jardín está en plena floración.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "2d6e3419-203f-4274-be50-7a6b8aa1ccb8"}, {"id": "ce5b4412-36c6-4a96-a69e-f96a912deb3e", "textEn": "The flowers will bloom in early spring this year.", "textEs": "Las flores florecerán a principios de primavera este año.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "2d6e3419-203f-4274-be50-7a6b8aa1ccb8"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally to mean 'give me', often in casual or fast speech, like asking for something quickly.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "05624fa0-4c02-4d55-96ae-17122df8b95d", "textEn": "Gimme a minute.", "textEs": "Dame un minuto.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "3d17685d-9d40-48be-8a06-a44d3509512e"}, {"id": "fe3c0a22-3b64-4192-908a-b48a5570b3bb", "textEn": "Gimme the keys.", "textEs": "Dame las llaves.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "3d17685d-9d40-48be-8a06-a44d3509512e"}, {"id": "653e4d6d-8a89-4025-a125-ff499b9748fa", "textEn": "Gimme that book, please.", "textEs": "Dame ese libro, por favor.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "3d17685d-9d40-48be-8a06-a44d3509512e"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to indicate the direction opposite south, often in navigation or describing locations.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "68272e30-fab3-4b57-9b90-9de4df231a92", "textEn": "The wind is coming from the north.", "textEs": "El viento viene del norte.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "c7feab13-a7b0-4e51-979d-14f413a53ad5"}, {"id": "1b267ce4-d3e0-4ed8-bbd7-77b077c70644", "textEn": "They traveled north for the summer.", "textEs": "Viajaron al norte para el verano.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "c7feab13-a7b0-4e51-979d-14f413a53ad5"}, {"id": "c35e0134-30ee-4e50-a52d-b5571fa1a217", "textEn": "The wind is blowing north today.", "textEs": "El viento está soplando hacia el norte hoy.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "c7feab13-a7b0-4e51-979d-14f413a53ad5"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in casual, fast speech as a contraction of 'have to', indicating obligation or necessity.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "9fa7e101-2d37-4749-bd9c-9fcd9e0345f0", "textEn": "I hafta work late tonight.", "textEs": "Tengo que trabajar hasta tarde esta noche.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "b9c15cf8-879c-43b2-b289-38909a287075"}, {"id": "9270ce7a-6e9a-4e72-be38-6cb707de05b6", "textEn": "She hafta study for the exam.", "textEs": "Ella tiene que estudiar para el examen.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "b9c15cf8-879c-43b2-b289-38909a287075"}, {"id": "f145e891-d754-4e82-9c2f-e9b54f8b910b", "textEn": "I hafta finish this report by noon.", "textEs": "Tengo que terminar este informe para el mediodía.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "b9c15cf8-879c-43b2-b289-38909a287075"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to explain purpose or result, often reduced in fast speech to 'so 'at' or 's'that'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "bcbd85a1-611d-4895-9f7e-b3b581abd5f5", "textEn": "I left early so that I wouldn't miss the bus.", "textEs": "Salí temprano para no perder el autobús.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "5a46f7ed-d307-4209-b846-fc140c347592"}, {"id": "7cc40bb2-87a1-4fa4-844c-da5de0e9fcda", "textEn": "She saved money so that she could travel.", "textEs": "Ahorró dinero para poder viajar.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "5a46f7ed-d307-4209-b846-fc140c347592"}, {"id": "3aea49c1-fbeb-4acc-abba-590b214b703a", "textEn": "I woke up early so that I wouldn't miss the bus.", "textEs": "Me desperté temprano para no perder el autobús.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "5a46f7ed-d307-4209-b846-fc140c347592"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe a pale red color, often associated with flowers, candy, or feminine themes; also used informally to mean 'in good health' (e.g., 'in the pink').
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "fb424559-8b82-4f1d-b419-50cb4e3cc23b", "textEn": "She wore a pink dress.", "textEs": "Ella llevaba un vestido rosa.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "ed5e1969-a29f-4ae2-997a-87ff8d929a37"}, {"id": "283b076d-e38e-4acd-a992-3fd66d4cdc36", "textEn": "The flower is pink.", "textEs": "La flor es rosa.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "ed5e1969-a29f-4ae2-997a-87ff8d929a37"}, {"id": "0cb81d6e-7fde-4f94-9c3a-75eaf4104f93", "textEn": "The engine is running pink, so we need to check the timing.", "textEs": "El motor está cascabeleando, así que necesitamos revisar el tiempo de encendido.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "ed5e1969-a29f-4ae2-997a-87ff8d929a37"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe an underground passage, often in contexts of travel, construction, or metaphorical situations like 'light at the end of the tunnel'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "cd36231e-1372-4928-ade1-3768169f6619", "textEn": "The train goes through a tunnel.", "textEs": "El tren pasa por un túnel.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "4f515704-35fc-4a16-87cb-062ca44109f4"}, {"id": "d72fe20a-c6ef-4ae7-93bf-4c78c816f118", "textEn": "They built a tunnel under the river.", "textEs": "Construyeron un túnel debajo del río.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "4f515704-35fc-4a16-87cb-062ca44109f4"}, {"id": "ce6a39d2-6493-46f7-8845-f6ee2bc5093f", "textEn": "The train went through a dark tunnel and then came out into the sunlight.", "textEs": "El tren pasó por un túnel oscuro y luego salió a la luz del sol.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "4f515704-35fc-4a16-87cb-062ca44109f4"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe a sharp, burning pain or a harsh criticism, often in casual conversation about physical sensations or verbal attacks.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "19a31b3d-67d2-4e4b-aae9-faaa8f712099", "textEn": "The bee was stinging the flower repeatedly.", "textEs": "La abeja estaba picando la flor repetidamente.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "0dd3b45c-48f5-41bb-a21b-7071617b0e80"}, {"id": "ac0a93f8-f522-43bf-94a3-b92f620e83f2", "textEn": "His words left a stinging sensation in her heart.", "textEs": "Sus palabras dejaron una sensación punzante en su corazón.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "0dd3b45c-48f5-41bb-a21b-7071617b0e80"}, {"id": "bb961f10-7ca6-4030-813c-6a5a8e95c231", "textEn": "The cold wind was stinging my cheeks as I walked to work.", "textEs": "El viento frío me picaba las mejillas mientras caminaba al trabajo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "0dd3b45c-48f5-41bb-a21b-7071617b0e80"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to mean examining something in great detail, often in business or technical contexts, like analyzing data or a problem deeply.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "dda5e1b1-1bfc-473d-9c2c-b2a70208f0fd", "textEn": "Let's drill down into the budget details.", "textEs": "Profundicemos en los detalles del presupuesto.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "0c74e491-5481-423f-a7a2-4b30534d196f"}, {"id": "d99ccc5a-b477-450d-b380-13678299f828", "textEn": "We need to drill down into the root cause.", "textEs": "Necesitamos profundizar en la causa raíz.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "0c74e491-5481-423f-a7a2-4b30534d196f"}, {"id": "f10a3471-006f-4672-91ac-ace53918fed2", "textEn": "We need to drill down into the sales data to understand why revenue dropped last quarter.", "textEs": "Necesitamos profundizar en los datos de ventas para entender por qué los ingresos cayeron el trimestre pasado.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "0c74e491-5481-423f-a7a2-4b30534d196f"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something that is the right size or shape, or to indicate suitability, as in 'This dress fits perfectly' or 'He’s fit for the job.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "d9a3d4a2-21e0-445c-a3d2-487d8b10d0d4", "textEn": "This key doesn't fit the lock.", "textEs": "Esta llave no encaja en la cerradura.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "42c9ae3b-2bae-4b4f-bfdd-d58eb144736c"}, {"id": "6e65245c-0075-40a9-8218-efdb3536e39f", "textEn": "The dress fits her perfectly.", "textEs": "El vestido le queda perfectamente.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "42c9ae3b-2bae-4b4f-bfdd-d58eb144736c"}, {"id": "7a627436-c9e8-411e-b30d-7b9dac45a6b5", "textEn": "This song is so catchy, it really fits the mood right now.", "textEs": "Esta canción es tan pegadiza, realmente encaja con el ambiente de ahora.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "42c9ae3b-2bae-4b4f-bfdd-d58eb144736c"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe shouting loudly, often in anger, excitement, or to get someone's attention from a distance.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "f76ccdf9-7813-4f26-a2f0-1219ce7604d2", "textEn": "Don't yell at me.", "textEs": "No me grites.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "933b0b4f-cbed-4ec1-8e47-e688b324f90a"}, {"id": "a462809e-7659-4349-a7b5-50164c78f721", "textEn": "The fans yell loudly at the game.", "textEs": "Los aficionados gritan fuerte en el partido.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "933b0b4f-cbed-4ec1-8e47-e688b324f90a"}, {"id": "2b814076-fb81-4f3d-b3b4-096b24a8a9eb", "textEn": "The kids started to yell when they saw the ice cream truck coming down the street.", "textEs": "Los niños empezaron a gritar cuando vieron el camión de helados venir por la calle.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "933b0b4f-cbed-4ec1-8e47-e688b324f90a"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something going below the surface of a liquid, or metaphorically for failing or declining.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "e4c8df79-e03e-4d8f-b8f1-5e98654805d4", "textEn": "Please wash your hands in the sink.", "textEs": "Por favor, lávate las manos en el lavabo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "a4ebe2cf-f1ee-497e-aa6d-3647ae07efe1"}, {"id": "51e1beb7-a44c-455b-9a53-32dfc2e41703", "textEn": "The sink is full of dirty dishes.", "textEs": "El fregadero está lleno de platos sucios.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "a4ebe2cf-f1ee-497e-aa6d-3647ae07efe1"}, {"id": "8ad2ac5b-66ba-42b4-9411-0cb21426dfd7", "textEn": "I heard the sink drip all night long.", "textEs": "Escuché el grifo del fregadero gotear toda la noche.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "a4ebe2cf-f1ee-497e-aa6d-3647ae07efe1"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a noun for a curved tool or as a verb meaning to catch or attach something, often in casual contexts like 'hook me up' or 'get off the hook'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "ffa17b42-5ff9-401d-9195-105df4a02bd5", "textEn": "Hang your coat on the hook.", "textEs": "Cuelga tu abrigo en el gancho.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "cd585276-fc06-42ed-bcb0-7acd1f04681d"}, {"id": "f1376e96-fe31-4de1-944c-2eb94fc15122", "textEn": "The fish got caught on the hook.", "textEs": "El pez quedó atrapado en el anzuelo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "cd585276-fc06-42ed-bcb0-7acd1f04681d"}, {"id": "743ecf9a-7397-4f1e-a07d-f0e3dd08e936", "textEn": "The clock on the wall went tick-tock all night.", "textEs": "El reloj en la pared hizo tictac toda la noche.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "cd585276-fc06-42ed-bcb0-7acd1f04681d"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something solid, unyielding, or a company; often said with a steady tone to emphasize certainty or resolve.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "f75bb24a-6594-40b5-88af-57cb79c45be8", "textEn": "She gave a firm handshake.", "textEs": "Ella dio un apretón de manos firme.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "02a36e07-1f10-4cdd-b231-afbb7efe10a5"}, {"id": "f7987641-9efe-49c4-86ea-1a7e5beac80d", "textEn": "The ground is firm enough to walk on.", "textEs": "El suelo está lo suficientemente firme para caminar.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "02a36e07-1f10-4cdd-b231-afbb7efe10a5"}, {"id": "eb944299-e589-4cc8-a965-4ce01541e505", "textEn": "The ground felt firm under my feet after the rain stopped.", "textEs": "El suelo se sentía firme bajo mis pies después de que dejó de llover.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "02a36e07-1f10-4cdd-b231-afbb7efe10a5"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a noun for an eating utensil, or as a verb meaning to cuddle closely, often in a romantic context.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "c09af5be-4d5d-4734-9962-168f6f170bfb", "textEn": "Pass me the spoon, please.", "textEs": "Pásame la cuchara, por favor.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "d1fbfdc7-ef36-45d9-8a41-ae2da5e365d6"}, {"id": "504a692a-6688-40b7-9527-79ee0696c12b", "textEn": "The spoon is on the table.", "textEs": "La cuchara está en la mesa.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "d1fbfdc7-ef36-45d9-8a41-ae2da5e365d6"}, {"id": "c586c1a8-c5d3-41b6-9b23-5ed50edb6645", "textEn": "The metal spoon clinked against the ceramic bowl as she stirred her coffee.", "textEs": "La cuchara de metal tintineó contra el tazón de cerámica mientras revolvía su café.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "d1fbfdc7-ef36-45d9-8a41-ae2da5e365d6"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to introduce a term or phrase that might be unusual or metaphorical, often as a polite way to suggest an alternative description.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "d48d77bf-1951-4fe7-9efa-c1cde97df2c9", "textEn": "It's a kind of magic, if you will.", "textEs": "Es una especie de magia, por así decirlo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "cdc3b753-f6ac-4484-ac2e-564905465d93"}, {"id": "87e35ef7-74ef-4e19-8a27-562e4e23cb3a", "textEn": "He's a genius, if you will.", "textEs": "Es un genio, por así decirlo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "cdc3b753-f6ac-4484-ac2e-564905465d93"}, {"id": "becc5ebc-d561-43d3-b1b3-50e4be7ea0c3", "textEn": "He was, if you will, a modern-day philosopher.", "textEs": "Él era, si se quiere, un filósofo moderno.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "cdc3b753-f6ac-4484-ac2e-564905465d93"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to indicate selecting or picking one option from a set, often in everyday decisions like 'choose a color' or 'choose wisely'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "596aa489-255c-4bb8-8133-3bba49c19f67", "textEn": "You can choose any color you like.", "textEs": "Puedes elegir cualquier color que te guste.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "b88b982b-90d5-4b11-9032-c991ccee8e9c"}, {"id": "25f4178d-8fdd-484c-8a19-226f3de499eb", "textEn": "She had to choose between two jobs.", "textEs": "Ella tuvo que elegir entre dos trabajos.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "b88b982b-90d5-4b11-9032-c991ccee8e9c"}, {"id": "5c6ef53e-8a94-42c1-98f4-33dc04c876ab", "textEn": "I need to choose a new phone plan that fits my budget.", "textEs": "Necesito elegir un nuevo plan de teléfono que se ajuste a mi presupuesto.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "b88b982b-90d5-4b11-9032-c991ccee8e9c"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in casual speech as a contraction of 'would have,' often in past hypotheticals like 'I woulda gone if I'd known.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "7e503334-7478-4152-a3fd-de0dafee89d7", "textEn": "He woulda helped if he could.", "textEs": "Él habría ayudado si hubiera podido.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "9b81ca92-8d3f-434f-82a5-9e777b2e9830"}, {"id": "147c5213-3fc6-4dc6-a646-0ce834df6de8", "textEn": "I woulda gone, but I was sick.", "textEs": "Habría ido, pero estaba enfermo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "9b81ca92-8d3f-434f-82a5-9e777b2e9830"}, {"id": "00a56a1e-516c-40f8-9c45-5783d5009f64", "textEn": "I woulda come to the party if I had known about it.", "textEs": "Habría ido a la fiesta si hubiera sabido de ella.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "9b81ca92-8d3f-434f-82a5-9e777b2e9830"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a specific detail, idea, or location; often in phrases like 'good point' or 'point of view'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "6b020642-c0ac-4e9a-9f75-5dd8762532b0", "textEn": "She made a good point during the meeting.", "textEs": "Ella hizo un buen punto durante la reunión.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "3a330c0c-ab51-4b09-aef3-9750a468ac63"}, {"id": "338eed7c-4a37-4e50-be63-d574ece7e911", "textEn": "Please point to the map where we are.", "textEs": "Por favor, señala en el mapa dónde estamos.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "3a330c0c-ab51-4b09-aef3-9750a468ac63"}, {"id": "e77c5dd5-cbda-4bf7-b804-f2ed2324449c", "textEn": "That's a good point, I hadn't considered that.", "textEs": "Ese es un buen punto, no lo había considerado.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "3a330c0c-ab51-4b09-aef3-9750a468ac63"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally to mean 'excellent' or 'very good,' often in music or parties, e.g., 'That song is banging.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "00056a21-9f58-4641-9151-0b036f874ea7", "textEn": "Someone was banging on the door loudly.", "textEs": "Alguien estaba golpeando la puerta fuertemente.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "ae129f4e-2caa-4bf2-90c0-c83eedf79230"}, {"id": "16ce7ab3-2f1c-407f-8846-b1de63af7507", "textEn": "The kids were banging pots and pans together.", "textEs": "Los niños estaban golpeando ollas y sartenes juntos.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "ae129f4e-2caa-4bf2-90c0-c83eedf79230"}, {"id": "e9cf2bb2-519f-4595-bbae-5170c6dc5501", "textEn": "That party last night was banging, the music was incredible.", "textEs": "Esa fiesta de anoche estuvo brutal, la música era increíble.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "ae129f4e-2caa-4bf2-90c0-c83eedf79230"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to suggest or confirm a plan to get together in person, often with emphasis on 'meet' to highlight the action.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "36acddd0-acf8-4ff4-8cb6-5d3ba17fcdf7", "textEn": "We can meet at the coffee shop tomorrow.", "textEs": "Podemos reunirnos en la cafetería mañana.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "05da46b5-34fc-4209-8e26-ae8535c4f723"}, {"id": "ea5a3ebc-d39c-49b4-b157-ec0dc090926f", "textEn": "Let me know when we can meet.", "textEs": "Dime cuándo podemos reunirnos.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "05da46b5-34fc-4209-8e26-ae8535c4f723"}, {"id": "a01094e5-58c2-4094-bb0f-769687b1737f", "textEn": "We can meet at the coffee shop tomorrow.", "textEs": "Podemos encontrarnos en la cafetería mañana.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "05da46b5-34fc-4209-8e26-ae8535c4f723"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the upper part of the body, or metaphorically for a leader or the top of something; common in everyday speech.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "15e393df-1ad0-44c8-adcc-8c5583303ba0", "textEn": "She hit her head on the low shelf.", "textEs": "Se golpeó la cabeza contra el estante bajo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "61344340-a781-4544-8994-27c2dad08ef2"}, {"id": "940f1c3c-3ea6-4c6c-9e59-4daba524e3ff", "textEn": "Use your head to solve this puzzle.", "textEs": "Usa tu cabeza para resolver este rompecabezas.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "61344340-a781-4544-8994-27c2dad08ef2"}, {"id": "72524c84-8ea6-43fc-a5f4-941907031d98", "textEn": "The word 'head' sounds like 'hed' in most dialects.", "textEs": "La palabra 'head' suena como 'hed' en la mayoría de los dialectos.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "61344340-a781-4544-8994-27c2dad08ef2"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something limited in width, or figuratively to mean restricted or not broad in scope, often in contexts like 'a narrow path' or 'a narrow view'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "7df950c8-4673-4f58-aae9-26007376546b", "textEn": "The street is very narrow.", "textEs": "La calle es muy estrecha.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "ae6d9c40-f01c-435b-9a1a-ff0588de1a25"}, {"id": "a1a72959-fb43-4f99-aa8f-a70a20d6791b", "textEn": "He walked through the narrow path.", "textEs": "Él caminó por el sendero estrecho.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "ae6d9c40-f01c-435b-9a1a-ff0588de1a25"}, {"id": "635e19af-0151-4eb3-836a-0e8f43d4ec63", "textEn": "Her voice was so narrow and thin that I could barely hear her.", "textEs": "Su voz era tan estrecha y fina que apenas podía oírla.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "ae6d9c40-f01c-435b-9a1a-ff0588de1a25"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to mean dividing or giving a portion of something, or to talk about something in common, like 'share a story' or 'share your food'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "d2dc9d13-f921-449f-ba19-0e74b09d1e6e", "textEn": "Can you share your snack with me?", "textEs": "¿Puedes compartir tu merienda conmigo?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "d23a06b0-611f-484a-9895-c63de224ba8f"}, {"id": "8e0587bc-d778-40f8-a5db-ad99fddce361", "textEn": "They share a love for music.", "textEs": "Ellos comparten un amor por la música.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "d23a06b0-611f-484a-9895-c63de224ba8f"}, {"id": "3e5f702d-9eac-4a79-887c-80affeb9f388", "textEn": "Can you share your notes with me after the meeting?", "textEs": "¿Puedes compartir tus notas conmigo después de la reunión?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "d23a06b0-611f-484a-9895-c63de224ba8f"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to express a possibility or uncertainty about someone's arrival, often with a slight pause or emphasis on 'come' to indicate the action is the focus.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "dadf10cb-1a0b-420f-b695-9fc06072455c", "textEn": "They might come if the weather is nice.", "textEs": "Podrían venir si el clima está bien.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "a3f45742-ecee-4c11-8369-657ad1f58d17"}, {"id": "cd12432a-f6b1-4a10-938d-2457890cf809", "textEn": "I think they might come late.", "textEs": "Creo que podrían llegar tarde.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "a3f45742-ecee-4c11-8369-657ad1f58d17"}, {"id": "e779ae28-911c-4478-ae9a-6de21e74887c", "textEn": "They might come to the party if they finish work early.", "textEs": "Ellos podrían venir a la fiesta si terminan el trabajo temprano.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "a3f45742-ecee-4c11-8369-657ad1f58d17"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in driving contexts to mean letting others go first, or in farming to mean produce; also common in finance for return on investment.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "973fef14-8abc-4249-9d1d-9de65447c3e9", "textEn": "You must yield at the stop sign.", "textEs": "Debes ceder el paso en la señal de alto.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "9f80c2a9-7b3c-4d2e-a6f3-ed30ff7c04b0"}, {"id": "767efcd4-ad6e-4337-9564-7325b741f1d7", "textEn": "The farm had a good yield this year.", "textEs": "La granja tuvo un buen rendimiento este año.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "9f80c2a9-7b3c-4d2e-a6f3-ed30ff7c04b0"}, {"id": "dc9c0658-285c-401e-aa5c-cddb33e68796", "textEn": "The car finally yielded to the traffic on the main road.", "textEs": "El automóvil finalmente cedió el paso al tráfico en la carretera principal.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "9f80c2a9-7b3c-4d2e-a6f3-ed30ff7c04b0"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe a mountain with a vent that erupts lava, ash, and gases, often in scientific or travel contexts.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "484d444a-72ef-41e1-834e-84f314973a6a", "textEn": "The volcano erupted last night.", "textEs": "El volcán entró en erupción anoche.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "376a8d36-d383-4d9f-80d2-8218fbf12d9a"}, {"id": "d90fcb00-23cd-4ead-b0ee-578bb0577bef", "textEn": "We hiked near an active volcano.", "textEs": "Caminamos cerca de un volcán activo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "376a8d36-d383-4d9f-80d2-8218fbf12d9a"}, {"id": "bc52d9c8-6e62-4e7d-9ad3-779db5d051e2", "textEn": "The volcano erupted with a deafening roar, shaking the entire island.", "textEs": "El volcán entró en erupción con un rugido ensordecedor, sacudiendo toda la isla.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "376a8d36-d383-4d9f-80d2-8218fbf12d9a"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe the quality of being strikingly clear or intense, often in memories, descriptions, or colors.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "0fb3b9cd-7db2-4b05-ad09-796a48c0dcc1", "textEn": "The vividness of the dream surprised me.", "textEs": "La vividez del sueño me sorprendió.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "e197a00e-5e14-40a4-9633-ddc7ba40744f"}, {"id": "7ca5e754-ed78-4490-aa9b-af5f60989922", "textEn": "Her storytelling has a special vividness.", "textEs": "Su narración tiene una vividez especial.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "e197a00e-5e14-40a4-9633-ddc7ba40744f"}, {"id": "caf5ccab-d9e6-4cce-8bf1-a2dcd3f3a4fd", "textEn": "The vividness of her description made me feel like I was actually there.", "textEs": "La viveza de su descripción me hizo sentir como si realmente estuviera allí.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "e197a00e-5e14-40a4-9633-ddc7ba40744f"}]

flashcards.meaning: A mí me lo dices, dime a mí
flashcards.native_speech: Used to strongly agree with someone, often when they state something obvious or frustrating, like 'This is so hard' — 'You're telling me!'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "7fca2c87-5704-4649-bbeb-c82ac4b0d871", "textEn": "You're telling me, the traffic was awful.", "textEs": "A mí me lo dices, el tráfico fue horrible.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "3e6fcee0-a207-43b2-bdbb-c824629aebe0"}, {"id": "e6dff490-fce9-49f5-942a-79aa36ece48e", "textEn": "You're telling me, I've been waiting for hours.", "textEs": "Dime a mí, he estado esperando horas.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "3e6fcee0-a207-43b2-bdbb-c824629aebe0"}, {"id": "b6e6f415-f77e-47a7-8a31-5918348ffb9b", "textEn": "You're telling me this project is difficult? I've been working on it for months.", "textEs": "¿Me estás diciendo que este proyecto es difícil? He estado trabajando en él durante meses.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "3e6fcee0-a207-43b2-bdbb-c824629aebe0"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to express a possibility or willingness to leave or start an action, often with emphasis on 'go' to show readiness or determination.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "a941260f-7610-4c88-b77d-d7505b1accbc", "textEn": "I could go to the party if I finish early.", "textEs": "Podría ir a la fiesta si termino temprano.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "b3672531-f303-45cb-90c1-c3f3aa92692e"}, {"id": "584b5010-73ef-480c-8dc5-19a895f279ce", "textEn": "Maybe I could go with you.", "textEs": "Quizás podría ir contigo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "b3672531-f303-45cb-90c1-c3f3aa92692e"}, {"id": "c67b9d0c-9234-4f77-b1d7-00df75792edd", "textEn": "I could go to the store if you need anything.", "textEs": "Podría ir a la tienda si necesitas algo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "b3672531-f303-45cb-90c1-c3f3aa92692e"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Emphasizing 'work' to stress obligation or necessity, often used when someone must do a task despite reluctance.
