flashcards.examples: [{"id": "e2f1b109-b30b-4619-8d57-1ac40b4a5af5", "textEn": "He has to work on the project all weekend.", "textEs": "Él tiene que trabajar en el proyecto todo el fin de semana.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "eff8128a-db9a-4c23-a60b-8a726b4a4878"}, {"id": "f0062126-c31e-44ea-a9b9-76d4bc2f98bc", "textEn": "She told me he has to work overtime.", "textEs": "Ella me dijo que él tiene que trabajar horas extra.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "eff8128a-db9a-4c23-a60b-8a726b4a4878"}, {"id": "d1fe7b94-ae4d-456b-9fa4-7463b3c87b0b", "textEn": "He has to work late tonight to finish the report.", "textEs": "Él tiene que trabajar hasta tarde esta noche para terminar el informe.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "eff8128a-db9a-4c23-a60b-8a726b4a4878"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to state a future action, often with emphasis on the verb 'call' to indicate certainty or a plan.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "1ceba28b-f881-4359-860f-bf0e96c708d9", "textEn": "She will call you when she arrives.", "textEs": "Ella te llamará cuando llegue.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "6db39fa2-0ff4-403d-a963-78b3526cdbba"}, {"id": "d293993b-7b6c-424b-a9eb-6f2e9cb33d62", "textEn": "I hope she will call soon.", "textEs": "Espero que ella llame pronto.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "6db39fa2-0ff4-403d-a963-78b3526cdbba"}, {"id": "aae40741-210b-4fc7-a988-5872f1ff697d", "textEn": "She will call you tomorrow, don't worry.", "textEs": "Ella te llamará mañana, no te preocupes.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "6db39fa2-0ff4-403d-a963-78b3526cdbba"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to express a choice or decision in an election or meeting, often in phrases like 'I vote yes' or 'cast your vote'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "acd31e0f-778d-4744-b6ad-d43df58ca3d7", "textEn": "Every citizen has the right to vote.", "textEs": "Cada ciudadano tiene derecho a votar.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "e0d6e74a-67b0-4163-863e-704a77b558f2"}, {"id": "13a5f5ef-ba64-4769-9b35-3af928578668", "textEn": "She cast her vote early this morning.", "textEs": "Ella emitió su voto temprano esta mañana.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "e0d6e74a-67b0-4163-863e-704a77b558f2"}, {"id": "4549fe03-9345-4a56-91dd-a35360a96cd2", "textEn": "I'm going to vote in the upcoming election.", "textEs": "Voy a votar en las próximas elecciones.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "e0d6e74a-67b0-4163-863e-704a77b558f2"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to suggest or propose having a meal, often with emphasis on 'eat' to convey urgency or strong desire.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "027a3ecb-7816-4e14-bee4-4ae29994ffca", "textEn": "We should eat before the movie starts.", "textEs": "Deberíamos comer antes de que empiece la película.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "6fb2cf01-0f05-466d-b788-bea464123f40"}, {"id": "815e92d3-c3bf-483c-ac65-8fe0b5e9bdfa", "textEn": "They suggested we should eat together.", "textEs": "Sugirieron que deberíamos comer juntos.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "6fb2cf01-0f05-466d-b788-bea464123f40"}, {"id": "805a4f47-3bc0-45b9-9cfd-43422289a9df", "textEn": "We should eat before the movie starts.", "textEs": "Deberíamos comer antes de que empiece la película.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "6fb2cf01-0f05-466d-b788-bea464123f40"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe pressing something firmly, often from two sides, like squeezing a lemon or a tube of toothpaste; also used figuratively, like squeezing into a crowded space or squeezing time out of a busy schedule.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "ca761bb8-3d10-48b6-8709-5eefbe3763dd", "textEn": "Please squeeze the lemon to make juice.", "textEs": "Por favor, exprime el limón para hacer jugo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "644c200b-6bec-4005-8efb-4637749d2523"}, {"id": "a876653b-3a87-464a-8c98-19e514a358c6", "textEn": "They had to squeeze through the narrow gap.", "textEs": "Tuvieron que apretarse para pasar por el hueco estrecho.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "644c200b-6bec-4005-8efb-4637749d2523"}, {"id": "ab8adb94-4eab-43c1-a6c1-786ba5c152f8", "textEn": "I heard the mouse squeeze through the crack in the wall.", "textEs": "Escuché al ratón pasar apretado por la grieta en la pared.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "644c200b-6bec-4005-8efb-4637749d2523"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer back to a previous point or statement, often to emphasize that something was already mentioned or to reassert an opinion.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "be10835e-b02f-4a0f-8ca8-0e5c8d1aef34", "textEn": "Like I said, it's not my problem.", "textEs": "Como dije, no es mi problema.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "e8f73fb4-9978-4737-ae5f-27acc2512312"}, {"id": "beefa2a0-7273-46e9-b3f4-12c436c6a055", "textEn": "Like I said before, we should wait.", "textEs": "Como dije antes, deberíamos esperar.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "e8f73fb4-9978-4737-ae5f-27acc2512312"}, {"id": "32525f7f-0445-44f9-ac9a-b19df7bfdd27", "textEn": "Like I said, we need to finish this report by Friday.", "textEs": "Como dije, tenemos que terminar este informe para el viernes.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "e8f73fb4-9978-4737-ae5f-27acc2512312"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to offer assistance, often with emphasis on 'help' to show willingness or capability.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "c051597d-076c-401a-87e0-611bd758859c", "textEn": "I can help you with your homework.", "textEs": "Puedo ayudarte con tu tarea.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "89ca4c3c-3508-49f7-90a0-0d38b7addfd8"}, {"id": "87cda249-ca39-41f0-a028-6443a55adaaf", "textEn": "Let me know if I can help in any way.", "textEs": "Dime si puedo ayudar de alguna manera.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "89ca4c3c-3508-49f7-90a0-0d38b7addfd8"}, {"id": "36227e4c-3dcf-4d8c-bb70-d3954f9f8304", "textEn": "I can help you with that if you want.", "textEs": "Puedo ayudarte con eso si quieres.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "89ca4c3c-3508-49f7-90a0-0d38b7addfd8"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to add a further, often stronger, point in a list or argument, similar to 'furthermore' or 'moreover'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "817feb81-63f8-43cb-9e31-68c13cd1f8ac", "textEn": "The project is behind schedule. What's more, we've run out of budget.", "textEs": "El proyecto está retrasado. Es más, nos hemos quedado sin presupuesto.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "13d92449-4adf-4763-a328-7bb6e465da51"}, {"id": "a0cf3f89-e74a-4c94-a686-88ef7da74958", "textEn": "She's a talented singer. What's more, she writes her own songs.", "textEs": "Ella es una cantante talentosa. Además, escribe sus propias canciones.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "13d92449-4adf-4763-a328-7bb6e465da51"}, {"id": "5f9cfaa4-2114-4668-8f59-4c89bf01f224", "textEn": "The new restaurant has excellent food, and what's more, the prices are quite reasonable.", "textEs": "El nuevo restaurante tiene excelente comida, y lo que es más, los precios son bastante razonables.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "13d92449-4adf-4763-a328-7bb6e465da51"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe a group of vehicles, especially ships or cars, moving together or owned by one company; also an adjective meaning fast and nimble.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "2e2fde7c-e777-43f0-a073-979494de2fee", "textEn": "The fleet of ships sailed across the ocean.", "textEs": "La flota de barcos navegó a través del océano.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "a97bcc35-d869-4436-bb58-39fe87b0435a"}, {"id": "6c8c60c0-79bb-43cf-8960-b7cd565f6f69", "textEn": "A fleet of taxis waited at the airport.", "textEs": "Una flota de taxis esperaba en el aeropuerto.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "a97bcc35-d869-4436-bb58-39fe87b0435a"}, {"id": "e7941c25-8705-4254-a3fa-66aae9f322ac", "textEn": "The fleet of ships sailed into the harbor at dawn.", "textEs": "La flota de barcos navegó hacia el puerto al amanecer.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "a97bcc35-d869-4436-bb58-39fe87b0435a"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to preface a candid or personal opinion, often softening a blunt statement.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "01a4a294-7cb3-4419-a07b-6f3d09cdcd81", "textEn": "To be honest, I don't like it.", "textEs": "Para ser honesto, no me gusta.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "ee50a8b2-f425-4d82-8540-690cd601f1e7"}, {"id": "213770a4-1665-47bb-bc2c-0a192129acfa", "textEn": "To be honest, I'm tired.", "textEs": "Para ser honesto, estoy cansado.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "ee50a8b2-f425-4d82-8540-690cd601f1e7"}, {"id": "51a5729f-19f3-4d40-8ebc-b4a512d166fe", "textEn": "To be honest, I didn't like the movie at all.", "textEs": "Para ser honesto, no me gustó la película en absoluto.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "ee50a8b2-f425-4d82-8540-690cd601f1e7"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to add an additional point, often emphasizing something extra or negative, like 'and also' or 'besides that'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "4a1dac47-8c11-4004-baa6-3c406b29c8e6", "textEn": "He lost his job. On top of that, his car broke down.", "textEs": "Perdió su trabajo. Encima de eso, su coche se averió.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "580af855-efb3-4f30-bfa2-0a875cd6173b"}, {"id": "e78d25fa-c3bd-4909-870f-3eae6a0bba4a", "textEn": "The hotel room was tiny. On top of that, the air conditioning didn't work.", "textEs": "La habitación del hotel era diminuta. Además, el aire acondicionado no funcionaba.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "580af855-efb3-4f30-bfa2-0a875cd6173b"}, {"id": "43f93d33-300c-45b7-b9e0-7632e59365e2", "textEn": "I missed the bus this morning, and on top of that, it started raining.", "textEs": "Perdí el autobús esta mañana, y para colmo, empezó a llover.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "580af855-efb3-4f30-bfa2-0a875cd6173b"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to express empathy or understanding, often in informal conversation, meaning 'I understand how you feel' or 'I sympathize with you'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "5d73dd6e-0e72-439e-8033-ad47762713ad", "textEn": "I feel you, work has been crazy lately.", "textEs": "Te entiendo, el trabajo ha sido una locura últimamente.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "86d48349-b789-4377-aaa3-cff01f6089b9"}, {"id": "e21f9ae5-acd4-4c33-801f-4c99ea7b93eb", "textEn": "I feel you, that's exactly how I feel.", "textEs": "Te entiendo, eso es exactamente lo que siento.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "86d48349-b789-4377-aaa3-cff01f6089b9"}, {"id": "6f3dc6ef-fd73-4c6e-a329-9c22ae6a1e4b", "textEn": "I feel you, man. That exam was brutal.", "textEs": "Te entiendo, amigo. Ese examen fue brutal.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "86d48349-b789-4377-aaa3-cff01f6089b9"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something that requires little effort, often in casual conversation like 'That test was easy' or as a reassurance like 'Take it easy.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "72d2e1cd-03c0-422e-ab06-bde259f8beca", "textEn": "This exam is very easy.", "textEs": "Este examen es muy fácil.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "94117959-39b2-42fa-b600-10967c98eb46"}, {"id": "2cfaaa69-9f9b-4b8f-8bae-5f63e29a424b", "textEn": "Learning to cook is easy with practice.", "textEs": "Aprender a cocinar es fácil con práctica.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "94117959-39b2-42fa-b600-10967c98eb46"}, {"id": "2f143301-3be3-40e3-846f-2110322b438e", "textEn": "This recipe is so easy, even I can make it.", "textEs": "Esta receta es tan fácil, hasta yo puedo hacerla.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "94117959-39b2-42fa-b600-10967c98eb46"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe twisting or squeezing something, often to remove liquid, or metaphorically to express distress, as in 'wringing one's hands'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "815bc16d-7c86-42aa-bd2b-2ef4f76dc90b", "textEn": "She was wringing the wet towel over the sink.", "textEs": "Estaba escurriendo la toalla mojada sobre el fregadero.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "69386664-1b72-41d7-b9c8-b8ee727bd25c"}, {"id": "9c963e3e-82b7-4859-b94d-3243b2479bd3", "textEn": "He kept wringing his hands in nervousness.", "textEs": "No dejaba de retorcerse las manos por los nervios.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "69386664-1b72-41d7-b9c8-b8ee727bd25c"}, {"id": "69b22a03-8299-4f5f-879b-f8dfba9f7303", "textEn": "The faucet is wringing loudly in the kitchen.", "textEs": "El grifo está chirriando fuertemente en la cocina.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "69386664-1b72-41d7-b9c8-b8ee727bd25c"}]

flashcards.meaning: sin mencionar, por no hablar de
flashcards.native_speech: Used to add an additional point that strengthens or emphasizes what was just said, often implying the point is obvious or extra.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "7cfca794-5aa6-4dc8-a6fc-2019fc8db2ab", "textEn": "The restaurant has great food, not to mention the amazing view.", "textEs": "El restaurante tiene buena comida, sin mencionar la vista increíble.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "ae207711-0783-4ecb-af62-310c776d2ef5"}, {"id": "14a7489b-996c-413b-a593-7f38cd92d901", "textEn": "He's smart, funny, and kind—not to mention incredibly handsome.", "textEs": "Es inteligente, divertido y amable, por no hablar de increíblemente guapo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "ae207711-0783-4ecb-af62-310c776d2ef5"}, {"id": "79f57ff9-a238-4856-b7ae-e7702edfb8da", "textEn": "I can barely afford my rent, not to mention a vacation.", "textEs": "Apenas puedo pagar mi alquiler, por no hablar de unas vacaciones.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "ae207711-0783-4ecb-af62-310c776d2ef5"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Commonly used in everyday conversation to refer to a telephone, especially a mobile phone, often in phrases like 'on the phone' or 'phone call.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "4b71af98-5bc8-49f4-a165-4ccd55585872", "textEn": "She answered the phone quickly.", "textEs": "Ella contestó el teléfono rápidamente.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "6b4a4f45-d9e7-45d5-8304-3c49a3c307bd"}, {"id": "de6c0085-602d-4a1d-bd33-43d87bcd6a77", "textEn": "My phone battery is low.", "textEs": "La batería de mi teléfono está baja.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "6b4a4f45-d9e7-45d5-8304-3c49a3c307bd"}, {"id": "b70d79cb-49b4-41c4-9f69-a36e33c23a1f", "textEn": "Could you please phone me when you arrive at the station?", "textEs": "¿Podrías llamarme cuando llegues a la estación?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "6b4a4f45-d9e7-45d5-8304-3c49a3c307bd"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in math, to add items, or to mean 'and also' in casual conversation.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "b3a440e5-e9ec-437c-be87-5b9b949f0293", "textEn": "We have a meeting at 3. Plus, we need to prepare the report.", "textEs": "Tenemos una reunión a las 3. Además, necesitamos preparar el informe.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "f120cc43-fd81-4de3-8bf7-5df3055f2b11"}, {"id": "2b503df4-603b-4074-a150-89b9a360c9fd", "textEn": "The car is fuel-efficient. Plus, it has a lot of trunk space.", "textEs": "El coche es eficiente en combustible. Además, tiene mucho espacio en el maletero.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "f120cc43-fd81-4de3-8bf7-5df3055f2b11"}, {"id": "8c7c3509-0661-4432-8dd1-ba8a4aff6a2a", "textEn": "I really like the design, plus it's on sale.", "textEs": "Me gusta mucho el diseño, además está en oferta.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "f120cc43-fd81-4de3-8bf7-5df3055f2b11"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to indicate togetherness or addition, often in lists or when combining items or people.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "aed75bca-c295-4c2f-ac78-2c3492d1b411", "textEn": "She brought her laptop along with a stack of books.", "textEs": "Ella trajo su computadora portátil junto con una pila de libros.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "b527dcde-a9ab-4bfa-8500-b7f030f7d5fa"}, {"id": "b8040ded-ff41-4b03-91db-85510fef86d5", "textEn": "The package includes a charger along with a protective case.", "textEs": "El paquete incluye un cargador además de una funda protectora.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "b527dcde-a9ab-4bfa-8500-b7f030f7d5fa"}, {"id": "98953bf8-e775-4155-885c-15d6933cfbcc", "textEn": "I need to bring my laptop along with the charger to the meeting.", "textEs": "Necesito traer mi computadora portátil junto con el cargador a la reunión.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "b527dcde-a9ab-4bfa-8500-b7f030f7d5fa"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to link two related ideas or factors, often emphasizing that they work together to produce a result.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "5b04558a-4116-458d-862e-576c8a9c4953", "textEn": "Her determination, coupled with her talent, led to success.", "textEs": "Su determinación, junto con su talento, la llevaron al éxito.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "b3982571-42f9-4b12-b9c9-8b252e8e1b33"}, {"id": "d92246d3-cbc1-49a2-a259-b67619048901", "textEn": "The low price, coupled with the high quality, makes it a great deal.", "textEs": "El bajo precio, combinado con la alta calidad, lo convierte en una gran oferta.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "b3982571-42f9-4b12-b9c9-8b252e8e1b33"}, {"id": "820fc5e2-9922-47a0-9613-76f2f2285eee", "textEn": "A healthy diet, coupled with regular exercise, is key to maintaining good health.", "textEs": "Una dieta saludable, junto con el ejercicio regular, es clave para mantener una buena salud.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "b3982571-42f9-4b12-b9c9-8b252e8e1b33"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally to mean 'in addition' or 'as well,' often emphasizing an extra, sometimes surprising, element.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "aad973e6-a4b4-4f3d-b2a7-a233dd8d790e", "textEn": "He's a brilliant scientist and a great teacher to boot.", "textEs": "Es un científico brillante y además un gran profesor.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "e6b657bc-11a6-48bf-ba61-7e2d1ecc98a5"}, {"id": "2bb46749-ade0-4920-af1b-95fb48a78a28", "textEn": "The house is spacious, affordable, and in a great location to boot.", "textEs": "La casa es espaciosa, asequible y, para colmo, en una excelente ubicación.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "e6b657bc-11a6-48bf-ba61-7e2d1ecc98a5"}, {"id": "7cc9940f-a87f-47ed-b1f3-bab7571bdff7", "textEn": "I got a promotion and a raise, and a new office to boot.", "textEs": "Obtuve un ascenso y un aumento de sueldo, y una oficina nueva para colmo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "e6b657bc-11a6-48bf-ba61-7e2d1ecc98a5"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to introduce an extra point or item, often in formal or structured speech, like listing reasons or adding information.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "8ffb2fbd-4007-46d3-81e8-eae28cba7440", "textEn": "In addition to this, we offer free shipping on all orders.", "textEs": "Además de esto, ofrecemos envío gratis en todos los pedidos.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "f8684d7e-94db-4a2b-92fc-a8733407b380"}, {"id": "90c786df-4549-45e3-a1fd-29083ac9fd30", "textEn": "In addition to this, the team will receive extra training.", "textEs": "Además de esto, el equipo recibirá capacitación adicional.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "f8684d7e-94db-4a2b-92fc-a8733407b380"}, {"id": "0adee52c-994f-44ad-8ab1-e47d9a8bfa20", "textEn": "In addition to this, we need to consider the budget constraints.", "textEs": "Además de esto, debemos considerar las restricciones presupuestarias.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "f8684d7e-94db-4a2b-92fc-a8733407b380"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in everyday conversation to refer to physical or mental well-being, often in phrases like 'good health' or 'health issues'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "a060f493-12c3-4aaf-b617-2fd4581b403b", "textEn": "Good health is important for happiness.", "textEs": "La buena salud es importante para la felicidad.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "60c7bf74-76d6-4000-a49d-5069996439dc"}, {"id": "22e5bbcd-1e7a-4829-b978-872fc05f4844", "textEn": "She exercises to improve her health.", "textEs": "Ella hace ejercicio para mejorar su salud.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "60c7bf74-76d6-4000-a49d-5069996439dc"}, {"id": "2d77d457-785e-4552-8c03-5c0710322443", "textEn": "I've been trying to improve my health by eating more vegetables.", "textEs": "He estado tratando de mejorar mi salud comiendo más verduras.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "60c7bf74-76d6-4000-a49d-5069996439dc"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to introduce an additional point or topic in conversation, often after a pause or to shift focus.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "21c99ca4-9fc8-485f-8b10-5204247f41be", "textEn": "The food was delicious. Another thing is, the service was excellent.", "textEs": "La comida estaba deliciosa. Otra cosa es que el servicio fue excelente.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "26927158-e785-4968-bb3b-9b80a12d9738"}, {"id": "e286c7ef-9249-495d-9772-7362cea3a5a7", "textEn": "He's very organized. Another thing is, he always meets deadlines.", "textEs": "Él es muy organizado. Otra cosa es que siempre cumple con los plazos.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "26927158-e785-4968-bb3b-9b80a12d9738"}, {"id": "76d64f20-e138-424f-880e-e1afa9b0def7", "textEn": "Another thing is, we need to consider the budget for this project.", "textEs": "Otra cosa es que debemos considerar el presupuesto para este proyecto.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "26927158-e785-4968-bb3b-9b80a12d9738"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to introduce a contrasting point or qualification after a previous statement, often in formal or thoughtful conversation.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "cb550eca-d5f7-4bea-ba5e-c70ae9d94422", "textEn": "The plan seems risky. That said, it might be our only option.", "textEs": "El plan parece arriesgado. Dicho esto, podría ser nuestra única opción.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "03e07b80-e757-4692-baf3-a7762211dd7d"}, {"id": "411b61c2-4bb7-45ec-9462-23a3954ebcfe", "textEn": "She's not very experienced. That said, she learns fast.", "textEs": "No tiene mucha experiencia. Dicho esto, aprende rápido.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "03e07b80-e757-4692-baf3-a7762211dd7d"}, {"id": "0bf62186-d9ea-44b8-b17f-3f28081d71ed", "textEn": "That said, the plan has some potential benefits we shouldn't ignore.", "textEs": "Dicho esto, el plan tiene algunos beneficios potenciales que no deberíamos ignorar.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "03e07b80-e757-4692-baf3-a7762211dd7d"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe a series of thoughts or images during sleep, or a cherished aspiration; often said with a soft, reflective tone.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "d937d1e2-e12a-4860-9f8b-c78b6a1388de", "textEn": "I had a strange dream last night.", "textEs": "Tuve un sueño extraño anoche.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "3ee27464-5593-440c-8efd-4950dab7c3dd"}, {"id": "88d531e4-0bbd-49ff-941e-67812fc553e3", "textEn": "Her dream is to travel the world.", "textEs": "Su sueño es viajar por el mundo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "3ee27464-5593-440c-8efd-4950dab7c3dd"}, {"id": "d73fb9b2-55ff-45cd-b905-ec5b9f810e4f", "textEn": "I had a strange dream last night about flying over the city.", "textEs": "Anoche tuve un sueño extraño sobre volar sobre la ciudad.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "3ee27464-5593-440c-8efd-4950dab7c3dd"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to express necessity or requirement, often in everyday requests or statements like 'I need help' or 'You need to go.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "0876a9f7-1684-4805-8498-bd1e3740b12a", "textEn": "I need a glass of water.", "textEs": "Necesito un vaso de agua.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "60d8df21-7204-4d6f-b713-e3da8087cde6"}, {"id": "2d56c929-d00c-43e8-bd43-4f6965eb5786", "textEn": "You don't need to worry about that.", "textEs": "No necesitas preocuparte por eso.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "60d8df21-7204-4d6f-b713-e3da8087cde6"}, {"id": "fd4b40c9-d1be-4039-9f91-159a7d3da8b6", "textEn": "I need to finish this report by tomorrow.", "textEs": "Necesito terminar este informe para mañana.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "60d8df21-7204-4d6f-b713-e3da8087cde6"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a writing instrument with a graphite core, commonly in phrases like 'pencil in' for scheduling or 'pencil it in' for tentative plans.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "55eb642f-836e-46fc-9493-0bbaa7f173f4", "textEn": "I need a pencil for the test.", "textEs": "Necesito un lápiz para el examen.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "88ba511b-d86a-4fb4-bfd2-ff3f388aaab1"}, {"id": "67626ca7-810e-474b-9c33-934b446622de", "textEn": "Her pencil is sharp.", "textEs": "Su lápiz está afilado.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "88ba511b-d86a-4fb4-bfd2-ff3f388aaab1"}, {"id": "cae4d9d6-278c-40b6-9c57-14e10bc983dd", "textEn": "Could I borrow a pencil? I need to jot down this number.", "textEs": "¿Me prestas un lápiz? Necesito apuntar este número.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "88ba511b-d86a-4fb4-bfd2-ff3f388aaab1"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to highlight a difference between two things, often in formal or analytical speech, like 'By contrast, the second option is cheaper.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "ccd8338e-6a4a-49ad-a8dd-52ec729e9afe", "textEn": "The north is rainy and cold. By contrast, the south is sunny and warm.", "textEs": "El norte es lluvioso y frío. En contraste, el sur es soleado y cálido.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "ddedf44a-beeb-465c-b7b1-08e0f4f45a23"}, {"id": "19a6898a-72e0-4d5f-b109-8400d14826b1", "textEn": "He prefers action movies. By contrast, his sister loves romantic comedies.", "textEs": "Él prefiere las películas de acción. En contraste, su hermana ama las comedias románticas.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "ddedf44a-beeb-465c-b7b1-08e0f4f45a23"}, {"id": "7cfcd9cb-f527-4d65-9717-e6aff731b26b", "textEn": "The north of the country is cold and rainy; by contrast, the south is warm and sunny.", "textEs": "El norte del país es frío y lluvioso; en contraste, el sur es cálido y soleado.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "ddedf44a-beeb-465c-b7b1-08e0f4f45a23"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to introduce a contrasting or opposite point, often in formal or academic speech, like 'Conversely, the other option is cheaper.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "98ed05e8-558b-41cc-bbbc-7c826fd1b89b", "textEn": "Exercise boosts energy. Conversely, a sedentary lifestyle drains it.", "textEs": "El ejercicio aumenta la energía. Por el contrario, un estilo de vida sedentario la agota.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "56e9315c-6b3e-46a8-a002-cfb5c3d6e99e"}, {"id": "7572c9e6-c964-4086-a058-d71bb5356fa7", "textEn": "Online shopping saves time. Conversely, it can lead to impulse buying.", "textEs": "Comprar en línea ahorra tiempo. Por el contrario, puede llevar a compras impulsivas.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "56e9315c-6b3e-46a8-a002-cfb5c3d6e99e"}, {"id": "74824f9a-20a6-4873-9ce2-3f94222a0a82", "textEn": "The first method is quick but expensive; conversely, the second is slower yet more cost-effective.", "textEs": "El primer método es rápido pero costoso; por el contrario, el segundo es más lento pero más rentable.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "56e9315c-6b3e-46a8-a002-cfb5c3d6e99e"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe moving upward, increasing in number or level, or getting out of bed; common in everyday speech.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "0c297dab-b80b-474e-b853-802d69962e34", "textEn": "The sun will rise at 6 AM.", "textEs": "El sol saldrá a las 6 AM.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "751b19d3-1f14-4306-8f20-f8ad147a3004"}, {"id": "1e60df05-02ca-4dc7-b63b-8d4aa210a966", "textEn": "Prices continue to rise every year.", "textEs": "Los precios continúan subiendo cada año.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "751b19d3-1f14-4306-8f20-f8ad147a3004"}, {"id": "59eecb13-3c64-4b6e-b5ad-3662613509dd", "textEn": "The sun rises in the east every morning.", "textEs": "El sol sale por el este cada mañana.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "751b19d3-1f14-4306-8f20-f8ad147a3004"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to contrast two statements, often in formal or written contexts, meaning 'while on the contrary'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "3a36da9f-7402-4cce-8d63-b7293668064e", "textEn": "Cats are independent, whereas dogs need constant attention.", "textEs": "Los gatos son independientes, mientras que los perros necesitan atención constante.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "a9596618-7a1a-4c5e-b507-012e565cec76"}, {"id": "e4f21e51-42e9-4d45-9a13-bbc22df7ce87", "textEn": "She enjoys city life, whereas her brother prefers the countryside.", "textEs": "Ella disfruta la vida en la ciudad, mientras que su hermano prefiere el campo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "a9596618-7a1a-4c5e-b507-012e565cec76"}, {"id": "2555a893-a185-4026-b6f8-900e9853cf19", "textEn": "He loves spicy food, whereas his wife prefers mild flavors.", "textEs": "A él le encanta la comida picante, mientras que su esposa prefiere los sabores suaves.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "a9596618-7a1a-4c5e-b507-012e565cec76"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something with a large distance between opposite sides, like a thick book, or to describe a liquid that is not runny, like thick soup; also informally means stupid or dense.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "bbe91cfc-22c3-467d-a0ec-52be9765715b", "textEn": "The book has a thick cover.", "textEs": "El libro tiene una cubierta gruesa.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "16098ab1-4df0-4069-945c-87d4d3560238"}, {"id": "22178658-16d0-4a04-b98d-4672fe2cbc12", "textEn": "The fog was so thick I couldn't see.", "textEs": "La niebla era tan espesa que no podía ver.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "16098ab1-4df0-4069-945c-87d4d3560238"}, {"id": "0c76f5d1-be1a-41f1-8cfa-df491dfa1b4b", "textEn": "That accent is so thick I can barely understand him.", "textEs": "Ese acento es tan cerrado que apenas puedo entenderlo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "16098ab1-4df0-4069-945c-87d4d3560238"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to indicate reaching a destination or the occurrence of an event, often in casual conversation like 'I'll arrive soon.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "13ceadf3-761a-4fb5-b5c5-a60086196bf9", "textEn": "We will arrive at noon.", "textEs": "Llegaremos al mediodía.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "7323b9e7-4b44-4558-aaa1-c81c392a2d79"}, {"id": "4c287f2c-f15f-4b23-b422-9eb913274df6", "textEn": "She arrived late to the meeting.", "textEs": "Ella llegó tarde a la reunión.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "7323b9e7-4b44-4558-aaa1-c81c392a2d79"}, {"id": "1e0c4155-65d8-4ade-b674-ec4dcc77d667", "textEn": "I usually arrive at the office around 8:30 AM.", "textEs": "Normalmente llego a la oficina alrededor de las 8:30 AM.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "7323b9e7-4b44-4558-aaa1-c81c392a2d79"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to enthusiastically grant permission or agree to a request, often meaning 'of course' or 'certainly'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "84c86fbf-90da-434c-ba6b-2715d42f70f2", "textEn": "By all means, you should attend the meeting.", "textEs": "Por supuesto, deberías asistir a la reunión.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "f1c56755-5d68-42d0-8a1b-03646efb3944"}, {"id": "53a92141-8fa5-40a4-a12a-9be478e119d2", "textEn": "By all means, let me know if you need help.", "textEs": "Sin duda, házmelo saber si necesitas ayuda.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "f1c56755-5d68-42d0-8a1b-03646efb3944"}, {"id": "23bf69dd-83d4-4e12-a743-e774ea640da5", "textEn": "By all means, feel free to use my car while I'm away.", "textEs": "Por supuesto, siéntete libre de usar mi coche mientras estoy fuera.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "f1c56755-5d68-42d0-8a1b-03646efb3944"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to indicate a cardinal direction, often in navigation or describing location, e.g., 'Head north on the highway.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "2ecefca4-5bba-448c-b0e2-2c2f8179a6e6", "textEn": "The wind is blowing from the north.", "textEs": "El viento sopla desde el norte.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "4c4fe5ef-5504-415e-b335-bac85c67c148"}, {"id": "bcd47a86-1c7e-4e3b-bcb3-ac4bbe9a8075", "textEn": "They traveled north for the summer.", "textEs": "Viajaron al norte para el verano.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "4c4fe5ef-5504-415e-b335-bac85c67c148"}, {"id": "c8bdf6a2-c9fe-4994-9ff1-5346a023d918", "textEn": "The wind is blowing from the north, so it's getting colder.", "textEs": "El viento sopla del norte, así que está haciendo más frío.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "4c4fe5ef-5504-415e-b335-bac85c67c148"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to single out a specific item or detail from a group, often for emphasis or clarification in conversation.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "96ed6b44-9c70-46d7-8d60-0a9508f05e1a", "textEn": "I love fruits, in particular strawberries.", "textEs": "Me encantan las frutas, en particular las fresas.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "ecbb4a99-e12d-45de-a229-4136c4263f30"}, {"id": "e313c72a-cdb2-4dc6-b0ad-48b40f91162e", "textEn": "She mentioned one book in particular.", "textEs": "Ella mencionó un libro en particular.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "ecbb4a99-e12d-45de-a229-4136c4263f30"}, {"id": "6c4d075a-8ce7-471c-bc3d-cba487bb448c", "textEn": "I love all types of music, in particular jazz and classical.", "textEs": "Me encanta todo tipo de música, en particular el jazz y la clásica.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "ecbb4a99-e12d-45de-a229-4136c4263f30"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a noun for a cleaning tool with a long handle and absorbent material, or as a verb meaning to clean or wipe with such a tool; also informally means to defeat or finish something quickly.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "b27dfbef-ea36-413b-89da-6692d2d9e8f5", "textEn": "I need a mop to clean the floor.", "textEs": "Necesito un trapeador para limpiar el piso.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "ad8baef2-c0c0-42a6-815e-a7f8cfa71219"}, {"id": "01f0dc74-b4cc-48ea-bc20-054f67af8df0", "textEn": "He dropped the mop on the spot.", "textEs": "Él dejó caer el trapeador en el lugar.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "ad8baef2-c0c0-42a6-815e-a7f8cfa71219"}, {"id": "45c6b437-9e1f-4e7c-b022-e9414ccdd352", "textEn": "I need to mop the kitchen floor after the kids spilled juice.", "textEs": "Necesito trapear el piso de la cocina después de que los niños derramaron jugo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "ad8baef2-c0c0-42a6-815e-a7f8cfa71219"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe going far beyond what is required or expected, often in a positive context like praising someone's extra effort.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "67162b45-bea4-44f4-8f21-41647fb5a36e", "textEn": "She went above and beyond to help us.", "textEs": "Ella hizo más allá de lo esperado para ayudarnos.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "f0d9af38-9a80-4a5d-8482-d1cc04268cf4"}, {"id": "767d6fa5-423e-4ab1-ba9d-ee1ca441f49b", "textEn": "Their service was above and beyond.", "textEs": "Su servicio fue más allá de lo esperado.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "f0d9af38-9a80-4a5d-8482-d1cc04268cf4"}, {"id": "ffaa5004-8d39-4796-be80-969ecfed5ef1", "textEn": "The team went above and beyond to meet the project deadline.", "textEs": "El equipo hizo todo lo posible y más para cumplir con el plazo del proyecto.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "f0d9af38-9a80-4a5d-8482-d1cc04268cf4"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to emphasize the key point or most significant aspect of what you're saying, often at the start of a sentence or clause.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "00ce083a-e5d9-4163-b913-d833e873de35", "textEn": "Most importantly, we must stay safe.", "textEs": "Lo más importante, debemos mantenernos a salvo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "aa7985cc-d04b-45e2-9f0d-100292bf97e1"}, {"id": "cd830162-8887-412e-b344-8b14c505d3fa", "textEn": "He finished the project on time, most importantly.", "textEs": "Él terminó el proyecto a tiempo, lo más importante.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "aa7985cc-d04b-45e2-9f0d-100292bf97e1"}, {"id": "4ed90b01-19e0-4577-8524-d035246bae51", "textEn": "We need to finish the project on time, but most importantly, ensure the quality is top-notch.", "textEs": "Necesitamos terminar el proyecto a tiempo, pero lo más importante, asegurar que la calidad sea de primera.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "aa7985cc-d04b-45e2-9f0d-100292bf97e1"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a noun for fine particles on surfaces, or as a verb meaning to remove those particles; common in everyday cleaning contexts.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "a406fad6-3020-4799-bbcf-71dad435ef66", "textEn": "There is dust on the shelves.", "textEs": "Hay polvo en los estantes.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "76729f77-949d-444a-8693-529d98fbddd6"}, {"id": "1b7cd6f9-e8d0-4600-86c5-2a488f05b8d6", "textEn": "He dusted the furniture with a cloth.", "textEs": "Quitó el polvo de los muebles con un paño.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "76729f77-949d-444a-8693-529d98fbddd6"}, {"id": "9146d3b6-476f-4f83-8f50-338554736695", "textEn": "The dust motes danced in the sunbeam that streamed through the window.", "textEs": "Las motas de polvo bailaban en el rayo de sol que entraba por la ventana.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "76729f77-949d-444a-8693-529d98fbddd6"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe riding waves on a surfboard, or informally to mean browsing the internet casually.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "e625ad43-1b72-4521-a9f8-31f172299fbb", "textEn": "They love to surf in Hawaii.", "textEs": "Les encanta surfear en Hawái.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "83731b58-bf28-4d8c-ba47-976bb7f7e36f"}, {"id": "54d85103-fa47-40d4-9596-07ce58fbb1c7", "textEn": "The surf is high today.", "textEs": "Las olas están altas hoy.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "83731b58-bf28-4d8c-ba47-976bb7f7e36f"}, {"id": "9c0383ac-0f1f-4769-84af-c9df6a4d5c99", "textEn": "I love to surf the waves every summer.", "textEs": "Me encanta surfear las olas cada verano.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "83731b58-bf28-4d8c-ba47-976bb7f7e36f"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to strongly agree or confirm something, often casually in conversation.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "f6584feb-9e1a-4d08-9660-81259dd804ed", "textEn": "For sure, I'll help you with that.", "textEs": "Seguro, te ayudaré con eso.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "35404b43-e48f-4445-a954-088483b38283"}, {"id": "e457a8a5-6bd5-44d4-a334-3197212a073b", "textEn": "For sure, that's a great idea.", "textEs": "Definitivamente, esa es una gran idea.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "35404b43-e48f-4445-a954-088483b38283"}, {"id": "0e0034e1-4bd5-445a-b86a-512e2314011c", "textEn": "I'll be there for sure, don't worry about it.", "textEs": "Estaré allí seguro, no te preocupes.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "35404b43-e48f-4445-a954-088483b38283"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a small, simple, roughly built shelter or house, often in a rural or temporary context.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "7faf2bd0-017e-4777-aeaf-3c32ab71e770", "textEn": "We stayed in a small hut near the lake.", "textEs": "Nos quedamos en una pequeña cabaña cerca del lago.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "b174807a-ea42-4cdd-9c38-5eb55c455808"}, {"id": "957c7aea-d707-49a1-9de3-4fe93792b548", "textEn": "The hut was made of wood and straw.", "textEs": "La cabaña estaba hecha de madera y paja.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "b174807a-ea42-4cdd-9c38-5eb55c455808"}, {"id": "13de41c0-8cc3-46a6-9297-fac31d8ce3ae", "textEn": "We stayed in a small wooden hut by the lake during our vacation.", "textEs": "Nos alojamos en una pequeña cabaña de madera junto al lago durante nuestras vacaciones.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "b174807a-ea42-4cdd-9c38-5eb55c455808"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to add an extra point that strengthens the previous statement, often implying the added point is obvious or even more significant.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "106ed46a-1395-490c-a4be-ea58de56161e", "textEn": "He is smart, not to mention kind.", "textEs": "Él es inteligente, sin mencionar amable.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "a562eb13-ac8f-408d-bda1-13833de3514c"}, {"id": "f3ae30b0-9ca2-40a0-90f1-d3005f9e0850", "textEn": "The trip was fun, not to mention cheap.", "textEs": "El viaje fue divertido, sin mencionar barato.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "a562eb13-ac8f-408d-bda1-13833de3514c"}, {"id": "e368c6c4-82e8-46cd-8fdc-3febb3e5df11", "textEn": "She’s an amazing chef, not to mention a wonderful host.", "textEs": "Es una chef increíble, sin mencionar que es una anfitriona maravillosa.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "a562eb13-ac8f-408d-bda1-13833de3514c"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to emphasize that something is even less likely or possible than a previously mentioned thing, often in negative contexts.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "83379645-082e-4510-8896-d97b99eca8f3", "textEn": "I can't afford a car, let alone a house.", "textEs": "No puedo pagar un coche, y mucho menos una casa.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "cb49b985-0d55-4ec8-96fa-20d5e14ce6d4"}, {"id": "9dcb3438-b270-49fb-a55c-e92660a46bab", "textEn": "She didn't say hello, let alone thank me.", "textEs": "Ella no dijo hola, y mucho menos me agradeció.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "cb49b985-0d55-4ec8-96fa-20d5e14ce6d4"}, {"id": "413a6df2-fa61-444c-a5e6-f91ac28924d4", "textEn": "I can't afford a bicycle, let alone a car.", "textEs": "No puedo permitirme una bicicleta, y mucho menos un coche.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "cb49b985-0d55-4ec8-96fa-20d5e14ce6d4"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something enjoyable or amusing, often in casual conversation like 'That was fun!' or 'Let's have some fun.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "a15ce648-df25-4cc6-a307-678db908a404", "textEn": "The party was a lot of fun.", "textEs": "La fiesta fue muy divertida.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "e264468a-d578-4510-9806-9dc8d0851af0"}, {"id": "2044a4ab-7a5d-4053-9190-f55208e7ea86", "textEn": "We had fun playing games all afternoon.", "textEs": "Nos divertimos jugando juegos toda la tarde.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "e264468a-d578-4510-9806-9dc8d0851af0"}, {"id": "a7d57b52-20dc-4ed7-9e08-d4899920994f", "textEn": "That party was so much fun, I didn't want to leave.", "textEs": "Esa fiesta fue tan divertida, no me quería ir.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "e264468a-d578-4510-9806-9dc8d0851af0"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe a gesture of the hand or a moving ridge of water, often in casual conversation about greetings or ocean conditions.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "7610fae8-d4fc-476c-948f-3069bf0fd4be", "textEn": "The wave crashed onto the shore.", "textEs": "La ola rompió en la orilla.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "dbd8ef6d-e028-4099-8920-9327bbbf685b"}, {"id": "04532bb0-49ff-402b-9db0-b56e1597a6bd", "textEn": "She waved goodbye to her friends.", "textEs": "Ella saludó con la mano a sus amigos.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "dbd8ef6d-e028-4099-8920-9327bbbf685b"}, {"id": "305153fb-2130-43b6-a643-a94dcdb32555", "textEn": "I waved goodbye to my friends as the train pulled away.", "textEs": "Saludé con la mano a mis amigos mientras el tren se alejaba.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "dbd8ef6d-e028-4099-8920-9327bbbf685b"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to downplay or understate something, often implying the reality is more extreme or significant than what is being said.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "c5487eab-4cf9-4d35-8962-e937c167fa17", "textEn": "The movie was boring, to say the least.", "textEs": "La película fue aburrida, por decir lo menos.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "6b5398ea-df8c-457d-b3d5-4b2ade3f2844"}, {"id": "f2e145f7-0dc8-49f8-84d3-6f9dccaf363c", "textEn": "He was surprised, to say the least.", "textEs": "Él estaba sorprendido, por decir lo menos.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "6b5398ea-df8c-457d-b3d5-4b2ade3f2844"}, {"id": "301b7d79-26d2-4996-bbfa-5ae473da12f3", "textEn": "The movie was disappointing, to say the least.", "textEs": "La película fue decepcionante, por decir lo menos.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "6b5398ea-df8c-457d-b3d5-4b2ade3f2844"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to paid work or a specific task; often in phrases like 'get a job' or 'good job'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "c0541a12-e2d2-4fb2-847d-58948bef7462", "textEn": "I got a new job last week.", "textEs": "Conseguí un nuevo trabajo la semana pasada.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "478f7017-5267-4162-b10a-60f0ad8f8b37"}, {"id": "3bee5c1c-023c-4806-b3e5-b749cc493526", "textEn": "His job is very hard.", "textEs": "Su trabajo es muy duro.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "478f7017-5267-4162-b10a-60f0ad8f8b37"}, {"id": "fcea49ce-8ac1-46f0-97c2-90d7a5de0451", "textEn": "I need to update my job on the application form.", "textEs": "Necesito actualizar mi trabajo en el formulario de solicitud.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "478f7017-5267-4162-b10a-60f0ad8f8b37"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe sliced bread browned by heat, or the act of raising a glass in celebration.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "1ebae908-7902-4714-8366-595657181222", "textEn": "I ate toast for breakfast.", "textEs": "Comí tostadas para el desayuno.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "60129e68-cc7c-4c8a-b4a0-4b6d7de59642"}, {"id": "aebf1604-4b26-4816-8679-a86fc5057a7d", "textEn": "Let's make a toast to the couple.", "textEs": "Hagamos un brindis por la pareja.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "60129e68-cc7c-4c8a-b4a0-4b6d7de59642"}, {"id": "31b61e7f-dea0-45f5-9117-6ee875937c6c", "textEn": "The toast popped up from the toaster.", "textEs": "La tostada saltó de la tostadora.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "60129e68-cc7c-4c8a-b4a0-4b6d7de59642"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to single out one thing or person as more important or notable; often pronounced quickly as 'speshly' in casual speech.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "4271e4cf-b2f0-4a1b-9912-d9fee9c5bc93", "textEn": "I love animals, especially dogs.", "textEs": "Me encantan los animales, especialmente los perros.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "d57494a5-8525-4779-8b87-754ec16528eb"}, {"id": "cdd3cc60-3869-4a3a-818b-ccef9958a5b1", "textEn": "She is especially good at math.", "textEs": "Ella es especialmente buena en matemáticas.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "d57494a5-8525-4779-8b87-754ec16528eb"}, {"id": "32516cc3-73b0-4592-b439-b5a776894c19", "textEn": "I love all fruits, especially strawberries and mangoes.", "textEs": "Me encantan todas las frutas, especialmente las fresas y los mangos.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "d57494a5-8525-4779-8b87-754ec16528eb"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to strongly emphasize certainty or agreement, often in casual or formal speech.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "e1cd2245-ec9e-4ab3-90e9-1cd2df5faf81", "textEn": "Without a doubt, she is the best candidate.", "textEs": "Sin duda alguna, ella es la mejor candidata.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "d32280ce-8dff-41aa-a091-211916d1ff54"}, {"id": "fce8d489-9d94-456d-9951-e4ac6b42b6a2", "textEn": "This is without a doubt the best pizza.", "textEs": "Esta es sin duda alguna la mejor pizza.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "d32280ce-8dff-41aa-a091-211916d1ff54"}, {"id": "be4af2d3-1798-4c74-9ec0-c95686262b4b", "textEn": "Without a doubt, this is the best pizza in town.", "textEs": "Sin duda, esta es la mejor pizza de la ciudad.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "d32280ce-8dff-41aa-a091-211916d1ff54"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a common noun for a writing instrument, often in classroom or office settings.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "fc9d0d15-ed06-4ae6-89a4-3baca077066d", "textEn": "I need a pencil to draw.", "textEs": "Necesito un lápiz para dibujar.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "af4609bc-a310-4094-b16e-a8051fd086cd"}, {"id": "848597a9-a523-4610-8661-63e8adc96e98", "textEn": "She sharpened her pencil.", "textEs": "Ella afiló su lápiz.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "af4609bc-a310-4094-b16e-a8051fd086cd"}, {"id": "b5623605-1d68-456a-9082-b787f87a8d2a", "textEn": "Can I borrow a pencil for the test?", "textEs": "¿Me prestas un lápiz para el examen?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "af4609bc-a310-4094-b16e-a8051fd086cd"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to mean 'at the beginning' or 'initially,' often in formal or written contexts to refer to the start of a process, event, or discussion.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "7551dab6-4ca8-4c2c-8d98-9171d72fd54d", "textEn": "At the outset, we faced many challenges.", "textEs": "Al principio, enfrentamos muchos desafíos.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "929b6d13-2b9f-41f0-b06b-fe51c7c51f29"}, {"id": "f9a6224c-2ebc-40ce-a1d5-870765f71379", "textEn": "He explained the rules at the outset.", "textEs": "Explicó las reglas al principio.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "929b6d13-2b9f-41f0-b06b-fe51c7c51f29"}, {"id": "3f961f96-9c4d-46c9-bbcc-4c71b142ecd8", "textEn": "At the outset of the project, we established clear goals and deadlines.", "textEs": "Al inicio del proyecto, establecimos metas y plazos claros.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "929b6d13-2b9f-41f0-b06b-fe51c7c51f29"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to emphasize a statement or introduce a clarifying or contrasting point, often in casual conversation or formal speech.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "9bc4ee51-87f1-45f3-942c-cf323bd76423", "textEn": "In fact, I have never been there.", "textEs": "De hecho, nunca he estado allí.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "2faebbba-84c6-4143-8496-1a13587bf9ba"}, {"id": "8c6941a2-5654-4269-85a6-d32e28437f03", "textEn": "He is, in fact, the owner.", "textEs": "Él es, de hecho, el dueño.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "2faebbba-84c6-4143-8496-1a13587bf9ba"}, {"id": "192ccfed-a9ac-4407-9560-4a2becf422d1", "textEn": "I thought the movie was boring; in fact, I fell asleep halfway through.", "textEs": "Pensé que la película era aburrida; de hecho, me quedé dormido a mitad de camino.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "2faebbba-84c6-4143-8496-1a13587bf9ba"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a spherical object for games, or in idioms like 'have a ball' meaning to have fun.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "24a5983d-ca92-4cfc-a998-02bffcb07460", "textEn": "He kicked the ball into the goal.", "textEs": "Él pateó el balón hacia la portería.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "7d741039-ccdc-4dbb-9c12-ce84cd9c93b7"}, {"id": "9dd2fbca-c803-4a12-a8a7-435016253c28", "textEn": "The ball is under the table.", "textEs": "La pelota está debajo de la mesa.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "7d741039-ccdc-4dbb-9c12-ce84cd9c93b7"}, {"id": "79a9e946-1f16-4ebf-b7a9-e2cc80074e04", "textEn": "The cat is playing with a ball of yarn.", "textEs": "El gato está jugando con una bola de estambre.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "7d741039-ccdc-4dbb-9c12-ce84cd9c93b7"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to express unhappiness or disappointment, often in a subdued tone.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "91bd6e7e-7d64-4d51-a5a3-363954bc1841", "textEn": "She felt sad when her friend moved away.", "textEs": "Ella se sintió triste cuando su amigo se mudó.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "6825c129-56da-4e57-858d-b5366bf5af50"}, {"id": "335c7d97-ebe9-48a1-b897-15723f61b4b4", "textEn": "The movie had a sad ending that made everyone cry.", "textEs": "La película tuvo un final triste que hizo llorar a todos.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "6825c129-56da-4e57-858d-b5366bf5af50"}, {"id": "21272c35-ceb6-4475-8961-653f7eaef0dd", "textEn": "That movie made me so sad I couldn't stop crying.", "textEs": "Esa película me puso tan triste que no podía dejar de llorar.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "6825c129-56da-4e57-858d-b5366bf5af50"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to express disbelief, surprise, or rejection, often with emphasis on 'way'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "96a79258-50fb-4193-b924-b72001b86bc6", "textEn": "No way, you won the lottery?", "textEs": "No puede ser, ¿ganaste la lotería?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "623e008d-0685-4981-82f0-62679e4d3ec2"}, {"id": "3eaff8fa-a6a4-491a-900e-4c9914c76eb7", "textEn": "No way, I can't believe she said that.", "textEs": "Qué increíble, no puedo creer que ella dijera eso.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "623e008d-0685-4981-82f0-62679e4d3ec2"}, {"id": "420e8fb2-a3b8-4deb-93e4-f255e02c8234", "textEn": "No way! I can't believe you got tickets to the concert.", "textEs": "¡No puede ser! No puedo creer que conseguiste boletos para el concierto.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "623e008d-0685-4981-82f0-62679e4d3ec2"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something done at the last possible moment, often implying urgency or a close deadline.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "041aa331-14ff-4246-9f90-0dec02e05b12", "textEn": "They reached an agreement at the eleventh hour.", "textEs": "Llegaron a un acuerdo en el último momento.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "72a79d5e-b08e-4214-8010-c0991e31eb28"}, {"id": "ac600272-c4de-4235-ac84-7d6efe0f6adf", "textEn": "She submitted her application at the eleventh hour.", "textEs": "Envió su solicitud en el último momento.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "72a79d5e-b08e-4214-8010-c0991e31eb28"}, {"id": "95c5331f-a0f4-4fa8-a665-62f9341f0149", "textEn": "They reached a settlement at the eleventh hour, just before the strike was set to begin.", "textEs": "Llegaron a un acuerdo a última hora, justo antes de que comenzara la huelga.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "72a79d5e-b08e-4214-8010-c0991e31eb28"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to express disbelief, surprise, or amazement, often in reaction to something unexpected or extreme.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "14873264-9542-49a4-a4cc-a07e4c5e0c56", "textEn": "That's crazy, I never expected that.", "textEs": "Eso es una locura, nunca esperé eso.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "46463f3e-d26f-4c92-947f-350c76e93047"}, {"id": "49999e31-0510-442a-aa1e-c71afb746000", "textEn": "That's crazy, how did you manage to do it?", "textEs": "Eso es una locura, ¿cómo lograste hacerlo?", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "46463f3e-d26f-4c92-947f-350c76e93047"}, {"id": "235e4ab7-8928-4f07-8f8a-6bbdfbfe09e8", "textEn": "He said he'd run a marathon without any training, and I was like, that's crazy.", "textEs": "Dijo que correría un maratón sin entrenar, y yo pensé, eso es una locura.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "46463f3e-d26f-4c92-947f-350c76e93047"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to introduce an example or clarify a point, often in formal or explanatory contexts.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "5e68020e-f691-44ec-907c-c70669c1ae7d", "textEn": "To illustrate, consider the impact of social media on teenagers.", "textEs": "Para ilustrar, considera el impacto de las redes sociales en los adolescentes.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "3273a55c-29cd-44c4-bfb8-a6eac0e0b66f"}, {"id": "413b2d51-36f9-4daa-959d-142750099114", "textEn": "Let me give you an example to illustrate my point.", "textEs": "Déjame darte un ejemplo para ilustrar mi punto.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "3273a55c-29cd-44c4-bfb8-a6eac0e0b66f"}, {"id": "93bcf7b4-ef96-4707-b91f-ca832c33be7b", "textEn": "To illustrate the difference, consider how a caterpillar transforms into a butterfly.", "textEs": "Para ilustrar la diferencia, considera cómo una oruga se transforma en mariposa.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "3273a55c-29cd-44c4-bfb8-a6eac0e0b66f"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the pointed end of something, a piece of advice, or a small amount of extra money given for service.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "a0e3d849-6146-43da-99e8-f010dc77f9ba", "textEn": "The tip of the pencil is sharp.", "textEs": "La punta del lápiz está afilada.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "ada2b086-302c-45ec-8897-16a9a41125fe"}, {"id": "ef7c9381-ab4a-4e97-924e-f61bc50a1603", "textEn": "He left a generous tip for the waiter.", "textEs": "Dejó una propina generosa para el mesero.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "ada2b086-302c-45ec-8897-16a9a41125fe"}, {"id": "d0b2b91b-e8d6-4b8e-a692-5fffc60116fc", "textEn": "Could you tip the waiter a few dollars for the great service?", "textEs": "¿Podrías dejarle una propina de unos dólares al mesero por el excelente servicio?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "ada2b086-302c-45ec-8897-16a9a41125fe"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something dropping downward, decreasing in amount, or transitioning into a different state, often in casual contexts like 'prices fall' or 'fall asleep'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "1490f95b-cfb2-456f-badf-f984b4af1071", "textEn": "Leaves fall from the trees in autumn.", "textEs": "Las hojas caen de los árboles en otoño.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "61f40c93-b95a-47cb-b795-f10da4ed22e0"}, {"id": "5d711c4b-8cc4-4f2b-974a-10ff4d805cb6", "textEn": "Be careful not to fall on the ice.", "textEs": "Ten cuidado de no caerte en el hielo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "61f40c93-b95a-47cb-b795-f10da4ed22e0"}, {"id": "757e2de0-3ddd-408e-8174-c0fc0ddff785", "textEn": "I heard a loud thud as the book fell off the shelf.", "textEs": "Escuché un fuerte golpe cuando el libro se cayó del estante.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "61f40c93-b95a-47cb-b795-f10da4ed22e0"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally to mean connecting or meeting someone, often for a romantic or sexual encounter, or to refer to setting up a device or arrangement.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "1e49bd27-4953-432e-8ffc-1161f4a9c264", "textEn": "Let's hook up after work for coffee.", "textEs": "Encontrémonos después del trabajo para un café.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "aa84acc7-6408-4db6-afbe-9c3576db2296"}, {"id": "46a518c3-f799-4372-9c33-4bf3cf920e9c", "textEn": "Can you hook up the printer to my laptop?", "textEs": "¿Puedes conectar la impresora a mi laptop?", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "aa84acc7-6408-4db6-afbe-9c3576db2296"}, {"id": "a6b72e21-5028-4281-acb3-0cc36c482845", "textEn": "We can hook up after work to discuss the project.", "textEs": "Podemos encontrarnos después del trabajo para discutir el proyecto.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "aa84acc7-6408-4db6-afbe-9c3576db2296"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to introduce a specific instance that illustrates a general point, often in explanations or arguments.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "a9f5f318-4a18-4c6b-b724-0404dbb9a73d", "textEn": "As an example, many companies now offer remote work options.", "textEs": "Como ejemplo, muchas empresas ahora ofrecen opciones de trabajo remoto.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "5ab781aa-d536-431a-88d7-b0600da3baa7"}, {"id": "8c4e9e2f-acce-49c4-a2ac-9c1b8ac7d9b4", "textEn": "As an example of good leadership, she always listens to her team.", "textEs": "Como ejemplo de buen liderazgo, ella siempre escucha a su equipo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "5ab781aa-d536-431a-88d7-b0600da3baa7"}, {"id": "2016258d-61d1-4c0a-a38b-ef80bcb6abbf", "textEn": "As an example, consider how bees pollinate flowers.", "textEs": "Como ejemplo, considera cómo las abejas polinizan las flores.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "5ab781aa-d536-431a-88d7-b0600da3baa7"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to introduce more specific details or examples, often in formal or explanatory speech.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "60517256-ddf6-4e11-b828-7c7fd02aa26a", "textEn": "He has one major flaw, namely his impatience.", "textEs": "Él tiene un defecto importante, a saber, su impaciencia.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "9e9f3f74-7109-44a8-bdbc-37188599e64f"}, {"id": "4a3bb659-adf2-477d-9362-f3ad99169989", "textEn": "We need to focus on two things, namely quality and speed.", "textEs": "Necesitamos enfocarnos en dos cosas, es decir, calidad y velocidad.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "9e9f3f74-7109-44a8-bdbc-37188599e64f"}, {"id": "91f9b50d-039d-4eda-b059-608b4e04fcc6", "textEn": "There are three main reasons for the project's success, namely, strong leadership, dedicated teamwork, and sufficient funding.", "textEs": "Hay tres razones principales para el éxito del proyecto, a saber, un liderazgo fuerte, un trabajo en equipo dedicado y una financiación suficiente.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "9e9f3f74-7109-44a8-bdbc-37188599e64f"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to introduce an example or rough estimate that helps clarify a point, often before explaining something in simpler terms.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "56ffc27c-a582-4c82-89c7-c8d1fe4203ea", "textEn": "To give you an idea, the project took over 200 hours.", "textEs": "Para darte una idea, el proyecto tomó más de 200 horas.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "42fc2dd6-ce41-4943-b6ea-b03ba7d19432"}, {"id": "c40ce4b6-1abb-43c4-a940-67ed2c0adcf8", "textEn": "To give you an idea of the cost, a basic model starts at $500.", "textEs": "Para darte una idea del costo, un modelo básico comienza en $500.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "42fc2dd6-ce41-4943-b6ea-b03ba7d19432"}, {"id": "458d8059-132b-41c2-8df1-0663b8359300", "textEn": "To give you an idea of the cost, a similar project in New York was over a million dollars.", "textEs": "Para darte una idea del costo, un proyecto similar en Nueva York costó más de un millón de dólares.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "42fc2dd6-ce41-4943-b6ea-b03ba7d19432"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to introduce an example that clarifies or supports a point, often in formal or explanatory contexts.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "9913537c-10e9-42c4-bd21-7cab9d033d19", "textEn": "By way of illustration, imagine a world without smartphones.", "textEs": "A modo de ilustración, imagina un mundo sin teléfonos inteligentes.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "d046ef86-1732-4331-a8fb-cb7c79b98706"}, {"id": "7d63a007-0d8d-45c0-a23f-d944deeaf867", "textEn": "By way of illustration, the author uses a simple story.", "textEs": "A modo de ilustración, el autor usa una historia simple.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "d046ef86-1732-4331-a8fb-cb7c79b98706"}, {"id": "df1a39ce-bb7c-4972-bcfa-63f300925c67", "textEn": "By way of illustration, consider how a small change in temperature can affect the entire ecosystem.", "textEs": "A modo de ilustración, considere cómo un pequeño cambio en la temperatura puede afectar a todo el ecosistema.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "d046ef86-1732-4331-a8fb-cb7c79b98706"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something not firmly fixed, tight, or contained; also in phrases like 'loose change' or 'cut loose'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "d26ca160-3aab-4c44-8847-bb2a35738428", "textEn": "The screw is loose.", "textEs": "El tornillo está suelto.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "10f0594b-ea72-49f9-bd37-7e3591373427"}, {"id": "b13c7326-c9e2-4541-846e-70c884b1031d", "textEn": "He wore a loose shirt.", "textEs": "Él llevaba una camisa floja.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "10f0594b-ea72-49f9-bd37-7e3591373427"}, {"id": "5e88c6da-e99c-45b7-8799-a2fd3fa261e6", "textEn": "The screw is loose, so the door handle keeps wobbling.", "textEs": "El tornillo está suelto, por lo que la manija de la puerta sigue tambaleándose.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "10f0594b-ea72-49f9-bd37-7e3591373427"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a verb meaning to allow or give consent, often in formal or official contexts.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "66f6a276-130f-4726-b2ad-2760e1b96075", "textEn": "They won't permit smoking in the restaurant.", "textEs": "No permitirán fumar en el restaurante.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "dcb48cbb-6594-4198-8899-3769bb43a8db"}, {"id": "1e1e1871-bea7-4275-a66c-ced5b24afcb4", "textEn": "Please permit me to introduce myself.", "textEs": "Por favor, permíteme presentarme.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "dcb48cbb-6594-4198-8899-3769bb43a8db"}, {"id": "4f15d0b6-f8da-463e-add4-9a0c35136e78", "textEn": "Can you permit me to leave early today?", "textEs": "¿Puedes permitirme salir temprano hoy?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "dcb48cbb-6594-4198-8899-3769bb43a8db"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in writing to introduce examples, but in natural speech, people often say 'for example' instead of pronouncing the letters.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "1eff9418-a217-44fe-a42b-56c885f1eea6", "textEn": "You should eat more fruits, e.g., apples and bananas.", "textEs": "Deberías comer más frutas, p. ej., manzanas y plátanos.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "aeae7cdc-c15c-4a4c-a95c-cf81ff112ca5"}, {"id": "1a158c2d-0183-4774-ba04-cddce8d3c4ed", "textEn": "Many animals, e.g., dogs and cats, are domesticated.", "textEs": "Muchos animales, p. ej., perros y gatos, están domesticados.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "aeae7cdc-c15c-4a4c-a95c-cf81ff112ca5"}, {"id": "f6f8c378-87a9-4158-a393-d29c88dcaf4c", "textEn": "I enjoy many outdoor activities, e.g., hiking, cycling, and swimming.", "textEs": "Disfruto de muchas actividades al aire libre, p. ej., senderismo, ciclismo y natación.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "aeae7cdc-c15c-4a4c-a95c-cf81ff112ca5"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something level, smooth, or lacking elevation; also commonly means an apartment in British English.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "472e060a-687b-4c98-9ff6-3479376df0a8", "textEn": "The road is flat and easy to walk on.", "textEs": "El camino es plano y fácil de caminar.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "6b0a363f-6e1f-4fda-8a18-c26805f63e4e"}, {"id": "7ff5f760-c6b9-4101-a929-9b785a538ffc", "textEn": "They rent a small flat in the city center.", "textEs": "Ellos alquilan un pequeño departamento en el centro de la ciudad.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "6b0a363f-6e1f-4fda-8a18-c26805f63e4e"}, {"id": "0aeeff31-d54b-442a-a757-b596946d5b64", "textEn": "I got a flat tire on the highway, so I had to pull over and call for help.", "textEs": "Se me pinchó una llanta en la autopista, así que tuve que orillarme y pedir ayuda.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "6b0a363f-6e1f-4fda-8a18-c26805f63e4e"}]

flashcards.native_speech: A small, simple, often roughly built shelter or house, commonly used in casual speech to describe a basic dwelling or cabin.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "d13e3767-7ed0-4347-b77f-7e002e8769df", "textEn": "We stayed in a small hut near the beach.", "textEs": "Nos quedamos en una pequeña cabaña cerca de la playa.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "e21e152a-402d-4a37-a308-b7eb4df9550c"}, {"id": "758a5442-64b5-42e3-b373-9c33889d731b", "textEn": "The hut was made of wood and straw.", "textEs": "La cabaña estaba hecha de madera y paja.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "e21e152a-402d-4a37-a308-b7eb4df9550c"}, {"id": "0835dcda-e275-4027-9d35-938c5effbd35", "textEn": "We stayed in a small hut near the beach during our vacation.", "textEs": "Nos quedamos en una pequeña cabaña cerca de la playa durante nuestras vacaciones.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "e21e152a-402d-4a37-a308-b7eb4df9550c"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a filler word, similar to 'um' or 'uh', to pause while thinking, or to soften statements, especially in casual speech.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "2dc0da8b-7830-424b-ba53-ac380d62670b", "textEn": "I enjoy outdoor activities, like hiking and cycling.", "textEs": "Disfruto de actividades al aire libre, como senderismo y ciclismo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "3f17e099-22b2-4ee0-a02a-4c720f1af220"}, {"id": "0c67b67d-1770-4d3e-8129-c9c219344d25", "textEn": "She has skills like coding and design.", "textEs": "Ella tiene habilidades como programación y diseño.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "3f17e099-22b2-4ee0-a02a-4c720f1af220"}, {"id": "c67bd3ab-1801-4b5c-8282-931c6fecb7a6", "textEn": "Like, I was so tired after the meeting that I just went straight to bed.", "textEs": "O sea, estaba tan cansado después de la reunión que me fui directo a la cama.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "3f17e099-22b2-4ee0-a02a-4c720f1af220"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something easy to see, understand, or free from obstacles; often in phrases like 'clear the table' or 'it's clear now'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "828532af-60ae-40f2-9342-4ca13a6d6100", "textEn": "The sky is clear today.", "textEs": "El cielo está claro hoy.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "cd12c019-2940-4fcb-96d6-3e043f39fc0a"}, {"id": "5f890871-406d-41a0-aa82-8b9e32d008cc", "textEn": "She gave a clear explanation.", "textEs": "Ella dio una explicación clara.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "cd12c019-2940-4fcb-96d6-3e043f39fc0a"}, {"id": "da823c24-f7e8-43b9-b7e3-63402b33ea23", "textEn": "The instructions were clear, so everyone knew what to do.", "textEs": "Las instrucciones estaban claras, así que todos sabían qué hacer.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "cd12c019-2940-4fcb-96d6-3e043f39fc0a"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to popular styles in clothing, hair, or behavior, often in casual conversation about trends or personal taste.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "231645e6-2b07-4620-9c47-a08222b96066", "textEn": "Fashion trends change very quickly these days.", "textEs": "Las tendencias de la moda cambian muy rápido hoy en día.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "74e45f86-db3c-422a-b292-2e97ad545e78"}, {"id": "68bfe8d3-63fb-4aa1-be97-a33d634202f9", "textEn": "He works in the fashion industry as a designer.", "textEs": "Él trabaja en la industria de la moda como diseñador.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "74e45f86-db3c-422a-b292-2e97ad545e78"}, {"id": "751cd577-653f-46ad-8bcc-ed86dffad2d6", "textEn": "She has a real fashion for wearing vintage clothes from the 1970s.", "textEs": "Ella tiene una verdadera moda por usar ropa vintage de los años 70.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "74e45f86-db3c-422a-b292-2e97ad545e78"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to add something to a list or group, often in formal or explanatory contexts.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "95ac80df-8ba7-4963-8fe3-e636e837cc8c", "textEn": "Several countries, including Spain and Italy, attended the summit.", "textEs": "Varios países, incluyendo España e Italia, asistieron a la cumbre.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "995a47b7-6283-49a7-b804-1e9841c3b47f"}, {"id": "222341fa-1d33-4abb-a812-ce5810a0fd2b", "textEn": "The package includes items like a charger and a case.", "textEs": "El paquete incluye artículos como un cargador y una funda.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "995a47b7-6283-49a7-b804-1e9841c3b47f"}, {"id": "c1fbb051-c7ac-423f-93de-4a062d98439d", "textEn": "I love all kinds of fruit, including apples, bananas, and oranges.", "textEs": "Me encanta todo tipo de frutas, incluyendo manzanas, plátanos y naranjas.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "995a47b7-6283-49a7-b804-1e9841c3b47f"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a polite or conditional form of 'can', often in requests or hypotheticals, like 'Could you help me?' or 'I could go if I wanted.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "ccb627e7-b887-4878-828e-82ccfd250899", "textEn": "I could help you with that.", "textEs": "Podría ayudarte con eso.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "9c5a4483-516b-4b7d-8b4d-63c17ad01415"}, {"id": "8f3855b9-75a2-4441-a8ba-a1952f82139f", "textEn": "She could not find her keys.", "textEs": "Ella no pudo encontrar sus llaves.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "9c5a4483-516b-4b7d-8b4d-63c17ad01415"}, {"id": "0c2611ac-1872-4f61-951b-1741c6c7e4ec", "textEn": "Could you pass me the salt, please?", "textEs": "¿Podrías pasarme la sal, por favor?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "9c5a4483-516b-4b7d-8b4d-63c17ad01415"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to introduce a concise summary or to cut a long explanation short, often in casual or formal conversation.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "392d71b4-d1c0-4cad-bc02-d5cf03294dfd", "textEn": "To put it briefly, we lost the game.", "textEs": "Para decirlo brevemente, perdimos el partido.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "cbcd3ea7-613a-4a7b-b292-6c4b15332842"}, {"id": "b337148d-f895-4678-829b-0e230f2ef26e", "textEn": "To put it briefly, she resigned.", "textEs": "Para decirlo brevemente, ella renunció.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "cbcd3ea7-613a-4a7b-b292-6c4b15332842"}, {"id": "bd57a963-eb47-44d2-b4e0-50ab3cacaefa", "textEn": "To put it briefly, the project was a success.", "textEs": "Para ser breve, el proyecto fue un éxito.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "cbcd3ea7-613a-4a7b-b292-6c4b15332842"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe the flavor of food or drink, or metaphorically for a brief experience or preference.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "1c54deb4-18b0-4d3d-baa4-5dabe59d976b", "textEn": "This soup has a delicious taste.", "textEs": "Esta sopa tiene un sabor delicioso.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "81f497df-b898-4960-83f4-17bb5efae2af"}, {"id": "d5c977c8-d491-49d5-a637-02a7f7508ceb", "textEn": "Taste the cake and tell me what you think.", "textEs": "Prueba el pastel y dime qué piensas.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "81f497df-b898-4960-83f4-17bb5efae2af"}, {"id": "c54cea02-3524-4bac-9bff-0991a8ccc2f7", "textEn": "The soup tastes a bit salty, but it's still good.", "textEs": "La sopa sabe un poco salada, pero todavía está buena.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "81f497df-b898-4960-83f4-17bb5efae2af"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the upper limb from shoulder to hand, or metaphorically to a branch or section of an organization.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "eaa8a030-2c1b-4252-a57b-109d02fa8018", "textEn": "He broke his arm playing soccer.", "textEs": "Él se rompió el brazo jugando fútbol.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "8c03a23a-805d-4197-801c-54f971c6b070"}, {"id": "2dfc42ff-f30f-4ecf-aede-2338a206499f", "textEn": "She carried the bag under her arm.", "textEs": "Ella llevaba la bolsa debajo del brazo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "8c03a23a-805d-4197-801c-54f971c6b070"}, {"id": "bc4f1666-72eb-4f60-829a-303cfb9d509a", "textEn": "The baby was sleeping peacefully in her mother's arms.", "textEs": "El bebé dormía plácidamente en los brazos de su madre.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "8c03a23a-805d-4197-801c-54f971c6b070"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to express a strong emotional response to danger or threat, often in a serious or urgent tone.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "15ac0484-6598-4ddd-8352-a73bd67207b5", "textEn": "He has a fear of heights.", "textEs": "Él tiene miedo a las alturas.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "d104c0b5-43cf-4a2f-91f6-5fd0bab098cb"}, {"id": "f8332de1-f717-446d-bd84-fe6ae37dd0c8", "textEn": "Don't fear the unknown.", "textEs": "No temas a lo desconocido.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "d104c0b5-43cf-4a2f-91f6-5fd0bab098cb"}, {"id": "5d14bc93-2935-4f79-b9c6-f3c837cec905", "textEn": "I have a fear of heights, so I avoid tall buildings.", "textEs": "Tengo miedo a las alturas, por eso evito los edificios altos.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "d104c0b5-43cf-4a2f-91f6-5fd0bab098cb"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the whole quantity or every member of a group, often emphasized in natural speech to indicate completeness or totality.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "873b0a4a-f672-40d5-9bae-170a0ded0593", "textEn": "All the kids are playing outside.", "textEs": "Todos los niños están jugando afuera.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "cd2fec7f-c94e-45d7-8306-88ed4c3241af"}, {"id": "f36a50d1-7d0c-4cfc-abcf-e98d654f4301", "textEn": "She gave her all in the race.", "textEs": "Ella dio todo en la carrera.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "cd2fec7f-c94e-45d7-8306-88ed4c3241af"}, {"id": "16b29366-b75d-4a31-9605-a8f573705902", "textEn": "I ate all the cookies.", "textEs": "Me comí todas las galletas.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "cd2fec7f-c94e-45d7-8306-88ed4c3241af"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to mean 'at the appropriate time' or 'when the time is right,' often in formal or polite contexts to indicate something will happen without specifying exactly when.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "154b9b2d-be4b-43b9-8a8d-b5d504eec4ff", "textEn": "The results will be published in due course.", "textEs": "Los resultados se publicarán a su debido tiempo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "66cb92e7-0d84-40aa-86aa-8e501751681d"}, {"id": "6f2717fe-ada2-4328-81c1-5b2132fe3333", "textEn": "She'll learn to drive in due course.", "textEs": "Aprenderá a conducir a su debido tiempo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "66cb92e7-0d84-40aa-86aa-8e501751681d"}, {"id": "430cc28a-3266-4c7f-92c0-592fca6a3e88", "textEn": "You will receive your exam results in due course.", "textEs": "Recibirás los resultados de tu examen a su debido tiempo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "66cb92e7-0d84-40aa-86aa-8e501751681d"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to mean 'stop doing something' (e.g., 'Cut it out!'), or to remove something physically or figuratively (e.g., 'Cut out the middleman').
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "121f5342-0927-4b93-a8e8-dbbaf56a9dc5", "textEn": "I'm going to cut out of the party early.", "textEs": "Voy a salir de la fiesta temprano.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "5992bc4b-7fdd-4042-be03-1540915d1ed2"}, {"id": "8c4688a7-964a-446f-8af4-0da869a26302", "textEn": "You need to cut out sugar from your diet.", "textEs": "Necesitas eliminar el azúcar de tu dieta.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "5992bc4b-7fdd-4042-be03-1540915d1ed2"}, {"id": "79950fd3-b35e-4f3d-a31d-3dfeff12d791", "textEn": "You need to cut out the junk food if you want to lose weight.", "textEs": "Tienes que eliminar la comida chatarra si quieres perder peso.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "5992bc4b-7fdd-4042-be03-1540915d1ed2"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the planet we live on, or soil and ground, often in contexts like 'the Earth is round' or 'digging in the earth'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "529b99bc-bed2-42ce-99c3-e8492f52e458", "textEn": "The earth is round.", "textEs": "La tierra es redonda.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "b6d54dff-87e1-44b5-80dd-485de98e1d7c"}, {"id": "7a500e33-1b6e-4ff4-8719-1506c6780059", "textEn": "They dug into the earth.", "textEs": "Cavaron en la tierra.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "b6d54dff-87e1-44b5-80dd-485de98e1d7c"}, {"id": "363718cf-3c3f-437d-b54d-91b05b99eda7", "textEn": "The earth trembled as the heavy trucks passed by.", "textEs": "La tierra tembló cuando pasaron los camiones pesados.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "b6d54dff-87e1-44b5-80dd-485de98e1d7c"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the thick hair covering an animal's body, or in casual speech to describe something as being furry or fuzzy.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "1f0b6cea-5425-4d21-b522-08d303e23306", "textEn": "The cat has soft fur.", "textEs": "El gato tiene pelaje suave.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "bf066752-88d6-49e3-adc8-aee79a003937"}, {"id": "e88fb63c-6b0b-437d-be12-74a4b594153e", "textEn": "She wore a fur coat.", "textEs": "Ella usó un abrigo de piel.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "bf066752-88d6-49e3-adc8-aee79a003937"}, {"id": "e7f9e71f-33aa-49da-a0f0-abfe1db2326f", "textEn": "The cat's fur was so soft and fluffy.", "textEs": "El pelaje del gato era tan suave y esponjoso.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "bf066752-88d6-49e3-adc8-aee79a003937"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe unwanted or disruptive sound, often in contexts like 'stop making noise' or 'background noise'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "d06ca0d5-4492-40ff-8c5e-9b8370422db1", "textEn": "I can't sleep because of the noise outside.", "textEs": "No puedo dormir por el ruido de afuera.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "88cdb93b-4d9f-4704-9ba5-af76761461b0"}, {"id": "54ae7633-5705-4604-ad43-af4193c2c4f8", "textEn": "The noise from the party was too loud.", "textEs": "El ruido de la fiesta era demasiado fuerte.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "88cdb93b-4d9f-4704-9ba5-af76761461b0"}, {"id": "37680913-89ab-4801-9a2d-f1681cda31a5", "textEn": "The noise from the construction site is driving me crazy.", "textEs": "El ruido de la obra me está volviendo loco.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "88cdb93b-4d9f-4704-9ba5-af76761461b0"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe physically moving upward, often with hands and feet, or metaphorically for increasing in status or difficulty.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "00f499f7-8e30-44d0-8bc6-89491a301c39", "textEn": "They climb the mountain every year.", "textEs": "Ellos escalan la montaña cada año.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "585555dc-0cb8-4c8b-a654-77458fa38977"}, {"id": "817adac6-a22c-4648-84fe-6ff82209cd41", "textEn": "He climbed the tree quickly.", "textEs": "Él subió al árbol rápidamente.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "585555dc-0cb8-4c8b-a654-77458fa38977"}, {"id": "a9d5a9ee-6a63-4053-a32e-e273e3708edf", "textEn": "I can hear the cat climb the tree outside my window.", "textEs": "Puedo oír al gato trepar el árbol afuera de mi ventana.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "585555dc-0cb8-4c8b-a654-77458fa38977"}]
