flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a liquid or semi-liquid condiment, or informally to describe something impressive or cool, as in 'That's the sauce!'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "65edf1e3-c0ea-43bc-98b7-802edaadf9d9", "textEn": "I love this tomato sauce.", "textEs": "Me encanta esta salsa de tomate.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "5814c501-f7e0-4dcd-8a1b-3051d1430841"}, {"id": "8ebb6642-b313-4663-8d30-26c052b8e4a8", "textEn": "She poured the sauce over the pasta.", "textEs": "Ella vertió la salsa sobre la pasta.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "5814c501-f7e0-4dcd-8a1b-3051d1430841"}, {"id": "b9535b9d-c18c-462b-ac5f-09ad9dd3eefe", "textEn": "I love the tangy sauce on these ribs.", "textEs": "Me encanta la salsa picante en estas costillas.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "5814c501-f7e0-4dcd-8a1b-3051d1430841"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a single step in a staircase, or more commonly in the plural 'stairs' to mean the entire staircase.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "a3c826e7-de7a-42c4-827c-8a486cae6b2e", "textEn": "Be careful on the top stair.", "textEs": "Ten cuidado en el último escalón.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "1cfd9634-7929-4d5d-8009-b638d44654e1"}, {"id": "85a1f9b8-9b0c-4428-89e0-ac32355eb8a4", "textEn": "She sat on the bottom stair.", "textEs": "Ella se sentó en el escalón de abajo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "1cfd9634-7929-4d5d-8009-b638d44654e1"}, {"id": "ca5ceedb-2086-434a-90ca-25cc8fd31194", "textEn": "I heard a creak on the stair, but when I looked, no one was there.", "textEs": "Escuché un crujido en la escalera, pero cuando miré, no había nadie.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "1cfd9634-7929-4d5d-8009-b638d44654e1"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe physical pain or emotional distress, often in casual conversation like 'That really hurts' or 'I hurt my back.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "d3841df6-f0cf-456c-af52-7871074fe835", "textEn": "My leg hurts after the run.", "textEs": "Me duele la pierna después de la carrera.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "c1fa47f6-6bd1-4062-a492-5dc1fbcd5763"}, {"id": "4ae4dfad-2b6b-4ddb-a724-0a775f9209ac", "textEn": "Don't hurt yourself with that knife.", "textEs": "No te lastimes con ese cuchillo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "c1fa47f6-6bd1-4062-a492-5dc1fbcd5763"}, {"id": "63cdd961-5d38-40c6-845d-f123fb1768de", "textEn": "I hurt my back lifting that heavy box.", "textEs": "Me lastimé la espalda levantando esa caja pesada.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "c1fa47f6-6bd1-4062-a492-5dc1fbcd5763"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe a moderate, comfortable temperature, often for weather, objects, or feelings of friendliness.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "37f684ef-e32d-45b4-8b9e-5fdf031bc95f", "textEn": "The soup is warm.", "textEs": "La sopa está cálida.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "01405f8d-a282-4951-bc95-43cd3325c49c"}, {"id": "12693872-e517-450a-99d8-ab2670eb5a0c", "textEn": "Warm your hands by the fire.", "textEs": "Calienta tus manos junto al fuego.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "01405f8d-a282-4951-bc95-43cd3325c49c"}, {"id": "d0be63ef-1748-4f2b-86df-7094cae83d15", "textEn": "You look warm; would you like a glass of water?", "textEs": "Te ves acalorado; ¿quieres un vaso de agua?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "01405f8d-a282-4951-bc95-43cd3325c49c"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in American English to refer to the sport known as football in most other countries; common in casual conversation about games, teams, or playing.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "461f6b9a-9d2a-40dc-9446-e6a82e7fc180", "textEn": "He plays soccer every weekend.", "textEs": "Él juega fútbol cada fin de semana.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "5dc948fa-4bd7-42dc-9795-69591921872c"}, {"id": "b4b229e4-c40d-4588-8acb-33dc513b86d0", "textEn": "Soccer is very popular here.", "textEs": "El fútbol es muy popular aquí.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "5dc948fa-4bd7-42dc-9795-69591921872c"}, {"id": "c08b3c44-5f40-4fd1-b344-004ed2502d06", "textEn": "I love playing soccer with my friends on weekends.", "textEs": "Me encanta jugar fútbol con mis amigos los fines de semana.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "5dc948fa-4bd7-42dc-9795-69591921872c"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a common domestic animal, often as a pet or working animal, and can be used affectionately or neutrally in everyday conversation.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "bd124f02-76b7-4f0f-ba25-3e8867a12565", "textEn": "The dog ran across the lot.", "textEs": "El perro corrió por el lote.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "69e1ff7d-640d-40aa-885d-279dea2c1794"}, {"id": "bf268aed-db9b-4923-bc01-8f7e7bf3cf5d", "textEn": "My dog loves to hop on the bed.", "textEs": "Mi perro ama saltar en la cama.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "69e1ff7d-640d-40aa-885d-279dea2c1794"}, {"id": "788689b3-5bba-43f0-9f6d-8431395610b6", "textEn": "The dog barked loudly at the mailman.", "textEs": "El perro ladró fuerte al cartero.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "69e1ff7d-640d-40aa-885d-279dea2c1794"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the back part of something, like a car's rear, or as a verb meaning to raise or bring up, e.g., 'rear children'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "56ac70de-fca5-47e6-a40b-b1e6e46980dc", "textEn": "The car hit the rear of the truck.", "textEs": "El coche golpeó la parte trasera del camión.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "2aa22eba-eab7-44a1-8680-3d8b911d8f2e"}, {"id": "da34ac9a-7c67-499d-9eae-1f2a36750518", "textEn": "They rear cattle on the farm.", "textEs": "Ellos crían ganado en la granja.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "2aa22eba-eab7-44a1-8680-3d8b911d8f2e"}, {"id": "11948159-3194-46dc-972f-b3c170d8e2a5", "textEn": "The horse reared up when it heard the loud noise.", "textEs": "El caballo se encabritó cuando escuchó el fuerte ruido.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "2aa22eba-eab7-44a1-8680-3d8b911d8f2e"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something containing as much as possible, like a full glass, or to express satiety after eating, e.g., 'I'm full.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "f1348b31-0e4e-425b-844b-adedb354e171", "textEn": "The glass is full of water.", "textEs": "El vaso está lleno de agua.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "87ce4b98-5a1f-48e4-ba77-9de97345c0e2"}, {"id": "ef5f1585-31e1-4db5-9b2b-41c366bc612a", "textEn": "I ate a full meal.", "textEs": "Comí una comida completa.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "87ce4b98-5a1f-48e4-ba77-9de97345c0e2"}, {"id": "6f3c7871-81ab-4e8e-9ba7-74e472510f15", "textEn": "I'm so full after that meal, I can't eat another bite.", "textEs": "Estoy tan lleno después de esa comida, no puedo comer ni un bocado más.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "87ce4b98-5a1f-48e4-ba77-9de97345c0e2"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a natural flowing watercourse, often in geographical or poetic contexts.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "84ff83db-d4c4-408b-b48a-aa6cc01bb42e", "textEn": "The river flows through the valley.", "textEs": "El río fluye a través del valle.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "c7ee594a-242b-4b6b-b36e-323753d20a7c"}, {"id": "684b6788-0b0b-40e6-926e-25f0319df016", "textEn": "We crossed the river by boat.", "textEs": "Cruzamos el río en bote.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "c7ee594a-242b-4b6b-b36e-323753d20a7c"}, {"id": "abd90ba1-a020-40f6-98f0-334bf4de6c1c", "textEn": "The river flows gently through the valley.", "textEs": "El río fluye suavemente a través del valle.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "c7ee594a-242b-4b6b-b36e-323753d20a7c"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to someone with long experience in a field, especially military service, often said with respect.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "58ba5ad5-55b4-43a3-9976-e25a3c822547", "textEn": "He is a veteran of the war.", "textEs": "Él es un veterano de la guerra.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "a34fc8fa-e6dc-4c22-a5ca-3013cd0013e6"}, {"id": "67c7e83e-00ae-40d9-9a86-d7a329a9037e", "textEn": "The veteran teacher shared her experience.", "textEs": "La maestra veterana compartió su experiencia.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "a34fc8fa-e6dc-4c22-a5ca-3013cd0013e6"}, {"id": "4e700719-9a18-44bf-b3df-977764affce2", "textEn": "My grandfather is a veteran of World War II.", "textEs": "Mi abuelo es un veterano de la Segunda Guerra Mundial.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "a34fc8fa-e6dc-4c22-a5ca-3013cd0013e6"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the animal, often in hunting or wildlife contexts, or in phrases like 'deer in headlights' to describe someone frozen in shock.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "f3e707d1-d00c-4584-8b78-fe0bf9baa5f6", "textEn": "A deer ran across the road.", "textEs": "Un venado cruzó la carretera.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "68639277-5b78-41e4-aeb4-78fce58674d5"}, {"id": "faced2f3-9fdd-4f74-97fe-dcf98eba7f9a", "textEn": "We saw deer in the forest.", "textEs": "Vimos ciervos en el bosque.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "68639277-5b78-41e4-aeb4-78fce58674d5"}, {"id": "9f57f112-179d-429b-a41c-a31f6efcd887", "textEn": "I saw a deer in the forest this morning.", "textEs": "Vi un ciervo en el bosque esta mañana.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "68639277-5b78-41e4-aeb4-78fce58674d5"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a noun, often in business or technology contexts, to refer to goods brought in from another country or data brought into a system.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "a93ef39c-eef3-4334-a00e-6875574e2333", "textEn": "The import of goods increased this year.", "textEs": "La importación de bienes aumentó este año.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "8eed4d15-1e15-4484-b5c0-e59e18c2268f"}, {"id": "ee10ffd8-7783-4006-83aa-265b1c240c00", "textEn": "They placed an import order for electronics.", "textEs": "Hicieron un pedido de importación de electrónicos.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "8eed4d15-1e15-4484-b5c0-e59e18c2268f"}, {"id": "77c08527-4e27-476d-87f4-8739f225f8ab", "textEn": "Can you import the data from the spreadsheet into our system?", "textEs": "¿Puedes importar los datos de la hoja de cálculo a nuestro sistema?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "8eed4d15-1e15-4484-b5c0-e59e18c2268f"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as an exclamation of joy or encouragement, often in celebrations or to motivate someone.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "bb5d6685-5cf0-44da-b72a-8c1aee2cd5af", "textEn": "The crowd gave a loud cheer.", "textEs": "La multitud dio un fuerte grito de alegría.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "f41cc198-7cb1-476f-8f42-9f36e461ea67"}, {"id": "ea59aab2-13a3-4718-8c94-dbb1ac1273c8", "textEn": "Cheer up, it's not that bad.", "textEs": "Anímate, no es tan malo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "f41cc198-7cb1-476f-8f42-9f36e461ea67"}, {"id": "b27026db-12fc-49dd-afaa-7f7dbacf29fe", "textEn": "The crowd gave a loud cheer when the team scored the winning goal.", "textEs": "La multitud dio un fuerte vítores cuando el equipo anotó el gol de la victoria.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "f41cc198-7cb1-476f-8f42-9f36e461ea67"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe fixing something broken, like a car or a relationship, often in casual or technical contexts.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "a03bb847-1dda-4f43-a7d8-facd32854a24", "textEn": "He needs to repair the broken chair.", "textEs": "Él necesita reparar la silla rota.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "26d93f84-592b-4001-99a4-123c86ed3676"}, {"id": "2749376f-5aa5-4ef2-8b42-39d72df0265a", "textEn": "The car is in the shop for repair.", "textEs": "El coche está en el taller para reparación.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "26d93f84-592b-4001-99a4-123c86ed3676"}, {"id": "5a4d6858-ff8a-4ae3-87a6-4273cfda644b", "textEn": "I need to repair my bicycle tire before the race tomorrow.", "textEs": "Necesito reparar la llanta de mi bicicleta antes de la carrera de mañana.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "26d93f84-592b-4001-99a4-123c86ed3676"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe someone who is shy, timid, or easily embarrassed, often in social situations.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "4fe4e47a-cadb-4b7f-aedc-f9010c8ee882", "textEn": "The bashful child hid behind his mother's legs.", "textEs": "El niño tímido se escondió detrás de las piernas de su madre.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "67cfeb00-2875-4a69-a42a-a80bba0f6968"}, {"id": "f364cd47-b87d-4e2d-a5f2-b0dec65ca02a", "textEn": "She gave a bashful smile when she received the compliment.", "textEs": "Ella dio una sonrisa tímida cuando recibió el cumplido.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "67cfeb00-2875-4a69-a42a-a80bba0f6968"}, {"id": "3d5eb415-d8d5-4108-8203-f382e74adeba", "textEn": "The bashful child hid behind his mother's skirt when meeting new people.", "textEs": "El niño tímido se escondió detrás de la falda de su madre al conocer gente nueva.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "67cfeb00-2875-4a69-a42a-a80bba0f6968"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe causing fear or alarm, often in casual conversation like 'You scared me!' or in warnings like 'Don't scare the dog.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "21549e65-fb13-49ac-90bb-6aaef809ddc0", "textEn": "The loud noise gave me a scare.", "textEs": "El ruido fuerte me dio un susto.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "6b0e9c44-bf47-4161-91af-263fa5eefc6a"}, {"id": "041a8126-9094-4214-ab89-8901dcf55e44", "textEn": "Don't scare the cat with that toy.", "textEs": "No asustes al gato con ese juguete.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "6b0e9c44-bf47-4161-91af-263fa5eefc6a"}, {"id": "af85cda8-65b0-4fd2-8580-c308bbbb01f1", "textEn": "The sudden noise scared the cat.", "textEs": "El ruido repentino asustó al gato.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "6b0e9c44-bf47-4161-91af-263fa5eefc6a"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a 60-minute period of time, often in contexts like telling time or describing duration.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "9f1a0306-36ec-40fb-bbc6-eda3afb42984", "textEn": "I waited for an hour.", "textEs": "Esperé una hora.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "e13eee30-d99d-4536-b40a-3024be58221d"}, {"id": "98f53eeb-4081-4492-b01f-81ad7d363b47", "textEn": "The meeting lasts one hour.", "textEs": "La reunión dura una hora.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "e13eee30-d99d-4536-b40a-3024be58221d"}, {"id": "4aac9e45-3c09-4b4f-9aed-16ba73caa571", "textEn": "I'll meet you in one hour.", "textEs": "Te veré en una hora.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "e13eee30-d99d-4536-b40a-3024be58221d"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally to mean 'from the very beginning,' often in casual conversation about starting a process or activity.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "1e2c1308-8cc6-4aef-b13c-0449e6ae9cf2", "textEn": "He was against the idea from the get-go.", "textEs": "Estuvo en contra de la idea desde el principio.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "20c00e28-b447-457e-abbe-caf455a41751"}, {"id": "d80a819f-3146-4021-9c76-d26a3266c18c", "textEn": "The team worked well from the get-go.", "textEs": "El equipo trabajó bien desde el principio.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "20c00e28-b447-457e-abbe-caf455a41751"}, {"id": "b4faa49a-8d93-4998-bc38-0c211cfa61cd", "textEn": "I knew from the get-go that this project would be a success.", "textEs": "Supe desde el principio que este proyecto sería un éxito.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "20c00e28-b447-457e-abbe-caf455a41751"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to emphasize a gradual change or progression over time, often in a slightly formal or reflective tone.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "5c4fe232-b686-4194-a04e-a46f50e38862", "textEn": "With each passing day, the deadline gets closer.", "textEs": "Con cada día que pasa, la fecha límite se acerca.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "1b2dafb0-5e33-423d-a651-a86c5643b5bb"}, {"id": "9c758e16-c63e-480d-b095-82f259f484d6", "textEn": "Her confidence grew with each passing day.", "textEs": "Su confianza crecía con cada día que pasaba.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "1b2dafb0-5e33-423d-a651-a86c5643b5bb"}, {"id": "59e81c1b-9457-4ab9-a61d-d37ebd8c998b", "textEn": "With each passing day, the flowers in the garden grow taller and more beautiful.", "textEs": "Con cada día que pasa, las flores en el jardín crecen más altas y hermosas.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "1b2dafb0-5e33-423d-a651-a86c5643b5bb"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe looking fixedly at something or someone, often with intensity or curiosity, as in 'Don't stare at people.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "b6523d4e-dc59-40e1-89d0-5e46df547bc6", "textEn": "It is rude to stare at people.", "textEs": "Es grosero mirar fijamente a la gente.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "77f5b751-db5d-4000-9acc-55954e786e1a"}, {"id": "25df0706-ac35-4f98-b6df-7a49281917c2", "textEn": "She gave him a long stare.", "textEs": "Ella le dio una mirada larga y fija.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "77f5b751-db5d-4000-9acc-55954e786e1a"}, {"id": "4293c8c5-5cb7-42ad-b9ed-a279d06ec9c9", "textEn": "She stared at the painting for a long time, lost in thought.", "textEs": "Ella miró fijamente la pintura durante mucho tiempo, perdida en sus pensamientos.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "77f5b751-db5d-4000-9acc-55954e786e1a"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a noun to refer to a competition or event where people try to win something, like a spelling contest or a talent contest.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "d0ef0c1d-8a8c-457f-ad1b-b5967c0d360e", "textEn": "She won the spelling contest.", "textEs": "Ella ganó el concurso de ortografía.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "c068acf3-47aa-4223-a04e-2dd175ab2397"}, {"id": "88880e09-8359-4a59-b82f-b36e3b1f883c", "textEn": "The contest starts at noon.", "textEs": "El concurso comienza al mediodía.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "c068acf3-47aa-4223-a04e-2dd175ab2397"}, {"id": "af1dbd54-2bca-454e-bb72-788b7565c691", "textEn": "CONtest, my foot. The correct pronunciation is conTEST.", "textEs": "CONtest, ni hablar. La pronunciación correcta es conTEST.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "c068acf3-47aa-4223-a04e-2dd175ab2397"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe the period following a significant event, often a disaster or conflict, focusing on its consequences or results.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "1d16efbc-22c5-4b65-9d1c-917a2cef47ac", "textEn": "In the aftermath of the storm, the town rebuilt.", "textEs": "Después de la tormenta, el pueblo se reconstruyó.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "72c19340-bd31-44bb-ab89-dad7303264b0"}, {"id": "3de6e117-417e-40c9-acf4-41a02b9ae306", "textEn": "In the aftermath, many questions remained.", "textEs": "Después, quedaron muchas preguntas.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "72c19340-bd31-44bb-ab89-dad7303264b0"}, {"id": "134a7f68-9a86-4b4f-80a8-9f3a5fc21fc7", "textEn": "In the aftermath of the storm, the community came together to rebuild the damaged homes.", "textEs": "Después de la tormenta, la comunidad se unió para reconstruir las casas dañadas.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "72c19340-bd31-44bb-ab89-dad7303264b0"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to summarize or clarify the core point of something, often before rephrasing an idea more simply.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "94c85f3c-4b16-4320-9827-ba51e3c2377a", "textEn": "In essence, the plan is simple.", "textEs": "En esencia, el plan es simple.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "f405e1d1-2d9c-47eb-ab45-3d5c4deaccdf"}, {"id": "2970d46c-6d90-44ab-9c79-4399fdb267c4", "textEn": "In essence, they agreed to cooperate.", "textEs": "En esencia, acordaron cooperar.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "f405e1d1-2d9c-47eb-ab45-3d5c4deaccdf"}, {"id": "cc8264b7-98be-4108-ae21-aaf316b68210", "textEn": "In essence, the project failed due to poor planning.", "textEs": "En esencia, el proyecto fracasó debido a una mala planificación.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "f405e1d1-2d9c-47eb-ab45-3d5c4deaccdf"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe controlling the direction of a vehicle, or metaphorically guiding a situation or person.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "e9c233bd-dc9a-400f-97fd-7d25f0241410", "textEn": "Steer the car to the left.", "textEs": "Conduce el coche hacia la izquierda.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "c52ab6ac-1436-42c3-862c-ab5b236da636"}, {"id": "e10828b0-0c46-4763-ae27-ddd32b21a321", "textEn": "He tried to steer the conversation.", "textEs": "Él intentó dirigir la conversación.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "c52ab6ac-1436-42c3-862c-ab5b236da636"}, {"id": "ff8ff015-3372-4b59-8be8-b271724a219b", "textEn": "Can you steer the boat toward that island?", "textEs": "¿Puedes dirigir el bote hacia esa isla?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "c52ab6ac-1436-42c3-862c-ab5b236da636"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something with an even, flat surface, or a person who is charming and persuasive in a polished way.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "21af7576-6448-4446-8cd3-433ef83e26df", "textEn": "The table has a smooth surface.", "textEs": "La mesa tiene una superficie lisa.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "cb9124cc-c9c6-4ecd-a3ab-e307541cd50b"}, {"id": "6861edf8-b850-42fd-a490-033698b90d68", "textEn": "Her voice is smooth and calm.", "textEs": "Su voz es suave y tranquila.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "cb9124cc-c9c6-4ecd-a3ab-e307541cd50b"}, {"id": "b3e7ea9c-3e00-4341-95dc-b9e0a94a0a8c", "textEn": "That presentation was really smooth—you didn't even stumble once.", "textEs": "Esa presentación fue muy fluida—ni siquiera tropezaste una vez.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "cb9124cc-c9c6-4ecd-a3ab-e307541cd50b"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the star at the center of our solar system, often in weather talk or daily life, like 'The sun is bright today.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "df33d452-fb92-4c95-baeb-20dab60970e4", "textEn": "The sun is shining brightly.", "textEs": "El sol brilla intensamente.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "b06302f1-4029-4eaa-9f87-d6283478ab60"}, {"id": "f9ea0556-b46a-4c31-9422-15e16c3e5b32", "textEn": "We sat in the sun all afternoon.", "textEs": "Nos sentamos al sol toda la tarde.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "b06302f1-4029-4eaa-9f87-d6283478ab60"}, {"id": "fc1c73d7-60ed-4e85-acec-218dc0be05c1", "textEn": "The sun is shining brightly today.", "textEs": "El sol brilla intensamente hoy.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "b06302f1-4029-4eaa-9f87-d6283478ab60"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in formal or written contexts to mean 'because of' or 'due to', often explaining reasons or causes.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "a0d3fcad-855f-498b-a8f3-733e5a54faf5", "textEn": "Owing to the rain, the picnic was postponed.", "textEs": "Debido a la lluvia, el picnic fue pospuesto.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "452aed79-c6e6-4a0e-bb5d-7c4ee9a0550e"}, {"id": "fed9af28-e7bd-4a21-90cb-408d59ee5889", "textEn": "The event was a success owing to everyone's effort.", "textEs": "El evento fue un éxito gracias al esfuerzo de todos.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "452aed79-c6e6-4a0e-bb5d-7c4ee9a0550e"}, {"id": "14970a07-2906-424e-9896-86fe25337a9d", "textEn": "The flight was delayed owing to heavy fog at the airport.", "textEs": "El vuelo se retrasó debido a la densa niebla en el aeropuerto.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "452aed79-c6e6-4a0e-bb5d-7c4ee9a0550e"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally to mean contacting someone, often by phone or text, or to suggest going somewhere together.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "f7f9deba-49e5-4636-ac7d-91132a43526b", "textEn": "I'll hit you up when I get there.", "textEs": "Te contacto cuando llegue.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "f5de621a-82fa-435b-a472-e5ce16d32c10"}, {"id": "971c9180-524b-496b-83b1-4dd7220519af", "textEn": "He hit me up for money again.", "textEs": "Me pidió dinero otra vez.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "f5de621a-82fa-435b-a472-e5ce16d32c10"}, {"id": "b27115ca-f10c-4491-99ea-4b62e10e1f68", "textEn": "I'm going to hit up the grocery store on my way home.", "textEs": "Voy a pasar por el supermercado de camino a casa.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "f5de621a-82fa-435b-a472-e5ce16d32c10"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a small, flat piece of metal money, or metaphorically to mean 'invent' or 'create' a word or phrase.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "0d436956-04b1-4689-be7c-6a199d517218", "textEn": "I found a shiny coin on the sidewalk.", "textEs": "Encontré una moneda brillante en la acera.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "2624f96b-d36d-4c00-8372-e6788025f587"}, {"id": "cb9cb4c0-dece-422e-aa0b-e7527e5d2983", "textEn": "He collects old coins from different countries.", "textEs": "Él colecciona monedas antiguas de diferentes países.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "2624f96b-d36d-4c00-8372-e6788025f587"}, {"id": "dcecfecb-350b-4e89-9abb-b41ee4c36042", "textEn": "Can you hear the coin drop on the floor?", "textEs": "¿Puedes oír caer la moneda al suelo?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "2624f96b-d36d-4c00-8372-e6788025f587"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally to refer to a police officer, often in casual conversation or media.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "96293d4b-1682-4cd7-b94d-21d452885a19", "textEn": "The cop stopped the car.", "textEs": "El policía detuvo el coche.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "ecbda471-5cb2-41f2-8ec0-6f6d52a30471"}, {"id": "fd1ad5d4-6d13-48e1-885b-212915000c59", "textEn": "A cop helped me find my way.", "textEs": "Un policía me ayudó a encontrar el camino.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "ecbda471-5cb2-41f2-8ec0-6f6d52a30471"}, {"id": "d1bf8e34-ef6c-4e88-9b16-b1cdf1745519", "textEn": "I saw a cop pull over a car on the highway this morning.", "textEs": "Vi a un policía detener un coche en la autopista esta mañana.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "ecbda471-5cb2-41f2-8ec0-6f6d52a30471"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the body part at the end of the arm, or in phrases like 'give me a hand' to mean help.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "837713fe-83f3-4d98-b6f6-7766432ebf0b", "textEn": "She raised her hand to ask a question.", "textEs": "Ella levantó la mano para hacer una pregunta.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "a392e365-b024-4c24-84b2-2e6793509a63"}, {"id": "1a66831b-9988-4169-b086-870c279b1d7b", "textEn": "He held the book in his left hand.", "textEs": "Él sostuvo el libro en su mano izquierda.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "a392e365-b024-4c24-84b2-2e6793509a63"}, {"id": "3a9b2681-8e3e-4f8c-b805-7776aba803bc", "textEn": "Give me a hand with these boxes, will you?", "textEs": "Échame una mano con estas cajas, ¿quieres?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "a392e365-b024-4c24-84b2-2e6793509a63"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to indicate a cause-and-effect relationship, often in formal or written contexts, but also in natural speech to explain outcomes.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "dec9a3a3-535f-4a33-9775-4489c07a399f", "textEn": "The factory leaked chemicals, resulting in water pollution.", "textEs": "La fábrica filtró químicos, resultando en contaminación del agua.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "5d581b21-c31f-4efd-b8f2-83ae78803a1d"}, {"id": "3c087987-2309-44f3-bd90-2363eca3692a", "textEn": "He missed the deadline, resulting in a penalty.", "textEs": "No cumplió con la fecha límite, lo que provocó una multa.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "5d581b21-c31f-4efd-b8f2-83ae78803a1d"}, {"id": "a10bc4fe-11f5-4c7c-b5d4-e56ce2151e65", "textEn": "The heavy rain caused widespread flooding, resulting in significant property damage.", "textEs": "La fuerte lluvia causó inundaciones generalizadas, lo que resultó en daños significativos a la propiedad.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "5d581b21-c31f-4efd-b8f2-83ae78803a1d"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a phrasal verb meaning to move backward, support someone, or create a copy of data; often said quickly with stress on 'back'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "79477b68-d076-4c89-9463-eb1738b59d0e", "textEn": "Back up your car a little more.", "textEs": "Retrocede tu coche un poco más.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "668e9063-d1c9-4651-aa71-1d362f092e7e"}, {"id": "95a1a3c4-b43f-4f48-808f-9e5fa7bafed1", "textEn": "I'll back you up in the meeting.", "textEs": "Te apoyaré en la reunión.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "668e9063-d1c9-4651-aa71-1d362f092e7e"}, {"id": "9a44440a-5ca5-42a4-a43b-801779436eaa", "textEn": "You need to back up your files before the computer crashes.", "textEs": "Necesitas hacer una copia de seguridad de tus archivos antes de que la computadora se bloquee.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "668e9063-d1c9-4651-aa71-1d362f092e7e"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as the past tense of 'think' or as a noun meaning an idea or opinion; often pronounced with a clear 'th' sound and a long 'aw' vowel in standard English.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "b86f4467-d00e-4f19-b476-f9452b0715c1", "textEn": "I had a strange thought last night.", "textEs": "Tuve un pensamiento extraño anoche.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "9a81ecf6-5279-4e62-9403-26f23fd4089d"}, {"id": "b5c82af1-13e2-4a90-a8da-87a704967f3c", "textEn": "She thought about the problem for hours.", "textEs": "Ella pensó en el problema durante horas.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "9a81ecf6-5279-4e62-9403-26f23fd4089d"}, {"id": "63e992b3-33b7-4837-9ef3-79387abcd077", "textEn": "I thought you were coming to the party tonight.", "textEs": "Pensé que ibas a venir a la fiesta esta noche.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "9a81ecf6-5279-4e62-9403-26f23fd4089d"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a plural third-person pronoun to refer to a group of people, animals, or things; also commonly used as a singular pronoun for a person whose gender is unknown or non-binary.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "75af633a-3f04-45bf-89a9-d5dbc3322d16", "textEn": "They are coming to the party.", "textEs": "Ellos vienen a la fiesta.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "425827f1-7aab-4ca5-8242-70381ac50f68"}, {"id": "d2609b16-0725-4f94-9f27-8f10c30c9b30", "textEn": "They said it was fine.", "textEs": "Ellos dijeron que estaba bien.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "425827f1-7aab-4ca5-8242-70381ac50f68"}, {"id": "f1cb89c4-0d42-45a1-9c81-9bf6ab6dc1d9", "textEn": "They said they would help us with the project.", "textEs": "Ellos dijeron que nos ayudarían con el proyecto.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "425827f1-7aab-4ca5-8242-70381ac50f68"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a verb meaning to create a picture with a pen or pencil, or to pull something gently.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "ceb701ef-9226-4071-a99d-2d072b0b7024", "textEn": "Can you draw a picture of a cat?", "textEs": "¿Puedes dibujar un dibujo de un gato?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "07176546-9e81-481b-a7a3-2b8bc382ae74"}, {"id": "37a6af54-33ca-4a08-884e-b35cea1f496f", "textEn": "The game ended in a draw.", "textEs": "El partido terminó en empate.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "07176546-9e81-481b-a7a3-2b8bc382ae74"}, {"id": "51435f0f-7377-4dee-b3e2-ff6b52d28a1b", "textEn": "The teacher asked the students to draw a picture of their favorite animal.", "textEs": "El profesor pidió a los estudiantes que dibujaran una imagen de su animal favorito.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "07176546-9e81-481b-a7a3-2b8bc382ae74"}]

flashcards.native_speech: yooz
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "f6308b03-9d08-476e-b221-3e951b318043", "textEn": "What do youse want?", "textEs": "¿Qué quieren ustedes?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "75200066-e0a0-41d9-a37f-82139d0e6c47"}, {"id": "6a325a97-3cdf-4156-a3ae-26f6d2d9c07f", "textEn": "Youse better be careful.", "textEs": "Ustedes mejor tengan cuidado.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "75200066-e0a0-41d9-a37f-82139d0e6c47"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Commonly used to refer to the fruit, often in casual contexts like 'I ate an apple for lunch.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "6c559a40-59ab-4316-b362-3cbeece0cd9c", "textEn": "He ate a red apple.", "textEs": "Él comió una manzana roja.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "d98997ed-e220-48e7-a6cf-98c67059576e"}, {"id": "9e271519-a297-4394-af8c-cecd17ef1024", "textEn": "The apple is fresh.", "textEs": "La manzana está fresca.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "d98997ed-e220-48e7-a6cf-98c67059576e"}, {"id": "a193d461-d557-4d63-8792-59c701b2a26c", "textEn": "The apple fell from the tree with a soft thud.", "textEs": "La manzana cayó del árbol con un golpe suave.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "d98997ed-e220-48e7-a6cf-98c67059576e"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something covered or saturated with water, often in casual contexts like 'The ground is wet' or 'Don't touch it, it's wet.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "dc177e4b-87c5-42d0-8161-7b64a605234b", "textEn": "The grass is wet after the rain.", "textEs": "El césped está mojado después de la lluvia.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "f8776f43-7b59-4958-8af9-938d9f922284"}, {"id": "4e03424c-8e0d-49e9-8e66-9c07af75b837", "textEn": "Don't touch the wet paint.", "textEs": "No toques la pintura mojada.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "f8776f43-7b59-4958-8af9-938d9f922284"}, {"id": "ccce4a9f-9dde-4bd8-9627-e59a0abacdfd", "textEn": "The rain left the ground wet, so I had to wear boots.", "textEs": "La lluvia dejó el suelo mojado, así que tuve que usar botas.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "f8776f43-7b59-4958-8af9-938d9f922284"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a piece of clothing worn on the foot, often in casual contexts like 'I need to find my other sock.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "9114827d-a7bc-42d2-a285-f97b1abf8660", "textEn": "I lost one sock in the laundry.", "textEs": "Perdí un calcetín en la lavandería.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "2ba8225f-509d-4c12-955f-cb48163d6620"}, {"id": "ba8b1e0f-d594-4065-9176-c4968d89aab0", "textEn": "He wore a red sock.", "textEs": "Él usó un calcetín rojo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "2ba8225f-509d-4c12-955f-cb48163d6620"}, {"id": "de816236-8915-4a2a-924f-ca8f5123d05e", "textEn": "I love the feel of a soft, woolly sock on a cold morning.", "textEs": "Me encanta la sensación de un calcetín suave y de lana en una mañana fría.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "2ba8225f-509d-4c12-955f-cb48163d6620"}]

flashcards.meaning: a causa de / por motivo de
flashcards.native_speech: Used in natural speech to mean 'because of' or 'due to,' often in formal or explanatory contexts, like 'The game was canceled on account of rain.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "287f1d6a-1e4e-4e13-94d5-4ab5b8c2f9e2", "textEn": "They stayed home on account of the storm.", "textEs": "Se quedaron en casa a causa de la tormenta.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "e7b8d002-7cac-4e44-9eb9-33505d671124"}, {"id": "48b3c627-0d5c-44e0-849e-3bc32184f202", "textEn": "On account of his injury, he couldn't play.", "textEs": "Debido a su lesión, no pudo jugar.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "e7b8d002-7cac-4e44-9eb9-33505d671124"}, {"id": "cdfaa97a-4453-4e5d-8844-94b3374d3888", "textEn": "The picnic was cancelled on account of the heavy rain.", "textEs": "El picnic fue cancelado a causa de la fuerte lluvia.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "e7b8d002-7cac-4e44-9eb9-33505d671124"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to indicate position in a sequence, often with a slight emphasis on the 'th' sound, and can be clipped in fast speech.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "9f4a28f0-c2fb-4153-b970-e779b6f77dcd", "textEn": "This is the third time I've called you.", "textEs": "Esta es la tercera vez que te llamo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "f3d51cb8-c1e2-451f-a2b6-08ede0b02fa7"}, {"id": "aeadb326-49b7-4add-900c-99a790749b86", "textEn": "He finished third in the race.", "textEs": "Él terminó tercero en la carrera.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "f3d51cb8-c1e2-451f-a2b6-08ede0b02fa7"}, {"id": "02ed9a30-f15e-42d1-ba18-a46d1940ec26", "textEn": "I third that motion; let's move forward with the plan.", "textEs": "Apoyo esa moción; sigamos adelante con el plan.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "f3d51cb8-c1e2-451f-a2b6-08ede0b02fa7"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally when you can't remember or don't know the name of something, like a placeholder word.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "e7b4a787-b7f7-47fe-bc27-da89706a9a13", "textEn": "Can you pass me the whatchamacallit on the table?", "textEs": "¿Me pasas la cosa esa de la mesa?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "d95f69f7-17ae-4eac-9367-38e27a833d71"}, {"id": "ae7ded8a-f1ba-43ba-a5c9-8437fa295c78", "textEn": "I need to fix the whatchamacallit in the car.", "textEs": "Necesito arreglar el como se llame del coche.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "d95f69f7-17ae-4eac-9367-38e27a833d71"}, {"id": "aa0ea3ef-170e-4f13-ae65-ae3ece0331cb", "textEn": "Can you hand me that whatchamacallit on the table?", "textEs": "¿Puedes pasarme ese coso que está en la mesa?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "d95f69f7-17ae-4eac-9367-38e27a833d71"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the period of being young, or a young person, often in formal or descriptive contexts.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "e1455df5-b719-4cc1-9736-62cd97114942", "textEn": "Youth is a time of learning.", "textEs": "La juventud es una época de aprendizaje.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "154b2eb6-ca3e-444e-ad77-34324d1b6578"}, {"id": "2ed91475-2604-44e2-a80c-706013a525c1", "textEn": "The youth center offers many activities.", "textEs": "El centro juvenil ofrece muchas actividades.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "154b2eb6-ca3e-444e-ad77-34324d1b6578"}, {"id": "d2a88242-ba9b-432f-9643-852090a34d3d", "textEn": "The youth of today are incredibly passionate about climate change.", "textEs": "Los jóvenes de hoy están increíblemente apasionados por el cambio climático.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "154b2eb6-ca3e-444e-ad77-34324d1b6578"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in formal or written contexts to mean 'as a result of that' or 'by that means,' often linking a cause to an effect.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "766aa661-ff99-47b6-aa68-5e3fb85b2737", "textEn": "He improved his diet, thereby boosting his energy.", "textEs": "Mejoró su dieta, aumentando así su energía.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "83553c29-6ba7-4b0d-a7a8-7b7987eb5390"}, {"id": "4dacfd63-29ce-4d56-af6e-fa80e99201a1", "textEn": "The company cut costs, thereby increasing profits.", "textEs": "La empresa redujo costos, aumentando así las ganancias.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "83553c29-6ba7-4b0d-a7a8-7b7987eb5390"}, {"id": "7bef7b4a-142a-41ac-9989-6198955df2e5", "textEn": "He studied hard, thereby passing the exam with flying colors.", "textEs": "Estudió mucho, aprobando así el examen con excelentes notas.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "83553c29-6ba7-4b0d-a7a8-7b7987eb5390"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to introduce a logical conclusion or justification, often in formal or explanatory contexts, like 'For this reason, we decided to cancel the event.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "ea7593ae-90ad-4112-aeca-e382419ffbb0", "textEn": "The roads are icy; for this reason, drive carefully.", "textEs": "Las carreteras están heladas; por esta razón, conduce con cuidado.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "adc2097b-c361-4189-880e-9edef1f1f273"}, {"id": "8e172b1f-3b9f-4486-b634-e74eadbd70eb", "textEn": "She loves animals; for this reason, she became a vet.", "textEs": "Ella ama a los animales; por esta razón, se convirtió en veterinaria.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "adc2097b-c361-4189-880e-9edef1f1f273"}, {"id": "3957cc3d-fa58-44d9-bb8e-aa2ad30c9c1b", "textEn": "The weather was terrible; for this reason, we decided to stay indoors.", "textEs": "El clima era terrible; por esta razón, decidimos quedarnos en casa.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "adc2097b-c361-4189-880e-9edef1f1f273"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to introduce a brief summary or concise explanation of something, often after a longer discussion.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "c73d7d31-be5b-4067-ab31-9d475b7f357a", "textEn": "In a nutshell, the project was a success.", "textEs": "En pocas palabras, el proyecto fue un éxito.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "f628e532-caa8-4dd5-baed-e29b7cbe418c"}, {"id": "7606bb9c-6f30-4ab4-956b-10f94e16864b", "textEn": "She explained the theory in a nutshell.", "textEs": "Ella explicó la teoría en pocas palabras.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "f628e532-caa8-4dd5-baed-e29b7cbe418c"}, {"id": "2f23420f-2064-458c-ae7a-a843d072f33d", "textEn": "In a nutshell, the project failed due to poor planning and lack of funds.", "textEs": "En pocas palabras, el proyecto fracasó debido a una mala planificación y falta de fondos.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "f628e532-caa8-4dd5-baed-e29b7cbe418c"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to summarize or conclude, meaning 'considering everything' or 'overall'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "242fb0f0-f583-4e0f-a9f5-292e8efe12b6", "textEn": "All in all, it was a great vacation.", "textEs": "En general, fueron unas grandes vacaciones.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "a066fcea-c264-417f-a5d5-9ea472d0f3e3"}, {"id": "be71517b-0a6b-4542-9454-e043c7489826", "textEn": "All in all, we learned a lot from the experience.", "textEs": "Todo considerado, aprendimos mucho de la experiencia.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "a066fcea-c264-417f-a5d5-9ea472d0f3e3"}, {"id": "0c6c5547-5eaf-4a7a-8613-fac14db27965", "textEn": "All in all, it was a great vacation despite the rain.", "textEs": "En general, fue unas excelentes vacaciones a pesar de la lluvia.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "a066fcea-c264-417f-a5d5-9ea472d0f3e3"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to mean 'arrive' or 'appear,' often casually, like 'He didn't show up to the party.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "abbdcae4-f2d2-45f6-acd7-32a8cd91fc1b", "textEn": "She didn't show up to the party.", "textEs": "Ella no apareció en la fiesta.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "11ce2a80-1bae-4ff2-a443-19e8449f5fcc"}, {"id": "063a00e9-2a62-4e63-b446-9cbb5bee87c3", "textEn": "Make sure to show up on time.", "textEs": "Asegúrate de llegar a tiempo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "11ce2a80-1bae-4ff2-a443-19e8449f5fcc"}, {"id": "e3ca5824-7cdc-478d-a8ef-4ba6d37ecc51", "textEn": "I was worried he wouldn't show up on time, but he came right at 8.", "textEs": "Me preocupaba que no llegara a tiempo, pero vino justo a las 8.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "11ce2a80-1bae-4ff2-a443-19e8449f5fcc"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to introduce a concise restatement of key points, often in formal or structured speech.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "7150f559-3dbf-4be2-99fd-caec4991fc84", "textEn": "To summarize, we need more time.", "textEs": "Para resumir, necesitamos más tiempo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "92ce70af-1a41-4d57-8c2f-24a87510bf26"}, {"id": "a97afb24-1681-4bb7-aa93-62369ac22156", "textEn": "To summarize the report, sales increased.", "textEs": "Para resumir el informe, las ventas aumentaron.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "92ce70af-1a41-4d57-8c2f-24a87510bf26"}, {"id": "2d53c18c-211f-4f52-acfa-942970bac17a", "textEn": "To summarize, the main points of the presentation were the budget cuts and new marketing strategy.", "textEs": "Para resumir, los puntos principales de la presentación fueron los recortes presupuestarios y la nueva estrategia de marketing.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "92ce70af-1a41-4d57-8c2f-24a87510bf26"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to introduce a concise summary or conclusion, often in formal or professional contexts.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "6f1e12f9-3ac5-4c72-98bd-26c84af0c3b0", "textEn": "In brief, the meeting was productive.", "textEs": "En resumen, la reunión fue productiva.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "50373588-106e-4d36-9931-708871cf3571"}, {"id": "cd78665d-a6e1-4984-bf97-2d381e63ceb1", "textEn": "In brief, he accepted the offer.", "textEs": "En resumen, él aceptó la oferta.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "50373588-106e-4d36-9931-708871cf3571"}, {"id": "0b30f9cb-d504-4c9d-98ad-a448556ce4a4", "textEn": "In brief, the meeting was a success.", "textEs": "En resumen, la reunión fue un éxito.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "50373588-106e-4d36-9931-708871cf3571"}]

flashcards.meaning: la conclusión es, lo esencial es
flashcards.native_speech: Used to introduce the most important point or final conclusion, often in discussions or arguments.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "ffeb8a35-04c3-494a-87aa-db8e0536b61e", "textEn": "The bottom line is we need to cut costs.", "textEs": "La conclusión es que necesitamos reducir costos.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "04b88067-3b6a-46fa-a879-ceb5db113568"}, {"id": "c14aa7db-a3bc-4179-93d5-6681f132d05a", "textEn": "The bottom line is that he was right.", "textEs": "Lo esencial es que él tenía razón.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "04b88067-3b6a-46fa-a879-ceb5db113568"}, {"id": "86824958-9c69-4428-9768-37f76d362463", "textEn": "The bottom line is that we need to increase sales by 20% this quarter.", "textEs": "La conclusión es que necesitamos aumentar las ventas en un 20% este trimestre.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "04b88067-3b6a-46fa-a879-ceb5db113568"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe something stopping working, like a machine, or to analyze something in detail, often in casual or technical contexts.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "5caeaf03-47e8-4d65-9638-c8dfc954f8ba", "textEn": "My car broke down on the highway.", "textEs": "Mi coche se descompuso en la autopista.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "f4071b1c-46de-4241-8c79-dbc76cdaa98d"}, {"id": "60c0d8ff-0009-4078-9ca1-a465d5d2c04b", "textEn": "Let me break down the problem for you.", "textEs": "Déjame analizar el problema para ti.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "f4071b1c-46de-4241-8c79-dbc76cdaa98d"}, {"id": "c5433551-2640-4554-a05b-0c889bc56ac0", "textEn": "I need to break down the problem into smaller parts so I can solve it.", "textEs": "Necesito desglosar el problema en partes más pequeñas para poder resolverlo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "f4071b1c-46de-4241-8c79-dbc76cdaa98d"}]

flashcards.expression: to cut a long story short
flashcards.native_speech: Used to skip unnecessary details and get to the main point, often after a lengthy explanation.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "47dd18dc-218f-403f-a01d-833c35c9cad6", "textEn": "To cut a long story short, we missed the flight.", "textEs": "Para hacerla corta, perdimos el vuelo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "90c409df-8fde-4473-bef5-1cb190e4c1cb"}, {"id": "0c5249e9-6d1c-4bca-9c80-3c1158f64b4e", "textEn": "To cut a long story short, he got the job.", "textEs": "Para hacerla corta, él consiguió el trabajo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "90c409df-8fde-4473-bef5-1cb190e4c1cb"}, {"id": "98aa2377-d823-4e11-83bc-1e7ebb597e87", "textEn": "To cut a long story short, we missed the last train and had to walk home.", "textEs": "Para no hacer un cuento largo, perdimos el último tren y tuvimos que caminar a casa.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "90c409df-8fde-4473-bef5-1cb190e4c1cb"}]

flashcards.expression: I'd like to walk you through
flashcards.meaning: me gustaría guiarlos a través de
flashcards.native_speech: Used to introduce a step-by-step explanation or presentation, often in professional or instructional contexts.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "f1caa85f-db5f-4d09-8fd1-87b321b5d644", "textEn": "I'd like to walk you through the key points of this proposal.", "textEs": "Me gustaría guiarlos a través de los puntos clave de esta propuesta.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "0487447c-e72c-4c35-b796-649ffe5cad24"}, {"id": "d99abf2b-ce18-4a79-9fff-feec4c3f9d5a", "textEn": "First, I'd like to walk you through the timeline for the project.", "textEs": "Primero, me gustaría guiarlos a través del cronograma del proyecto.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "0487447c-e72c-4c35-b796-649ffe5cad24"}, {"id": "49710909-ee73-450a-859d-92c5cf3ae31e", "textEn": "I'd like to walk you through the main features of our new software.", "textEs": "Me gustaría guiarlo a través de las principales características de nuestro nuevo software.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "0487447c-e72c-4c35-b796-649ffe5cad24"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to signal a transition to a new topic or point, often in conversations or presentations, implying the speaker is about to finish the current subject.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "702606a8-7d51-4407-ab64-98fa0ad99ce1", "textEn": "Before I move on, does anyone have questions about this section?", "textEs": "Antes de continuar, ¿alguien tiene preguntas sobre esta sección?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "aac1e9f2-a1f3-477d-a70a-48230b597f2e"}, {"id": "273d6a4f-023a-41b8-aad6-a6b310ee6de8", "textEn": "Before I move on, let me highlight one more detail.", "textEs": "Antes de continuar, déjenme resaltar un detalle más.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "aac1e9f2-a1f3-477d-a70a-48230b597f2e"}, {"id": "cc28b118-22da-4d0f-a331-3b013c0c58ad", "textEn": "Before I move on, let me clarify one more point.", "textEs": "Antes de continuar, déjame aclarar un punto más.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "aac1e9f2-a1f3-477d-a70a-48230b597f2e"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to introduce a concise conclusion or recap of key points, often in formal or structured speech.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "f167303a-ec3e-43f1-af67-de733adb1408", "textEn": "In summary, the experiment failed.", "textEs": "En resumen, el experimento falló.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "f6063362-10b4-4f74-9ec7-c4db72f01738"}, {"id": "44a1b00c-7550-4567-aaf1-04a407d9b18c", "textEn": "In summary, we achieved our goals.", "textEs": "En resumen, logramos nuestros objetivos.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "f6063362-10b4-4f74-9ec7-c4db72f01738"}, {"id": "ea23b21a-ea5c-475c-b745-bdf67871d8d6", "textEn": "In summary, the project was a success despite the initial challenges.", "textEs": "En resumen, el proyecto fue un éxito a pesar de los desafíos iniciales.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "f6063362-10b4-4f74-9ec7-c4db72f01738"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to signal the end of a discussion or presentation, often in formal or academic settings.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "13602f99-6bcf-41e6-9b8f-0202651054d8", "textEn": "To conclude, the evidence is clear.", "textEs": "Para concluir, la evidencia es clara.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "4263f665-bc60-48ae-96b5-fd29f38b25bc"}, {"id": "53f9c086-8636-49ad-9c2d-849fa1bce838", "textEn": "To conclude, we must act now.", "textEs": "Para concluir, debemos actuar ahora.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "4263f665-bc60-48ae-96b5-fd29f38b25bc"}, {"id": "4f26abee-96ea-4e88-8139-36ee0615a4d4", "textEn": "To conclude, I believe that the evidence strongly supports our argument.", "textEs": "Para concluir, creo que la evidencia respalda firmemente nuestro argumento.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "4263f665-bc60-48ae-96b5-fd29f38b25bc"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in meetings to mean either to postpone discussion (US) or to bring up for discussion (UK), often said to move the agenda forward.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "30205eae-abc6-49a8-975e-0597b576b9f6", "textEn": "Let's table this item until the next meeting.", "textEs": "Pospongamos este tema hasta la próxima reunión.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "185f3aac-6143-471b-8b39-09f150a573bd"}, {"id": "6ff6c2e8-51fa-4322-96bd-b7c3c4159d66", "textEn": "I move to table this item for now.", "textEs": "Propongo posponer este tema por ahora.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "185f3aac-6143-471b-8b39-09f150a573bd"}, {"id": "7f44c07c-2aaf-49c5-beef-37c8c45d306b", "textEn": "I move to table this item until we have more information.", "textEs": "Propongo posponer este asunto hasta que tengamos más información.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "185f3aac-6143-471b-8b39-09f150a573bd"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a placeholder for an object whose name is forgotten or unknown, often in casual conversation.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "c46a863a-8790-4186-bb8d-ba90bf6787a8", "textEn": "Hand me that thingamabob over there.", "textEs": "Pásame ese coso de allá.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "17aecd70-241e-409d-b6b2-349fc334be3d"}, {"id": "7c9fc60d-8238-432a-90cc-60032a0273e0", "textEn": "I lost the thingamabob for the blender.", "textEs": "Perdí el chisme de la licuadora.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "17aecd70-241e-409d-b6b2-349fc334be3d"}, {"id": "ce04d58d-c243-405f-ace2-340abda7c6ad", "textEn": "Can you hand me that thingamabob on the desk?", "textEs": "¿Me puedes pasar ese coso que está en el escritorio?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "17aecd70-241e-409d-b6b2-349fc334be3d"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to the physical, mental, and spiritual practice originating in ancient India, often in casual conversation about exercise or relaxation.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "0a5ce9a2-f81a-423c-9ea0-d62757fee1ae", "textEn": "She does yoga every morning.", "textEs": "Ella hace yoga cada mañana.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "8ef75fa8-df96-4cee-b5a9-66e9af68c370"}, {"id": "1feb1d74-3a0b-4b7f-b2d8-8e7c8a668b58", "textEn": "Yoga helps me relax.", "textEs": "El yoga me ayuda a relajarme.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "8ef75fa8-df96-4cee-b5a9-66e9af68c370"}, {"id": "ff0d38ce-a52f-4f06-b90e-0e2d4c013def", "textEn": "I do yoga every morning to stretch and relax.", "textEs": "Hago yoga cada mañana para estirarme y relajarme.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "8ef75fa8-df96-4cee-b5a9-66e9af68c370"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to cancel or abandon something that was planned, like an event or activity.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "951dd590-ba62-45dc-a24a-cc81a12f9fc8", "textEn": "They called off the wedding.", "textEs": "Cancelaron la boda.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "2d843b48-86de-4740-a058-72802afedae9"}, {"id": "210433e6-57de-46c5-a48b-e441844750df", "textEn": "We should call off the search.", "textEs": "Deberíamos cancelar la búsqueda.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "2d843b48-86de-4740-a058-72802afedae9"}, {"id": "de3eaeb1-45b9-4d9f-90c2-0b10c5280ebe", "textEn": "They had to call off the picnic because of the heavy rain.", "textEs": "Tuvieron que cancelar el picnic debido a la fuerte lluvia.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "2d843b48-86de-4740-a058-72802afedae9"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to mean completing missing information, like in forms or blanks, or temporarily substituting for someone.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "44b30a8a-b90b-4a84-ad5f-4baddf0ac252", "textEn": "Fill me in on what happened.", "textEs": "Ponme al día sobre lo que pasó.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "d379a09e-7f1d-4707-9f19-f6c4e30ce508"}, {"id": "c4d17f7e-e6cc-4952-8ae0-98d9c464314c", "textEn": "Please fill in the form.", "textEs": "Por favor, rellena el formulario.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "d379a09e-7f1d-4707-9f19-f6c4e30ce508"}, {"id": "c6b1d3a9-2e90-4427-a13c-5fe2012e0cc5", "textEn": "I need you to fill in the missing details on this form before I can process it.", "textEs": "Necesito que completes los detalles faltantes en este formulario antes de que pueda procesarlo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "d379a09e-7f1d-4707-9f19-f6c4e30ce508"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally to refer to a small object or gadget whose name is forgotten or unknown, often in casual conversation.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "ed4f81ae-d76c-465a-ac7b-e2e2c81a9167", "textEn": "This doohickey opens the bottle.", "textEs": "Este artilugio abre la botella.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "1389effb-80e1-438a-91a9-ae3e9345abdf"}, {"id": "eab7bd02-df89-4c1d-85d9-3266088384e3", "textEn": "Where's the doohickey for the tent?", "textEs": "¿Dónde está el cacharro para la tienda?", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "1389effb-80e1-438a-91a9-ae3e9345abdf"}, {"id": "56415833-e517-4037-bf40-43822df74d0a", "textEn": "Could you hand me that little doohickey on the table? I need it to fix this drawer.", "textEs": "¿Puedes pasarme ese chisme pequeño que está en la mesa? Lo necesito para arreglar este cajón.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "1389effb-80e1-438a-91a9-ae3e9345abdf"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally to mean briefly meeting or communicating with someone to update or check in, often in a work or social context.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "87cc0ed5-1b61-4110-b1e7-30343772e7ac", "textEn": "Let's touch base after the meeting.", "textEs": "Pongámonos en contacto brevemente después de la reunión.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "b13e162a-6fca-409d-8061-a6328642fb77"}, {"id": "6f5e5521-aa74-47ee-aeea-955aff89a26a", "textEn": "I'll touch base with the team tomorrow.", "textEs": "Me pondré en contacto brevemente con el equipo mañana.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "b13e162a-6fca-409d-8061-a6328642fb77"}, {"id": "b899dbe8-92c9-42c8-89ae-85fd387d4f31", "textEn": "Let's touch base next week to see how the project is progressing.", "textEs": "Pongámonos en contacto la próxima semana para ver cómo va el proyecto.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "b13e162a-6fca-409d-8061-a6328642fb77"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refuse an offer or request, or to reduce the volume or intensity of something.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "16ea19d1-8edb-48a0-a604-4206fb303cdd", "textEn": "She turned down the job offer.", "textEs": "Ella rechazó la oferta de trabajo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "7f60d606-7b54-4916-8509-0dfb475de898"}, {"id": "44063699-e373-468d-b8ef-a4ef73f0fa49", "textEn": "Can you turn down the music?", "textEs": "¿Puedes bajar el volumen de la música?", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "7f60d606-7b54-4916-8509-0dfb475de898"}, {"id": "54a940ca-88ff-493e-b4c9-03982bdd1cc3", "textEn": "She turned down the job offer because the salary was too low.", "textEs": "Ella rechazó la oferta de trabajo porque el salario era demasiado bajo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "7f60d606-7b54-4916-8509-0dfb475de898"}]

flashcards.expression: to put a pin in it
flashcards.native_speech: Used to suggest temporarily pausing a discussion or idea to revisit later, often in meetings or brainstorming sessions.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "4fe281bc-71c4-4e80-b77d-bd4a9822cd23", "textEn": "Let's put a pin in it and move on.", "textEs": "Dejémoslo pendiente y sigamos adelante.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "ee31fa48-4002-45a0-9f22-c12faf1fd6b0"}, {"id": "b524deb9-0475-457d-9177-b8baf2496045", "textEn": "We can put a pin in that idea for now.", "textEs": "Podemos dejar esa idea pendiente por ahora.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "ee31fa48-4002-45a0-9f22-c12faf1fd6b0"}, {"id": "e489f06a-aca1-443a-8968-905aa3d69272", "textEn": "Let's put a pin in that topic for now and come back to it after lunch.", "textEs": "Dejemos ese tema en pausa por ahora y retomémoslo después del almuerzo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "ee31fa48-4002-45a0-9f22-c12faf1fd6b0"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to express tentative agreement, uncertainty, or a reluctant conclusion in casual conversation.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "4ba8240e-eaae-4e42-a46b-1fa72663b8b0", "textEn": "I guess we could try that.", "textEs": "Supongo que podríamos intentar eso.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "7bb44b01-777a-4ff8-9fbe-4921e6c7dac8"}, {"id": "fa6b7a5c-b1ef-4ac3-a953-ad8ad1d79de4", "textEn": "It's, I guess, a bit complicated.", "textEs": "Es, supongo, un poco complicado.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "7bb44b01-777a-4ff8-9fbe-4921e6c7dac8"}, {"id": "084ac030-16c9-41c4-aeca-b371ce2d02eb", "textEn": "I guess we'll have to wait and see what happens.", "textEs": "Supongo que tendremos que esperar y ver qué pasa.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "7bb44b01-777a-4ff8-9fbe-4921e6c7dac8"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in meetings to suggest discussing a topic later, outside the current conversation.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "867a5c58-145b-407b-adb8-64a996b516c0", "textEn": "Let's take it offline and discuss later.", "textEs": "Discutámoslo fuera de la reunión y hablemos después.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "ce051a9f-cfb6-4b60-aef1-21e7ebb557e2"}, {"id": "6549d8c8-af79-4c40-9ffa-6d388bc5a1d6", "textEn": "I suggest we take this offline.", "textEs": "Sugiero que discutamos esto fuera de la reunión.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "ce051a9f-cfb6-4b60-aef1-21e7ebb557e2"}, {"id": "795cf1a5-81ff-4611-bb94-5808d34ebeb9", "textEn": "Let's take this discussion offline and continue it after the meeting.", "textEs": "Dejemos esta discusión para después de la reunión y continuémosla fuera de ella.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "ce051a9f-cfb6-4b60-aef1-21e7ebb557e2"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to mean quickly reviewing or rehearsing something, like 'Let's run through the plan again,' or to physically move through a space.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "d4abf913-6d4a-4c50-a3fe-f13a5375a86a", "textEn": "Let's run through the agenda quickly.", "textEs": "Repasemos rápidamente la agenda.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "cb39f715-8977-495c-82ee-46e13907e161"}, {"id": "d3a3ae1c-fa9b-445d-b6c0-b0cbba3c2a21", "textEn": "I'll run through the main points.", "textEs": "Repasaré rápidamente los puntos principales.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "cb39f715-8977-495c-82ee-46e13907e161"}, {"id": "dc4fd9f1-caa0-48f4-8263-03611d8c686e", "textEn": "Let me just run through the main points of the presentation before we begin.", "textEs": "Déjame repasar los puntos principales de la presentación antes de empezar.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "cb39f715-8977-495c-82ee-46e13907e161"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a placeholder noun when you can't remember or don't know the exact name of something, like 'Pass me that thingy over there.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "b982bbcf-b613-426e-9ecf-c721efc5a2a4", "textEn": "Can you grab that thingy for me?", "textEs": "¿Puedes agarrar esa cosita para mí?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "81f22209-c7ef-42ae-a48e-67618d108506"}, {"id": "4a367f4c-a77e-4dd1-a596-5511f357a1a6", "textEn": "The thingy on the remote is stuck.", "textEs": "El chisme del control está atascado.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "81f22209-c7ef-42ae-a48e-67618d108506"}, {"id": "e0916fcb-e278-45ae-aa94-c1c46105ea0c", "textEn": "Can you pass me that red thingy on the table?", "textEs": "¿Puedes pasarme esa cosita roja que está en la mesa?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "81f22209-c7ef-42ae-a48e-67618d108506"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a filler or discourse marker to draw attention to an explanation or point, often implying the listener should understand or agree.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "eec2cf29-b21d-4843-84a9-981cc1c6ad70", "textEn": "You see, it's not that simple.", "textEs": "Ves, no es tan simple.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "a8e85099-cc8c-4b7a-87b3-62da693a6317"}, {"id": "416d8a8f-2a76-4755-9378-0d756090f731", "textEn": "I was late, you see, because of traffic.", "textEs": "Llegué tarde, ves, por el tráfico.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "a8e85099-cc8c-4b7a-87b3-62da693a6317"}, {"id": "d39df581-e444-49b8-978e-ca56dd171b17", "textEn": "You see, the problem isn't just about money; it's about trust.", "textEs": "Verás, el problema no es solo el dinero; es la confianza.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "a8e85099-cc8c-4b7a-87b3-62da693a6317"}]

flashcards.meaning: incluir a alguien en la conversación
flashcards.native_speech: Used in workplace or group settings to mean including someone in a conversation, email thread, or decision-making process, often by adding them to a communication chain.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "f6501fb9-0dc4-4b87-846d-800de76d8214", "textEn": "Let's loop Sarah in on this discussion.", "textEs": "Incluyamos a Sarah en esta discusión.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "2df1e1ab-0347-403b-a454-2a47b35ea463"}, {"id": "21f14c75-4c8b-42ae-ab2f-72a0be58b6e0", "textEn": "I'll loop the manager in via email.", "textEs": "Incluiré al gerente por correo electrónico.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "2df1e1ab-0347-403b-a454-2a47b35ea463"}, {"id": "53ece388-65b8-4d3e-817a-28da9fc907ff", "textEn": "Could you please loop me in on that email thread about the new project?", "textEs": "¿Podrías incluirme en ese hilo de correo sobre el nuevo proyecto?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "2df1e1ab-0347-403b-a454-2a47b35ea463"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to introduce a key point, explanation, or problem in conversation, often with a slight pause after 'thing'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "6f0619ba-6e2e-4bd5-b950-30b8b4cc8f7f", "textEn": "The thing is, I don't have time.", "textEs": "La cosa es que no tengo tiempo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "7073c8d3-de08-4d2b-b0d8-f5aeb11db459"}, {"id": "928aaf5f-b50b-46ba-9975-455d30d58bec", "textEn": "The thing is, we need more money.", "textEs": "La cosa es que necesitamos más dinero.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "7073c8d3-de08-4d2b-b0d8-f5aeb11db459"}, {"id": "78841bdf-ef02-4599-8d9e-9e003784ef7a", "textEn": "The thing is, I really want to go, but I have too much work to do.", "textEs": "La cosa es que realmente quiero ir, pero tengo demasiado trabajo que hacer.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "7073c8d3-de08-4d2b-b0d8-f5aeb11db459"}]

flashcards.meaning: unirse para defenderse o resolver algo
flashcards.native_speech: Used metaphorically to describe a group uniting defensively against a perceived threat, often in business or politics.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "46e0d8fe-0c36-47df-aeae-f3d0456bdefc", "textEn": "We need to circle the wagons and solve this issue.", "textEs": "Necesitamos unirnos y resolver este problema.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "b0cb2087-d589-4e59-9f18-eb4f0aa9d9a3"}, {"id": "507392d2-931a-49c7-808b-bdc7a21dc499", "textEn": "Let's circle the wagons before the deadline.", "textEs": "Unámonos antes de la fecha límite.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "b0cb2087-d589-4e59-9f18-eb4f0aa9d9a3"}, {"id": "790e7ac9-0225-41e8-85d1-81cb1fa81706", "textEn": "When the project faced criticism, the team decided to circle the wagons and defend their work.", "textEs": "Cuando el proyecto enfrentó críticas, el equipo decidió cerrar filas y defender su trabajo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "b0cb2087-d589-4e59-9f18-eb4f0aa9d9a3"}]

flashcards.meaning: sabes a lo que me refiero
flashcards.native_speech: Used as a conversational filler or to check understanding, often at the end of a statement to confirm the listener agrees or follows.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "4e44f52a-7514-46ca-b669-9d076eab7ece", "textEn": "It's just stressful, you know what I mean?", "textEs": "Es estresante, ¿sabes a lo que me refiero?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "1abaffaa-6ce8-489e-9dc8-eddb222010fd"}, {"id": "a6f7bf1a-bc5e-4733-a654-d53f12a7c0fc", "textEn": "I need a break, you know what I mean?", "textEs": "Necesito un descanso, ¿sabes a lo que me refiero?", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "1abaffaa-6ce8-489e-9dc8-eddb222010fd"}, {"id": "2208fb75-b98d-46ae-a2c1-98531b1d9140", "textEn": "I'm just saying, sometimes you need to take a break, you know what I mean?", "textEs": "Solo digo que a veces necesitas tomarte un descanso, ¿sabes a lo que me refiero?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "1abaffaa-6ce8-489e-9dc8-eddb222010fd"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally to refer to a small, often novel or complex device or gadget, especially when the exact name is unknown or unimportant.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "8ba86f83-d914-4590-be3a-94aa87ca82c7", "textEn": "I bought a new gizmo for my phone.", "textEs": "Compré un nuevo chisme para mi teléfono.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "9b2b76ff-86ff-4749-9ad5-057aa2b0f084"}, {"id": "8c59b8eb-9743-4c18-af84-db802ffcfbda", "textEn": "That gizmo is supposed to save energy.", "textEs": "Se supone que ese aparato ahorra energía.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "9b2b76ff-86ff-4749-9ad5-057aa2b0f084"}, {"id": "1ad01f71-894a-49d6-8495-cf775c927fa3", "textEn": "I need to find a gizmo to open this bottle.", "textEs": "Necesito encontrar un artilugio para abrir esta botella.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "9b2b76ff-86ff-4749-9ad5-057aa2b0f084"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally as a placeholder for something whose name you can't recall or don't want to specify, like 'hand me that whatsit over there'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "e6177428-69c8-4177-b28c-38673443c389", "textEn": "Pass me the whatsit from the drawer.", "textEs": "Pásame la cosa esa del cajón.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "d5ee6bc3-1ce2-4356-b572-241a80302900"}, {"id": "ab623063-5cb8-4e53-bd9e-ccf74a1905e3", "textEn": "I forgot the name of the whatsit we used.", "textEs": "Olvidé el nombre del como se diga que usamos.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "d5ee6bc3-1ce2-4356-b572-241a80302900"}, {"id": "c1a6012f-dff9-4901-a8d1-b3a1439b36d5", "textEn": "I need to fix the whatsit on the car, but I can't remember its name.", "textEs": "Necesito arreglar el coso del coche, pero no recuerdo su nombre.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "d5ee6bc3-1ce2-4356-b572-241a80302900"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to a genre of music with improvisation and swing, or informally to describe something flashy or exaggerated.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "77ed758d-5dcb-4b1c-a36e-12240f71d6fa", "textEn": "All that jazz about the project is confusing.", "textEs": "Todo ese rollo del proyecto es confuso.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "c755f0ea-a5bf-4de3-998a-b9fd398176ee"}, {"id": "36a3df28-14b4-4dfc-bf75-19f785af4708", "textEn": "I don't need all the jazz, just the facts.", "textEs": "No necesito todas esas cosas, solo los hechos.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "c755f0ea-a5bf-4de3-998a-b9fd398176ee"}, {"id": "dfd25fbc-a863-4e80-b07f-f997e1fb222c", "textEn": "Let's cut the jazz and get straight to the point.", "textEs": "Dejemos las tonterías y vayamos al grano.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "c755f0ea-a5bf-4de3-998a-b9fd398176ee"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a generic placeholder for any small manufactured item or hypothetical object, especially in technical or business contexts.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "30e287d2-1812-4646-8c46-6617525bd58d", "textEn": "The widget on the dashboard is broken.", "textEs": "El adminículo del tablero está roto.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "373d4be9-9002-437c-aa41-15cbdc016692"}, {"id": "6eb19348-6c5e-4841-b10f-970a5d7cd3a2", "textEn": "I need a widget to attach this part.", "textEs": "Necesito un cacharro para unir esta pieza.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "373d4be9-9002-437c-aa41-15cbdc016692"}, {"id": "c016990d-9432-44d3-94c3-fcdae126e16c", "textEn": "I need to order a new widget for the machine; the old one broke yesterday.", "textEs": "Necesito pedir un nuevo artilugio para la máquina; el viejo se rompió ayer.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "373d4be9-9002-437c-aa41-15cbdc016692"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally to refer to a small object or gadget when its name is unknown or forgotten, like 'hand me that doodad over there.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "cb6534f5-a036-4e90-a256-b8dba5bc193b", "textEn": "This doodad is for decoration only.", "textEs": "Esta chuchería es solo decorativa.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "0799aeec-46af-47f1-9751-4489ebf0748c"}, {"id": "ffe593e7-c276-4922-ba94-3069e726db00", "textEn": "I found a doodad in the toolbox.", "textEs": "Encontré un adminículo en la caja de herramientas.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "0799aeec-46af-47f1-9751-4489ebf0748c"}, {"id": "26e0cafb-87da-46d5-9d13-8f1adf38d598", "textEn": "Can you hand me that little doodad next to the toolbox?", "textEs": "¿Puedes pasarme ese cosito que está al lado de la caja de herramientas?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "0799aeec-46af-47f1-9751-4489ebf0748c"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a placeholder for an object whose name you can't remember or don't know, often in casual conversation.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "0b55eda2-631e-40c1-8204-899ce5cc0082", "textEn": "I need that thingamajig to fix the sink.", "textEs": "Necesito ese coso para arreglar el lavabo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "48f68bad-0d87-4eb7-a47d-812ecaee5f37"}, {"id": "75c4c86a-87ff-4485-b318-25d7af7d7f57", "textEn": "Where did you put the thingamajig?", "textEs": "¿Dónde pusiste el chisme?", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "48f68bad-0d87-4eb7-a47d-812ecaee5f37"}, {"id": "87b5793b-c3ca-44e6-9718-3f18d35f1e55", "textEn": "Can you hand me that thingamajig on the table?", "textEs": "¿Puedes pasarme ese coso de la mesa?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "48f68bad-0d87-4eb7-a47d-812ecaee5f37"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally to address a group of people, often with a tone of mild annoyance, affection, or camaraderie, like 'you bunch of idiots' or 'you bunch of friends'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "0e1700ba-4f88-4de1-94f3-2177e6f926bd", "textEn": "You bunch are hilarious!", "textEs": "¡Ustedes son muy divertidos!", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "7f092108-94c7-4110-bac4-ffb2541b3678"}, {"id": "566871a5-583e-465a-8dd0-6764730ff040", "textEn": "You bunch need to calm down.", "textEs": "Ustedes necesitan calmarse.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "7f092108-94c7-4110-bac4-ffb2541b3678"}, {"id": "4a8902b6-9f71-4fdc-b3d7-90b168c0e7aa", "textEn": "You bunch are always causing trouble in class.", "textEs": "Ustedes, grupo, siempre están causando problemas en clase.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "7f092108-94c7-4110-bac4-ffb2541b3678"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally to call out or address a group of people, often in a playful or teasing manner, like 'you guys' or 'you lot'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "1f33b6da-d1c3-499d-9660-b7acf2572211", "textEn": "What's up, you crew?", "textEs": "¿Qué tal, ustedes?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "4b60dbd7-ed8d-46b4-b69f-208e92bb7e3e"}, {"id": "6d51fde4-1998-46ba-8372-5cb5516da90e", "textEn": "You crew ready to roll?", "textEs": "¿Ustedes listos para arrancar?", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "4b60dbd7-ed8d-46b4-b69f-208e92bb7e3e"}, {"id": "31d5624d-5da9-487b-8a89-441f4a1119ec", "textEn": "You crew is always causing trouble around here.", "textEs": "Tu pandilla siempre está causando problemas por aquí.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "4b60dbd7-ed8d-46b4-b69f-208e92bb7e3e"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally in Australian or British English to address a group of people, similar to 'you guys' or 'you all'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "d077f3ec-dec7-48e1-b2e4-4001a9943687", "textEn": "Alright, you mob, listen up!", "textEs": "¡Bien, ustedes, escuchen!", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "bcf2be6a-bcaa-4ab8-a98f-3a34f55436f0"}, {"id": "3584c902-72ed-4a4b-bb9f-b2cba905da25", "textEn": "You mob coming to the party?", "textEs": "¿Ustedes vienen a la fiesta?", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "bcf2be6a-bcaa-4ab8-a98f-3a34f55436f0"}, {"id": "2fc3c13e-1525-4259-9669-efb2dd4045a0", "textEn": "Alright, you mob, listen up—we've got a lot of work to do today.", "textEs": "Bien, muchachos, escuchen—tenemos mucho trabajo que hacer hoy.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "bcf2be6a-bcaa-4ab8-a98f-3a34f55436f0"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally to address a close group of friends or teammates, often in a playful or affirming way.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "80175dc7-988a-4f91-a986-e8d646be2cb4", "textEn": "You squad always got my back.", "textEs": "Ustedes siempre me apoyan.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "caba6d24-e6cd-4f9d-a56e-438558d68ee2"}, {"id": "a7cb5303-4c73-4b0e-ad81-9eb8fbf292c2", "textEn": "You squad coming to the game?", "textEs": "¿Ustedes vienen al partido?", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "caba6d24-e6cd-4f9d-a56e-438558d68ee2"}, {"id": "1883c5e0-4c68-43d3-807f-244a04f4c2d5", "textEn": "You squad is always down to help when someone's in need.", "textEs": "Tu grupo siempre está dispuesto a ayudar cuando alguien lo necesita.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "caba6d24-e6cd-4f9d-a56e-438558d68ee2"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally to address or rally a group, like in sports or work contexts, meaning 'you all as a team'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "789bdf11-e03b-45d7-a708-232a53fab6a7", "textEn": "Great job, you team!", "textEs": "¡Buen trabajo, equipo!", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "e13bb240-e7b0-40d6-97f6-1621c65f2db6"}, {"id": "7d07b589-9769-42ca-83df-0095e9f29895", "textEn": "You team need to finish this by noon.", "textEs": "Ustedes necesitan terminar esto al mediodía.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "e13bb240-e7b0-40d6-97f6-1621c65f2db6"}, {"id": "84764b78-655f-40b3-a167-79be9b6ff7f4", "textEn": "You team up with Sarah for the project, and I'll handle the rest.", "textEs": "Tú te asocias con Sarah para el proyecto, y yo me encargo del resto.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "e13bb240-e7b0-40d6-97f6-1621c65f2db6"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to mean successfully achieving something difficult or surprising, like 'He pulled off the deal.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "3873a9af-cfbf-4c04-9c84-4310bfb23aa5", "textEn": "I can't believe you pulled off that prank!", "textEs": "¡No puedo creer que hayas logrado esa broma!", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "814ab071-6481-4699-9a08-1a4c8ca7b221"}, {"id": "2ac2f6b5-097b-4e31-9a3f-dc1dd78ba94e", "textEn": "She pulled off the presentation despite being nervous.", "textEs": "Logró la presentación a pesar de estar nerviosa.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "814ab071-6481-4699-9a08-1a4c8ca7b221"}, {"id": "650201a5-3b4c-4e80-9b6e-91963a43d950", "textEn": "I can't believe we managed to pull off the surprise party without her finding out.", "textEs": "No puedo creer que logramos llevar a cabo la fiesta sorpresa sin que ella se diera cuenta.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "814ab071-6481-4699-9a08-1a4c8ca7b221"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally to mean contacting someone, often via text or call, or to suggest going somewhere together, like 'hit me up later' or 'let's hit up the store'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "a7d35fa3-3ff9-4ce1-a088-ca265afd3931", "textEn": "Hit me up when you get the tickets.", "textEs": "Contáctame cuando consigas los boletos.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "ca164578-f099-42e5-9e1b-2b6fe3459f19"}, {"id": "eefade5f-d601-4563-b4bc-ec6c5af0de77", "textEn": "I'll hit up my friend to see if he's free.", "textEs": "Le escribiré a mi amigo para ver si está libre.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "ca164578-f099-42e5-9e1b-2b6fe3459f19"}, {"id": "d0f5b9f8-ee2d-4a8b-8c17-1a381aefabcf", "textEn": "I'm going to hit up the grocery store on my way home.", "textEs": "Voy a pasar por el supermercado de camino a casa.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "ca164578-f099-42e5-9e1b-2b6fe3459f19"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe a strong emotional reaction, like panic, anger, or excitement, often in informal contexts.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "4d4fec32-cf47-4a26-bda5-9f05022bee3d", "textEn": "Don't freak out, but I lost your keys.", "textEs": "No te asustes, pero perdí tus llaves.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "89ecd16b-ed70-400c-8b2e-8c71db5d0a02"}, {"id": "8c61ee21-d421-46b1-a2db-89dfc59db050", "textEn": "She freaked out when she saw the spider.", "textEs": "Se asustó cuando vio la araña.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "89ecd16b-ed70-400c-8b2e-8c71db5d0a02"}, {"id": "f4143136-77de-4d34-bbf9-e800136a0a2a", "textEn": "Don't freak out, but I accidentally spilled coffee on your laptop.", "textEs": "No te asustes, pero derramé café accidentalmente en tu computadora portátil.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "89ecd16b-ed70-400c-8b2e-8c71db5d0a02"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally to address a group of friends or peers, often in a playful or teasing manner.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "b0742bcc-3553-4599-b040-3c6cc1f183ce", "textEn": "Hey, you gang, what's the plan?", "textEs": "Oigan, ustedes, ¿cuál es el plan?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "177d3237-3a7b-4bea-8944-f799717cd5b0"}, {"id": "bad59209-6ef0-49cd-83f5-d517a1d31102", "textEn": "You gang better behave.", "textEs": "Ustedes mejor se portan bien.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "177d3237-3a7b-4bea-8944-f799717cd5b0"}, {"id": "45d85b10-0766-46d6-bac1-5de8aed62e64", "textEn": "You gang, stop messing around and get to work.", "textEs": "Ustedes, pandilla, dejen de perder el tiempo y pónganse a trabajar.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "177d3237-3a7b-4bea-8944-f799717cd5b0"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally in British English to address a group of people, similar to 'you guys' or 'y'all' in other dialects.
