flashcards.examples: [{"id": "d520f28a-3942-499e-a292-80b57a9c5c56", "textEn": "You lot are always late.", "textEs": "Ustedes siempre llegan tarde.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "998e7b3b-be5b-459f-a22c-0dddc570e9cb"}, {"id": "55549d88-e2b7-421c-839c-4d748fd86b04", "textEn": "What are you lot up to?", "textEs": "¿Qué están haciendo ustedes?", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "998e7b3b-be5b-459f-a22c-0dddc570e9cb"}, {"id": "998c6f6a-d14c-4619-8044-1902ace5b111", "textEn": "What are you lot up to this weekend?", "textEs": "¿Qué estáis haciendo este fin de semana vosotros?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "998e7b3b-be5b-459f-a22c-0dddc570e9cb"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally to accuse someone of being in a group or clique, often playfully or with mild annoyance.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "69d8c040-2d99-430d-ace2-3854ba02d104", "textEn": "You posse always travel together.", "textEs": "Ustedes siempre viajan juntos.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "2a5caec3-d0f3-4de6-bc04-2e0ab4793b91"}, {"id": "b4f86c8b-0526-46cb-8f50-bd1452b63a5e", "textEn": "You posse coming to the beach?", "textEs": "¿Ustedes vienen a la playa?", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "2a5caec3-d0f3-4de6-bc04-2e0ab4793b91"}, {"id": "fa0525bb-fb64-4d6a-b8fd-878f60f64444", "textEn": "You posse, we need to stick together if we're going to make it through this.", "textEs": "Tú pandilla, tenemos que permanecer unidos si vamos a superar esto.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "2a5caec3-d0f3-4de6-bc04-2e0ab4793b91"}]

flashcards.meaning: ustedes (grupo grande, a veces en evento)
flashcards.native_speech: Used to tell someone they are physically too close or invading personal space, often in a slightly annoyed or warning tone.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "5cc3cbf0-d882-48bb-af12-f8f2cba8987b", "textEn": "You crowd are amazing tonight!", "textEs": "¡Ustedes están increíbles esta noche!", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "8f7e20c2-5caa-4ce6-bc0a-bced83c739ef"}, {"id": "99e8b037-5c37-4fcf-8998-67c4a2ecd3b5", "textEn": "You crowd need to quiet down.", "textEs": "Ustedes necesitan callarse.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "8f7e20c2-5caa-4ce6-bc0a-bced83c739ef"}, {"id": "1707247b-e012-45f5-a389-b1c04444fec3", "textEn": "You crowd my personal space when you stand that close.", "textEs": "Invades mi espacio personal cuando te paras tan cerca.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "8f7e20c2-5caa-4ce6-bc0a-bced83c739ef"}]

flashcards.meaning: ustedes (puede sonar formal o despectivo según contexto)
flashcards.native_speech: Used to address a group, often with a tone of frustration or condescension, as in 'You people need to listen.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "e7de6348-2b86-4521-8e78-866f09c9d139", "textEn": "You people need to understand the rules.", "textEs": "Ustedes necesitan entender las reglas.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "dd629cdd-09ac-49ae-aabe-c64e7a043cf3"}, {"id": "7579e8c3-3dfa-423c-bbe7-885619ad3ed9", "textEn": "I'm talking to you people over there.", "textEs": "Les estoy hablando a ustedes de allá.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "dd629cdd-09ac-49ae-aabe-c64e7a043cf3"}, {"id": "76a70e0f-733c-43a3-8432-8342b0e6a7c1", "textEn": "You people need to stop making assumptions about others.", "textEs": "Ustedes necesitan dejar de hacer suposiciones sobre los demás.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "dd629cdd-09ac-49ae-aabe-c64e7a043cf3"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in casual speech as a contraction of 'going to' to express future intention or prediction, often in informal contexts like 'I'm gonna go now'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "b9b0d01c-9b85-4b28-b562-ff3aad683d8b", "textEn": "I'm gonna grab some coffee after work.", "textEs": "Voy a tomar un café después del trabajo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "82c2b05c-85db-4e43-8f1c-74b8aeb460b9"}, {"id": "35f30dc5-e2b3-4073-8195-9d23a99a6ca1", "textEn": "She's gonna be late again.", "textEs": "Ella va a llegar tarde otra vez.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "82c2b05c-85db-4e43-8f1c-74b8aeb460b9"}, {"id": "139da967-0dd3-4a86-8325-c55da3c3e5b9", "textEn": "We're gonna have a party this weekend.", "textEs": "Vamos a tener una fiesta este fin de semana.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "82c2b05c-85db-4e43-8f1c-74b8aeb460b9"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally to mean 'want to', often in casual conversation to express desire or intention.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "5f817055-9234-4dab-87f3-8ead90df1fac", "textEn": "Do you wanna hang out later?", "textEs": "¿Quieres salir luego?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "858fb309-56e3-4428-a261-89371e6ada27"}, {"id": "aecbc07a-4417-4114-b565-1732b7c5ee32", "textEn": "I don't wanna go to the meeting.", "textEs": "No quiero ir a la reunión.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "858fb309-56e3-4428-a261-89371e6ada27"}, {"id": "dfd6fb40-bd19-4543-a0b8-5e82408b62f5", "textEn": "They wanna see that new movie.", "textEs": "Ellos quieren ver esa nueva película.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "858fb309-56e3-4428-a261-89371e6ada27"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used as a casual, fast way to say 'let me' in everyday conversation, often before a verb like 'lemme see' or 'lemme think'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "4f960a86-5645-424c-9b73-cc20fdb91086", "textEn": "Lemme check my phone real quick.", "textEs": "Déjame revisar mi teléfono rápido.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "6a17e7ac-89c9-46c4-b8e7-ee7bbba3a079"}, {"id": "9c370e3e-aee9-4dcd-a9d2-05b2fe46f5b1", "textEn": "Lemme think about it for a second.", "textEs": "Déjame pensar en eso un segundo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "6a17e7ac-89c9-46c4-b8e7-ee7bbba3a079"}, {"id": "b20ed611-7526-4413-a4df-0a34b9e2a8d7", "textEn": "Lemme help you with that bag.", "textEs": "Déjame ayudarte con esa bolsa.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "6a17e7ac-89c9-46c4-b8e7-ee7bbba3a079"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in casual conversation as a quick, informal way to say 'I don't know,' often when shrugging or showing uncertainty.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "7538802b-a4e6-40d5-8a05-ef901df4272a", "textEn": "I dunno what time the party starts.", "textEs": "No sé a qué hora empieza la fiesta.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "442ecc15-50cc-4673-8471-aa4185a021db"}, {"id": "4290d60b-8501-4cd0-80bc-4808d7798e34", "textEn": "She dunno how to fix the car.", "textEs": "Ella no sabe cómo arreglar el coche.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "442ecc15-50cc-4673-8471-aa4185a021db"}, {"id": "6ce47732-6e76-450e-b818-0dde3a99b807", "textEn": "We dunno if he's coming or not.", "textEs": "No sabemos si él viene o no.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "442ecc15-50cc-4673-8471-aa4185a021db"}]

flashcards.meaning: vamos, por favor (contracción de come on)
flashcards.native_speech: Used as a casual, friendly way to urge someone to do something or to express disbelief or impatience.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "9ac6c9b8-7995-4dbb-a7d7-4203e4afc51a", "textEn": "C'mon, let's go already!", "textEs": "¡Vamos, ya vámonos!", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "39136a47-c16a-41d0-8e3e-056162ba8340"}, {"id": "d66b2e28-bc4e-4642-afe3-f8247a05341b", "textEn": "Oh c'mon, you can't be serious.", "textEs": "Ay vamos, no puede ser en serio.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "39136a47-c16a-41d0-8e3e-056162ba8340"}, {"id": "526d7d4e-442b-48b4-9672-89f9b26f206e", "textEn": "C'mon, give it a try.", "textEs": "Vamos, inténtalo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "39136a47-c16a-41d0-8e3e-056162ba8340"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally to mean 'give me', often in casual or fast speech, like asking for something quickly.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "678adda6-140c-461a-9b3d-843d837ac801", "textEn": "Gimme a minute, I'm almost ready.", "textEs": "Dame un minuto, ya casi estoy listo.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "cf6735d3-490c-45df-a179-7d1478efb4d4"}, {"id": "90b7d700-4bda-432f-8dc6-076b34ae2777", "textEn": "Gimme that remote, please.", "textEs": "Dame ese control remoto, por favor.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "cf6735d3-490c-45df-a179-7d1478efb4d4"}, {"id": "549f2942-2bb8-4e29-9d11-59ddccbb6c2a", "textEn": "Gimme a break, I'm tired.", "textEs": "Dame un descanso, estoy cansado.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "cf6735d3-490c-45df-a179-7d1478efb4d4"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used in casual, fast speech as a contraction of 'out of', often in phrases like 'get outta here' or 'outta my way'.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "4bacd8df-70e3-4ab3-b164-bc94e454e26b", "textEn": "We're outta milk, can you buy some?", "textEs": "No tenemos leche, ¿puedes comprar un poco?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "f4a0c995-41f9-4ba1-8c9e-f4b61a522ae0"}, {"id": "c71a9f03-cfcc-488f-94f6-526ac15ce783", "textEn": "Get outta here, you're joking!", "textEs": "¡Fuera de aquí, estás bromeando!", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "f4a0c995-41f9-4ba1-8c9e-f4b61a522ae0"}, {"id": "231698ea-adc3-46ca-8883-3c55854865ec", "textEn": "I'm outta time, gotta run.", "textEs": "Se me acabó el tiempo, tengo que correr.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "f4a0c995-41f9-4ba1-8c9e-f4b61a522ae0"}]

flashcards.meaning: más o menos, algo así (contracción de sort of)
flashcards.native_speech: Used informally to mean 'kind of' or 'somewhat,' often to soften a statement or express hesitation.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "7e38d56f-4a88-4374-947b-f8991b463217", "textEn": "I'm sorta tired after the workout.", "textEs": "Estoy más o menos cansado después del entrenamiento.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "8bc9a992-751a-435e-a671-32525b9c4a75"}, {"id": "fde8ed21-74e0-44f5-8f6c-664973a31f17", "textEn": "That's sorta what I meant.", "textEs": "Eso es algo así como lo que quise decir.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "8bc9a992-751a-435e-a671-32525b9c4a75"}, {"id": "b54bef7d-38df-49b0-9a2c-0295e0d47dad", "textEn": "She's sorta weird, but cool.", "textEs": "Ella es un poco rara, pero genial.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "8bc9a992-751a-435e-a671-32525b9c4a75"}]

flashcards.meaning: un poco, algo así (contracción de kind of)
flashcards.native_speech: Used as a casual contraction of 'kind of', often to express approximation or uncertainty in informal conversation.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "9e8019c0-2af2-4bf0-8d03-fd0ac1ad18a2", "textEn": "It's kinda cold outside today.", "textEs": "Hace un poco de frío afuera hoy.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "80ff136a-986c-4f2e-aeb1-098277a669e9"}, {"id": "9b427513-7edb-403a-9231-2a8334418210", "textEn": "I kinda like that song.", "textEs": "Me gusta un poco esa canción.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "80ff136a-986c-4f2e-aeb1-098277a669e9"}, {"id": "d4135f56-b641-42eb-845a-b7691bed51c4", "textEn": "He's kinda busy right now.", "textEs": "Él está un poco ocupado ahora mismo.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "80ff136a-986c-4f2e-aeb1-098277a669e9"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to mean 'relax' or 'calm down,' often as an informal command or to describe a laid-back attitude.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "8b9ac1f9-d3ea-46f3-80b1-6f4635b645e4", "textEn": "I'm just gonna chill at home tonight.", "textEs": "Solo me voy a relajar en casa esta noche.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "e46fffd8-8b49-48e9-93ce-4c935a9aacc7"}, {"id": "e8bbe181-406d-428b-bcd0-2e7ef85cc9a2", "textEn": "Chill out, dude, it's not a big deal.", "textEs": "Relájate, amigo, no es para tanto.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "e46fffd8-8b49-48e9-93ce-4c935a9aacc7"}, {"id": "ed725c7a-159d-44f8-a4af-c1e73f631afc", "textEn": "I'm just going to chill at home tonight and watch some movies.", "textEs": "Esta noche solo voy a relajarme en casa y ver algunas películas.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "e46fffd8-8b49-48e9-93ce-4c935a9aacc7"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to describe a sudden loud noise, a collision, or a system failure; also common in tech contexts for software or computer breakdowns.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "3ea18df3-f62a-4f3a-90b8-5f15db477565", "textEn": "Can I crash at your place tonight?", "textEs": "¿Puedo dormir en tu casa esta noche?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "be50eccb-5a2d-4ae6-a170-12ee3e6980f1"}, {"id": "0a7f7006-efde-44c9-98fa-618c13277213", "textEn": "I was so tired I crashed on the couch.", "textEs": "Estaba tan cansado que me dormí en el sofá.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "be50eccb-5a2d-4ae6-a170-12ee3e6980f1"}, {"id": "68584827-f584-4e00-8e11-95373c815b82", "textEn": "I'm so tired, I'm going to crash as soon as I get home.", "textEs": "Estoy tan cansado, me voy a desplomar en cuanto llegue a casa.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "be50eccb-5a2d-4ae6-a170-12ee3e6980f1"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally to mean leaving or escaping a situation, like 'I'm going to bail on the party.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "7ad862b5-2766-4ca9-b99f-0e0eeea5f718", "textEn": "I'm gonna bail on the party, I'm too tired.", "textEs": "Voy a cancelar la fiesta, estoy muy cansado.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "e4087aec-e1ce-402b-8605-9a68e364f9f3"}, {"id": "ff27f210-5e07-48a8-9646-e455d020b7ba", "textEn": "She bailed as soon as things got awkward.", "textEs": "Se fue tan pronto como las cosas se pusieron incómodas.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "e4087aec-e1ce-402b-8605-9a68e364f9f3"}, {"id": "f28e6e41-e9dd-40c6-89ac-349aa1873b68", "textEn": "I tried to bail on the party, but my friend convinced me to stay.", "textEs": "Intenté escabullirme de la fiesta, pero mi amigo me convenció de quedarme.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "e4087aec-e1ce-402b-8605-9a68e364f9f3"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used to refer to points in a game, a musical composition, or to achieve something, often with emphasis on the outcome.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "7877c862-9976-4c87-a3f3-24c75044c3d8", "textEn": "I scored two free tickets to the concert!", "textEs": "¡Conseguí dos boletos gratis para el concierto!", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "04728eaa-85c9-450d-a60d-3759ed3c855a"}, {"id": "21bae9b4-de9c-46e5-98f2-ef63a3042367", "textEn": "He scored a great deal on that car.", "textEs": "Consiguió una gran oferta en ese coche.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "04728eaa-85c9-450d-a60d-3759ed3c855a"}, {"id": "060da3ec-2a53-44d5-ba51-acfe502b3326", "textEn": "I need to score some tickets for the concert tonight.", "textEs": "Necesito conseguir algunos boletos para el concierto de esta noche.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "04728eaa-85c9-450d-a60d-3759ed3c855a"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally to mean 'abandon' or 'get rid of' someone or something, like 'Let's ditch this place' or 'He ditched me.'
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "10c7bd75-5e12-47a3-ab14-ceae6f8edf85", "textEn": "Let's ditch this place and go somewhere else.", "textEs": "Salgamos de aquí y vayamos a otro lado.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "df9dc955-9f9a-4924-b937-914032c92b65"}, {"id": "06f950a4-edd6-4b04-9c67-79d01d368a32", "textEn": "I ditched my old phone for a new one.", "textEs": "Dejé mi teléfono viejo por uno nuevo.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "df9dc955-9f9a-4924-b937-914032c92b65"}, {"id": "d713204f-5096-4029-b6bf-f3a10be7d509", "textEn": "I'm going to ditch the party early because I have an early meeting tomorrow.", "textEs": "Voy a dejar la fiesta temprano porque tengo una reunión mañana temprano.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "df9dc955-9f9a-4924-b937-914032c92b65"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally to mean spending time together casually, often with friends, without a specific plan or activity.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "f8fb1838-753a-409d-8baa-0008e8fb4b86", "textEn": "Wanna hang out at the mall later?", "textEs": "¿Quieres pasar el rato en el centro comercial después?", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "ebb62d7c-3847-4ed8-bd7f-5997885fb73f"}, {"id": "65ffa3a0-7278-46b3-b140-7d9c6e41413f", "textEn": "We hung out all weekend playing video games.", "textEs": "Pasamos todo el fin de semana jugando videojuegos.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "ebb62d7c-3847-4ed8-bd7f-5997885fb73f"}, {"id": "6fdb3551-b1e4-442c-96c4-53fae8d218a4", "textEn": "Do you want to hang out at the mall this weekend?", "textEs": "¿Quieres pasar el rato en el centro comercial este fin de semana?", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "ebb62d7c-3847-4ed8-bd7f-5997885fb73f"}]

flashcards.native_speech: Used informally to mean making a mistake or failing at something, often with a sense of frustration or self-blame.
flashcards.examples: [{"id": "10c401e2-8a03-4ce2-860d-b055c1ebf05c", "textEn": "I really screwed up the recipe; it tastes awful.", "textEs": "Arruiné la receta; sabe horrible.", "position": 1, "flashcardId": "139deed6-4413-4da5-b94f-0948f564b325"}, {"id": "13e6b544-1c8f-4c50-8d67-52d8146633cd", "textEn": "He screwed up his chances by arriving late.", "textEs": "Arruinó sus oportunidades al llegar tarde.", "position": 2, "flashcardId": "139deed6-4413-4da5-b94f-0948f564b325"}, {"id": "848963ea-8063-40bb-92d8-6d231e363567", "textEn": "I totally screwed up the presentation by forgetting the key slides.", "textEs": "Arruiné completamente la presentación al olvidar las diapositivas clave.", "position": 3, "flashcardId": "139deed6-4413-4da5-b94f-0948f564b325"}]
